t: All GTA 6 Cheats: Full List of 61 Codes and How to Unlock Each One
r: GTA 6 has 61 cheats for PS5 and Xbox: money, ammo, armor, wanted level, weather, vehicles and screen filters. Here is every known sequence and the challenge that unlocks it.

l: GTA 6 has 61 cheats for PS5 and Xbox Series X · S. But they don't work from the start: first you have to beat the main story, and then each cheat unlocks with its own challenge. Below is the full list, with the button sequence for each one (when it has been published) and what you need to do to unlock it.

The list comes from GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer, who played until they unlocked the cheats, plus the sequences Bubs showed on YouTube. When the same sequence shows up in two of them, the cheat is marked confirmed on its own page.
Beat the main story (91 missions, according to PC Gamer).
In the pause menu, go to the Progress tab. A Cheats option appears there, with what you have already unlocked.
In the game, press Up on the D-pad to open your phone.
Hold L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox) and enter the sequence on the D-pad.
Heads up: using any cheat turns off trophies, achievements and saving until you quit the game. Save first. Full walkthrough in how to use cheats in GTA 6.

Where it says "GamesRadar+ only", the sequence came from a single source. It becomes confirmed when another source shows the same one.

Before launch, a "GTA 6 cheat list" with a jetpack, a tank and PlayStation face buttons like circle and triangle went viral. It is made of GTA 5 and San Andreas codes. Real GTA 6 cheats use only the D-pad.
How many cheats are in GTA 6? 61: 10 player cheats, 11 combat, 3 environment, 21 vehicle spawns and 16 screen filters, according to GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer.
How do you unlock cheats in GTA 6? Beat the main story first. Then each cheat unlocks with its own challenge, like winning medals at shooting ranges or finding collectibles.
Is there a money cheat in GTA 6? Just one: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up, Left, Down, Right. It gives $250,000 and unlocks when you beat the story.
Is there a tank cheat in GTA 6? Yes, the Hauners Rhino Tank, unlocked by completing all survival challenges. Its sequence has not been published yet.
Is there a jetpack cheat in GTA 6? No. The official list of 61 cheats has no jetpack. Viral lists with a jetpack are recycled GTA San Andreas codes.
Can you save after using a cheat in GTA 6? No. Using a cheat turns off saving, trophies and achievements until you quit the game.

t: GTA 6 Dexter's Apartment: Where to Find Dexter Morgan's Building in Vice City
r: GTA 6 recreates Dexter Morgan's apartment building from the Dexter TV series in Vice City. Here's where it is on the map, which door is his and the other nods to the show nearby.

l: GTA 6 has Dexter Morgan's apartment building from the Dexter TV series in Vice City. It's on Washington Island, in the east of the city. His door is locked, but the outdoor hallway matches the end of the show's opening sequence. GameSpot and IGN both show it.
On the map, go to Washington Island, in eastern Vice City, east by northeast of Penmarch Isle.
Find the Pay 'n' Spray and Vice Beach Top Fun Drones icons.
Between them is a small light blue building with a cylinder on its south side, between a bigger building with a rectangle on its roof and a smaller apartment complex.
The cylinder is a staircase. Take it to the second floor and head west along the outdoor hallway, with apartments on your left.
Dexter's is the last one on the row, a corner unit with a water view.
According to GameSpot:
The building is called Trinity Apartments, a nod to the Trinity Killer from Season 4.
On the roof you'll find Dexter's tools: a knife, tape, a syringe, a plastic bag and rope, according to IGN.
A boat docked out front looks a lot like Dexter's Slice of Life. You can take it.
IGN found one more nod, away from the apartment: a plastic-wrapped room like Dexter's, in the garage of a house on the Key Lento coast.
Take a boat to the coastal house IGN shows.
You can go inside, but an armed man doesn't like visitors. Take him down.
The house has weapons: a sniper rifle, body armor and a rocket launcher in the bathtub.
If you were loud, leave and wait for the cops to go. Then come back and break into the garage: the plastic room is inside, with tools and bags.
GTA 6 Easter eggs list

Where is Dexter's apartment in GTA 6? On Washington Island in eastern Vice City, between the Pay 'n' Spray and the Vice Beach Top Fun Drones icons. It's a small light blue building with a round staircase on its south side.
Can you go inside Dexter's apartment in GTA 6? No, according to GameSpot. The door is locked, but you can walk the outdoor hallway from the show's opening.

t: GTA 6 Assassin Nipper .38 and Smuggler Gorse 425 Locations
r: Both legendary guns sit in shipwrecks on the small islands near Mile Zero Air Station in Mariana County. You can grab them early without a fight.

l: The Assassin Nipper .38 and the Smuggler Gorse 425 are in two shipwrecks on the small Mariana County islands near Mile Zero Air Station. You can take both early on without a fight. Arekkz Gaming and Vexies showed the same spots, and both weapon names come from their voiceovers.
By helicopter: follow the edge of Key Lento round to Southwind. Vexies found a free helicopter on the pad there.
By boat: it's a small island group, so a boat or a swim works too, as Arekkz points out.
Stay out of the airspace over the military base or you'll pick up a wanted level.
Head for the tip of the pointy islet at the south end of the group. Vexies counts the islands on the map and stops at the bottom of the fourth.
Look for the abandoned boat, which the WAiNK app labels a derelict spy vessel.
Walk all the way inside and use the prompt to open the hatch.
Take the pistol. Arekkz says the magazine holds about 8 rounds.
It's a great early stealth gun: Arekkz notes a suppressor alone costs close to $1,000 in stores.
Move up to the island with a strip of sand between two green areas.
Land on the sand and walk to the north side.
Find the small wrecked boat. This one can't be scanned with WAiNK.
The shotgun is glowing in plain sight by the boat.
In Vexies' video it has 7.5 damage, against 7.4 for the regular shotguns they compare it with. Arekkz says it fires almost like a semi-auto.
Both are unique variants, so a lost copy comes back from the Ammu-Nation weapon locker. See how to store weapons in your trunk and all the legendary and unique weapon locations.
Where is the Assassin Nipper .38 in GTA 6? In a hidden compartment inside the wreck at the tip of the southern islet, in the island group near Mile Zero Air Station.
Where is the Smuggler Gorse 425? At the wreck on the island with the sandy strip, north of the pistol. The shotgun is out in the open.
Do you need story progress? No. Vexies says no missions are needed, and Arekkz grabbed both as Jason early in the game.

t: How to Use Cheats in GTA 6 on PS5 and Xbox (and Why They Don't Work)
r: GTA 6 cheats only work after you beat the story. Each one unlocks with a challenge, and you enter it on the in-game phone while holding L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox).

l: GTA 6 has cheats, but they work very differently from older GTA games. No cheat works until you beat the main story. After that, each cheat still has to be unlocked with its own challenge. Only then can you enter the sequence on your character's phone.
Every cheat, its sequence and its unlock challenge are in the full list of all GTA 6 cheats.
According to PC Gamer, that's 91 main missions. They loaded a mid-story save to test it and the cheats didn't work. Knowing the sequence early does nothing.

Once the story is done, a new option shows up in the pause menu: go to the Progress tab (press R1 on PS5 or RB on Xbox to get there) and open Cheats. It lists the cheats you've unlocked and the challenge for the rest. What you did during the story counts.
Some examples:
Money ($250,000), unlimited focus and attack force: unlocked when you beat the story.
Body armor: complete 100 workouts.
Max ammo, infinite ammo and no reload: 25 bronze, silver and gold medals at shooting ranges.
Cycle weather: reveal the whole map.
Raise heat level: lose a 3-star wanted level 25 times.
Press Up on the D-pad to open your phone.
Hold L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox).
Without letting go, enter the sequence on the D-pad.
Sequences only use Up, Down, Left and Right, so they're the same on PS5 and Xbox.

p.h: What happens when you use one
l: Trophies and achievements are disabled until you quit the game.
Saving is disabled too. To save again you have to quit without saving. That's why PC Gamer warns you can't use cheats to breeze through side missions or challenges.
Save your game before trying anything.
61, according to GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer:
10 player cheats (money, focus, armor, wanted level and more)
11 combat cheats (ammo, explosives, attack force)
3 environment cheats (weather and time of day)
21 vehicle spawns (cars, bikes, boats, planes and a tank)
16 screen filters (visual only)
Many sequences haven't been published yet, because outlets are unlocking cheats as they go. The full list is updated every round.
A viral "GTA 6 cheat list" with buttons like square, circle, L2 and R2 is made of GTA 5 and San Andreas codes. Real GTA 6 cheats only use the D-pad and the in-game phone.
How do you enter cheats in GTA 6? Press Up on the D-pad to open your phone, hold L1 and R1 (LB and RB on Xbox) and enter the sequence on the D-pad.
Why are my GTA 6 cheats not working? Almost always because you haven't finished the story. No cheat works before that. After that, each cheat also has to be unlocked with its own challenge.
Do cheats disable trophies in GTA 6? Yes. They also disable saving until you quit the game, according to GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer. Save before you use one.
Are GTA 6 cheats the same on PS5 and Xbox? Yes. The sequences only use the D-pad, so they're identical. Only the shoulder buttons you hold change: L1 and R1 on PS5, LB and RB on Xbox.

Only five things require full completion: robberies (gang operations, banks, Payday Loans and bank vaults), all 33 underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's 15 hunting quests. Everything else only needs part of the total.

p.h: What to do during the story to save time
l: Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app: hold the phone button, then the scan button. Boats and aircraft count too. Start early and the 200 come naturally.
Study animals with binoculars: pick the binoculars from the weapon wheel, zoom in and hold to study. No hunting needed. Every dog and cat breed counts separately.

Do optional missions as they appear. They have purple icons or black icons with pink letters. Each car delivery for Moses and Randy counts as one, and meditating as both Jason and Lucia at the same spot counts as two.

How do you get the Snap Gun in GTA 6? It unlocks in Chapter 3, in the Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs mission. Hand the first item to Yasmani and he gives you the Snap Gun, which opens doors without setting off the alarm.
How do you get the Key Cloner in GTA 6? In Chapter 3, in the mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy. It lets you steal sports cars that have an advanced tracker.
Where do you get the Dye Pack Jammer in GTA 6? It unlocks in Chapter 3, in the Credit Check mission with Raul's crew. It stops dye packs from ruining the cash you take from banks and ATMs.

Do you need to equip your equipment in GTA 6? No. It's always on you. You pick some items from the item wheel, next to your weapons, and others kick in on their own when you use something in the world.

t: What to Do Before Finishing Chapter 3 in GTA 6: Missable Weapons, Cars and Missions
r: Before you wrap up Chapter 3, grab the golden Monty's 1922, don't turn Halifax down for good, run the Yago race before it expires and claim the pink Growler. Here's what you lose and what stays.

l: Before finishing Chapter 3 in GTA 6, check four things:
grab the golden Monty's 1922 pistol;
don't leave Halifax's mission behind;
run the Race Against Yago before it expires;
claim the pink Growler in the La Perle garage.
This list only includes what two or more channels show. Anything only one channel mentions is flagged. Make a separate save before the chapter's final mission.

In a Chapter 3 mission, a photo shoot ends abruptly and a shootout starts. Once you leave the room, go back in: Monty's 1922, a gold, engraved pistol, is on the floor. It's a unique variant and can't be modded.
Caspahz and RageGamingVideos show the same gun. Caspahz names the mission The Missing Link. Move on without it and it's gone.

p.h: 2. Don’t turn Halifax down for good
l: In Dubious Providence, the second Chapter 3 story mission, Halifax wants your statue at an antique shop in Capri and offers a watch in exchange.
If you refuse, the mission goes away. But you can call him back as long as Chapter 3 isn't over, according to KhrazeGaming. Caspahz says to keep calling until Jason and Lucia decide to go find him.
If you finish the chapter without calling, it's gone for good, along with what it gives you.
The reward, per KhrazeGaming: cash, the Crowax watch and a Vapid Hustler, a hot rod with an exposed engine.
When the game asks whether you trust him, Caspahz says to trust him. More on Benedict Halifax.

p.h: 3. Race Against Yago has a deadline
l: Yago has a chain of 4 races: Join a Street Race, the mentoring, Race Against Yago and Brother to Brother. Race Against Yago shows an hourglass on the map: if time runs out, it's gone. Caspahz and KhrazeGaming both warn about it.

According to KhrazeGaming, finishing all four leaves you with Yago's race car, styled after the Nissan Skyline, which disappears once you reach Chapter 4. Only he mentions the car. Yago's questline also counts for Strangers & Freaks.

p.h: 4. The pink Growler and the free garage
l: In the Chapter 3 apartment, the laptop opens with Muffins, Queen, 15 and gives you the code 92665 for a garage in La Perle, next to Auntie's Place. Inside is Vanessa's pink Growler, with no tracker, and the garage becomes yours. Diggy, KhrazeGaming and Tylarious all show it, and Diggy says to do it before Chapter 3 ends. Full steps in the Chapter 3 laptop password.
Safe Word mission: if you give up on the practice vault, Caspahz says you can come back later and open it for cash and a weapon.
Mercenary LMG 6: Caspahz grabs a unique machine gun from a yellow container during the lock-cutting mission. RageGamingVideos got the same gun later in free roam, so it may not be missable.
Apartment parking spots: Caspahz recommends registering or selling any cars parked there before the chapter ends.

t: GTA 6 Bowling Alley Safe Code: 0300 (Kingpin Bowling)

The alley is the target of Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, though PC Gamer notes you can hit it earlier as Lucia on her own.
It isn't in the bowling alley. The notepad by the safe points you to Brooks Boatworks, another Kolt & Associates hideout in northwest Port Gellhorn.

Climb the stairs.

t: GTA 6 Brooks Boatworks Safe Code: 6823 (Port Gellhorn)
r: The Brooks Boatworks safe code in GTA 6 is 6823. See where the wall map with the codes hangs, where the safe is and where to pick up the Clunker 556 rifle.

l: The Brooks Boatworks safe code in GTA 6 is 6823. ConCon finds the number on a wall map and opens the safe with it, and RaidAway opens the same safe with 6-8-2-3 in his own game.

It's the Kolt & Associates boatyard in Port Gellhorn, on the bay right by the bridge. On the map it's flagged as a robbery opportunity, and the card ConCon pulls up says the gang moves prescription meds through the docks. Security is high and the estimated take is $5,300 to $7,900. ConCon says it's a Chapter 2 job, and by then the boatyard is already marked on your map.
ConCon grabs the code without firing a shot. Bring a silenced pistol anyway, in case someone spots you.
Skip the main entrance on the left: the guards there will stop and question you. Go around to the right side instead.
Park near the blue tarp fence next to the shed with the "Port Gellhorn" sign and hop it.
Stay crouched, cut through the brush and squeeze through the gap in the next fence.
Hug the fence on your right so the armed guard doesn't notice you.
Slip into the small building with outside stairs and climb up to the office full of monitors.
Check the Port Gellhorn map on the wall, next to the whiteboard.

Three numbers are scrawled on it: 6823 (Brooks Boatworks), 6969 (La Cascara Motel) and 0300 (Kingpin Bowling). Examining the map updates your game map, so the Brooks Boatworks card now reads "Safe code: 6823", and the number is saved to your Notes in the corner of the screen.
RaidAway got the same 6823 another way: he found it while robbing a different warehouse run by the gang, before heading to the boatyard.

p.h: Grab the rifle while you’re there
l: In that same office, ConCon picks up the unique Clunker 556 assault rifle from a table. See more legendary and unique weapons.
ConCon says the boatyard has two safes. One is small and easy to break into without a code. The big one, the one that asks for 6823, is in the big warehouse:
Head for the big warehouse in the yard and expect plenty of armed guards. ConCon found it too hard to sneak through and shot his way in.
Go in, keep left and take the stairs to the upper floor.
The safe sits in a small room covered in posters. Interact with it and choose Enter Code. There's also an option to plant an explosive.
Enter 6823 and take the cash. In ConCon's video the safe held about $2,400.
Close by there's a pool table with pills on it.
RaidAway went upstairs too and found cash, pills and the safe. Around the yard he also picked up a gold weapon and a sticky bomb.

Both players escape by boat from the dock, and ConCon recommends heading out to sea. On the way in, RaidAway even dove into the water and swam to stay out of sight of the crew on a boat, and the cops were closing in as he left. Pills can be sold, as covered in fence locations.
For other robberies, read how safe codes work.
What is the Brooks Boatworks safe code in GTA 6? It's 6823. ConCon and RaidAway both opened the safe with it in their own playthroughs.

Where is the Brooks Boatworks safe code written? On the Port Gellhorn map pinned up in the office at the top of the outside stairs of the small building, near the right-hand fence. The same map lists 6969 for La Cascara Motel and 0300 for the bowling alley.
Where is the safe at Brooks Boatworks? Upstairs in the big warehouse, in a small room plastered with posters. There's a pool table with pills on it close by.
How much is the Brooks Boatworks robbery worth? The in-game map puts the whole take at $5,300 to $7,900. In ConCon's run, the safe alone paid out around $2,400.

t: GTA 6 Chapter 3 Laptop Password: Muffins, Queen, 15 (Free Garage and Pink Growler)
r: The Chapter 3 laptop password in GTA 6 is Muffins, Queen, 15. See where the clues are, what the 92665 code opens in La Perle and how to claim Vanessa's pink Growler.

l: The Chapter 3 laptop password in GTA 6 is Muffins, Queen, 15. You don't type it in: you pick each part, in that order, from options mapped to the D-pad. Both ConCon and SimDEX log in this way. Once you're in, a message hands you the code 92665, which opens a lock-up in La Perle holding a free pink car, Vanessa's Growler.

It's in apartment 201 in Bayside, the new place you move into early in Chapter 3. The laptop sits in the bedroom. SimDEX calls it Boobie's laptop, but the chats inside belong to Vanessa, the woman who lived there before you.
They're all inside the apartment, so check each one before you sit down at the laptop.
Muffins: in the hallway, by the front door, there's a small pink picture frame with a photo of a dog named Muffins.
Queen: in the bedroom, near the bed, a notepad sketch shows the same dog wearing a crown and sitting like royalty.
15: flip the notepad over. The back mentions a Class of '15 reunion next Friday.
In the bedroom, press Triangle (Y on Xbox) at the laptop.
Pick Muffins on the D-pad. The other choices look similar, such as Fluffy and Pawprints. ConCon warns that the direction may not match his, so read the label before you press.
Next, pick Queen. The alternatives are King and Princess.
Finally, pick 15.
SimDEX points out that snooping through the laptop has no negative consequences.

Inside, open the WhatUp messages and look for the Unknown contact. They tell Vanessa to go to La Perle, right next to Auntie's Place, and use 92665 to collect a gift. When you close the laptop, the game saves the number to your notes.
Head to La Perle in Vice City.
Find Auntie's Place. The lock-up is right beside it.
Look for the garage door with a pink bow painted on the wall and a "Do Not Park Here" sign. The keypad is there.
Enter 92665.
Inside is Vanessa's pink Pfister Growler. ConCon also shares a map tip: buildings shown in dark blue are the ones you can enter.

In ConCon's game, the notice was clear: Vanessa's Growler became an owned vehicle, and the garage unlocked too. He adds that the garage reportedly disappears if you sell the Growler. Since you can only have one active personal vehicle, your previous ride gets sent to another garage. See the other garage locations and prices.
ConCon says this is reportedly missable, so grab it while you're still in Chapter 3, before you move on with the story.
For other locked boxes, read how safe codes work.
What is the Chapter 3 laptop password in GTA 6? It's Muffins, Queen, 15. You pick the three parts in that order with the D-pad rather than typing them.

Where are the laptop password clues? All in the apartment: the framed photo of Muffins the dog in the hallway, the notepad sketch of the dog wearing a crown in the bedroom, and the back of that notepad, which mentions the Class of '15.
What does the 92665 code open in GTA 6? A lock-up garage in La Perle, right next to Auntie's Place. Inside is Vanessa's pink Growler, which becomes yours.
Is the laptop car missable? ConCon says it's reportedly missable, so grab it while you're still in Chapter 3.
The chat on the apartment laptop, with the message about La Perle.
Vice City, home to the Chapter 3 apartment and La Perle, in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games. It shows the city, not the laptop.

t: GTA 6 La Cascara Motel Safe Code: 6969 (Port Gellhorn)
r: The La Cascara Motel safe code in GTA 6 is 6969. See where the code is written, how to reach the safe at the top of the motel and where to grab the Scrapper VF5C SMG.

l: The La Cascara Motel safe code in GTA 6 is 6969. It worked for GosuNoob, WoW Quests, Accelerated Ideas and ConCon, each in their own game, so you can punch it in straight away. Inside you'll find cash and a big haul of pills.

p.h: Where the motel is and when it shows up
l: La Cascara sits on the waterfront in Port Gellhorn, close to the bridge. It's one of the hideouts run by the Kolt & Associates gang, described on the map as an old, crumbling motel that's heavily guarded.
ConCon and Accelerated Ideas both place the robbery in Chapter 2. ConCon adds that the motel only appears on your map once Lucia calls and tells you to hit it.

You won't find the number at the motel. It's on the Port Gellhorn map hanging on the office wall at Brooks Boatworks, next to a whiteboard. In ConCon's video you can read 6969 scribbled by the motel, along with 6823 for Brooks Boatworks itself and 0300 for the bowling alley. Once you've looked at the map, the game remembers the codes.
There's no need to make that trip just for this safe. If you want the other two codes, see the Brooks Boatworks safe code and the bowling alley safe code.
The safe is up on the roof, inside a small house built on top of the motel. Here's ConCon's route:
Bring a silenced pistol. Every floor has armed gang members, and you'll often hear them talking before you see them.
Slip in from the lower end of the street and work your way up the left side of the building, crouched.
Break the gate blocking the way to the top, then follow the burnt-out walkway past the generators.
On the top floor there's a GLR40 grenade launcher on a low table if you want it.
Head into the rooftop house. There's another weapon in there, plus sticky bombs.
The safe is in a small room with yellow, graffiti-covered walls. Interact with it and enter 6969.
Accelerated Ideas follows the same path to the top floor. GosuNoob made it through unseen and picked up a Stealth Bonus when the safe opened.
If you don't have the number, ConCon notes that the sticky bombs in the rooftop house will open the safe for you.

p.h: Don’t leave without the Scrapper VF5C
l: The unique Scrapper VF5C, a compact military SMG, is lying on a desk in the rooftop house, close to the safe. GosuNoob grabs it right after opening the safe, and ConCon picks it up in the same spot. If you're already carrying too many guns, do what ConCon does: hold right on the D-pad, switch to Lucia and have her pick it up. See more legendary and unique weapons.
There's so much loot here that you'll end up with a second bag. Hold right on the D-pad and press Circle (B on Xbox) next to Lucia to hand it over.

To leave, ConCon drops down on the right side and drives off with Lucia. Accelerated Ideas warns that you should expect to shake off the cops afterwards. Any pills you take can be sold, as covered in fence locations.
For other robberies, read how safe codes work.
What is the La Cascara Motel safe code in GTA 6? It's 6969. Four different channels opened the safe with that number in their own playthroughs.
Where is the safe in the La Cascara Motel? On the roof, inside a small house built on top of the motel, in a room with yellow, graffiti-covered walls. Work your way up the left side of the building.
Where is the La Cascara code written down? On the Port Gellhorn map pinned to the office wall at Brooks Boatworks, another hideout of the same gang. 6969 is scrawled next to the motel.
Can you open the La Cascara safe without the code? Yes. ConCon points out sticky bombs inside the rooftop house, close to the safe, so you can blow the door.
Inside the La Cascara Motel during a stealth robbery.
Port Gellhorn, home of the La Cascara Motel, in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games. It shows the area, not the motel itself.

t: GTA 6 Moses Drop-Off Locations: All 7 Cars and the Secret Sultan Reward
r: In Chapter 2, Moses asks for 7 cars that never show on the map. Here's where each one is, how to sell to him without wasting money and the fully customized car he gives you at the end.

l: In Chapter 2, Moses, who runs a garage in Port Gellhorn, asks you to steal 7 cars for him. The catch: none of them show on your map. Finish the list and he hands you a fully customized car.
The locations come from Mislead, in a TikTok video with over 500,000 views. That's one source for the locations so far, so this page is unverified. The selling tips come from Vice Clips.
Car · Where it is
Declasse Yosemite 1500 · West side of Port Gellhorn, next to a small inlet. It may be getting towed: just get in anyway.
Annis Hellion 95 · Far south of Port Gellhorn, in front of an L-shaped house.
Canis Crawler 82 · The roundabout in north Port Gellhorn. It's the first one the game sends you after, and it counts.
Karin Futo 85 · Draper Island, next to Port Gellhorn, inside the long building on the south end. Sometimes there are armed guards.
Declasse Vamos · Grayson, Lummox County, among the small houses on the far right: a single garage at a run-down spot covered in stop signs. The garage is locked.
Western Nightblade · Ambrosia, inside the bikers' warehouse, with plenty of armed guys around.
BF Bandito · Buckskin Swamp. A group of rednecks may be driving it around, so you might have to chase it down and take it.
Car not there? If the purple marker doesn't appear when you get close, you still need to wait for Moses' next text. He unlocks the requests a few at a time.
Lost a car or got arrested with it? It ends up in the Port Gellhorn impound lot (or another impound marked on the map). Steal it back and deliver it anyway.
According to Mislead, once all 7 are delivered, go back to his garage and head to the door on the right. Moses lets you open it, and inside is a fully customized Sultan for you to keep.
Vice Clips sums up the rules: low-key cars only, no trackers, and sleep at a safehouse to skip his cooldown between sales.
They also found four cars around Port Gellhorn worth over $20,000 to Moses in one go:
Car · Max value in the video
Orange Caracara in a gang compound · $5,855
Caracara behind a broken fence (shoot the gate switch to drive it out) · $6,490
Firebug Dominator, the most valuable · $7,205
Chino, nobody guarding it · $2,850
Even shot up, the cars sold close to their max.
How to sell cars in GTA 6, including registration and your free first one
Randy's rare car list, the Chapter 3 buyer

Where are Moses' cars in GTA 6? Around Port Gellhorn and up north: the Yosemite 1500 being towed on Port Gellhorn's west side, the Hellion 95 in the south, the Crawler 82 at the north roundabout, the Futo 85 on Draper Island, the Vamos in a Grayson garage, the Nightblade in an Ambrosia biker warehouse and the Bandito in Buckskin Swamp.

What do you get for finishing Moses' drop-offs? According to Mislead, once all 7 are delivered you go back to his shop and open the door on the right: a fully customized Sultan is waiting for you to keep.
Does Moses buy cars with trackers? No. Stick to low-key cars with no tracker, and sleep at a safehouse to skip his cooldown between sales.
The WAiNK scanner showing a car's lock, alarm, tracker and sell value.
Port Gellhorn, home of Moses' garage. This image is for illustration.

t: GTA 6 Platinum Trophy Guide: Roadmap, Time, Difficulty and the Trophies You Can Get Now
r: The GTA 6 platinum takes about 200 hours, rates 4 out of 10 in difficulty and has no missable trophies. Here's the 3-step roadmap and the quick ones: cocktail, tank, plane, Banshee and more.

l: The GTA 6 platinum takes about 200 hours and rates 4 out of 10 in difficulty, according to PowerPyx. There are 55 trophies, all in story mode, and none are missable: anything you skip can be done after the ending, in the open world.
The roadmap comes from PowerPyx. The quick trophies match GTA6 Drops' video.
Item · According to PowerPyx
Difficulty · 4 out of 10
Time · About 200 hours
Trophies · 55 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze)
Missable · None
Online · No trophies
Does the difficulty setting matter? · No: the game has a single difficulty
Cheats · Turn off trophies and saving for that session
Hardest · A Long Road (100% completion)
Saves · 15 manual and 1 autosave
Save tip: since you can't replay missions, PowerPyx suggests keeping a save at the start and end of each chapter, and rotating the other slots during the final cleanup.
Story, no rush (60 to 80 hours). Do side missions as they come up, scan every new vehicle with WAiNK and study animals with your binoculars. That gets you ahead on 100%.

The 100% checklist (about 100 hours). The list shows up under Progress after the ending. See everything that counts toward 100%. You need 70 of the 80 challenges, so you can skip the most annoying ones.
Cleanup (about 10 hours). Stranger missions don't count toward 100%, but they have a trophy. See the 8 that count in Strangers & Freaks.
These are quick and don't depend on finishing the story:
Trophy · How to get it
In The Beginning... · At the rooftop bar of the Ocean View in Ocean Beach, order an Apple Martini and drink it. GTA6 Drops says to take the drink to the railing and look out at the view
Challenging Tank · Steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station, the island in the southwest of the map. The tanks are in the south of the base
Catch Me If You Can · At Vice City airport, get in the big plane parked at terminal E3/E4, reverse onto the runway, take off and fly about 1 km away
The Goodtime State · Clear the fog from the whole map. A plane is the fastest way
The Truth Is Out There · Late at night, find the car with flashing lights and follow the trail to the UFO. See the abduction
Capital Offense · With the Key Cloner (Chapter 3), steal the blue Banshee from the dealership in south Vice City and drive out through the showroom window
Sneakthief · After Yasmani's jewelry jobs, rob a jewelry store through the back with the Snap Gun without being seen. Do it before Retail Therapy
Retail Therapy · Rob 3 stores in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level. See the Retail Therapy guide
Let's Go Bowling · At Kingpin Bowling, grab the 3 valuables: the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe (code 0300). See the bowling alley safe code
Ten Pin · On a motorcycle, knock down 10 pedestrians with kicks within 60 seconds. Do it somewhere busy, like Ocean Beach
Bad Luck, I Guess · After the Credit Check mission (Chapter 3), go back with Lucia alone to the Payday Loans in Little Cuba, rob it again and escape on foot

Personal Best: reach strength level 4 with both Jason and Lucia. If you train together, your partner gains too. Jojo Gaming Guides shows that in Chapter 5 the new house has a gym: work out, drink the protein shake from the fridge, sleep and repeat.

The Shootist: gold in every shooting range challenge. According to GTA6 Drops, there are two ranges: Griffin Shooting Range in northwest Vice City and Rogers Ranch in northeast Port Gellhorn. A pass costs $5. There are 12 challenges and 42 medals.
Gunslinger: take down 5 enemies in a single use of combat Focus. Eat or shower first to fill your Focus, use adrenaline and a rifle, and look for big groups in gang operations.
Hot Together: lose 4 stars with your partner. PowerPyx points to the train tunnel north of Ambrosia. It can also pop on its own during the bank vaults in Chapter 4.
Full list of all 55 trophies
All GTA 6 cheats, but remember they turn off trophies
All GTA 6 equipment and when it unlocks
How long does the GTA 6 platinum take? About 200 hours, according to PowerPyx: 60 to 80 hours for the story, around 100 hours for 100% completion and about 10 more for cleanup.
Is the GTA 6 platinum hard? PowerPyx rates it 4 out of 10. The most work is A Long Road, the 100% completion trophy.
Are there missable trophies in GTA 6? No. According to PowerPyx, no trophy is missable, and everything is still available after the story.
Do cheats disable trophies in GTA 6? Yes. With a cheat active, the game doesn't award trophies and doesn't save during that session.
Do you need to play online for the GTA 6 platinum? No. All 55 trophies are in story mode.
Lucia robbing the Payday Loans again for the Bad Luck, I Guess trophy.

t: GTA 6 Vice City Portal Easter Egg: How to Visit 2002 Vice City
r: GTA 6 hides a portal that sends Jason to the PS2-era Malibu Club. Here's the tower, the 12 substations and which switch to hit, the power plant hours and the rewards.

l: GTA 6 has a hidden portal that drops Jason into the 2002, PS2-era version of Vice City. You land in the original Malibu Club, blocky graphics and all, and come home with Tommy Vercetti's blue Hawaiian shirt and a chopper motorcycle. Kotaku credits creator Memeio with figuring it out.

Fair warning: it's a long one. You power up a tower in the south, hit a switch at 12 electrical substations in a set order, then head to a power plant between 7 p.m. and 6 a.m. Kotaku's writer needed about 30 minutes of flying with Memeio's guide. Dan Allen Gaming says to set aside an hour.
Save first. Dan Allen Gaming saves right before the tower.
Grab a helicopter. By car, every leg takes several minutes. Dan Allen thinks there are a couple of helis in the bottom left of the map.
No fast travel. The 12 substations have to be done in one sitting.
Don't die. Dan Allen stresses this near the end, and Misleading has a whole section on dying and fast travel (5:12).
Tommy's blue shirt from Vice City (Kotaku).
A chopper modeled on the American-flag bike Tommy gets early in the 2002 game (Kotaku). TmarTn2 lists it as the Malibu Zombie Bobber.
A phone call from Kent Paul afterward, according to the TmarTn2 (17:42) and Misleading (7:54) chapters.

p.h: Step 1: the tower in the south
l: It starts at a tower in the southern part of the map. Misleading calls it the radio tower.
Check the poster. It references "Life Is Passing Me By", the PC cheat that sped up the clock in the original game.
Pull the lever, then press the button. A short sound from Vice City plays.
When the TV shows the Malibu, the easter egg is live (Dan Allen Gaming).

Each substation has an LPL sign and is often fenced in. Letters are painted on each one, and together they spell LIFE IS PASSING ME BY. Visit them in the order that spells the phrase and hit one switch on the panel at each.

The panels are marked W, A, D and a dot. The right one follows the old PS2 cheat: Dan Allen points out that D stands for Circle, and the cheat opened with Circle, Circle. Hit the wrong switch or go out of order and you have to start over, he warns.
# · Switch (Dan Allen) · Where, per Dan Allen · Dan Allen · TmarTn2 · Misleading
1 · D · Shown on the map only · 1:14 · 2:20 · 0:39
2 · D · Shown on the map only · 1:33 · 3:29 · 1:28
3 · Dot · Shown on the map only · 2:25 · 4:34 · 2:07
4 · A · Shown on the map only · 2:53 · 5:19 · 2:19
5 · Dot · Shown on the map only · 3:31 · 6:27 · 2:34
6 · A · Shown on the map only · 3:56 · 7:11 · 2:56
7 · A · East side of Hamlet: through the gates, behind the power lines · 4:10 · 8:04 · 3:11
8 · A · Shown on the map only · 4:35 · 8:49 · 3:29
9 · Dot · West side of Hamlet · 4:59 · 10:55 · 3:54
10 · Not called out · Far top left of the map · 5:27 · 11:30 · 4:16
11 · D · Back in Hamlet; the switches sit very close together · 5:57 · 12:04 · 4:33
12 · W · Shown on the map only · 6:18 · 13:05 · 4:50

Dan Allen doesn't say which switch he hits at the 10th stop, so pause his video at 5:27 and check before you press anything. Spot names come from auto-generated captions, so use the timestamps to see each location on the map.
The cops can get involved, too. Kotaku's writer picked up a wanted level along the way and lost it by hiding in a dumpster.

Hit the 12th switch and a text from "Unknown" arrives: "Reactor 2 1906." Dan Allen reads it as Reactor 2 at the power plant, from 7 p.m. to 6 a.m. The portal won't open during the day. If the text came through, you've done it: you can save and go whenever you like.
Wait for night. Dan Allen showed up around 10 p.m.
Fly in by helicopter and parachute down onto the plant so you don't get spotted. That was the easiest way he found.
Behind a metal door you'll find a huge pink portal. Step through and a cutscene takes over.
Jason ends up in the Malibu Club from the original game, with PS2-style animation.
You can dance on the floor.
You can try to order a drink. Kotaku found Jason can't hold the glass, since PS2-era hands had no fingers, so he spills it.
Head up the back stairs to find Kent Paul. Before you can chat, a new portal pulls Jason back to 2026.
Back in the present, the shirt and the bike are yours (TmarTn2 16:53, Misleading 7:27).

p.h: Same tower: the man who won’t die
l: According to GameSpot, the radio tower from Step 1 hides another secret. Only GameSpot has shown it so far, so treat it as unverified.
Climb the ladder to the very top of the tower.
Aim down the sights of any gun and zoom in to look for a man in a plain t-shirt and glasses below.
Whether you shoot him or not, he looks at you and makes a throat-slitting gesture. Creepy music kicks in and he sprints after you.

He can't be killed by bullets, falls or distance, and he kills you with one punch. According to GameSpot, the chase only ends if you die some other way: the writer jumped off the tower and he didn't come back after the respawn. It doesn't seem to reference anything; it's a Rockstar joke.

Exact addresses for the substations haven't been published in writing, which is why the table points you to the video timestamps. The switch for the 10th stop isn't spoken in Dan Allen's guide. We'll update this page when a source we can check spells those out.
For more secrets, see the GTA 6 easter eggs list, including the Mario block that gives Jason and Lucia matching caps.

How do you get to old Vice City in GTA 6? Power up the tower in the south of the map, hit the 12 electrical substations in the order that spells Life Is Passing Me By, then go to Reactor 2 at the power plant between 7 p.m. and 6 a.m. A pink portal there sends Jason to the 2002 Malibu Club.
What time does the GTA 6 Vice City portal open? The text reads Reactor 2 1906. Dan Allen Gaming reads that as 7 p.m. to 6 a.m., and the portal won't open during the day.
How do you get Tommy Vercetti's shirt in GTA 6? It's the reward for the secret Vice City portal, along with a chopper motorcycle. You get both after Jason comes back from the 2002 Malibu Club.
Who found the GTA 6 Vice City portal? Kotaku credits content creator Memeio, who spent days hunting down the substations. TmarTn2 credits Memeio too.
Jason in Tommy Vercetti's shirt, the portal's reward.
Vice City at night, in an official GTA 6 image. It shows the city, not the portal.

t: GTA 6 Wyman's Classic Car Collection: All 15 Part Locations, Cost and the Free Jacket
r: With the Special or Ultimate Edition, Wyman builds 5 classic cars from 15 parts you scan around the map. Here's how to unlock it, where the parts are, what it costs and what you get at the end.

l: Wyman, the mechanic from the Thrillbilly Mud Club, builds 5 classic cars for you. You just have to find and scan 15 parts scattered around the map. The collection comes with the Special or Ultimate Edition of GTA 6.
The guide is LunarGaming's. The part locations come from Clips Leonida, which uses footage from the same channel. We still need a second independent channel, so this is unverified.
In Chapter 2, talk to Wyman at the Starlet Motel.
Finish the first Thrillbilly Mud Club race.
Wait for Wyman's text about the classic cars. From then on you can hunt the parts.
You don't have to finish one car before finding parts for the next: grab all 15 in one go and he builds them one after another.
He charges $1,500 per car.
After the first four, pay another $1,000 for the fifth car plus a free jacket. Clips Leonida says the fifth car is a Deviant and the jacket is the Patriot Jacket.
Expect waiting: Wyman takes at least an in-game day to build each car, plus a day between you collecting one and him starting the next. Much of it is waiting for his texts.
One part needs the cutting tool to open a shipping container. It only unlocks midway through Chapter 3.
These come from Clips Leonida, with the map shown in the video. The auto captions mangle a few names, so use the video for the exact spot.

You can register and store the cars like any other. See how to sell and register cars in GTA 6.

How do you unlock Wyman's classic cars in GTA 6? In Chapter 2, talk to Wyman at the Starlet Motel and finish the first Thrillbilly Mud Club race. He then texts you about the classic cars. It's part of the Special or Ultimate Edition.
How much does Wyman charge for the classic cars? $1,500 per car, according to LunarGaming. After the first four, another $1,000 gets you the fifth car plus a free jacket.
Do you need a tool for Wyman's car parts? Yes. One part sits inside a shipping container that only opens with the cutting tool, which unlocks midway through Chapter 3.
One of Wyman's classic cars, with a flag paint job.

t: GTA 6 Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs Safe Codes: Casa de Empeño, Richardson and Donovan
r: In Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, a Chapter 3 mission, each jewelry store has a safe with a fixed code: 1680, 6815 and 0104. Here's where each safe is, the best order and what Yasmani wants.

l: The safe codes for Yasmani's jewelry stores in GTA 6 are 1680 (Casa de Empeño), 6815 (Richardson Jewelry) and 0104 (Donovan Banks & Co.). They're part of the Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs mission in Chapter 3, and they're fixed: they work for everyone.

That's different from regular robberies. At any ordinary store or bank, the code is randomized and changes even if you rob the same place twice, according to GameSpot. See how to find safe codes for those.
Store · Code · Where the safe is · What Yasmani wants
Casa de Empeño · 1680 · Small back office · Buffalo skull chain
Richardson Jewelry · 6815 · Northeast corner of the center room · Diamond ring
Donovan Banks & Co. · 0104 · Halfway down the long back hallway · Amethyst necklace
At Donovan, type the leading zero: 0104.
You can go in any order, but PowerPyx recommends Casa de Empeño first:
It has no back door, so the alarm will go off either way. It's the smallest store, so you're in and out fast.
Hand the chain to Yasmani right after. He gives you the Snap Gun, which opens locked doors without triggering the alarm.
With the Snap Gun, go in through the back doors at Richardson and Donovan without alerting the guards up front.
Near the safe or in the back room you'll find the box to destroy the camera footage and the panel to disarm the alarm. Use both so the cops don't get your description.
If you came in quietly, you can leave through the back without anyone noticing. For extra cash, head to the front and smash the display cases.
When you're done, go back to Yasmani's store and sell everything. According to PowerPyx, the three items pay $20,000, plus whatever you grab from the cases.

Sneakthief asks you to rob a jewelry store undetected. After this mission, use the Snap Gun on the back door, disarm the alarm, destroy the footage and open the safe. PowerPyx suggests Richardson Jewelry. See the trophy list.
GTA 6 safe codes: the fixed ones and how to find the rest
What is the Casa de Empeño safe code in GTA 6? 1680. The safe is in the small back office and holds the buffalo skull chain Yasmani wants.
What is the Richardson Jewelry safe code in GTA 6? 6815. The safe is in the northeast corner of the center room and holds the diamond ring.
What is the Donovan Banks & Co. safe code in GTA 6? 0104, including the leading zero. The safe is halfway down the long back hallway and holds the amethyst necklace.

Which of Yasmani's jewelry stores should you do first? Casa de Empeño. It has no back door and it's the smallest, and once you hand over the item Yasmani gives you the Snap Gun, which opens the other two stores' back doors without setting off the alarm.
The Casa de Empeño safe open, with the buffalo skull chain Yasmani wants.
Vice City in an official GTA 6 screenshot, home of the three jewelry stores. This image is for illustration.

t: GTA 6 Free Purple Drank Emerus: Chatfield Storage, the 5800 Safe Code and a Legendary Pistol
r: Chatfield Storage on Waxman Island hides a purple Progen Emerus with no tracker, a legendary silenced pistol and a safe with the code 5800. Here's how to get in quietly and when to register the car.

l: The Purple Drank Emerus in GTA 6 is at Chatfield Storage & Logistics, on the Waxman Island docks in Vice-Dale. It's a Progen Emerus supercar that comes unlocked with no tracker. The same spot has a legendary silenced pistol and a safe with the code 5800.
Maxemilio Gaming shows the route and the code. LunarGaming shows the location and the car on screen.
Item · Where
Progen Purple Drank Emerus · Among the shipping containers
Legendary ES 9 silenced pistol · Main office, upstairs
Safe (code 5800) · Same office
Laptop with the code · Inside a shipping container, behind a privacy screen
Save first and bring a silenced weapon. There are plenty of guards.
Head to Chatfield Storage & Logistics on Waxman Island. Maxemilio found a weak side with a single guard. Stay stealthy so the alarm doesn't go off.
Find the laptop. It's inside a shipping container with a privacy screen that hides it well. Maxemilio walked past it the first time. The code is 5800.
Go up to the main office. The legendary pistol and the safe are there. Open it with 5800.
Take the Emerus. It's unlocked, with no alarm and no tracker.
No tracker: according to LunarGaming, it's the only supercar without a tracker, which is why you can keep it.
Registering: you register cars with Moses from Chapter 2. From Chapter 3, the Pay 'n' Spray on Waxman Island, right next door, can register it too, as LunarGaming's video shows.
You can grab it in Chapter 1, as LunarGaming's title says, but keep it safe: an unregistered car that gets destroyed or lost doesn't come back.
Legendary weapon loot locations, with more gang hideouts
How to sell and register cars
Truffade Thrax, the fastest car

Where is the Purple Drank Emerus in GTA 6? At Chatfield Storage & Logistics, a gang operation on the Waxman Island docks in Vice-Dale. The car, the Progen Purple Drank Emerus, sits among the shipping containers.
What is the Chatfield Storage safe code in GTA 6? 5800. It's on a laptop with a privacy screen inside a shipping container. The safe is in the main office, next to the legendary pistol.
Does the Purple Drank Emerus have a tracker? No. It's unlocked and has no tracker. LunarGaming says it's the only supercar without one, which is why you can keep it.
The Purple Drank Emerus leaving through the Chatfield Storage gate, with the car's name on screen.

t: Where to Find the Truffade Thrax in GTA 6, the Fastest Car: Locations and Registration Cost
r: The Truffade Thrax is the fastest stock car in GTA 6. Here's where to find Andrew Node's, the one you can register, plus Randy's and the one that can spawn by luck near Boone Speedway.

l: The Truffade Thrax is the fastest stock car in GTA 6, according to GameSpot. There's more than one on the map, but the one you can register as your own belongs to Andrew Node and sits in a mansion on Starfish Island, in Vice City. It has no tracker, and registering it costs $70,000.
GameSpot and RageGamingVideos both show Andrew Node's Thrax, the No Flusher route and the 8554013 code.
Thrax · Where · Can you keep it?
Andrew Node's · Mansion garage on Starfish Island, Vice City · Yes. No tracker, $70,000 to register
Randy's · Dalton Island Club, on Dalton Island · No, it goes to Randy
Boone Speedway · Can spawn near Boone Speedway · Only by luck, not guaranteed
End of the story · In a mission near the end · No, according to GameSpot

p.h: Andrew Node’s Thrax (the one you keep)
l: The mansion is on Starfish Island, in the Vice-Dale district. On the map, it's the long house just below the word "Island", on the south side of the main oval road.
The normal route, according to GameSpot:
In Chapter 3, Cal texts you about the No Flusher group.
From then on, use WAiNK to scan the manhole covers with a blue toilet painted on them. There are 10.
Once you have all 10, open a shed in Ocean Beach with the code 8554013.
Inside the shed there's a laptop with Andrew Node's address.
Go to the mansion on Starfish Island, open the garage and take the blue Thrax.
Not enough cash to register it? Park it in one of your garages, where it won't disappear, until you've saved up the $70,000.
GameSpot also mentions a shortcut that uses a glitch to get into the garage. We don't teach it: it can break your save and may stop working after an update.
The Thrax is one of the last cars on Randy's list. According to GameSpot:
Deliver the Mamba GT to Randy and wait for his call about the Thrax. If you go before the call, the car isn't there.
Head to Dalton Island, a resort island southeast of Vice-Dale. No boat? Take the ferry from the south port of Waxman Island for $50.
On the island, grab a golf cart and drive to the Dalton Island Club, in the south.
In the valet lot on the west side, take down the guard near the dark green Thrax.
Take the ferry back and deliver the car to Randy's shop in Balsero.
GameSpot says a third Thrax can spawn near Boone Speedway, but it's down to luck. Don't plan around it. If you want a Thrax of your own, Andrew Node's is the sure one.
Randy's rare car list
How to sell and register cars in GTA 6
Garages: locations and prices

Where do you find the Truffade Thrax in GTA 6? The one you can register belongs to Andrew Node and sits in a mansion on Starfish Island, in Vice City. Randy's is at the Dalton Island Club, and a third one can spawn near Boone Speedway, but only by luck.
How much does it cost to register the Truffade Thrax in GTA 6? Andrew Node's Thrax costs $70,000 to register, according to GameSpot. It has no tracker.
What is the fastest car in GTA 6? The Truffade Thrax, according to GameSpot. It's the fastest stock car. Upgraded cars can beat it.
Can you keep Randy's Thrax? No. That one goes to Randy, and according to GameSpot the Thrax that shows up near the end of the story can never be yours either. To get your own, take Andrew Node's.
Andrew Node's Truffade Thrax in the garage, with the scanner readout: no tracker and a $70,000 registration.

t: GTA 6 on Xbox: Turn Off Automatic Clip Uploads to Avoid a Suspension
r: One player says they got a two-day Xbox suspension over a GTA 6 clip that uploaded on its own. Here's how to turn off automatic uploads and what Xbox has said about clip suspensions.

l: If you play GTA 6 on Xbox, turn off automatic clip uploads. The console ships with it on: every clip you capture goes straight to the Xbox network. One player said on Reddit that they got a two-day suspension over a 28-second GTA 6 clip, according to GamesRadar+.
It's a single report, so this page is unverified. But Xbox has suspended accounts over mature clips from other games before, and its own support team's advice was to turn off auto-upload.
Press the Xbox button on your controller.
Go to Profile & system > Settings > Preferences > Capture & share.
Under Automatic uploads, pick the Xbox network and set it to Don't upload.
GamesRadar+ suggests switching off OneDrive uploads too if you don't want anything going up on its own. Your clips stay saved on the console: you just choose what to share.
According to GamesRadar+, the player got a two-day suspension with no appeal after a 28-second clip uploaded to the Xbox network on its own.
They say the clip only showed the characters in beachwear, and that it was flagged by mistake.
Xbox's email didn't say which rule the clip broke.
In January 2024, after a wave of suspensions over Baldur's Gate 3 clips, Xbox Support told GamesRadar+ that:
Suspensions aren't automatic: a moderator reviews each clip.
For a first offense, Xbox may lift the suspension and explain how to avoid it.
For sensitive content, the fix is to turn off automatic uploads.
Xbox's community rules say public content should suit all audiences. GTA 6 is rated for adults, so any clip can end up under review.
Can you play GTA 6 on PC, PS4, Xbox One or Game Pass?

Can you get suspended on Xbox for a GTA 6 clip? One player says they got a two-day suspension over a 28-second GTA 6 clip that uploaded to the Xbox network automatically. It's a single report, but Xbox has suspended accounts over mature clips from other games before.
How do you turn off automatic clip uploads on Xbox? Press the Xbox button, go to Profile & system > Settings > Preferences > Capture & share, and under Automatic uploads set it to Don't upload.
Are Xbox clip suspensions automatic? According to Xbox Support, no: each reported clip is reviewed by a moderator. For a first offense, Xbox said it may lift the suspension.
Leonida Keys in an official GTA 6 screenshot. This image is for illustration.

t: What to Do Before Finishing Chapter 2 in GTA 6: What You Lose When You Move to Vice City
r: Picking up the case at the Starlet Motel ends Chapter 2 and boards up the motel. Before that, pay Linda, grab the two motel cards, hit the savings goal and save in a separate slot.

l: Chapter 2 in GTA 6 ends when you pick up the case in room 6 at the Starlet Motel, and there's no going back: the motel gets boarded up. Before that, pay Linda, grab the two motel cards, hit the savings goal and save in a separate slot.
For now, this list comes from ABTW's video only.
The task to move to Vice City shows up once you finish all the main missions in the chapter and have $15,000.
For ABTW, it appeared when Vicky's $10,000 from the Afternoon Delight mission came in. That mission pays out the next day.

Going into the room and picking up the case starts the last mission. From then on, the Starlet Motel is boarded up. Port Gellhorn stays open. GameSpot confirms the Chapter 2 safehouse becomes inaccessible, just like Chapter 1's.
GTA 6 doesn't let you replay missions. Before you pick up the case, make a manual save in a new slot. That way you can go back if you forget something.

p.h: 2. Pay Linda and get the necklace back
l: If you bought Lucia's necklace in Chapter 1 and fell behind on rent, Linda is holding on to it. Pay her before you leave and the necklace comes back. Once the motel is boarded up, you can't.
Both are missable:
Vicky: on the floor of the reception bathroom, next to the toilet.
Victor Maravillas, the baseball player: inside the fridge in the motel kitchen.
See the rest in collectible cards.

In the BuckMe app, complete the $5,000 family savings goal. The bank deposits about $2,000, the account moves up to silver and the limit goes up to $100,000. Keep in mind that money in savings can't be taken back out.

p.h: 5. Make the most of Moses’s free registration
l: The first car you register with Moses is free. Bring a car you actually want to keep, or one that costs a lot to register. See how to sell and register cars.
Dunk's trunk takes stolen goods, but the money comes in later through BuckMe. Before you leave, ABTW recommends emptying whatever is still in his trunk.
Unlike Chapter 1, this time your money and your car come with you to Vice City. ABTW left with about $22,000, sold one last bag and arrived with $23,600.

p.h: Other things that are harder to reach later
l: Dark Knight Drifter shotgun: according to ABTW, it's a unique variant sold only at Gelhorn Outfitters, for $2,400.
Gelhorn Raceway race: ABTW shows a practice lap with Beau. Beat his time and you're in with the racing crew.
Moses drop-off locations
GTA 6 safe codes: the fixed ones and how to find the rest
When does Chapter 2 end in GTA 6? When you go into the room at the Starlet Motel and pick up the case. That mission shows up once you've finished all the chapter's main missions and have $15,000.
What do you lose when you finish Chapter 2 in GTA 6? The Starlet Motel gets boarded up. The two collectible cards there are gone for good and, if you didn't pay Linda, so is Lucia's necklace.
Does your money carry over from Chapter 2 to Chapter 3 in GTA 6? Yes. Unlike Chapter 1, your money comes with you to Vice City. ABTW left with about $22,000 and arrived with all of it.
Where are the Starlet Motel cards in GTA 6? Vicky's card is on the floor of the reception bathroom, next to the toilet. Victor Maravillas's card is inside the fridge in the motel kitchen.
