t: Can You Keep Playing GTA 6 After the Ending? How the Post-Game Works
r: Yes. Once the final mission and credits are done, GTA 6 rewinds to just before the finale and lets you roam free. You can replay the ending, chase 100% and unlock cheats.

l: Yes, you can keep playing GTA 6 after the ending. Once the credits finish, the game drops you back at the moment right before the final mission, and from there the whole map is open to you. Kotaku, which has already played through to the end, laid out how it works without spoiling the story.
The game warns you first. When you reach the last mission, GTA 6 makes a big deal of asking whether you really want to start the finale. Kotaku's reviewer got there after roughly 90 hours.
The finale is several missions long. When it's over, you see one of the main endings and the credits.
Then the clock rewinds. You're back at the moment you were asked. This time Jason and Lucia say they aren't ready yet and head back out into Vice City.
The map is yours. From then on you can clean up whatever you left behind and explore as much as you like.
The final mission marker stays on the map. Play the finale again and you may land on a different ending.
GTA 6 has more than one ending, and which one you get comes down to your choices. Kotaku saw two of them and says they go in very different directions. We're keeping the details out of this page.

Rockstar confirmed the multiple endings to GameSpot as well. GameSpot's own team saw two, and with other players' reports added in, it counts at least 4. The site says the best ending asks for two things: Jason and Lucia at the top relationship level and the couple's savings maxed out at $2 million. So before you replay the finale, it's worth raising the relationship and banking more cash.
For how many endings people have found so far and what drives each one, with no spoilers, see how many endings GTA 6 has.
Beating the final mission opens up two things that were locked before:
100% completion. You can only finish everything after the ending. That includes the A Long Road trophy from our GTA 6 trophy and achievement list.
Cheat codes. The challenges that reveal the game's cheats only show up once the story is done. See every GTA 6 cheat and how to use cheats.
vAnother Level spent more than two hours in another player's post-game and shows what's still open. No story spoilers:
Both characters stay playable.
Character questlines: Randy keeps the car jobs coming, and Kenton and Bret still have their missions. PowerPyx confirms every trophy-related character is still around.
Robberies: banks, Payday Loans and jewelry stores.
Optional missions you skipped, like mentoring Yago and recovering Pete's plane.
Your savings get a new goal, capped at $2 million.
According to vAnother Level and PowerPyx, nothing for 100% is missable: it can all be done after the ending.

p.h: Cheats that unlock when you finish
l: After the ending, a Cheats tab shows up in the Progress menu with all 61 cheats. According to PowerPyx, four unlock the moment you finish the story: $250,000, unlimited focus, attack force and cycle weather. The rest need challenges. vAnother Level points out the game's warning: with a cheat active, trophies don't unlock and the game won't save that session. See every GTA 6 cheat.
To see another ending, vAnother Level says you don't need a new save: just replay the last two missions.

p.h: Do you need to clear the map first?
l: No. There's a huge amount to do outside the story: main and side missions, activities, random events and races. Since the map stays open after the credits, you can push through the story and save the rest for later. To see how much story is left, our GTA 6 mission list has all 5 chapters in order.

p.h: How it compares to other Rockstar games
l: Rockstar's earlier open worlds handled the post-game in different ways:
Game · What happens after the ending
Red Dead Redemption 2 · You keep going as a different character
GTA IV · You keep playing as Niko, like in most GTA games
GTA 6 · The game rewinds to just before the finale, with Jason and Lucia

Kotaku points out one downside: after the ending, the world feels frozen in time. No big new storylines can kick off, since they could clash with how the story wraps up. What's left is the map, unfinished activities and the cheats.
Does GTA 6 end after the final mission? No. After the credits, the game takes you back to the moment before the finale and you carry on as Jason and Lucia.
Can you get a different ending in GTA 6? Yes. The final mission marker stays on the map, and the ending you get depends on the choices you made.
Do you need to beat GTA 6 to get 100%? Yes. According to Kotaku, 100% completion and the challenges that reveal cheat codes only open up after the final mission.
How long does it take to reach the end of GTA 6? Kotaku's reviewer needed roughly 90 hours to reach the final mission.
Free roaming in GTA 6's open world, which stays available after the ending.

t: GTA 6 Haunted Lighthouse and Ghost Ship: Where It Is and How to Find the Cursed Knife
r: After midnight, two ghosts fight at the top of a lighthouse on Little Hardin Island. Here's where it is, the order of the clues, where to dive for the cursed knife and how to see the ghost ship.

l: The haunted lighthouse in GTA 6 is on Little Hardin Island, in Leonard County, in the northeast of the map. After midnight, fog rolls in and two ghosts fight at the top of the lighthouse until one of them falls. Follow the clues and you'll find a cursed knife on the seabed and spot a ghost ship on the horizon.
Milo and GameSpot both show the ghosts. The full walkthrough comes from GameSpot.
Time: after midnight.
Boat: the island sits across deep water. Look for a boat on the beach, or take a RydeMe to a marina and steal one there.
Gear: you'll be diving. Bring the metal detector, which unlocks in Chapter 1 with Kenton.
According to GameSpot, you can do this one with your partner along, unlike some other mysteries.
Climb the lighthouse. In the fog you hear two men arguing. At the top, the two ghosts fight and one pushes the other off.
Scan the lighthouse with WAiNK. It's a landmark and counts toward the collection.
Grab the photo. Go down the stairs carefully. At the bottom there's a photograph of two men, Godfrey and Frank. Flip it over to read the back.
Read the diary. In the northwest of the island there's a ruined house where the two men lived. Go in, turn right and walk up to the fireplace: a diary falls. Read it.
Take the boat and the diving gear. At the dock on the island's north tip there's a boat and diving gear. Take both, or use the boat you came in.
Sail east of the lighthouse, past the point of land. At the right spot the boat stops on its own, you lose control, the fog comes back and the waves rise.
Dive with the metal detector. Aim it until you see green blinks and follow that direction to a sunken wooden boat.
Take the cursed knife from the skeleton. Swim up fast, get back in the boat and head back to the island. The storm gets worse and you can barely see, so check the map to stay on course.
Climb the lighthouse again. The ghosts are gone, and the game tells you there's something strange on the horizon.
Look northeast. That's the ghost ship. Pull out your binoculars quickly, because it disappears.
Milo unlocked The Truth Is Out There right after seeing the ghosts at the lighthouse. That trophy is better known for the UFO abduction. See the trophy list.
GTA 6 easter eggs list
WAiNK curiosities and landmarks
Sunken treasure and shipwrecks
Where is the haunted lighthouse in GTA 6? On Little Hardin Island, in Leonard County, in the northeast of the map. It's an island, so you need a boat to get there.
What time do the lighthouse ghosts show up in GTA 6? After midnight. Fog rolls in and you hear two men arguing.

How do you see the ghost ship in GTA 6? Get the cursed knife from the sunken boat east of the lighthouse, go back to the top of the lighthouse and look northeast. Use your binoculars before it disappears.
Does the haunted lighthouse give a trophy? Milo unlocked The Truth Is Out There right after seeing the ghosts. The lighthouse also counts as a WAiNK landmark, so scan it.
The Little Hardin Island lighthouse at night, in the fog.

t: How to Unlock Hurricanes in GTA 6: Freddie's Secret Bunker Mission, Step by Step
r: Hurricanes in GTA 6 only start after a hidden mission: breaking into the bunker of Freddie, a doomsday prepper. Here's where it is, how to get in twice and what you get.

l: Hurricanes in GTA 6 don't just happen: they unlock after a hidden mission at Freddie's bunker. Freddie is a doomsday prepper who lives in a compound full of mines and drones in northern Leonard County. You break in twice, go to a party in the bunker, and the first hurricane hits soon after.
Heads up: according to GameSpot, after the first hurricane they can hit at any time, in the middle of whatever you're doing.
GameSpot and AFGuidesHD both show the mission. The exact way in comes from GameSpot.
Go to Freddie's compound in northern Leonard County. At the gate, a recording warns you about the automated defenses. It doesn't matter what you say into the speaker: he won't let you in.
Walk around the concrete bunker to the right until you find a yellow tractor in front of an orange container.
Use the tractor to move the container. Underneath there's a hole with a ladder.
Climb down, follow the sewer and go up the next ladder. You come out inside the compound.
Watch for mines on the ground. You can shoot them from a distance. Stick to the grass and high ground.
A drone starts searching for you. Find it with Focus mode and shoot it down.
Reach the bunker door, the round metal building in the northwest corner. Freddie is furious, says he'll upgrade his defenses and tells you to come back when he lets you know.
It can take a few in-game days. Don't wait around: keep playing. When he texts, he offers you money to test his new defenses.
Now there are mines near the gate, and the old route is closed.
Go around the outside of the compound to the water tower. Climb one level and jump onto the roof just below, or climb to the top and parachute in. Watch out for mines.
Take down the drones on your way to the door.
The door handle gives you a shock, but this time Freddie opens the door and comes out with some friends.
Freddie shows you around the bunker, which he says is flood-proof and nuke-proof, makes you a drink and invites you onto his podcast.
A hurricane alert comes on TV. He seals the door and asks whether you're staying or leaving.
In AFGuidesHD's video, Lucia gets money and Freddie's car. According to GameSpot, you can take his Dubsta when you leave.
Outside, the sky goes dark and the wind picks up. Your partner may text to check that you're okay.
Retest Freddie's Defenses is one of the 8 strands that count for the Strangers & Freaks trophy, according to PowerPyx. See the others in Strangers & Freaks missions.
Free tank in a secret bunker, another bunker on the map
GTA 6 easter eggs list

How do you unlock hurricanes in GTA 6? Break into Freddie's bunker twice, in northern Leonard County. The second time he invites you to a party, a hurricane alert comes on TV, and from then on hurricanes can hit at any time.
Where is Freddie's bunker in GTA 6? In a fortified compound in northern Leonard County, with a fence, mines and drones. According to Jojo Gaming Guides, you can do it in any chapter.

How do you get into Freddie's bunker? The first time, use the yellow tractor to move the orange container and climb down the hole into the sewer. The second time, climb the water tower and jump or parachute in.
Does Freddie's mission count for a trophy? Yes. Retest Freddie's Defenses is one of the 8 strands that count for the Strangers & Freaks trophy, according to PowerPyx.
The party at the door of Freddie's bunker, after the second break-in.

t: GTA 6 on PC: What We Know About the Cyberleek Xbox Leak and Why You Can't Play It Yet
r: Cyberleek released the Xbox build's executable and fans are racing to run GTA 6 on PC. The most-cited project was taken down and nobody has a public playable build. Here's what's real and the official way to play.

l: You can't play GTA 6 on PC yet. On November 23, the leaker Cyberleek released the executable for the Xbox build they had leaked, and fan groups are racing to get it running on PC. So far they've shown the game almost booting, to a black screen, or its menus working. Nobody has shown anyone driving around Leonida.
Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version. This page is news only: no links, no instructions, and here's why you shouldn't download anything that promises GTA 6 on PC.
Cyberleek had already leaked the files of the Xbox Series build. One was missing: the executable, the file that starts the game.
They promised to drop it if their memecoin hit a certain market cap. According to Code Bear, it never got there, and the file came out anyway on November 23.
According to GameSpot, Cyberleek has been taunting Take-Two for failing to stop the leaks, and already cashed out hundreds of thousands of dollars from the coin in August and October.
In the message that came with the file, quoted by GamesRadar+, Cyberleek themselves tells people to verify any file before trusting it.

p.h: Update, November 25: the most-cited project was taken down
l: Project Leonida, the most-cited project, is over. According to GamesRadar+, its server disappeared, so did the original repository, and its creator announced they were stepping away. They say Rockstar took the server down. Rockstar hasn't commented.
Before it went down, a video attributed to the project showed the opening sequence and first-time setup running on PC, according to GamesRadar+. Optimus says the server lasted less than a day.
Copies of the code are still around and other groups keep going. One says the game boots, runs its menus at 30 fps and loads the world, but rendering fails there.

A private group says it can walk around the map with a controller and talk to characters, according to WiLLiSGaming and ApTreX. Both say the picture is broken, with missing textures and failing lighting, and ApTreX cites 5 to 10 frames per second. None of this has been independently verified, and that build isn't public.
Bottom line: there's still no playable, public PC version. Any file that promises one is a scam.

No. A console game reaches PC in stages: the program starts, it draws a picture, the menus work, the world loads, and only then is it playable. As of November 24, according to GameSpot, GamesRadar+ and Code Bear's fact check:
Stage · Status on November 24
The program starts · Yes
It draws a picture · Yes, but the most-cited project, Project Leonida, still gets a black screen and the audio cuts off
Menus · Some groups showed the menus at 30 frames per second
The world loads · One group reached the first mission's title card, but the scene stays dark at about 1 frame per second
Playable · No. Nobody has shown anyone walking or driving
According to GameSpot, the groups think they'll have a playable build within a week, using AI to translate the Xbox code. That's their forecast, not a fact.

p.h: Be careful with “GTA 6 running on PC” videos
l: A lot of what's going around isn't the game running on a computer:

It's console footage. Linus Tech Tips and Hardware Unboxed both showed GTA 6 "at 60 FPS" on a PC, but the game is running on a PS5. The picture goes through a capture card and the PC adds generated frames. Both warn it adds visual artifacts and input lag. According to Code Bear, the viral high-end graphics card numbers came from this trick, with PS5 Pro footage.

It's only setup screens. Code Bear went through the most-viewed clips frame by frame: the real ones show start screens and menus at most. Captions like "100% confirmed" and "running at 110 FPS" don't match the picture.

There's no playable version to download. So every "GTA 6 PC" download out there right now is fake or unfinished. According to Code Bear, security firms have counted hundreds of sites pushing fake launchers, and one of those files was flagged by more than half of the antivirus engines that scanned it. Some scams steal crypto wallets and quietly use your PC to mine.

There's also the legal side: this is piracy. According to Code Bear, Take-Two has already had fan projects taken down on GitHub and, in 2021, sued the people behind fan rebuilds of the old GTA 3 and Vice City. GamesRadar+ notes that Take-Two's CEO says the company has its legal team on standby.

p.h: What about an official PC version?
l: Rockstar hasn't announced one or given a date. According to GameSpot, rumors point to early 2027, a short gap by Rockstar standards. GamesRadar+ expects the official version within a year or two, as with GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2.

p.h: The official way to play on PC today: Remote Play
l: If you own the console and the game, you can stream GTA 6 from your console to your PC or phone. The game still runs on the console.
On Xbox Series X · S (Microsoft confirmed support, according to GameSpot):
On the console, go to Settings > Devices & connections > Remote features and tick Enable remote features. There's also a test for your connection there.
On PC: open the Xbox app, click your profile and go to Accessories & Remote Play.
On a phone: go to the Xbox Remote Play website and pick your console.
On PS5: according to GameSpot, the game's PlayStation Store page now says Remote Play is supported.
Quality depends on your internet, and the game still runs at 30 frames per second, as it does on console.
Can you play GTA 6 on PC, PS4, Xbox One or Game Pass?
GTA 6 FPS and performance on PS5 Pro and Xbox

Can you play GTA 6 on PC yet? No. As of November 25 there's no playable, public PC version. The most-cited project, Project Leonida, was taken down, and a private group claims it can walk around the map with broken graphics and low frame rates, unverified.
What did Cyberleek release? The executable (.exe) for the Xbox build they had already leaked. It was the missing file needed to start the game, and it came out on November 23.
Is it safe to download GTA 6 for PC? No. There's no playable version to download, so every GTA 6 PC download is fake or unfinished, and many carry malware. It's also piracy.
When is the official GTA 6 PC release? Rockstar hasn't announced one. According to GameSpot, rumors point to early 2027.
How can you play GTA 6 on PC officially? Through Remote Play, streaming from your own Xbox Series X|S or PS5 to your PC or phone. You need the console and the game.
Vice City in an official GTA 6 screenshot. This image is for illustration: it doesn't show the game on PC.

t: GTA 6 Permanent Health, Stamina and Focus Boosts: The 5 Easter Eggs That Give Them
r: Five GTA 6 secrets permanently boost health, stamina or focus: the aliens, hell, Kyle's strawberry, the mushroom parkour and the No Flushers sewer. Here's what each gives and how to do it.

l: Five secrets in GTA 6 permanently boost your health, stamina or focus. The alien one improves everything. Hell gives max health. And three give max stamina: Kyle's strawberry, the mushroom parkour and the No Flushers sewer.
The five secrets and their boosts come from Arekkz Gaming's video. PowerPyx confirms the name of the sewer mission.
Secret · What it gives · When
Aliens (abduction, dream and lab) · Health, stamina and focus · Chapter 2 onward, late at night
Hell · Max health, a legendary shotgun, tattoos and a T-shirt · At night, in Port Gellhorn
Kyle's strawberry · Max stamina · From Chapter 2
Mushroom parkour · Max stamina · Any time
No Flushers sewer · Max stamina · Any time
This is the longest one, in three parts:

Abduction: late at night, find a parked car with flashing lights on a country road near Port Gellhorn and follow the trail to the UFO. Help the woman and fetch her car. You get The Truth Is Out There trophy. See the abduction walkthrough.
Dream: sleep until morning for 2 to 4 nights until you have the dream. In it you learn the keypad code, which changes from player to player. See the alien dream.
Lab: use the code at the hidden complex near Hamlet, in the starting area. See the alien lab.
When you leave, your health, stamina and focus go up.
It starts at a garage in Port Gellhorn, next to a robbery spot, at night.
Talk to the two men out front. A van pulls up: get in.
Walk to the campfire and look into the fire.
You get a shotgun with infinite ammo and face a boss who summons goats and exploding monsters.
The reward is max health, the legendary Hell Spawn shotgun next to the throne, new tattoos at the parlor and a T-shirt. See the hell walkthrough.
If you die during the boss fight: according to Arekkz, you fail and get no boost, so save first.
In Chapter 2, take the pilot flyer from the wall in the motel reception.
Do the crop dusting job by plane.
Wait for Kyle's call and go pick up a van. They ask for $5,000: you can pay, haggle or take it on credit. Arekkz paid $3,000.
Drive the van carefully to the barn and eat the strawberry: max stamina.
The rest of this story is in the Red Hulk.
It's at a construction site next to a lake in the north of the map:
Behind some men, inside a yellow container, there's a mystery box with an eye on it. Use it and eat the mushroom.
Keep going until you pull the power lever.
Follow the purple light. At the fork, go right, toward the light, not down the dark hallway.
In the parkour room, if you fall you start over. Use running jumps. Your stamina doesn't drain in the water, but stay away from the jellyfish.
At the end you see yourself in the container. Jump on yourself: max stamina.
This is the The Final Flush mission, which also counts for the Strangers & Freaks trophy, according to PowerPyx:
Go to the public restroom on Corsair Key, the small island with a single building, close to where the game starts. Arekkz used the men's restroom with Jason.
Scan the QR code on the flyer with your phone.
Answer "truth" to the message and go to Frank's Waffles.
Drive the man's van, following the spoken directions, to the sewage treatment plant south of Vice-Dale. Park under the bridge and go on foot.
Skip the main entrance: go around to the right to the lit side entrance.
Climb the stairs. On the panel, set all three buttons to green and press the big button. A passage opens under the pump.
Flush him and climb into the pod. You wake up at home with max stamina.

t: GTA 6 Safe Codes: How to Find the Combination and Open Safes in Robberies
r: Every GTA 6 safe has its own code, and some are fixed: bowling alley 0300, La Cascara Motel 6969 and Brooks Boatworks 6823. Find the rest with Focus mode or by threatening an employee.

l: There's no single safe code in GTA 6. In story missions the game gives you the combination. In robberies, you find it on the spot or through a clue that may be in another hideout. Many are 4 digits. PC Gamer explains the two ways, and MrDalekJD and Arekkz Gaming both cover them in their beginner videos.
The code is often written somewhere inside the store or bank:
on a note on a board in the back office;
carried by a guard you knocked out.

Turn on Focus mode (press L3 and R3 together) to highlight important objects. MrDalekJD points out that Focus lights up notes with safe codes on them, along with enemies behind walls and the source of nearby noises. His habit: switch it on every time you walk into a new place, before you start digging through the room.

Aim your weapon at an employee. You get Threaten and Safe Code? prompts. Pick the safe code and they'll hand it over. In some robberies this also makes the cashier empty the register, like in older GTA games.

According to Arekkz Gaming, some clerks will even let you know the store has a safe and give up the combination once you pull a gun on them. In the staff area at the back of a shop, Focus also highlights the safe itself and anything else you can interact with.
This page used to say every robbery code was randomized. That was wrong. On November 21, PC Gamer reported that the bowling alley code, like many other robbery codes, isn't randomized.
Kingpin Bowling: 0300, the same number at PC Gamer and GamesRadar+. See the bowling alley safe code.
La Cascara Motel: 6969. It opened the safe for GosuNoob, ConCon and other channels. See the La Cascara Motel safe code.
Brooks Boatworks: 6823. ConCon and RaidAway both opened the safe with it. See the Brooks Boatworks safe code.
All three numbers are handwritten on a Port Gellhorn map pinned up in the Brooks Boatworks office, as ConCon shows. Examining the map saves the codes to your game.
Yasmani's jewelry stores in Chapter 3 have fixed codes too: Casa de Empeño 1680, Richardson Jewelry 6815 and Donovan Banks & Co. 0104. See Yasmani's jewelry store safe codes.

It isn't a safe, but it does need a code: the Chapter 3 apartment laptop unlocks with Muffins, Queen, 15 and gives you 92665, the code for a La Perle lock-up with a pink car inside. See the Chapter 3 laptop password.
That doesn't mean they all are. If a number from a video fails, look for the code in your own game.
Once you have the code, it appears in the lower right corner when you interact with the safe. Enter the 4 digits and it opens.
Be quick: the sooner it's open, the sooner your bag is full and you're gone.

p.h: Pick your target on the map
l: Select a store or bank on the map before you go. It shows whether it has a safe, its security level (low to high) and the approximate value of what's inside, so you can choose a target worth the risk.

In chapter 3 you get a tool to pick locks, and from then on back doors are the way to go: subdue the staff in the back, kill the alarm and destroy the security footage before opening the safe. MrDalekJD adds that Focus marks doors too: a white door can be opened, while a red one is alarmed, so look for another way in. More in how to make money fast in GTA 6.

What is the safe code in GTA 6? No single code opens them all. Each safe has its own, and many robbery codes are fixed: Kingpin Bowling is 0300, La Cascara Motel is 6969 and Brooks Boatworks is 6823. In story missions the game gives it to you.

How do you find a safe code in GTA 6? Use Focus mode (L3 and R3) to spot the note with the code, often on a board in the back office or on a knocked-out guard. Or aim at an employee and pick Safe Code.

How do you know if a store has a safe in GTA 6? Select it on your map. It shows whether it has a safe, the security level and the approximate value of the goods. Some clerks will also tell you about the safe if you threaten them.
Ambrosia, in an official GTA 6 image.

t: GTA 6 Satan Boss Fight Easter Egg: How to Start the Ritual, Beat Satan and Get the Shotgun
r: At a yellow house in Port Gellhorn after midnight, two metalheads invite you to a ritual that turns into a Doom-style trip through hell. Beat Satan for a unique red shotgun and a permanent health boost.

l: One of GTA 6's wildest hidden quests starts in a Port Gellhorn garage in the middle of the night. Two metalheads invite you to a ritual, the ritual drops you into hell for a Doom-style run through waves of demons, and it ends with a boss fight against Satan himself. Win and you walk away with a unique shotgun, an outfit, tattoos and a permanent health boost.
MrDalekJD made a full guide, and T5G shows the same house, ritual and boss in its 30 secrets video. The steps below follow MrDalekJD.
No map marker. Nothing tells you this exists.
Night only.
Go alone: as Jason or as Lucia. With both characters together, it won't start.
Save first. The boss fight is tough.
Head to north Port Gellhorn, on the streets north of Gellhorn Avenue looking out over Draper Bay. The house is north of the Stash House robbery.
In daylight it's a faded yellow single-story house with a yard full of junk and a "welcome to hell" tag sprayed on the front.
Come back between midnight and 4 a.m. When the quest is active, the garage door is up, with red lights and metal music blasting. MrDalekJD has heard of people getting it around 10 p.m. too.
Garage closed? Don't wait outside. Drive half a mile to a mile away and come back on the next hour. Shut at midnight? Try 1 a.m., then 2 a.m., and so on. It doesn't spawn every hour.
Two metalheads hang out in the garage. They offer you a beer and ask if you want to stick around before their ritual. Pick the option to go along and sit down and listen.
Very important: don't hit them, bump into them or pull a gun. Spook them and the whole thing shuts down.
After a while their friend shows up. Say yes when they invite you and get in the back of the van with the grim reaper on the side.
The van drops you at a clearing in the woods with a campfire and a big wooden throne.
When you get the prompt to look at the fire, keep staring until you pass out.
Missed it? Come back another night and eat the food on the throne. That also sends you to hell.
You wake up holding a shotgun in a level full of demons.
Keep moving and grab every health pack and ammo drop. Stand still and you won't last.
The small demon is the fastest: kill it first. The big ones are armored.
If one gets right up close, your character shotguns it in the face on their own.
If you die: you wake up by the ritual campfire. If it's still night, walk to the throne and eat the item again. A cutscene sends you straight back to where you died.
At the end you come face to face with Satan, and a boss health bar shows up at the bottom of the screen.
At first the bar is black: he's invulnerable and shooting him does nothing.
He sends out black goats and exploding enemies. Take out the exploders first.
When his bar turns red, he can take damage: unload everything on him.
Repeat: clear the wave, wait for the red bar, attack.
You wake up the next morning sitting on Satan's throne. According to MrDalekJD:
A unique red shotgun under the throne. The name wasn't clear in the auto captions, so we're leaving it out.
A Circles of Hell top, which your character is already wearing.
Exclusive tattoo designs at the tattoo parlor: one each on the chest, back, left arm and left leg, all hell themed.
A permanent bump to max health. Check the top left when you stand up from the throne. Unlike the health you build at the gym, this boost never goes away.
You can also sit on Satan's very tall throne afterwards.
Every GTA 6 easter egg found so far
Unique weapon locations

Where is the Satan easter egg house in GTA 6? In north Port Gellhorn, on the streets north of Gellhorn Avenue looking over Draper Bay, north of the Stash House robbery. It's a faded yellow single-story house with a junk-filled yard.
Why is the garage closed in the GTA 6 Satan easter egg? It only opens between midnight and 4 a.m., and not every hour. If it's shut, drive half a mile to a mile away and come back on the next hour.
What do you get for beating Satan in GTA 6? According to MrDalekJD: a unique red shotgun under the throne, a Circles of Hell shirt, new tattoo designs and a small permanent boost to max health.
The run-down, single-story yellow house in north Port Gellhorn. It stays shut during the day.

t: How to Steal ATMs in GTA 6: Winch Pickup, Sticky Bombs and Up to $100K an Hour
r: You can rip ATMs out of walls with a winch pickup and blow them open. Here's where to install the winch, what to unlock first, how much they pay and how to get away from the cops.

l: You can steal ATMs in GTA 6 by ripping them out of the wall with a winch pickup. Then you blow them open with a sticky bomb and grab the cash. GameSpot and YouTuber Unknown Player show the same method, and Unknown Player made $104,000 in under an hour.
A vehicle with a winch. Tow trucks driving around the city work, but they're slow to escape in. The better pick is a pickup with a winch, like the Bravado Bison 1800 or the Vapid Montagne.

The Dye Pack Jammer. Without it, the bills can come with a pink dye pack that explodes, ruins the cash and marks you for the cops. It unlocks in Chapter 3 when you finish the Credit Check mission, and it stays active for good on both characters.
Sticky bombs. Ammu-Nation sells them. According to Unknown Player, there's a table of free sticky bombs in the room behind Yasmani at his shop.
Unknown Player says you can do this from early in the game, but it gets much better from Chapter 3.

Take the pickup to a mod shop that works on that vehicle type. For pickups, GameSpot points to Wasteland Off-road in Kelly County. Ultimate Edition owners can also use One-Eyed Willie's in Leonard County.
Go to Bodyworks > Towing and buy the winch. GameSpot lists it at $1,595; Unknown Player paid about $1,700.

If the pickup was stolen with a tracker, take it through Pay 'n' Spray and register it first. Unknown Player often finds a pickup that already has a winch and no tracker in the lot behind Yasmani's shop.
With a winch fitted, your minimap automatically shows nearby ATMs you can steal. The BuckMe phone app also has a "Find Nearest ATM" option.
Find an ATM outside. Ones inside buildings don't work.
Reverse up to it with your back end facing it. The winch hooks on automatically.
Drive forward, reverse, and drive forward again a few times until the ATM rips out. This triggers the alarm, and the wanted stars follow soon after.
Open the ATM:
Sticky bomb (the best option, per Unknown Player): right after pulling it out, hop out, stick a bomb on it and move your vehicle away before it blows. The cassettes come out already open.
Cut-off tool, which unlocks in Chapter 3 during Meet the Heders.
Brute force: drag it into things until it breaks. Slow and luck-based.
Four cash cassettes drop out. Stomp or shoot them open and grab the cash.
Get away. The bills are marked, so sell them to a fence. Yasmani pays more for them.
ATM · Payout, per Unknown Player
Regular ATM · $7,000 to $8,000, sometimes more
Yasmani's 3 daily marked ATMs · $10,000 to $13,000
The three special ATMs show up on your map after you've done Yasmani's jewelry jobs and Credit Check.
Don't blow up your own car or anyone else's. It counts as another crime and brings the cops faster.
Stick to quiet areas. Downtown has more ATMs but more police too.
Only stash full bags in the vehicle. Winch vehicles hold 6 bags at most, according to Unknown Player.
Double-tap triangle (Y on Xbox) to hop out with the engine running.
The same ATM takes a while to come back, so keep moving.
Yasmani's jewelry store safe codes
GTA 6 bank and ATM deposits

How do you steal an ATM in GTA 6? Fit a winch to a pickup, reverse up to an ATM, hook it and pull until it rips out of the wall. Then blow it open with a sticky bomb and grab the cash from the cassettes.
Where do you get a winch in GTA 6? At a mod shop that handles pickups, such as Wasteland Off-road in Kelly County. It's under Bodyworks > Towing and costs around $1,600.
How much do ATMs pay in GTA 6? According to Unknown Player, $7,000 to $8,000 for a regular ATM and up to $13,000 for the ones Yasmani marks. He made $104,000 in under an hour.
Do you need the Dye Pack Jammer to steal ATMs? Yes, if you want to keep the cash. Without it, dye packs can explode and ruin the bills. It unlocks in Chapter 3 with the Credit Check mission.
A winch pickup pulling an ATM off the sidewalk.

t: GTA 6 Strangers and Freaks: The 8 Mission Strands That Count for the Trophy
r: The GTA 6 Strangers & Freaks trophy asks for 8 stranger strands. Here are the ones that count (Kirk, Kyle, Alvan, Yago, Pete, Dr. Merle, Freddie and Papa Audacity) and where each starts.

l: Stranger missions in GTA 6 are requests from characters you run into around the map, and the Strangers & Freaks trophy asks you to finish 8 mission strands of them. There's no complete list yet: neither Rockstar nor the big guide sites have said which eight count. Below is what players have turned up on day one.
Trophy · Requirement · Value
Strangers & Freaks · Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida · Silver, 30G
The word to notice is strands. A single stranger can have more than one mission in a row, like Shirley does.

PowerPyx and Jojo Gaming Guides landed on the same list of 8. Not every favor counts: according to PowerPyx, the questlines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie don't count as strangers. All of them are still available after the story.
Stranger · Missions · When it opens, per Jojo
Kirk (Skunk Ape) · Search for the Skunk Ape, the tree effigies and Mr. Mangrove · Chapter 1
Kyle · McKittrick Farm, collecting chemicals and checking on him · Chapter 2
Alvan · Gellhorn's missing tourists and the trophy room · Chapter 2
Yago · A street race, mentoring him, racing him and backing him up · Chapter 3
Pilot Pete · Recovering Pete's plane and the deliveries · You help him in Chapter 1, but the strand only opens after Chapter 4
Dr. Merle (No Flushers) · The Final Flush, at Frank's Waffles · Any chapter
Freddie · Retesting his bunker defenses · Any chapter
Papa Audacity · The Unknown Stuntman stunts through to the launch party · Chapter 3
Where each one starts:
Kirk: scan a branch effigy in the swamp and call the number it saves. See the Skunk Ape mission guide.
Yago: join a street race; afterward he asks you to mentor him. The race against him has a time limit.
Dr. Merle: scan the QR code in the public restroom on Corsair Key.
Freddie: break into his bunker. See how to unlock hurricanes.
Papa Audacity: do his stunts; each one unlocks the next. Jojo says few players know this strand counts.
You can see how many you've done in the trophy tracker in the trophy list.
These aren't on PowerPyx's list, but they're worth doing for the rewards.
She lives on the corner by Jason's house and yells at you as you drive past early in the story.
First favor: she asks for a bottle of Salty Squid rum from the Three Sheets liquor store, as OutlawGarry shows. RageGamingVideos says bringing it back gives you a permanent focus boost.

Second favor: keep visiting and she'll ask for help involving her friend Peggy and Peggy's mobility scooter. The reward is being able to borrow Shirley's car whenever you like, per Arekkz. It's not a registered personal vehicle, but it drives well.

A hidden quest in the Grassrivers swamps. JFM shows it starting when you find an effigy made of branches in the woods, near where the creature is seen eating a deer on the road. The game doesn't point you anywhere after that. Kirk, a Skunk Ape hunter, joins in, and there's a choice at the end. The reward is a unique camo sniper rifle. Full steps in the Skunk Ape mission guide.

Kenton shows up after the story mission Hey Arnold!, at his dive shop on the Key Lento beach, according to KultZ. He teaches you to dive for wrecks, and WiLLiSGaming says he calls again later with more dive spots. There's even a trophy just for him, This Was No Boat Accident, for finishing Kenton's final mission. According to PowerPyx, his strand isn't one of the 8 for Strangers & Freaks. More in sunken treasure and shipwrecks.
These pop up in the open world. It's not known whether they count toward the trophy.

D-Bag, the gym bro: on Shore Drive, across from the Hotel Dixon, he bets you $1,000 you can't make him tap out of a chokehold. MrBossFTW files him under strangers and random encounters. See the D-Bag challenge.

Todd and the sniper: west of the highway into Hamlet, near Grassrivers, you'll hear a gunshot. It's two hunters, one of them Todd, with a sniper rifle on the ground. Drive them to the hospital and one of them hands you the rifle, per KhrazeGaming. More in unique weapons.
The missing spouse: Kotaku describes someone who needs help finding their spouse after a night of partying. It's one of the random events you can stumble into while exploring.

Jimmy and the spear gun: BennyCentral describes a drunk named Jimmy, wearing a captain's hat and carrying a Bullhead spear gun, who tries to rob you at a spot he marks on the map (the place name isn't clear in the audio). Don't fight him right away. Follow him to the pool, and while he's distracted, grab the spear gun, which is great for diving. If you want the hat too, knock him out and pick it up off the ground. That's two free items from one encounter.

p.h: Other strands on the trophy list
l: Besides Kenton, the trophy list has awards for finishing the final mission of four more characters: Andy (Road to Rehabilitation), Billy (The Lone Rider), Randy (Supply & Demand) and Tyrone (Spin On This!). According to PowerPyx, none of these count for Strangers & Freaks: each has its own trophy.
Map index: GamesRadar+ says the Exploration tab lists optional quests. MrDalekJD shows that favors for your neighbors show up there too.
Listen: Kotaku's advice is to follow shouting and loud noises. Press L3 + R3 (focus) to see where a sound is coming from, then go take a look.
See also the platinum trophy guide.

How many stranger missions are in GTA 6? The Strangers & Freaks trophy asks for 8 strands. According to PowerPyx and Jojo Gaming Guides, the ones that count are Kirk, Kyle, Alvan, Yago, Pilot Pete, Dr. Merle, Freddie and Papa Audacity.

Where do you find stranger missions in GTA 6? In the Exploration tab of the map index, which lists optional quests and favors for your neighbors. Shouting or commotion on the street is often someone who needs help, too.
What is the first stranger mission in GTA 6? The easiest is neighbor Shirley, on the corner by Jason's house. She wants a bottle of rum from the Three Sheets liquor store.
Jason makes off on Peggy's mobility scooter during neighbor Shirley's second favor.

t: Can You Play GTA 6 on PC, PS4, Xbox One or Game Pass?
r: GTA 6 is only on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. There is no PC or PS4 version, Xbox One can only stream it from the cloud, and it isn't part of Game Pass.

l: You can't play GTA 6 on PC or PS4, and it isn't on Game Pass. The game runs on PS5 and Xbox Series X · S only. Xbox One owners are the one exception: they can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming, but they still have to buy it.
