Game Pass · Not included

PlayStation's official page is blunt about it. GTA 6 is only playable on PS5 consoles and will not be available on PS4. If you're on PS5 Pro, you get extra clarity from PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) plus ray-traced shadows, on a compatible display.

The game doesn't install or run natively on Xbox One. According to Xbox, older consoles can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming, which started serving GTA 6 at 1 a.m. ET on November 19. To do that you need two things:
Your own copy of the game. Cloud access doesn't include the game itself.
Cloud playtime. Game Pass members can use their plan's monthly cloud hours. Without Game Pass, you can buy cloud playtime in the Xbox Store or play with ads, in select regions.

Rockstar says the streamed version uses Xbox Series S graphics settings, and that your connection speed can affect how it plays. Its support page lists cloud play only on Xbox Series X · S and Xbox One consoles.

The official Xbox FAQ answers this one directly: GTA 6 isn't available with Game Pass, and players must purchase it. Windows Central's Xbox review lists Game Pass as "No" too. Nothing has been announced about it joining the service later.

Rockstar's support page only lists PS5 and Xbox Series X · S. On launch day, Kotaku still described a PC port as only a rumor, so there's no official version or date. Rockstar does say the game supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox, which streams from a console you already own. According to GameSpot, Microsoft has now confirmed Xbox Remote Play support.

What about the videos of GTA 6 running on PC? On November 23, the leaker Cyberleek released the executable for the leaked Xbox build, and fan groups are trying to get it running. So far it only boots to a black screen or shows the menus. It isn't playable, and every "GTA 6 PC" download is fake or unfinished. Full story in GTA 6 on PC: the Cyberleek leak explained.

Check how much room you need in our GTA 6 download size guide and what each edition adds in Ultimate Edition bonuses. Performance on each console is covered in GTA 6 FPS and performance, and our beginner tips help once you're in.
Is GTA 6 on PS4? No. PlayStation says GTA 6 is only playable on PS5 consoles and won't be available on PS4.

Can you play GTA 6 on PC? Not right now. Rockstar lists only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and no PC version has been announced. The clips of it running on PC come from a leaked build that isn't playable yet.
Is GTA 6 on Game Pass? No. Xbox says you have to buy the game. Game Pass members can only spend their monthly cloud hours streaming a copy they own.
Can you play GTA 6 on Xbox One? Only through Xbox Cloud Gaming, with the game purchased and cloud playtime available. It doesn't install or run natively on Xbox One.
GTA 6 running on Xbox Series X, from Digital Foundry's tech review.

t: How to Make GTA 6 Easier: Difficulty, Accessible Combat and Vehicle Damage Settings
r: GTA 6 has easy mode options in the Gameplay settings: Accessible Combat cuts the damage you take, Reduced Vehicle Damage protects your car and Simplified Mini Games removes the timing.

l: To make GTA 6 easier, open the settings and go to the Gameplay tab. The options that matter most sit at the very bottom of the list: Accessible Combat, Reduced Vehicle Damage and Simplified Mini Games. According to JuiceHead, you can flip them on and off whenever you like, even halfway through a police chase.
Everything here comes from JuiceHead's video, played on Xbox, with the menu text checked frame by frame.

p.h: The options that make it easier
l: Setting · What it does
Accessible Combat · Lowers enemy health and the damage your character takes. The game warns that it changes the balance a lot.
Reduced Vehicle Damage · Your car shrugs off crashes. JuiceHead slammed into things over and over and the car stayed in one piece.
Simplified Mini Games · Simplifies interactions like exercising, hotwiring and basketball.
Auto Drive · Drives you to your destination on its own. See how auto drive works.
When you save, the game warns that these changes can have a big impact on your experience. If you don't save, everything goes back to how it was.

With Accessible Combat on, JuiceHead took on a five-star wanted level right at the start of the game. He soaked up a lot of gunfire without body armor and kept going, then escaped by stealing a boat and running along the coastline. To shake the cops without help, read how to lose the police.

His approach is to use it only when things get ugly. If a chase goes wrong or you're carrying a lot of stolen cash, pause, scroll to the bottom of the Gameplay tab, switch it on and jump back in. Turn it off again afterwards.

What about trophies? JuiceHead says these settings don't disable trophies or achievements, unlike GTA 6 cheat codes, which only unlock after you finish the story. His video never shows a trophy unlocking with Accessible Combat on, so treat that as his claim for now.
The aiming options are at the top of the same tab:
Targeting: 3 modes. JuiceHead says the game starts on partial lock-on. You can switch to full Lock-On or turn locking off.
Lock-On Target Switch: while locked on, your aim jumps from one enemy to the next. JuiceHead recommends turning it on.
Aim Assist Strength and Lock-On Time: sliders for how strong the assist is and how quickly it locks.
Drive-By Assist: when you fire from a vehicle, your aim snaps to nearby targets.
The rest of the useful menu tweaks are in the best GTA 6 settings.

Movement Speed sets your top speed on the left stick. There are 4 choices: Walk, Fast Walk, Jog and Run. JuiceHead says it defaults to Walk. On Run, pushing the stick all the way makes you run, and easing off lets you move slower. He says this run doesn't use stamina, though it is slower than a real sprint.
Right below are Combat Movement Speed, which does the same in a fight, and Stand & Sprint, which stands you up automatically when you sprint out of a crouch.

p.h: Simplified Mini Games and working out
l: Lifting weights normally asks you to time the triggers. With Simplified Mini Games on, JuiceHead says the timing part goes away, which helps a lot if you plan to train every day. Training also raises your health and stamina; JuiceHead covers that in the same video.

p.h: These settings don’t cost you trophies
l: According to Kotaku, these options are unlocked from the start and don't block trophies or saving, unlike cheats. The path is Pause > Settings (bottom of the list) > R1/RB to Gameplay > the Accessibility section at the end. Auto Drive has an Unrestricted setting that lets you use it even during chases.

Can you change the difficulty in GTA 6? You can make it easier from the Gameplay tab in the settings. The biggest switch is Accessible Combat, which lowers enemy health and the damage your character takes.
Does Accessible Combat disable trophies in GTA 6? JuiceHead says no: unlike cheat codes, these settings keep trophies and achievements on. His video doesn't show a trophy popping with them enabled.

How do you make your character run without holding a button in GTA 6? In the Gameplay tab, change Movement Speed from Walk to Run. Pushing the left stick all the way then makes you run, and easing off slows you down.
Can you turn on Accessible Combat in the middle of a chase? Yes, according to JuiceHead. Pause, scroll to the bottom of the Gameplay tab, switch it on and save. Turn it back off once you're safe.
Bottom of the Gameplay tab: Accessible Combat lowers enemy health and the damage your character takes.
Simplified Mini Games makes exercising, hotwiring and basketball easier.
Movement Speed set to Run: pushing the left stick all the way makes your character run.

t: GTA 6 Hidden Features the Game Doesn't Explain
r: GTA 6 lets you flip your car back over by pushing it, sit anywhere, turn on autopilot, keep outfits in the trunk to shake the cops and skip a taxi ride for about $100. Here are the controls.

l: GTA 6 has a lot of controls it never really explains. These come from Kotaku, whose writer had played over 140 hours when he wrote them up, and from YouTube guides by MrDalekJD, BennyCentral, KhrazeGaming and others. Controls are listed for PS5; on Xbox, Square is X, Circle is B and Triangle is Y.

p.h: Flip your car back over (and push boats)
l: In GTA 5 you just wiggled the stick. In GTA 6 it's muscle:
Walk into the side of the flipped car and keep walking.
After a few seconds, Jason or Lucia braces against it and a shove prompt shows up.
Press Square until it's back on its wheels. KhrazeGaming tapped it repeatedly.

That's how MrDalekJD, BennyCentral and KhrazeGaming did it, with no other button first. Kotaku describes it a little differently: lean on the car, click the left stick (L3), then hold Square. If one way doesn't work for you, try the other.
MrBossFTW combines the two: start by walking into the car, and if it's too heavy, hold Square to charge up a stronger shove. Still stuck? Try the other side, or ram it with another car.

It won't work if the car is too heavy, you run out of stamina, or you're on a steep slope. The same move lets you push a car that's out of gas and shove a boat or jet ski off the sand into the water. It saves you a towing fee, and it's handy mid-chase, because the police block the app that brings your car to you.

On foot, hold Circle. On grass or sand your character sits down; elsewhere they rest on one foot; near a wall, they lean on it. No gameplay reason, but great for watching the beach or a campfire at night.

p.h: Your car has its own menu
l: Car menu: hold Left on the D-pad while driving. The radio stations and podcasts come up first; MrDalekJD then pushes the stick up to reach the vehicle menu. From there you can switch the headlights and high beams, turn on the hazards, roll the windows up or down and open or close the trunk. Some cars have extras, like opening the truck bed on a big 4x4 or putting the roof down on a convertible.
The trunk closes itself: no need to shut it by hand; it closes when you drive off.
Turn signals: tap Left or Right on the D-pad. Kotaku noticed NPC drivers seem to react.
Door-check people: MrDalekJD found that pressing Square while driving swings the passenger door open for a second or two. Time it right and it knocks riders off motorbikes and bicycles.

Leave the engine running: the car normally shuts off when you step out. JuiceHead's fix is to double-tap Triangle as you get out, which keeps the engine and radio on. Handy for photos of your car or for keeping the music going while you do something nearby.

p.h: Cop car sirens clear the road
l: Drive a police car with the siren on and the traffic ahead pulls aside, along with people on the street. Milo tried it heading toward a group of pedestrians and they all stepped out of the way. It's a quick way across town without sitting in traffic. JuiceHead adds that even auto drive moves more freely in a cop car with the siren going.
On a long trip, your character can drive for you:
Set a destination on the map first. It won't work without an active route.
While driving, hold Down on the D-pad and press Circle, according to BennyCentral.
KhrazeGaming uses the same menu but holds Circle: that switches on the cinematic camera, and from there he turns on auto drive.

You can change the speed, from crawling to as fast as the car goes. It works best on boats, where there's barely any traffic. On the road your character obeys the law, stopping at every red light and waiting for pedestrians.
The full walkthrough, with the on-screen prompts, the three speeds and the Auto Drive setting, is in how to use auto drive in GTA 6.
There's no free fast travel, but a cab does the job. Early on the service is Paradise Taxi, which you'll find in your phone contacts. Kotaku used the RydeMe app instead.
Call a cab and confirm a destination. It can be on the other side of the map.
The ride has its own fare. KhrazeGaming paid $350 for a long trip.
To skip the drive and load straight in at the destination, pay about $100 more. BennyCentral, KhrazeGaming and Kotaku all mention that price. In-game time still passes.

The button to skip depends on who you ask: Kotaku holds the left trigger to focus on the driver and picks the fast travel option, while BennyCentral just gets the option after choosing a destination. GamesRadar+ spells it out: once you're in the car, focus on the driver with L2 and ask to skip with Triangle, for the extra $100. KhrazeGaming says more taxi services unlock later in the story, and he uses the skip to reach places he's never been.
GamesRadar+ adds a few details on each way to get around:
Paradise Taxi: you get the number during a Chapter 1 mission, and it sits in your phone contacts. It takes cash only, so carry some bills or hit an ATM first.
RydeMe: unlocks in Chapter 2 and charges your BuckMe bank account rather than your wallet. In Chapter 3 you can sign up for BuckMe Premium, and one of its perks is 20% off every RydeMe trip.
Buses and trains: they work too. Hold down on the D-pad to see nearby stops and stations, wait at the stop, board, pick a destination on the line and hold Triangle to skip the journey.

For a sense of cost, Imack Studios set Jason's house as the destination from Vice City and Paradise Taxi wanted $268 for the ride, which he couldn't cover at the time. Every option, with prices, is in how to fast travel in GTA 6.

Cars run out of gas now. MrDalekJD says a full tank lasts about 20 to 30 minutes of driving, which goes faster than you'd think when you're exploring. Keep an eye on the gauge and fill up before a long trip so you don't run dry in the middle of a chase. See how to refuel and repair your car.

p.h: Tolls cost $5, unless the car isn’t yours
l: Leonida's highways have toll booths. According to MrBossFTW, each one costs $5, but you don't pay if you're driving a stolen car or a friend's vehicle. On a long run with several booths, that adds up.

p.h: Listen to the radio on foot
l: Buy headphones at an electronics store. NorZZa found them at Zeke's Electronics in Hamlet, north of the Keys, which also sells phone cases. With headphones on, hold Left on the D-pad on foot to play music or podcasts while you walk around.

JuiceHead bought his at a store in Hamlet whose sign on screen reads Zeke's Gadgets. NorZZa called it Zeke's Electronics; go by the name the game shows. JuiceHead says most other electronics stores carry them too. What the store screen shows:
Model and price: Clef Earbuds, $119, in 4 colors.
Turning them on and off: after you buy them, a tip says they live in your loadout. Hold the D-pad and press X (A on Xbox) to switch them on or off.

According to JuiceHead, the earbuds play separately from your car. Whatever you were listening to doesn't carry over when you get in, but a podcast picks up where you left off. He also notices a slight noise-canceling effect while they're in.
Store clothes and guns in your personal car's trunk. Changing outfits is a fast way to lose the cops' attention. BennyCentral and KhrazeGaming both swap outfits at the trunk after a crime.
Build and store outfits at any clothing store with a changing room, no trip home needed.
Rename your saved outfits (clubbing, hunting, everyday) so you know what's in the trunk without trying it on.
Shop as a couple: bring both Jason and Lucia to buy for both. Buying clothes for your partner earns romance points.
More in how to lose the police.

Scooter Bros: brings your car to you, repairs it and gets it out of the impound lot, for a fee each time. Premium costs $12,500 and gives you 3 free uses per in-game day. BennyCentral says it pays for itself over time.
Joey, the mechanic: call Joey from your contacts and your car shows up in front of you fully repaired, wherever you left it, for free. MrDalekJD and KhrazeGaming both showed it.
Waink: hold Up on the D-pad to scan a car and check it for an advanced tracker. See how to steal cars.
Strong rumble: BennyCentral says a sudden strong vibration while you're on foot means there's something nearby worth scanning with Waink, like a piece of art. That's why he leaves vibration on.
Reminders: this phone tab tells you who to call or text back, and it often opens new story moments.

Hear shouting? If you hear shouting, sirens or a loud argument, turn on focus to find the source. It's often a random event or a side quest, from a drug deal gone wrong to a man looking for his wife who vanished after a night out. That's how BennyCentral found a crashed plane full of loot.
Doors: in focus, a white door means you can go in and a red door is alarmed, according to MrDalekJD. Kotaku also says alarmed doors glow red. On a job, look for another way in.

p.h: Rooftops, guard dogs and pet snacks
l: Go in from above. MrBossFTW points out that a lot of places have more than one way in, including open ceiling hatches. If you want to slip into an enemy compound unseen, try the roof.
Attack dogs: if someone sets a dog on you and you'd rather not hurt it, fire at the ground near it. The shot scares it off.
Pet snacks: the cashier at convenience and grocery stores sells them. Feed them to friendly animals or toss one to distract a guard dog.

At the surface, tap sprint to swim faster, which drains stamina. Once it's empty, dive: underwater the game switches to your lung capacity bar, so you're back at top speed. This one is from BennyCentral.

Talk to the cop: at one star, hold the left trigger on the officer with no gun out and choose to defuse. The star goes away. BennyCentral says it works on regular people too, though some will still attack you.
Whistle: GamingBolt says you can whistle to grab an enemy's attention and draw them away, which helps when sneaking. The video doesn't say which button.
Eat and drink before heading out: food and drinks buff health, stamina and focus. You can eat while driving or shooting.
Pet dogs and cats: hold the left trigger on the animal and choose to praise or pet it. It buffs focus and adds good behavior points.
Throw away your garbage: also boosts focus and good behavior.
Repair at gas stations: any pump fixes your car for a small fee, cheaper than Scooter Bros. Joey is free, though.
Zombix: the game's healing item. If it's not on the shelf, ask the clerk.
Shave at home: the mirror in your safehouse bathroom trims your beard and hair. New styles need a barber.
For the rest of the early game, see the beginner tips and the GTA 6 index guide.

p.h: Control shortcuts the game doesn’t teach you
l: Kotaku rounded these up:
Radio: double-tap left on the d-pad to turn it on or off.
Headlights: in a car, double-tap circle (B on Xbox) to cycle off, low and high beams.
Yell at drivers: click R3.
Walk around a moving boat: while driving one, double-tap triangle (Y on Xbox) to stand up and walk the deck as the boat keeps going.

How do you flip your car back over in GTA 6? Walk into the side of the flipped car and keep pushing until your character braces against it and a shove prompt appears, then press Square (X on Xbox). Kotaku clicks the left stick first and holds Square. It fails if the car is too heavy or you run out of stamina.
How do you sit down in GTA 6? Hold Circle (B on Xbox) on foot. On grass or sand your character sits; elsewhere they rest on one foot, and near a wall they lean on it.

Is there fast travel in GTA 6? Sort of. Call a cab with Paradise Taxi or RydeMe, pick a destination and pay about $100 on top of the fare to skip the ride. Buses and trains let you skip the trip too. In-game time still passes.
How do you use turn signals in GTA 6? While driving, tap Left or Right on the D-pad. Kotaku noticed other drivers seem to react to them.
A flipped car: lean on its side and the game offers to shove it back over.
At Zeke's Gadgets, the Clef Earbuds cost $119 and come in 4 colors.

t: How to Sell Cars in GTA 6 (Moses, Randy and Car Registration)
r: Sell stolen cars at a Pay 'n' Spray (3 a day), to Moses or to Randy. Here's what they pay, how to register a car you want to keep, and how to get one out of the impound.
b: how often can you sell cars to Moses

l: You can sell a stolen car in three places in GTA 6: a Pay 'n' Spray, which takes up to three cars a day, and the story's two car buyers, Moses (Chapter 2) and Randy (Chapter 3). If you'd rather keep a car than sell it, you have to register it, and that only unlocks in Chapter 2.
Where · What they buy · Unlocks
Pay 'n' Spray · Any stolen car, 3 per day · PC Gamer doesn't say
Moses · Older, low-end models · Chapter 2, mission 5 (Moses), Port Gellhorn, Kelly County
Randy · Only certain flashy, expensive cars · Chapter 3, mission 16 (Steal the Zorruso for Randy), Balsero, Vice City
All of that comes from PC Gamer. The cars on Randy's list, and where to find them, are in our Randy rare car guide.
The 7 cars Moses asks for in Chapter 2 are in Moses drop-off locations.

p.h: Scan the car first with Waink It
l: You get the Waink It app in Chapter 1, during Unwanted Attention, when Cal installs it on your phone. Point it at a car and, according to PC Gamer, it shows:
make and model, lock, alarm, whether it's keyless and whether it has a tracker;
the car's condition and how much it sells for;
what it costs to register;
whether the car suits Moses or Randy.
How to get into each kind of car, and when the slim jim and key cloner unlock, is in how to steal cars.

p.h: Selling to Moses again and again
l: Ashy shows a simple loop for selling several cars to Moses without leaving his block. It's just the normal sale, repeated:
Unlock Moses. He shows up in Chapter 2, in the mission Moses. Ashy needed roughly 10 hours of play to get there.
Head to his shop. The sign on screen reads Watkins Auto Parts, owned by Moses "Mo" Watkins.
Check the corner by the shop. Ashy says there's almost always a car parked there.
Scan it with Waink It. Look at what it's worth and whether it has a tracker. Only a car with no tracker will do.
Pop the driver's door with the slim jim. Gang members hang around that spot, so get in without them seeing you. More on the tool in our slim jim and snap gun guide.
Deliver it to Moses. He pays by transfer straight into your bank account, not in cash.
Walk back to the corner and go again.
There's a cap. After a few deliveries Moses stops taking cars. Play another mission and he opens up again.
Ashy plays as Lucia here, so this isn't a Jason-only thing.

PC Gamer's money guide puts stolen cars at anywhere from $1,000 to $20,000 each, depending on the model and the buyer. In Chapter 2, a decent car for Moses usually brings in one to a few thousand dollars. PC Gamer calls it the best quick profit at that stage for little risk: it beats most smash-and-grabs you'll be doing then, and Moses pays better than the Chapter 2 goods fence. The rest of the fences are listed in our fence locations guide.

Ashy got less than that: $670 for one car and about $700 for another, both everyday cars from the corner by the shop. The price depends on the car, and Waink It tells you what it's worth before you drive it over.

Rare cars are a different story. Typical Gamer, about halfway through the campaign, found a Progen Royal Ruby Emerus at a mansion, unlocked, with its alarm off and no tracker. Waink It valued it at $30,000.

According to GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer, GTA+ members get 10% more when they sell a car they own at a Pay 'n' Spray. GamesRadar+ notes one exception: cars that come with the Ultimate Edition can't be sold. The rest of the membership perks are in every GTA+ reward in GTA 6.

Your first registration at Moses is free. ConCon shows that the first car you register at Moses' garage costs nothing; after that you pay full price. Choose well: bring a car you actually want, or at least one that's pricey to register. His respray is free too, according to ConCon. WAiNK shows the registration cost of each car along with its sell value.
Registered cars come to you. In the Scooter Bros app, pick the car and pay the delivery fee: it was $110 for ConCon.

Advanced trackers: sports and super cars carry a tracker that pings the cops. According to LunarGaming, you can only steal them with the key cloner, which you get in a Randy mission in Chapter 3, and you can only keep or sell them after finishing Randy's car missions.

Not in Chapter 1. MrDalekJD says you're stuck with the starter car. You can steal cars off the street, but they aren't saved for good. DPJ also thinks an unregistered car is gone once you reload your game.
Unregistered means still stolen. The police keep treating the car as stolen until it's registered, MrDalekJD says.
Unlocks in Chapter 2, after the main story mission Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Where: at a Pay 'n' Spray, per PC Gamer and GamingBolt. DPJ drove his car back to Moses and registered it there.
Cost: Waink It shows the price for each car. DPJ paid around $6,750 to register a rare car, and registering it swapped the license plate.
Size limits: GamingBolt found a monster truck that wouldn't fit inside the Pay 'n' Spray, so it couldn't be registered.

p.h: Inside the La Perle Pay ‘n’ Spray
l: Typical Gamer took the Emerus to the Pay 'n' Spray in La Perle, and the shop handles everything from one menu: Repair, Respray ($200 for red), Register and Sell. So the same place can make a car yours or buy it off you. A second tab, Stored Vehicles, lists the cars you've already put away.

Registering the Emerus cost $29,900, nearly its full resale value, and the price matched what Waink It had shown out on the street. The game describes registering as swapping the plates and putting the car in your name. He couldn't cover it with $25,392 in the bank and $9,671 in cash. On screen, the registration price only shows the BuckMe bank icon, so it seems to come out of your bank balance alone. No source has tested that yet.

Trackers are still a gray area. MrDalekJD says you can register cars that don't have a tracker. PC Gamer says a standard tracker only stops you from upgrading the car at a shop until it's registered. When in doubt, keep a car with no tracker.
GamingBolt has one more tip for once you own a few cars: swapping rides at a Pay 'n' Spray helps throw off the police.
A garage: buy one through the real estate app on your phone. PC Gamer says each garage fits one car; GameSpot says one or a couple.
Moses' garage: GameSpot says Moses hands you a free garage during the story, Port Gellhorn Station, just north of his shop.
Outside your safehouse: the parking spots out front also work for a stolen car, according to PC Gamer.

p.h: Getting a car out of the impound
l: Open the Scooter Bros app on your phone. Kotaku and BennyCentral both say it gets your car out of the police impound, for a fee. BennyCentral adds that the same app brings your car to you and repairs it, with every use costing money. He suggests saving up for Scooter Bros Premium: $12,500 for 3 free uses per in-game day.
The sources only talk about your own vehicles. None of them say whether an unregistered stolen car ends up in the impound.

How do you sell cars in GTA 6? Take a stolen car to a Pay 'n' Spray, which takes up to 3 a day, or sell it to Moses (Chapter 2) or Randy (Chapter 3). The Waink It app tells you which of the two wants it.
If I steal a car in GTA 6, can I keep it? Yes, if you register it. Registration unlocks in Chapter 2 after the Moses mission and costs money; until then the cops keep treating the car as stolen.
How do you register a car in GTA 6? After the Moses mission, drive the car into a Pay 'n' Spray. Waink It shows the price; DPJ paid around $6,750 for a rare car.
How do you get a car out of the impound in GTA 6? Use the Scooter Bros app on your phone, which charges for every use. Premium costs $12,500 and gives you 3 free uses per in-game day.
Inside Moses' shop, the prompt in the corner shows the button to talk to him.

t: Is Paul Walker's Car in GTA 6? Where to Find the Fast & Furious Eclipse
r: Yes: GTA 6 has a nod to Paul Walker's green Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious, in a garage on Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands. Wait until you unlock Moses so you can register and keep it.

l: Paul Walker's car is in GTA 6. It's a nod to the green Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious, decals included, and it sits in a double garage on Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands near Vice Beach. DPJ and Tristan both showed it, and GamesRadar+ has a guide too. GamesRadar+ calls it a Mitsubishi Eclipse, modeled on the bright green car Paul Walker drives as Brian O'Conner in the first movie.

The game doesn't call it an Eclipse. When Imack Studios pulled up on Vespucci Island in it and opened the map, the info card read Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF, listed as a Specialist: Tuner. That's the name the map uses, so look for it there when you want to track the car down later.
The original plate reads HAD YOU. Milo and Millzaa both point out that it's a nod to Brian's "I almost had you" line from the movie, and both show the plate on screen along with the green underglow.
Island: Vespucci Island, part of the Rialto Islands between Vice City and Vice Beach. You cross Catalan Island by bridge to get there.
The spot: a house in the middle of the island, with the car in its double garage.
Distance: Tristan puts it about 5 miles from Jason's house.

DPJ shows the exact map marker in his video at 1:52. GamesRadar+ backs up the spot: the garage is on Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands west of Vice Beach, which in turn sits east of Vice City.
You can grab it right at the start, but DPJ advises against it:
He believes cars like this don't respawn. If you don't register it, it may be gone when you reload your save.
Registering unlocks with Moses in Port Gellhorn, in Chapter 2.
Registering this car cost him about $6,750, so save up first.

Registering it for free. GamesRadar+ has a better plan: steal the car right before your first visit to Moses at the start of Chapter 2 and make it the first car you bring him. According to GamesRadar+, he registers that first one for free, which saves you a few thousand dollars. DPJ paid the $6,750, and his video doesn't say whether it was his first car for Moses. GamesRadar+ also notes that later on you can register cars at any Pay 'n' Spray, for a fee.
For how registering works, see how to steal cars in GTA 6.
Head to the garage on the Rialto Islands.
Break into the garage. The alarm goes off, but nobody showed up in the video: DPJ just waited for it to stop.
Before you leave, open the trunk and clear it out. Watch out for the snake, a Toy Story joke (more below).
Open the shutters and drive off. You don't need the slim jim.
Take it straight to Moses and register it. Registering swaps the plates (the original reads HAD YOU).

Tristan mentioned the snake first, and now two more channels have it on video. KingAlexHD opened the trunk and a big snake came straight out. Millzaa broke into the trunk on two separate runs and got a snake both times. His advice: when it lunges, mash Square (X on Xbox) as fast as you can, because if you're too slow, it kills you.
GamesRadar+ adds a few tips on the alarms:
Garage alarm: switch it off on the wall to your left as you walk in, and open the garage door from there. Move fast.
Snap gun: once you have it in Chapter 3, you can get into the garage without triggering the alarm. If you're quick with the switch, you don't need it.

Slim jim: Moses hands it over at the start of Chapter 2. It makes breaking into the car easier and stops the car alarm, which can keep the police away. It's optional too. Once inside, you hotwire the car and drive off.
Both tools are covered in slim jim and snap gun.
The Eclipse isn't the only Fast & Furious car in the game. Maka91Productions found Dom's Charger, a Bravado in game:
It's in the garage of a run-down house in Grayson, in the middle of town in Lummox County, near the top left of the map.
It's locked but has no alarm and no tracker, so you can grab it as early as Chapter 2, register it and keep it.
It comes rusty, just like in the movie. Paint it black at a Pay 'n' Spray to match Dom's.
The front plate reads DAY TWO, a nod to cars that leave the factory one day and are already modified the next.
Only one channel has shown it so far, so this part is unverified.

DPJ says it's super fast and one of the cars most worth keeping. GamesRadar+ agrees: it handles well and reaches high speeds, which makes it one of the best cars you can get, especially early on, since it costs nothing and doesn't draw much heat. For more rare cars with locations and times, see Randy's wish list cars.

Where is Brian O'Conner's car in GTA 6? Brian's green Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious sits in a house garage on Vespucci Island, near Vice Beach. Disable the alarm panel on the wall before opening the garage, then hotwire it: no key cloner needed.
Is Paul Walker's car in GTA 6? Yes. There's a nod to the green Eclipse from The Fast and the Furious, decals and all, stored in a double garage on the Rialto Islands in Vice Beach.
When should you get Paul Walker's car in GTA 6? After you unlock Moses in Chapter 2. You need him to register the car, and DPJ believes unregistered cars disappear when you reload your game.

How do you turn off the garage alarm for Paul Walker's car? According to GamesRadar+, you switch it off on the wall to your left as you walk into the garage. Be quick about it. With the snap gun from Chapter 3, you can open the garage without setting the alarm off at all.

How much does it cost to register Paul Walker's car? DPJ paid about $6,750 to register it with Moses in Port Gellhorn. According to GamesRadar+, it's free if this is the first car you bring to Moses at the start of Chapter 2.
The double garage where the car is stored.
On the Vespucci Island map, the car's info card shows its in-game name: Maibatsu '97 Penumbra FF.
The car's original HAD YOU plate, with green underglow.

t: GTA 6 Free Tank Forever: The Secret Bunker Mission and Door Codes
r: A hidden quest that starts at a Vice City memorial leads to two bunkers. You walk away with the legendary Russo's 1922 pistol, a rifle and a tank that always respawns. Codes 010317 and 085355.

l: GTA 6 hides a secret quest that ends with a tank you keep forever. It starts with a man at a Vice City memorial, runs through an apartment full of clues about a president's assassination and ends in two secret bunkers. Along the way you pick up the legendary Russo's 1922 pistol and a rifle.
KackisHD (YouTube) and MrDalekJD (TikTok, over a million views) both followed the same route. The door codes show on the in-game keypad display in KackisHD's video.
Go in daylight. KackisHD went at night and the man at the memorial wasn't there. He slept at his safehouse until morning.
Bring a flashlight for the second bunker, which starts out dark.
Both bunkers are on an island or deep in the woods, so part of the trip is swimming or on foot.
Head to the memorial in east downtown Vice City. KackisHD calls it the War Memorial; MrDalekJD calls it the Friends of Freedom landmark.
Talk to the man sitting by the wall and ask what really happened. He talks about a Cold War plot involving Cuba and the assassination of President Russo.
He gives you the address of his apartment in Little Cuba. It has a Cuban flag out front.
Inside there's a fallout shelter blueprint on the wall and a tape recorder. Listen to all of the recordings.
Check the photo (the back has a date on it) and the phone.
One photo says Shark Tooth Island, and the map on the wall has spots circled. That's your next stop.
Head to Shark Tooth Island, a remote island just north of Waning Sands in Leonard County. The road ends before it, so swim the rest.
At the bunker door, enter 010317.
Inside, follow the tunnel and turn right to switch on the power, then go through the doors on the left.
You're in the president's bunker: presidential seal, desk and red phone. There's also a photo of the president meeting an alien on Mount Chiliad.
Sit in the desk chair, check the drawer and pick up the phone. That turns on a radio in another room: follow the beeping and play the recording, which mentions Protocol 2.

Back at the desk, the drawer now has a classified document about Protocol 2 with the safe code. Both videos say the same number, but neither shows the safe being opened, so read it off the document in your game.
The safe holds the Russo's 1922 Pistol, a legendary pistol that stays in your weapon wheel.
There's a photo under it. Flip it over: the back says obsessed, the clue for the bigger bunker.
Go to the woods north of Watson Bay, in west Vice-Dale County, at one of the spots circled on the apartment map.
The big bunker's front entrance is shut. Climb the hill behind it and look in the tree line for a metal hatch in the ground and a keypad on a tree.
Enter 085355 and climb down the ladder.
It's dark. Head all the way to the far left and switch on the generator in the storage room.
Follow the beeping to another recording and listen to it.
Crouch under the door into the control room and press the button on the panel: the hangar door opens.
The hangar holds the tank and, according to MrDalekJD, a Cold War assault rifle.
The tank is yours for good. The hangar door stays open and the tank respawns there every time you come back.
It gets you to 5 and 6 stars in no time. In KackisHD's video the main gun never seemed to run out of ammo.
GTA 6 unique weapon locations
Every GTA 6 easter egg found so far

How do you get a free tank in GTA 6? Do the hidden quest that starts with a man at the memorial in east downtown Vice City. It runs through a bunker on an island north of Waning Sands and ends in a hidden bunker in the woods, where a tank always respawns.

What is the bunker code in GTA 6? The island bunker door opens with 010317. The second bunker's hatch, on a keypad attached to a tree, opens with 085355. The safe code in the first bunker is on a classified document in the president's desk drawer.
Does the bunker tank respawn in GTA 6? Yes. Once you open the hangar, the door stays open and the tank is there every time you come back, according to both videos.
The tank in the second bunker's hangar after you open the door from the control panel.

t: GTA 6 Legendary and Unique Weapons: All the Locations Found So Far
r: GTA 6 legendary and unique weapon locations by region: suppressed M306, gold KZ59, Assassin Nipper .38, Smuggler Gorse 425, Dirty Drifter, snipers and more.

l: GTA 6 has unique weapons: special variants with their own wraps and attachments that you couldn't afford to build early on. BennyCentral says there are 130 spread across Leonida, while WiLLiSGaming talks about "hundreds". Some are close to the start of the game.

When you pick one up, the game tells you it's a unique weapon variant and that, if lost, it can be recovered at the weapon locker in Ammu-Nation. WiLLiSGaming and YOUNG DIRK back this up: unique guns survive death and come back from the locker or your car's trunk. See how to store weapons in your trunk.
Not every unique gun is hidden: some are sold in gun stores (see the section near the end). And if you want an early-game route that grabs guns and cash in one trip, see GTA 6 secret early items.

Details for each are below. Names heard only in a voiceover may be spelled slightly differently in game.

p.h: How to spot a unique weapon
l: Yellow icon on the map. According to WiLLiSGaming, a small yellow gun icon shows up on the map when you're near a unique weapon. Arekkz Gaming calls it a golden gun icon, and inside gun stores it shows on the minimap.

No modding. OutlawGarry thought a blue weapon is yours and can be customized while a yellow one is unique and can't be, but he wasn't sure. Arekkz Gaming and BennyCentral now say the same thing: weapon variants can't be modified. What you find is what you get, which is why the ones that come with a scope and suppressor are so handy early on.

Not everything is unique. Grenade launchers and rocket launchers you find lying around are regular weapons: die with them and they're gone (WiLLiSGaming). The SM-69 sniper on the Key Lento radio tower and the Duke 5.56 rifles in hideouts are regular too, according to Arekkz Gaming, Rodwenn and RageGamingVideos. Keep those in your trunk.

Several spots have now been shown by more than one channel: the Kingfishers W-22, the tiger motel sniper, the swamp cabin guns, the Conspiracist Type 9, the glider pistol, the Crabshack VF5, the M306 rifle and the gold KZ59 at the fishing warehouse. When only one channel has shown a spot, the text says who.
KhrazeGaming calls it your first "yellow" (rare) sniper: top-tier accuracy and range with a long-range scope already on it.
Head to the west side of the highway into Hamlet, near Grassrivers, at a junction.
You'll hear a gunshot nearby. If you can't place it, press L3 + R3 (focus) to reveal where the sound comes from.
You'll find two guys (one is named Todd) with the sniper lying on the ground.
Play along: grab the truck down the road and drive them to the hospital.
At the hospital, one of them hands you the rifle for good.

p.h: Kingfishers W-22 Small Game Rifle (near silent)
l: A small game rifle with a scope and a suppressor that barely makes a sound. Headshots drop enemies instantly, which makes it great for stealth. KhrazeGaming and WiLLiSGaming both picked up this rifle.
Early on, Donnie tells you about a robbery opportunity at a Kingfishers compound in Grassrivers.
Bring firepower: WiLLiSGaming counts 20 or more enemies there. KhrazeGaming recommends coming by boat and picking off enemies on the pier from range.
Go into the building closest to the water, one of the gang's fishing shacks.
A weapons crate on a desk holds the rifle.
To get away, WiLLiSGaming takes one of the boats out back and leaves along the river.

Arekkz Gaming, BennyCentral and RageGamingVideos went after the same rifle. Arekkz and Benny call the spot Wetman Bay: a small island with a little dock and the gang's fishing shacks. Come in by the dock and the rifle is in a case inside the main cabin; Benny says it sits on the kitchen counter. Arekkz warns that body shots do very little damage, so aim for the head.

There's a bonus too. According to RageGamingVideos, behind the little red shed on the docks a scoped Duke 5.56 rifle is leaning against the wall. It isn't unique, but it's free. Put it in your trunk and it stays with you.
Clear the rest of the compound too: the drug bricks there go for about $350 each at Brian's lockup.

p.h: Black Eagle Import M306 rifle (Black Eagle warehouse)
l: This is WiLLiSGaming's favorite find: a marksman rifle with a scope and a suppressor. It sits in a Black Eagle warehouse, part of one of the game's gun store chains. He doesn't show where the warehouse is on the map.
Save first. The staff are unarmed, but they will call the cops. Once the police surround the building, the gun is out of reach. He needed the warehouse to himself for roughly 10 to 20 minutes.
Play as Lucia. The rifle is in a room you can only reach through a narrow gap, and Jason is too big for it.
As you walk into the warehouse, head left. The gap is behind a small opening in the wood. He used cover (R1 on PS5) to squeeze through.
The rifle is in a case inside. Leave through the same gap.

It took WiLLiSGaming 5 to 10 minutes to get in, and he says he doesn't know if there's another way. The same warehouse has a rocket launcher, and a safe in the office to the right of the entrance holds a Black Eagle Desert Eagle. The code going around online didn't work for him. Vexies has since opened it, using one code for the door and another for the safe. We've only heard those numbers in the voiceover, so they stay off this page until checked on screen.

p.h: Another way in: the forklift (Arekkz Gaming)
l: Arekkz Gaming showed where the warehouse is and a way into the room without the gap. It's next to the Black Eagle gun store, just down the road from the Griffin Shooting Range, the same range as the Conspiracist Type 9 (see below), so you can grab both on one trip. The warehouse is the big building to the right of the store.
Cover your face (bandana, hat or mask) before going in so the cops can't ID you.

Hop the fence. There are three workers on the ground floor: aim at them and threaten them until all three are on their knees. Stay close or they'll run and call the cops. Don't go upstairs: the people up there only notice you if you go up.
Go past the bars into the back storage room. There's a forklift there: hotwire it.

Three pallets block the hidden room. Line the forks up under each one, lift with the left stick, move it out of the way and drop it by pushing the stick down. Lining up the forks takes a bit of practice.
With all three gone, the room opens up: the M306 is in the corner, along with a rocket launcher.
According to Arekkz, the M306 is semi-auto, has a zoom scope and a suppressor, about 20 rounds per mag, and drops almost any enemy in one shot.

Vexies also moved the pallets with the forklift and took the rifle, marking the warehouse just below the space between the I and the D in LEONIDA. For the full route with a screenshot, see Black Eagle M306 location.

p.h: Swamp Bait revolver and Cruel Huntsman SM69 sniper (swamp cabin)
l: Two unique guns in one trip, according to WiLLiSGaming. They're in an abandoned cabin in the middle of the Pelican Valley swamp, near the Keys. Just walk in: the Swamp Bait revolver and the Cruel Huntsman SM69 sniper are both there.
Don't go at night. If an alligator grabs you in the water, it kills you in one go.

Millzaa visited the same cabin. He places the little house, which has no name on the map, just south of Hamlet, and you have to wade through a bit of river to reach it. Inside you'll find butchered alligators, a cleaver on the table and a body. The sniper is on the floor with a scope already fitted. The Swamp Bait revolver isn't out in the open: Millzaa spotted it by zooming in with Focus. There's also some footage on the floor showing what happened to the cabin's owner.

p.h: Cockroach Extreme carbine and Dvatek GL40 grenade launcher
l: WiLLiSGaming found both in Vice City, in the Vice-Dale area (he calls it "Dale County"), in the back storeroom of a store that anyone can walk into.
Go into the store and head for the storeroom.
Knock down the wall of toilet paper.
The Cockroach Extreme carbine and the Dvatek GL40 grenade launcher are behind it.
The carbine is unique. The grenade launcher isn't, so you lose it if you die.

Vexies narrows the location down to a storage unit just above Tequesta in Vice-Dale County, with a door that looks painted on but opens. WiLLiSGaming describes it as a store's back room, and both found the guns behind a wall of paper rolls. There's also food, body armor, grenades and a safe with a collectible card.

WiLLiSGaming found the Conspiracist Type 9, a unique SMG, in a junkyard west of Vice City, on SR-120 near Omega Pkwy, with Buckskin Swamp to the west. He says "Mariana County" out loud, but the map in his video puts the junkyard between Kelly County and Vice-Dale County. The weapon's name shows on screen. The same junkyard has a rocket launcher. He suggests waiting until Chapter 2, when the story takes you to that area anyway.
Jump the junkyard fence.
Look for an RV covered in antennas.
Round the back there's a bunker door. Inside you'll find a dead man and a weapons container with the SMG.
There are also grenades and a rocket launcher down there. Save the rockets for when you really need them: the launcher isn't unique and you lose it when you die.

Millzaa, Rodwenn and BennyCentral found the same SMG and give an easier landmark. The junkyard is a trailer park right across the street from the Griffin Shooting Range, a gun range in Balsero. On the map, Millzaa describes it as sitting "between the D and the A" of the word LEONIDA.
Stop in front of the shooting range, cross the street and climb the fence.
Go into the trailer. WiLLiSGaming mentions a bunker door at the back; Rodwenn and Millzaa show a hatch in the floor that drops into a cellar.
Down there, the Conspiracist Type 9 is in a gun case next to the rocket launcher, grenades and healing items.
According to BennyCentral, it's a machine pistol and goes into your pistol slot.
DPJ warns this one is easy to miss for good.
Near the end of Chapter 1, after the mission Swamp (with Brian), you have to pack Donnie's things at his trailer.
You load them into his car and drive it somewhere remote to destroy it.
Before you destroy it, open the trunk: the revolver is inside.
Destroy the car first and the weapon goes with it.

p.h: Sniper at the tiger motel (Manatee Motel)
l: Four channels have now shown this motel, with a tiger on the loose and a sniper as the prize.
BennyCentral describes a sniper with a custom wrap, taken from the Kingfishers, at an abandoned motel in Pelican Valley. It comes fully kitted out.

OutlawGarry calls the place the Manatee Motel and says it's just up the road from Key Lento, where the game starts. In his video, a group of hunters had a tiger locked up, it got loose and mauled everyone.

Millzaa found the motel marked on the map as an event. He puts it just south of Hamlet, about a mile from Jason's house. On the map in his video, that's the northern edge of Pelican Valley, across the water.
Rodwenn went to the same spot and took the sniper from the next room on the left.

This page used to say the area depended on who you asked (Pelican Valley or near Key Lento). Millzaa's map settles it: the motel sits in northern Pelican Valley, right below Hamlet, and the road from Key Lento gets you there.
When you get there, the tiger is on the attack. Wait for it and the wounded man to go down, or shoot it yourself.

Loot the rooms and the bodies for cash. OutlawGarry found a safe with $1,000 and left with about $3,300 in total. The safe at the back gave Millzaa $917 and Rodwenn just over $1,000. There's also a flare gun and some healing items.
Grab the sniper from the weapons case in the room next door. OutlawGarry found two snipers, one of them yellow (unique). Millzaa also picked up $640 worth of drugs in that room.
Leave quickly or be ready to fight: in OutlawGarry's video someone called the police, and in Millzaa's an armed group showed up right after.

Earlier, neither video made the weapon's name clear. Now it's settled: Millzaa's screen shows Kingfishers Laird 350 along with the unique variant notice, and Rodwenn and BennyCentral say the same name. Rodwenn adds that it comes with its own wrap, a sight and a stock upgrade. Don't mix it up with the Hunter's Laird 350 from the random event.

p.h: Sniper on top of the radio tower
l: Arekkz Gaming found a scoped sniper at the top of a radio tower in the starting area, close to the clothing store.
Take the stairs to the top platform.
Go through the door at the top and climb the ladder: the sniper is there.
Further up there's a parachute to jump off with.

Now we know which tower it is. It's the one in Key Lento, about 0.36 miles from Jason's house, according to Millzaa. Arekkz says it's near Donnie's trailer and counts as one of the game's 31 landmarks, so scan it with your phone before you climb. Millzaa, Arekkz and BennyCentral all call the gun the SM-69.

Heads up: this sniper is a regular gun, not a unique variant. Arekkz and Rodwenn both point out that you lose it if you die. On the same climb you'll find 2 collectible cards and the parachute at the top, which only works once. See collectible cards and parachutes.
The first video didn't make clear whether this is the same tower as the radio tower easter egg. Going by the locations, it isn't: the egg tower is near Hamlet, while this one is in Key Lento.

Milo found a propeller glider stuck in a tree on a small island in the south. Shoot the strings holding it up and it drops, with a unique pistol inside. The video places the island "just north of Mariana County" but doesn't show the exact spot.

Arekkz Gaming and BennyCentral went to the same glider and fill in the gaps. On Arekkz's screen the gun shows up as the Turnt Nipper .38 Pistol, with its own decal and a red dot sight already fitted. Benny describes the wrap as energy drink branding.
Head to Bobcat Bight, at the far end of the sandy strip. The glider is on a small island, so bring a boat or a jet ski.
Walk up from the beach to the pine trees. The wrecked glider is hanging in the branches with a bunch of ropes.
Shoot every rope. Arekkz used a rifle with a big magazine, since the last rope swings around and takes a few tries.
Once the glider drops, the pistol is inside it or on the ground right next to it.

This is the reward for the giant crab mystery in Mariana County. YOUNG DIRK shows it lying on the floor right inside the boathouse, scope already fitted, and it goes into your weapon locker. RageGamingVideos and Millzaa add that it also has a tactical flashlight and a biohazard wrap. The full solution, with all three codes, is in the giant crab mystery.

p.h: Marabunta Grande KZ59 rifle (Nova Auto junkyard, Hamlet)
l: Only BennyCentral has shown this one so far, and the name comes from his voiceover. It's a gold assault rifle engraved with M7 gang designs.
Head to the Nova Auto junkyard in Hamlet.
Climb the wall from the dumpster and take out the M7 gang in the yard.
The rifle is in a case on the workbench under the shed.
In the garage, the safe in the back room opens with 777, which is written right above it.
A button on the wall opens the garage shutter. Drive out in the lowrider inside: Benny says it has no tracker.

p.h: Gold KZ59 at the Palmer Fishing Warehouse (Bobcat Key)
l: BennyCentral and Arekkz Gaming have both shown this rifle. It's another gold KZ59 with fine engravings; the full name isn't clear in the voiceover, so we're not printing it. Arekkz doesn't name the place, but he describes a gang fishing warehouse with the same layout: computer with the code downstairs, rifle and safe upstairs.
Go to the Palmer Fishing Warehouse in Bobcat Key.
Fight your way through the gang and head up to the office: the rifle is in a case.

The computer downstairs gives you the code for the office safe. BennyCentral read out a different number from Arekkz and Vexies, and we haven't checked on screen which is right: read it off the computer in your own game. The safe gave Arekkz $3,000 to $5,000, and he thinks it refills after a few days.

Arekkz's route is through the water, by the bridge: climb up the small back dock, which works as a back door into the main building. Under the stairs there's a grenade launcher (not unique: stash it in your trunk) and upstairs a luxury watch on the table that sells well at the pawn shop.

Vexies ran the same robbery by circling left around the gate, taking the grenade launcher downstairs and finding the gold rifle upstairs near a gold watch. The warehouse on the left has more to steal, and a boat out back makes the getaway easy.

According to BennyCentral, a stilt house in Key Lento that looks a lot like Jason's belongs to a firearms enthusiast. Climb the back stairs and break the door open. The owner is home and comes at you. The unique sniper, with a patriotic wrap, is in a case on the kitchen counter, and the bedrooms hold body armor, a machine gun and an assault rifle. Benny marks the house on his map but doesn't give the street name.

Vexies found the same haul in a Key Lento house with a pool nearby, an outside staircase and an armed owner: a unique sniper, armor on the bed and a machine gun in the bedroom. It sounds like the same house. There are boats out back if the police show up.

p.h: Marabunta Grand Hobo shotgun (behind the Hamlet pawn shop)
l: RageGamingVideos found this engraved legendary double-barrel shotgun while visiting the Hamlet pawn shop at night. Behind the shop was a car with its trunk open, blood on the ground and screaming from the building next door. Follow the blood trail through a door into a warehouse: the shotgun sits in a gun case out in the open, with some cash. Whether you deal with what's in the next room is up to you. He isn't sure if it's a random event or if it always happens there.

p.h: Black and gold suppressed rifle (guarded manor south of Grassrivers)
l: Arekkz Gaming showed this spot. It's a fully automatic black and gold assault rifle, loaded with attachments and a suppressor. The name in his voiceover isn't clear, so we're not printing it.
Head to the guarded manor marked as an illegal opportunity on the edge of the swamp, just south of Grassrivers.
Bring a gun and, if you have them, armor and meds. Guards are all over the house, and once one spots you the rest come pouring out. With a suppressor you can try to stay sneaky.
Go in on the left side, along the riverfront, where there's an easy spot to hop in.
Head to the upper floor. The back corner room has a box of sticky bombs, and the rifle is right behind you.
Through the kitchen there's a luxury watch, and the computer shows the safe code; the safe gave Arekkz about $3,000. Read the code off the computer in your own game.

p.h: Suppressed rifle at the Watson Bay safe house
l: Vexies found a unique suppressed assault rifle at the Watson Bay illegal operation, which has high security.
Work around the back, keeping left, until you reach a blue tarp you can climb over.
Bring armor and healing: they barely survived the shootout.
The rifle is upstairs. The house also has a watch, about $5,000 in goods and a safe, with the code on the laptop.
Escape in the special vehicle in the garage.
This may be the same manor as the black and gold rifle from Arekkz. We haven't compared both maps yet, so they're listed separately.

p.h: Shotgun and suppressed pistol in the boat wrecks (near Mile Zero Air Station)
l: Shown by Arekkz Gaming and later by Vexies. You can grab both right at the start, as Jason.

Shotgun: in the cluster of small islands near Mile Zero Air Station and the Southwind port, go to the island with the sandy patch. On the north end, the green side, there's a small boat wreck, and the shotgun is on the ground next to it. He says it fires almost like a semi-auto.

Suppressed Nipper .38 pistol: at the tip of the pointy island at the south end of the same cluster there's another boat wreck. Climb in and open the hidden compartment with the on-screen prompt: the pistol is inside. Arekkz calls it the Assassin Nipper .38. It only holds about 8 rounds, but it's silent and free (a suppressor alone runs about $1,000 in the shop).

Two channels now back this up: Vexies took both guns from the same wrecks and uses the same names, Smuggler Gorse 425 and Assassin Nipper .38. WAiNK labels the pistol boat a derelict spy vessel. Full route: Assassin Nipper .38 and Smuggler Gorse 425.

p.h: Burst pistol at the Little Cuba shipping yard
l: Only Arekkz Gaming has shown this one. It's a silver, gold and ivory burst pistol; in his voiceover he calls it the Guardian ES 18.
Go to the shipping yard illegal activity by the port in the Little Cuba area of Vice City.
To get in quietly, go left of the main gate, climb the trash near the bridge and slip through the gap in the barbed wire.
The building in the middle of the yard has about 5 or 6 enemies. Use a suppressor or non-lethal takedowns, but expect a fight.
At the back of the building, by the door, there's a weapon case with the pistol. There's also a safe, but Arekkz couldn't find the code.
The gate button is to the left of the guard at the entrance. Open it if you want the red muscle car in the yard: he says Moses pays $12,000 for it.

Shown by Arekkz Gaming and ConCon. It's a rifle that already comes loaded with attachments, and you can take it without a fight. The spot is Brooks Boatworks: in ConCon's video the screen reads Clunker 556 Assault Rifle as he grabs it from a desk in the office with the monitors, at the top of the small building's outside stairs. It's the same room as the wall map with the safe codes. It's easy to get early in Chapter 2, once Lucia joins.
Go to the robbery opportunity next to the port bridge in Port Gellhorn.
Park outside the warehouse by the blue tarp fences, around the corner from the main entrance, so nobody sees you.
Hop the blue tarp fence, run past the warehouse and go through the hole in the next fence.
Take it slow to the marked small hut: the rifle is inside.
If you want, take the orange truck in the yard: it's great off-road and also sells.

p.h: Scrapper VF5C SMG (La Cascara Motel, Port Gellhorn)
l: Shown by GosuNoob and ConCon in Chapter 2. It's a compact military SMG sitting on a table in the rooftop hut of the La Cascara Motel, next to the 6969 safe. The route to the roof is in La Cascara Motel safe code.
Shown by Vexies, with 7.7 damage, higher than the store shotguns they compared it with.
Find Nifty Threads Islandwear on the map and follow the street to its end.
Look for the sea lion statue and enter the green house to its right. Expect armed men inside.
Go straight, take the left door, then turn left into the bathroom: the shotgun is at the back.
Grab the med kit and adrenaline on your way out. There's a free boat outside.

Also from Vexies. Leave the south of Key Lento by boat or swimming and head right of the two landmasses marked in the video. Dive to the sunken boat, turn on Focus and look under the hull. The same dive paid $3,600 in goods. Scuba gear helps, but Vexies managed without it.

On the same island as the Turnt Nipper .38, Vexies keeps going to the far end and, left of a small split in the land, twists open a cover. Inside is a unique combat knife that can also be thrown. The name sounds like Soldier's Combat Knife in the voiceover.
A fully automatic pistol, according to Vexies.
Go to the motel with the big sign marked just above Ambrosia.
Enter the room where everyone is passed out.
The pistol is on the right-hand nightstand.
The room also has a safe with a collectible card.

A sawed-off double barrel shown by Vexies. Go to the lookout camp in Bonanza at the top of the map, take the collectible and scan below with binoculars. Climb down to the car you spot and open the trunk.
PC Gamer found it on the pool table in the main room of the Port Gellhorn bowling alley. See also the bowling alley safe code.

p.h: Gold guns at the Kolt & Associates hideouts (Port Gellhorn)
l: RaidAway found two, during robbery opportunities you can run with a partner:
Kolt & Associates hideout near Dunk's trailer: a gold assault rifle that shows up with Focus once you're inside.
Brooks Boatworks, northwest Port Gellhorn: another gold weapon, just past the narrow entrance.
Neither gun is named in the voiceover.

Every gun store sells one or two exclusive variants, marked with the golden gun icon. Chuck's Tackle & Shot in Key Lento has the Mahi Nipper .38 for $1,160, and Big Shots in Hamlet has The Silver 1922 for $2,210: Arekkz Gaming and BennyCentral show the same prices. The full list, with bundles, is in GTA 6 gun store unique weapons.
According to KhrazeGaming, enemy hideouts refresh every few in-game days and restock goods and weapons. For buying and customizing everything else, see the GTA 6 weapons list.

What are unique weapons in GTA 6? Special weapon variants with their own wraps and attachments, hidden around the map, handed out in missions or sold in gun stores. They can't be modified. BennyCentral counts 130 of them, while WiLLiSGaming talks about hundreds.

Can you get a lost unique weapon back in GTA 6? Yes. When you pick one up, the game says that if it's lost, all owned weapons can be recovered at the Ammu-Nation locker. Regular grenade and rocket launchers you find don't count: you lose those when you die.

How do you get Donnie's revolver in GTA 6? At the end of Chapter 1, after the mission Swamp, you drive Donnie's car out to destroy it. Open the trunk first: the H&L 38 revolver is inside. Destroy the car and the gun is gone.

Where can you get a sniper early in GTA 6? The Hunter's Laird 350 comes from a random event near Grassrivers, west of the highway to Hamlet. The Kingfishers Laird 350 is at the Manatee Motel, just south of Hamlet. There's also a unique sniper in a Pelican Valley swamp cabin and a regular one at the top of the Key Lento radio tower.
The Hunter's Laird 350 in the weapon wheel, with accuracy and range near the top.
The weapons crate holding the Kingfishers W-22 Small Game Rifle at the Kingfishers hideout.
Donnie's car in the woods: open the trunk before you destroy it.

t: GTA 6 Easter Eggs: Every Secret Found So Far
r: Every GTA 6 easter egg found so far: the Vice City portal, the Mario block, Bigfoot (the Skunk Ape), the radio tower egg, the jet ski dog, the alien lab, Dexter and more.

l: GTA 6 launched packed with secrets, and players found dozens on day one. This list collects every GTA 6 easter egg that has been shown on video, from the most famous to the most hidden. The ones with a full walkthrough have their own page. The list grows every round.
When a secret has been shown by two different channels, it's marked confirmed. When only one channel has shown it, it's marked unverified.

A tower in the south, 12 electrical substations hit in the order that spells "Life Is Passing Me By" (an old Vice City cheat) and a power plant visit between 7 p.m. and 6 a.m. open a pink portal. It drops Jason into the PS2-era Malibu Club, with Kent Paul upstairs. Back home, you get Tommy Vercetti's blue shirt and a chopper. Confirmed: Kotaku and Dan Allen Gaming.
See the Vice City portal easter egg, with the switch for each substation.

The Grassrivers swamps are home to the Skunk Ape, the Bigfoot of Florida legend. You see it eating a deer on the road, find a wooden effigy in the woods and black out. That kicks off a hidden quest that ends with a camo sniper rifle. Confirmed: Punish, T5G, ZacCoxTV and JFM.
See the Skunk Ape mission.

p.h: The Easter egg on the radio tower
l: At the top of the tallest radio tower in the game, after about six minutes of ladder, there's a nest with an Easter egg. Throw it off the top and a cutscene plays. Confirmed: T5G, ZacCoxTV, Kotaku, Milo and InkTV. Milo and InkTV both ran into an influencer hanging out at the top, who chats with you and snaps a photo.
See the radio tower easter egg.

Stranded in the middle of Gambit Bay with no boat, you get rescued by a dog in a life jacket and goggles on a jet ski. It takes you to Dog Island, where a dog digs up about $1,200. Confirmed: ZoneX, ZacCoxTV, T5G, Kotaku and Milo.
See the jet ski dog location.

p.h: The alien lab and the alien dream
l: After the UFO abduction, the character who was taken dreams of alien eggs and a keypad. The light bars in that dream give you the code to a secret lab at South Point Airfield in Hamlet, near Pelican Valley. The code changes between playthroughs: 2134 and 2314 have both turned up (this list used to give only 2314). Down below there are skeletons, a bottle of milk and an alien you can set free. According to T5G, rescuing the alien gives you a permanent boost to stamina, health and focus (0:14). Confirmed: ZacCoxTV and GameSpot.
See the alien dream and the alien lab.
Michael's boat. The boat in Jason's yard is Michael's, the one stolen in a famous GTA 5 mission. Climb aboard and check the GPS: the Los Santos map is still on it. Confirmed: T5G and ZacCoxTV.
Michael's ringtone. On your phone, go to settings, ringtones, and pick "Wind Chimes". It's Michael's ringtone from GTA 5. Confirmed: T5G and ZacCoxTV.
Fabien, the yoga instructor. A magazine in Jason's backyard features Fabien from GTA 5, a little older. Unverified: ZacCoxTV.
Floyd and Debra. In a car with on-demand radio, a true crime podcast says Wade was arrested for the deaths of his cousins in Los Santos, a crime that was Trevor's in GTA 5. Unverified: ZacCoxTV.
Los Santos souvenirs. A trailer in Grassrivers has Grand Senora Desert and Grapeseed postcards and a newspaper with GTA 5's alien headline. Unverified: ZacCoxTV.
GTA 4. A book at Jason's house, "Lethal by Design", is the memoir of a Liberty City bodyguard who skipped the day Niko Bellic took out his crew. Unverified: ZacCoxTV.
Vice City. In the Keys, an iguana wanders around wearing Tommy Vercetti's shirt. Unverified: ZacCoxTV. To visit 2002 Vice City itself, see the secret portal at the top of this page.

San Andreas. Lil' Probe Inn bumper stickers on cars and a UFO-obsessed house just like San Andreas' in Bellville, with a meteorite under the bed you can sell. Milo got into the same house and found a snake in the trunk of the car parked out front, while InkTV opened the same trunk and found a revolver. Confirmed: ZacCoxTV, Milo and InkTV.
The Epsilon mystery. A truck with the Epsilon eye and a QR code. For now the code just leads to Rockstar's website. Unverified: T5G.

Race'n'Chase. A post on the in-game social feed complains that "Race and Chase 7" got delayed again. Race'n'Chase was the original name of the first GTA, so the joke is about the wait for GTA 6 itself. Kotaku spotted the post early in the game on Snapmatic, the phone's social app, where someone grumbles that even a game based on the kids' cartoon Barnyard Blue came out before "Race and Chase 7". Kotaku reads the 7 as a wink at GTA 7. Confirmed: T5G and Kotaku.

"Little Sam" (Chapter 3 spoiler). Skip this one if you haven't played the Chapter 3 mission "Boobie Time". When Jason meets up with Boobie Ike, a quiet guy called Little Sam shows up. Fans think he's Rockstar co-founder Sam Houser and point back to Sam in GTA 3, a minor character long rumored to be him. Rockstar won't confirm it. Confirmed: GamesRadar+ and Kotaku.

Tony the bird. According to Kotaku, Tony the bird from GTA San Andreas makes a cameo, with the same attitude as before. ZacCoxTV shows where: during the mission where neighbor Shirley sends you for rum, a foul-mouthed red parrot in a cage behind the liquor store talks about cash and gives away a hidden stash. Confirmed: Kotaku and ZacCoxTV. See the parrot money.

The old cities signpost. Tucked among the trees on a small island in the Keys is a wooden signpost pointing to Liberty City, San Fierro, Las Venturas and Los Santos, the cities from earlier GTA games. GameSpot lists it as a WAiNK curiosity, near an abandoned beach party in the middle island chain of the Permit Keys. The post has several arrows: ZacCoxTV reads Liberty City, San Fierro, Las Venturas and Los Santos, and vAnother Level gets a close look at the Los Santos and Vice City arrows. T5G also reads Vice City and Carcer City, the setting of Rockstar's Manhunt (20:00). Confirmed: ZacCoxTV, GameSpot, vAnother Level and T5G.

A photo from 2021. A location seen in a photo from GTA San Andreas: The Definitive Edition, released in 2021, has been found on the GTA 6 map by players from a fan mapping project. In other words, Rockstar was quietly showing a piece of Leonida five years early. T5G tracked the house in the photo down in Bellville (11:56). Break into the garage and there's a conspiracy board: the owner suspects he lives inside a video game, that everyone looks the same and that it's all one big loop. A Rottweiler guards the front door, a nod to Chop from GTA 5. Confirmed: Kotaku and T5G.

Dexter's apartment. Dexter Morgan's building is in Bay Harbor. You can't go in, but the roof has a knife, rope, gloves, plastic and handcuffs. A boat that looks like his is at the docks nearby. GamesRadar+ found the building too, with Dexter's tools on the roof, but places the complex on Washington Island. Confirmed: T5G, ZacCoxTV and GamesRadar+. In its second video, T5G goes further (9:43): in Key Lento, a beach house has a garage door you can break open to find Dexter's kill room, plastic sheeting and all. And in a Leonard County house, through the back door, a bedroom has a paint workbench and a severed mannequin arm with painted nails, a nod to the Ice Truck Killer. Unverified: T5G.
SpongeBob's house. A pineapple-shaped bus stop. Unverified: T5G.

Knockoff X-Men. Comics and trading cards with parodies of Magneto, Cyclops and others. GamesRadar+ highlights an issue of "RX Men" starring Dr. Placebo, a villain who looks a lot like Magneto. GameSpot says RX-Men sits on the magazine rack of the 24/7 store just east of Key Lento's main road. Confirmed: T5G and GamesRadar+. See magazines, books and comics.

Brian's car from Fast and Furious. Brian O'Conner's 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse, Paul Walker's car from the films, sits in a garage on Vespucci Island. According to GamesRadar+, it's already movie-accurate, no upgrades needed. See the Paul Walker Eclipse.

A Hulk in Leonida. A side quest involving strawberries ends with one character turning into a Hulk-like giant, torn clothes and all, according to GamesRadar+. Kotaku mentions a "Red Hulk" side mission that streamer IShowSpeed played live, which looks like the same one. Confirmed: GamesRadar+ and Kotaku. The giant is called Kyle, and at the end you can hug him or decline, as Aaraz Gaming's clip shows. See the Red Hulk.
Die Hard and Heat. Without going into detail, GamesRadar+ says later missions borrow heavily from both films. Heat had already inspired GTA 4's Three Leaf Clover mission. Unverified: GamesRadar+.

Bimyou, the "Japanese" bakery. Vice City has a Japanese restaurant called Bimyou whose sign promises sushi and ramen. Inside, it's a coffee shop, and "sushi" and "ramen" are the names of its breads. In Japanese, "bimyou" means something like "so-so". One of the breads is coppepan, a Japanese roll similar to a hot dog bun. Kotaku reports that players in Japan love the jab at restaurants that use Japanese words just to sound fancy. Unverified: Kotaku.

Arthur Morgan's hat. The Red Dead Redemption 2 hero's hat is for sale at a yard sale in Port Gellhorn, according to PC Gamer. In game it's called the Genuine Cowboy Hat. See Arthur Morgan's hat. T5G found one more Arthur nod (5:18): at the Leonard County mini golf course, there's a chihuahua on the deck of the Wild West saloon, and when you pet it you'll spot a tiny Arthur Morgan riding it. Unverified: T5G.

The Mario block. In brick ruins in the woods of Moreau, Lummox County, a half-invisible block floats near the top of the walls. Jump into it or shoot it and two caps drop: a J for Jason and an L for Lucia. Confirmed: Kotaku and TheGamingRevolution. See the Mario easter egg.

Better Call Saul in a dumpster. Walk past the right dumpster and a guy pops out to chat. He's a lawyer, and he wants painkillers. T5G reads it as a Better Call Saul reference (17:06). Unverified: T5G.
The Kill Bill truck. While stealing cars for Kenton, you may come across a yellow truck painted and decorated like the one in Kill Bill, and you can take it (15:35). Unverified: T5G.
MrBeast's chocolate. Around the map you can pick up a chocolate bar that looks a lot like Feastables, MrBeast's brand (23:12). Unverified: T5G.

Late-night abduction. Near Port Gellhorn, between 2 and 3 a.m., you can stumble on a flying saucer abduction. Get too close and you're next: the screen goes white and you wake up somewhere else (the next day for ZacCoxTV, about three days later for InkTV). Milo points to the north end of Kelly County, the same county as Port Gellhorn, at night and as Lucia, and says it's rare; he didn't catch it on his own footage. GameSpot says it only opens up after Chapter 1, and InkTV pulled it off at around 11:30 p.m., earlier than the others suggest. Confirmed: ZacCoxTV, GameSpot and InkTV. See the UFO abduction and, after it, the alien dream.

Meteorite on Mount Kalaga. At the top of the mountain there's a crater with a still-smoking meteorite. You can pick it up and sell it. There's also a ring of stones up there nobody has figured out yet. Unverified: ZacCoxTV. Milo showed a similar meteorite at the top of the map in Lummox County, where Mount Kalaga is: head east down the hill to a wrecked campsite with a glowing purple rock, and you can grab a piece. He doesn't name the mountain, so it may or may not be the same spot. T5G says meteor crash sites are scattered all over the map, and the rock he took to a pawn shop was worth just $50 (23:23).

The Kraken statue. Deep underwater in the southeast, just below Gloriana Key, there's a giant statue of an octopus grabbing a boat. A scuba diving boat sits above the spot, and a creepy figure appears nearby and sinks out of sight. Nobody has found treasure there yet. ZacCoxTV dove down to the statue, and Milo swam to the same spot without diving gear, spotted the statue's arm on the seabed and drowned before getting close. Confirmed: Robbin Rams, ZacCoxTV and Milo. T5G shows a shipwreck in the middle of the ocean wrapped in a dead kraken, which looks like the same spot (20:28).
Giant crab. Inside a building, a monster crab can attack out of nowhere. Confirmed: T5G and Kotaku. The mystery has since been solved, from the password to the reward: see the giant crab mystery.

The watchtower shed (code 69185). There's a fire watchtower on Mount Kalaga. Climb to the top: next to a magnifying glass is a sticky note with the word "shed" and the number 69185. The shed is under the tower's stairs, with a keypad on the door. Punch in 69185 and walk in. Inside is a UFO hunter's stash: alien stickers, a camera and the lookout's logbook, which has some strange drawings, including an abduction. Robbin Rams isn't sure the number is the same in every game, so check the note in yours. Confirmed: Milo and Robbin Rams.

A sealed bunker in Grassrivers. Out in the swamps there's a huge bunker with thick doors and, far from them, a hatch with a keypad that won't let you type anything. Focus doesn't highlight a thing. Nobody has found a way in yet. Unverified: Robbin Rams.

The SOS island. On a tiny island far out at sea there are cans everywhere, a giant SOS sign and a phone with a video recorded by the people who got stranded there. The video cuts off suddenly. Milo places it off the coast of Mariana County, in the south, but the name is hard to make out in his audio. InkTV also puts it in the south, right on the Mariana County line, and ZacCoxTV says it's out in the Keys, far from land. Besides the SOS, the words "SEND BEER" are spelled out in cans on the sand. T5G also places it off Mariana County and reads it as a nod to Lost: castaways, an SOS and something supernatural (17:41). Confirmed: Milo, ZacCoxTV, InkTV and T5G.

The desert island piano. On a tiny island south of Cottonmouth Lake and Gambit Bay (in the Shoeless Keys, according to vAnother Level), an old grand piano sits abandoned on the sand among the mangroves. It's one of the WAiNK app's curiosities, and GameSpot thinks it may nod to the 1993 film The Piano. Confirmed: ZacCoxTV and GameSpot.

The merman of the Keys. On a beach in the Keys, a man in a mermaid tail films himself on a tripod, talking in a high-pitched voice. You can mess with him: walk in front of his camera or knock the tripod over and he drops back into his normal voice. T5G found the same merman on the little islands, filming for his followers (18:29). Confirmed: ZacCoxTV and T5G.

Creature carcasses. In Wetman Bay, on an island north of a beach covered in dead sharks, lies the carcass of a half-fish creature. ZacCoxTV compares it to what people claim real mermaids look like, while GameSpot calls it alien remains. GameSpot lists two more carcasses as WAiNK curiosities, on Abismo Key and Goose Key, and each of the three has a meteorite nearby. Confirmed: ZacCoxTV and GameSpot.

The lighthouse ghosts. At night, climb the outside stairs of a tall lighthouse and greenish ghostly figures appear at the top. One goes over the railing while the other panics. Right after, Milo got The Truth Is Out There, the same trophy as the abduction. It only happens at night.
