T5G shows the same scene (14:08): arrive close to midnight and look up at the light with binoculars. A nearby house has the keeper's blue logbook. Come back at exactly 1:30 a.m., use the binoculars again and a ship appears; dive where it was and you'll find a wreck on the seafloor. Confirmed: Milo and T5G.

The haunted hotel. The Marbelle Hotel, a closed-down building for sale in Vice City, has a door that opens on its own and strange writing on the walls. After that the whole map turns into a foggy night, Silent Hill style, and a notebook on the roof has the safe code. Confirmed: Robbin Rams and T5G. See the haunted hotel.

The Port Gellhorn ritual and Satan (confirmed by T5G and MrDalekJD; full guide on its own page). In a Port Gellhorn house, a group surrounded by demonic imagery chats with you and eventually invites you to their ritual. A van picks you up, you wake up as they dance around a campfire, and they ask you to look into the flames. What follows is a Doom-style run through hell, with heavy rock and waves of demons, ending in a boss fight with Satan himself (5:38). Unverified: T5G.

The Capri summoning circle. Near Tortoise Lake in Capri, an abandoned office building has its door wide open. Inside are a pentagram on the floor, a book of human sacrifice drawings and writing on the walls. Bring the body of any NPC, place it in the circle and things get very strange (7:14). Unverified: T5G.
UFO news. A story in the phone's news app talks about a wave of UFO sightings across Leonida. Unverified: T5G.

Filming the cops gets you in trouble. Record police during an arrest and they get annoyed and may give you a wanted star. Milo tried it: he pulled out his camera during an arrest, the officers turned on him and he had to run. Confirmed: T5G and Milo.
Video games at home. Your safehouse gets a console with full games: a zombie shooter, a top-down shooter and a puzzle game. Unverified: T5G.
Forklift. You can steal a forklift and use it to flip cars. Unverified: T5G.

The Peewees billboards. Four pink Peewees billboards stand by the highways in Mariana, Vice-Dale, Leonard and Lummox counties. Scan all four with WAiNK to win the grand prize, a Peewees T-shirt and cap (the Calorie Maxxing set, per Jun Guides). PowerPyx notes they aren't needed for any trophy or for 100% completion. Confirmed: PowerPyx and Jun Guides.

The question mark box. Inside a storage container you may find a box covered in question marks. Eat what's inside and you're dropped into a wild obstacle course of floating objects, a slide, an underwater stretch full of jellyfish and an exit through the flames (16:17). Unverified: T5G.

The abandoned Port Gellhorn funfair. None of the rides work, but use binoculars on the stickers on a box and you can read tributes to people who died on the rides. An abandoned dog hangs around waiting for an owner who isn't coming back (20:42). Unverified: T5G.

The guarded Tallaloko estate. In Tallaloko, a gated estate has armed private security. Fight your way in and you'll find a mansion you can't enter, a lot full of supercars and, on the lake, a helipad with a helicopter T5G says you can't find anywhere else (22:19). Unverified: T5G. See also helicopter and plane locations.
The angry cyclist. In a random encounter at a gas station, a cyclist chews you out for driving instead of riding a bike (22:46). Unverified: T5G.

Escaped polar bear. In one random event, a polar bear breaks out of the truck taking it to the zoo. If it happens after you've met a certain hunter, he'll buy the dead bear from you. Unverified: Kotaku. See also fishing and hunting.
62 kinds of birds. You can log every one of them, according to Kotaku. Unverified: Kotaku.

Openings that change. Small details shift depending on how you play: a Kotaku writer and her husband got slightly different intro scenes depending on where and how Lucia was caught by the police. Unverified: Kotaku.
Books you can read. Lots of the books lying around can actually be opened, and plenty of them are funny. Unverified: Kotaku.
TV worth watching. The TV works like real TV, and some players have lost hours to it. Unverified: Kotaku.
Weird Al on the radio. "Weird Al" Yankovic hosts Vice City FM, the all-'80s station. See GTA 6 radio stations and songs.
Max weight Jason. Eat plenty of fast food and skip the gym and Jason hits his heaviest, while Lucia changes much less. See the hair and weight system.
Cheats have their own list: all GTA 6 cheats.

What are the easter eggs in GTA 6? The best known so far: the secret portal to PS2-era Vice City, the Mario block, the Skunk Ape (Bigfoot) in Grassrivers, the Easter egg on the radio tower, the jet ski dog and the alien lab.

Are there GTA 5 references in GTA 6? Lots. Michael's boat sits at Jason's house with the Los Santos map still on its GPS, Michael's ringtone is in the phone settings, and Fabien the yoga instructor appears in a magazine.
Is Dexter in GTA 6? His apartment is, in Bay Harbor. You can't go inside, but the roof has a knife, rope, gloves and plastic, like his kill kit.
Are there aliens in GTA 6? Yes. There's a night-time UFO abduction, a dream full of alien eggs that gives you the code to a secret lab with an alien inside, and meteorites you can sell.
The Vice City sign, in an official GTA 6 image.
The building with Dexter's apartment in Bay Harbor. The kill kit is on the roof.
On the SOS island, SEND BEER is spelled out on the sand with cans, planks and buoys.

t: GTA 6 Rare Car Locations: Every Car on Randy's Wish List
r: Where to find the 10 rare cars on Randy's wish list in GTA 6: Banshee, Tempesta, Infernus, Vacca, Gauntlet Hellfire, Mamba GT, Paragon, Furia, Toros and Growler, with times and how to steal each.

l: Randy, the high-end car buyer in Balsero (unlocked in Chapter 3), keeps a wish list of rare cars. Each one sits in a set spot, sometimes only at a certain time. How to Everything and Nerpah both cover the same cars, with the same spots and times. Most open with the key cloner; see how to steal cars for when you get it. Once the list unlocks, Nerpah tracks it from the map under Robberies > Randy's Wish List.
You don't have to hand them over: you can keep the car instead. For where Randy is, see fence locations.

p.h: All 10 cars and where to find them
l: Car · Where · When
Bravado Banshee · Outside the Sweet Bay Inn, East Buckley Drive, Capri · 3 to 4 a.m.
Pegassi Tempesta · NE 3rd Street, Vice City (Vice-Dale County), during a tow truck event · Around 1 p.m.
Pegassi Infernus · 7th floor of the Crosstown police station garage (NW 9th Street) · Any time
Pegassi Vacca · Villa on Flamingo Parkway, Waning Sands, east of Bellville (Leonard County) · Any time
Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire · M7 junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galerina St, Hamlet · Any time
Mamba GT · Mansion in Leaf Links, Vice Beach · Added to the list in the Dale Mamba mission
Ascot Paragon · Outside the Banana Hole bar, Shore Drive, Ocean Beach · Around 6 p.m.
Pegassi Furia · Mansion on Palomino Lane, Peacock Estates, Peacock Bay · Any time
Pegassi Toros · Outside the Pegassi Residence, Bayside Drive, Tequesta Retreat (west of Gloriana Key) · 6:30 to 7:30 p.m.
Pfister Growler · Top level of the multi-story car park on Fig Street, Ocean Beach · Around 5 p.m.

p.h: Banshee, Paragon, Toros and Growler: parked
l: Show up at the right time, open the car with the key cloner and drive off. The Paragon has a tracker, so keep your speed up so the cops can't trace you. The Toros has some security around, so be quick and quiet. Nerpah warns that outside their time window these cars just aren't there.
It's a random event: a repo man is towing the owner's car. Threaten the owner to get him out of the picture, release the Tempesta from the tow truck and leave. The Waink app shows its sale value.
Go to the Crosstown police station on NW 9th Street in Vice City and wait for a cop to open the gate.
Sneak in without drawing attention and head up to the 7th floor.
Open the Infernus with the key cloner and drive up to the top floor.
There's a stunt jump up there: use it to escape.
The car has a tracker, so stay fast.

Hop the fence. If you want a quick getaway, plant explosives on the gate first without setting them off. The Vacca is in the garage closest to the house, on the right as you face the entrance. Clone the key, blow the gate and go.
You can take it without anyone noticing. Open the entrance gates first, sneak around the right side of the junkyard and grab the car at the back.

p.h: Mamba GT: you need the key
l: The Leaf Links mansion has full security. Take the path on the right and use cover. The car is behind the building on the right, but you need its key: get into the house with the snap gun on the doors. The key is in a bowl on the table behind the sofa. According to Nerpah, the key cloner doesn't work on this one: no key from the bowl, no car. The Mamba GT isn't on the original list; it gets added during the Dale Mamba mission.
Skip the gate. Go left and hop the hedge. You'll end up between the water and a garage. The Furia is inside: clone the key, open the shutters and drive out.

If you're selling, bring the car back clean: Nerpah says damage cuts what Randy pays. You get the red Zorrusso in a Chapter 3 mission for Randy (Steal the Zorruso for Randy): according to Nerpah it sits in a Hathaway Apartments garage, and that's the mission where you get the key cloner.

DPJ explains that to keep a rare car for good, you have to register it with Moses in Port Gellhorn (Chapter 2). Registering swaps the plates and isn't cheap: he paid about $6,750 for a rare car. If you grab one before you have Moses, it may be gone when you reload your game. See also Paul Walker's car and the GTA 6 cars list.
How to Everything and Nerpah showed the same spots and times, so this page is verified.
What is Randy's wish list in GTA 6? It's the list of high-end cars that Randy, the Balsero car buyer unlocked in Chapter 3, pays you to steal. Each car has a set location and sometimes a set time.
Where is the Banshee in GTA 6? Parked outside the Sweet Bay Inn on East Buckley Drive in Capri, around 3 a.m. Open it with the key cloner.

What are the secret cars in GTA 6? The most wanted ones are on Randy's wish list: Banshee, Tempesta, Infernus, Vacca, Gauntlet Hellfire, Mamba GT, Paragon, Furia, Toros and Growler. Each sits in a fixed spot, and some only show up at certain times.

Where is the Infernus in GTA 6? On the 7th floor of the Crosstown police station parking garage, on NW 9th Street in Vice City. Slip in when a cop opens the gate, use the key cloner and escape via the stunt jump on the top floor.
Can you keep Randy's cars? Yes. Delivering to Randy is optional. To keep one, register it with Moses in Port Gellhorn.
A rare car stashed in a double garage: the alarm goes off, but no cops showed up.

t: GTA 6 Mario Easter Egg: Where to Find the Block With Jason and Lucia's Hats
r: The GTA 6 Mario easter egg is a hidden block in the brick ruins southwest of Moreau, Lummox County. Break it for two caps: a J for Jason and an L for Lucia.

l: GTA 6 has a Mario easter egg: a floating, half-invisible block that drops two caps. One has a J for Jason, the other an L for Lucia, a nod to Mario and Luigi. The block sits in crumbling brick and stone ruins in the woods southwest of Moreau, in Lummox County, the region north of Vice City. Kotaku credits player xGarbett with finding it.
Head to Lummox County, north of Vice City.
Go into the woods on the southwest side of Moreau.
Look for the ruins of an old brick and stone building (Kotaku).
TheGamingRevolution opens its video by marking the spot near the MacAlister Gold Mine on the map, then walks into a campsite at the ruins.

The block is see-through and hangs in the air near the top of one of the tallest parts of the ruin. Kotaku's writer couldn't spot it from the ground. It only showed up once he climbed the ruins the same way xGarbett did.
Get to the ruins.
Climb to the top of the walls.
Look for a faint cube floating above you.
Jump into it, Mario style. That's how xGarbett and TheGamingRevolution do it (1:15 in the video).
Shoot it. Kotaku's writer couldn't get Jason to break it with a jump, so he fired at it and the hats popped right out.
If jumping doesn't work after a couple of tries, just shoot it.

You get two baseball caps: the J cap for Jason and the L cap for Lucia. TheGamingRevolution shows Jason wearing his at 1:33. Kotaku's writer grabbed both, called Lucia and headed to a clothing store so the pair could dress up together.
IGN's video jokes that wearing your initial on your head while committing crimes isn't the smartest move. Still, the hats are yours.
This is one of many GTA 6 easter eggs. Another one that pays out in clothes is the Vice City portal, which unlocks Tommy Vercetti's shirt. And for another famous hat, see Arthur Morgan's hat.

Where is the Mario easter egg in GTA 6? In the old brick and stone ruins in the woods southwest of Moreau, Lummox County, north of Vice City. The block floats near the top of one of the tallest walls.
How do you break the Mario block in GTA 6? Jump up into it like Mario. If that doesn't work, shoot it: Kotaku couldn't break it by jumping, but one shot made the hats pop out.
What do you get from the Mario block? Two Mario and Luigi style baseball caps, one with a J for Jason and one with an L for Lucia.
Mount Kalaga in Leonida's backcountry, in an official GTA 6 image. It shows the wooded north, not the block itself.

t: GTA 6 Autosave Explained: When the Game Saves and How to Avoid Losing Progress
r: GTA 6 only autosaves after story missions and bigger side missions. Small errands and free roam aren't saved on their own, so save manually from the Game menu before you switch off.

l: GTA 6 does autosave, but only after story missions and larger side missions, based on Kotaku's testing. Whatever you get up to between missions, like holding up a store or running small errands, isn't saved for you. So before you turn the console off, save manually.

November 23 update: GTA 6's first patch fixes a bug that kept the game from autosaving correctly. Kotaku says at least some of the complaints about the game saving too rarely trace back to that bug. The testing on this page was done before the fix, and it isn't clear yet whether the game now autosaves at more points. See what changed in the patch.

Plenty of players learned this the hard way. Kotaku reports that people who spent their last 10, 15 or even 60 minutes on optional activities, then shut down for the night, woke up to find none of it had stuck.

p.h: When the game saves on its own
l: After a main story mission. In Kotaku's test, stealing a car from the impound lot for Cal and getting away from the cops, as part of the story, triggered a save.
After a larger side mission.
Small favors. Fetching rum for your neighbor didn't save the game.
Free roam after a mission, such as robbing a liquor store or doing errands.
Mid-mission, ever. Anything between starting and finishing a mission is lost if the console turns off or the power goes out.
Pause the game and open the menu.
Go to the Game section.
Pick the save option. Loading lives in the same place.
Our full saving guide covers save slots and the rest.
The menu won't let you save while you are:
in the middle of a mission;
in combat;
being chased by the police;
on the move, for example jumping off a bridge.
Before calling it a night, finish the mission, shake the cops, and stand still somewhere calm. Then save.
There are open questions about whether saving always works. Kotaku pointed to two cases, neither of them confirmed:

A manual save that didn't stick. One player said on X that he found around $10,000 in bagged stash money, saved by hand, then reloaded later and was back at his house without the cash or a collectible card he'd picked up. He and others suspect a bug.

11 hours gone. Streamer JasonTheWeen says he accidentally switched off his PS5 during a stream and lost 11 hours of progress, as IGN reported. Kotaku says it's unclear how that happened. He didn't seem to be saving manually, so it may have been too much faith in autosave, a fault in the feature itself, or both.
Since those reports, Rockstar has fixed an autosave bug in the November 23 patch. The notes don't say anything about manual saves.
Update the game: the November 23 patch fixes an autosave bug.
Don't rely on autosave alone.
Save manually every so often, and always before you quit.
After saving, make sure it went through before you turn the console off.
Also remember that cash in your pocket disappears when you die. Our guide on keeping your money safe shows where to stash it, and the beginner tips cover other early mistakes.
Does GTA 6 have autosave? Yes, but it only kicks in after story missions and larger side missions. Small errands and free roam activity aren't saved automatically.
Does GTA 6 save during a mission? No. According to Kotaku, nothing between starting and finishing a mission is kept if the console shuts off.
Did the GTA 6 update fix autosave? Yes. The November 23 patch fixes an issue that kept the game from autosaving correctly. Still, save manually before you turn the console off.
When can't you save in GTA 6? During missions, in combat, while the cops are chasing you, or while your character is moving, like mid-jump off a bridge. Stop somewhere quiet and save.
The Game section of the pause menu, with Save Game, Load Game and New Game.

t: GTA 6 Error CE-108255-1 on PS5: What It Is and What to Try
r: Error CE-108255-1 crashes GTA 6 on PS5, usually after early story cutscenes. The November 23 patch fixes several crashes but doesn't name this code, so there's no official fix yet.

l: CE-108255-1 is a PS5 crash in GTA 6: the game closes mid-session and throws that code. There is no official fix yet. Sony's only advice for the code is to update the game, and when GamesRadar+ covered it on the evening of November 19, GTA 6 didn't have a single patch to download. The first one arrived on November 23, but it doesn't mention this error (more below).
GamesRadar+ dug up more than a dozen Reddit threads describing the same crash:
It hits after certain story scenes early in the game, then repeats at the same point, so affected players can't progress.
One player couldn't get past the opening cutscene. Skipping it just led to a freeze right after.
Reports come from launch PS5, PS5 Digital and PS5 Slim owners.
The outlet found no recent reports of the code in other games, which points to GTA 6 rather than the hardware.
The article spells the code two ways, CE-108255-1 in the headline and CE-108225-1 in the body, so check the exact number on your screen.

p.h: What people have tried that didn’t work
l: Based on the posts GamesRadar+ collected, none of these has stopped the crash so far:
Attempt · Reported result
Clearing the console cache · Crash came back
Rebuilding the database · Crash came back
Reinstalling the game · Crash came back
Updating · Crash came back
Restoring licenses · Crash came back
Some Redditors put together long lists of attempted fixes, and none of them worked.
Rockstar's error troubleshooting page has no fix of its own. It points console players to PlayStation and Xbox support.
Sony's page for this code says to update the game, and if that doesn't help, to go through PlayStation Repairs.
One player who contacted Sony's repair service was quoted £300.
GamesRadar+ reached out to Sony for comment and said it would update the story if it heard back.

p.h: Does the November 23 patch fix it?
l: We can't say yet. GTA 6's first patch went out on November 23, and Rockstar's notes say it fixes several issues that made the game crash, but they don't list any error codes. Kotaku, which covered the patch, says it's unclear whether CE-108255-1 is one of them. Everything that changed is in GTA 6 patch notes.

p.h: What you can do right now
l: Check for a GTA 6 update in your PS5 game library and install the November 23 patch. It's the only step Sony lists for this code, even if there's no guarantee it helps.
If your problem is a different kind of crash, such as the game not launching, a stuck download or a license error, follow the official steps in GTA 6 crashing or stuck on loading: how to fix.
Keep an eye on Rockstar and Sony. The November 23 patch notes don't name this code, so watch for the next one.

GamesRadar+ itself notes that a handful of error posts on social media doesn't mean the problem is widespread. The writer plays on PS5 and hadn't had a single crash after several hours. For how the game runs on each console, see GTA 6 FPS and performance on PS5 Pro and Xbox.

What is error CE-108255-1 in GTA 6? It's a GTA 6 crash on PS5: the game shuts down and shows that code, often after cutscenes early in the story. Reports come from launch, Digital and Slim PS5 consoles.

Is there a fix for CE-108255-1 in GTA 6? Not an official one yet. Sony says to update the game. The November 23 patch fixes several crashes but doesn't name this code, and Kotaku says it's unclear whether it's resolved.

Does reinstalling GTA 6 fix CE-108255-1? Not according to the reports GamesRadar+ gathered. Players reinstalled, cleared the cache, rebuilt the database and restored licenses, and the crash kept coming back.
Vice City in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games.

t: GTA 6 Crashing or Stuck on Loading Screen: How to Fix
r: If GTA 6 crashes, freezes or won't load, check PlayStation or Xbox server status and restart the game first. On PS5, restore your licenses; on Xbox, fully power cycle the console.

l: If GTA 6 is crashing, freezing or stuck on a loading screen, start simple: check whether PlayStation Network or Xbox services are down, then restart the game. If that doesn't do it, the official fix on PS5 is to restore your licenses, and on Xbox it's a full power cycle, holding the console's power button for 10 seconds.
Rockstar hasn't published its own list of GTA 6 errors. Its support page points console errors to Sony's and Microsoft's help pages, so every step below comes from those official pages.

p.h: First, make sure the game is updated
l: GTA 6 got its first patch on November 23. According to Rockstar's notes, as reported by Kotaku, it fixes several issues that made the game crash, along with autosave problems and phone calls that never came through. If your game keeps closing on its own, check that the update is installed before you work through the steps below. The full list is in GTA 6 patch notes.

p.h: Step one: rule out an outage
l: PS5: check the PlayStation status page. If there's an alert, wait for the service to come back before trying again.
Xbox: check the Xbox status page and the known issues list for new game launches.
GTA 6 unlocked at midnight local time on November 19. Before that, it won't start even if it's fully installed.

p.h: PS5: won’t launch or license problems
l: Use the right account. If the profile you're on didn't buy the game, the account that owns it needs Console Sharing and Offline Play turned on for that PS5: Settings > Users and Accounts > Other > Console Sharing and Offline Play > Enable.
Restore licenses. Go to Settings > Users and Accounts > Other > Restore Licenses and pick the ones to restore. You can also highlight the game, press Options and choose Restore License.
Download didn't finish? Follow the next section.

p.h: PS5: stuck download or install errors
l: Open Downloads/Uploads in the control center, select the game, then hit Pause and Resume.
Still stuck? Select Cancel and Delete, then download it again from your Game Library.
Update your system software: Settings > System > System Software > System Software Update and Settings.
Check your free space. In the Game Library, open the game, go to "..." > View Product and the required space shows on the right. Rockstar says it can take up to 212 GB.
As a last step, boot the PS5 in Safe Mode and choose Clear Cache and Rebuild Database.

p.h: Xbox: freezing, crashing or won’t start
l: Xbox Support lays out this order:
Restart the game. Press the Xbox button, highlight the game, press Menu and choose Quit. Then launch it again.
Power cycle. Hold the Xbox button on the front of the console for at least 10 seconds. Turn it back on, and repeat if you don't see the green boot animation. This doesn't erase games or data.
Test your network: Profile & system > Settings > General > Network settings > Test network connection.
Try another profile. If the game works there, remove yours (Settings > Account > Remove accounts) and add it back.

Last resort: delete the local save and resync from the cloud, under Manage game and add-ons > Saved data. Xbox says saves are stored in the cloud while you're connected, but only do this after everything else.

The boxed version of GTA 6 only has a download code inside. Rockstar says PS5 codes are locked to the region of your PlayStation account, so buy from a store in your account's country. Xbox codes aren't region-locked. If you're told the code was already used, check your order history and make sure it wasn't redeemed on another account.
Rockstar's support page sends you to Sony's PS5 error code search and Microsoft's Xbox error code search. Type in the exact code on your screen to get the matching fix.
A number of PS5 players are hitting this one. GamesRadar+ found more than a dozen Reddit threads about it, and here's what they describe:
the game crashes after specific story scenes early on, then crashes again at the same point, so you're stuck;
it shows up on base PS5 consoles as well as Digital and Slim models;
clearing the cache, rebuilding the database, reinstalling and restoring licenses didn't help anyone in those reports;
Sony's page for the code only says to update the game, then contact PlayStation Repairs if that fails. As of November 19 there was no GTA 6 patch to download;
the first patch arrived on November 23 with several crash fixes, but the notes don't mention this code. Kotaku says it's unclear whether it's been resolved.

The article itself spells the code two ways (CE-108255-1 in the headline, CE-108225-1 in the body), so check the exact number on your screen before you search. What we know so far is on our CE-108255-1 error page.
Losing a few frames in a big chase or shootout is normal in GTA 6. Digital Foundry measured dips on every console, and more often on Xbox Series S. See GTA 6 FPS and performance for the numbers.

PlayStation splits it like this: download, install, launch and code problems go to PlayStation Support, while in-game bugs and patches go to Rockstar Support. Xbox's own help page also sends GTA 6 questions to Rockstar.
Before you reinstall, read up on how autosave works and how to save manually so you know where your progress lives.

What do I do if GTA 6 won't launch on PS5? Make sure you're on the account that bought it, then go to Settings > Users and Accounts > Other > Restore Licenses. If the download failed, delete it and download again from your Game Library.
How do I fix GTA 6 freezing on Xbox? Quit the game from the guide and restart it. If that doesn't work, hold the Xbox button on the console for 10 seconds to fully power cycle it.

Why won't my GTA 6 code work? PS5 codes are tied to the region of your PlayStation account, according to Rockstar. Xbox codes aren't region-locked. If it says the code was already used, check your order history.
Does GTA 6 need the internet to play? No. PlayStation lists offline play as enabled, and Xbox Support has a guide for playing single-player games offline.
Vice City in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games.

t: All GTA 6 Fence Locations: Where to Sell Stolen Goods
r: GTA 6 has 5 fences for drugs, jewelry and marked bills, plus 2 car buyers. Each fence pays best for a different item, and some only pay after you leave.

l: In GTA 6, the stuff you steal doesn't turn into money on its own. Drugs, jewelry and marked bills have to go to a fence, who swaps them for clean cash. There are 5 fences for goods and 2 car buyers, and each one unlocks during a story mission.
The game spells it out: when you pick up marked bills, a prompt tells you to take them to a drop-off to sell them for usable cash.
Fence · Location · Unlocked in
Brian · Key Lento · Chapter 1: Lab Fees
Donnie · Key Lento · Chapter 1: Clean Up After Donnie
Dunk · Port Gellhorn, Kelly County · Chapter 2: Slam Dunk
Tyrone · La Perle, Vice City · Chapter 3: Here, Kitty Kitty
Yasmani · Little Cuba, Vice City · Chapter 3: Boobie Time
Moses (cars) · Port Gellhorn, Kelly County · Chapter 2: Moses
Randy (high-end cars) · Balsero, Vice City · Chapter 3: Steal The Zorrusso for Randy
GamesRadar+ broke down what each robbery type in the index pays out:
Robbery type · What you get
Illegal Operations · Jewelry, marked bills, narcotics and pocket cash
Smash 'n' Grabs · Jewelry, marked bills and pocket cash
Bank Jobs and Payday Loans · Jewelry, marked bills and pocket cash
Pocket cash is yours right away. Everything else has to go through a fence.
Lose the cops first. PC Gamer's advice is to sell only after a clean getaway.
Go to any fence, any time of day.
Open the index, go to the Robberies tab and scroll to Drop-offs - Goods: those are the fences you've unlocked so far. In Chapter 1 that's just Brian and Donnie.
Hover over each fence's name to see who pays most for drugs, jewelry and marked bills. It pays to match the load to the fence.

Brian's lockup in South Key Lento has a keypad on the door. The code is 7700: KhrazeGaming, DooDooPoo and JoblessGarrett all used the same one. The game remembers it for you after the first time. Inside, drop your bags in the container and choose to sell. DooDooPoo sold one full stash bag for $10,000.
Donnie is the second fence you get in Chapter 1, out of his trailer in Key Lento. FuriousFade brought two full bags from a warehouse and walked through it:
Pull up near Donnie's trailer. Back the car in so the bags come out of the trunk easily.
The bags go in the old toolbox next to the trailer. Donnie picks them up later.
Before you confirm, the prompt already shows how much you'll get. In his video it read "Sell stash bags (+$11,600)" for drugs and marked bills together.
You can't split it: FuriousFade noticed the game sells the drugs and the marked bills in one go.
Soon after, Donnie texts you that the money is in your mailbox. Swing by home to collect it.

Donnie or Brian? BennyCentral compared both on the map before selling a warehouse bag: Donnie's trailer paid $800 more than Brian's lockup for the same load, and the bag went for about $10,000. It's worth checking both prices before you pick, as covered in "How to sell" above. That warehouse is in the early money warehouse.
Not every fence pays on the spot:
Pay right away: Tyrone (at his apartment) and Yasmani (at his shop).

Pay later: Brian (his lockup), Donnie (the drop box at his trailer) and Dunk (the trunk of his car). You drop off the goods and the money shows up later in your mailbox. GamesRadar+ says some fences can take several in-game days.
Send your partner: hand the goods to Jason or Lucia (whoever you're not playing) and tell them to fence it. They take care of it, but you get a bit less money.
Garage pickup: after two Payday Loan jobs for Yasmani, you can leave stolen goods in one of your garages and someone comes to collect them. That convenience comes with an extra fee.

p.h: Partner wouldn’t hand over the bags?
l: That was a bug. At launch, your partner could hang on to the bags instead of passing them to you, which left you with nothing to sell to the fence. GTA 6's first patch, released on November 23, fixes it, according to Rockstar's notes as reported by Kotaku. If it happened to you, update the game. See everything else the patch changed.
Robbing and fencing is one of the fastest ways to make money early on. See the rest in how to make money in GTA 6, and for robberies with a safe, the safe codes guide.
Where do you sell drugs and jewelry in GTA 6? At a fence. The first one is Brian in Key Lento, unlocked in the Chapter 1 mission Lab Fees. Donnie, Dunk, Tyrone and Yasmani come later.
What do you do with marked bills in GTA 6? Take them to a fence or drop-off. Marked bills can't be spent until they're swapped for clean cash.
Where do you sell stolen cars in GTA 6? To Moses in Port Gellhorn, from Chapter 2. High-end cars go to Randy in Balsero, Vice City, in Chapter 3.
The in-game prompt: marked bills have to go to a drop-off before you can spend them.

t: How to Lose the Police in GTA 6: Heat, Search Zones and Disguises
r: To lose the cops in GTA 6, get out of the search zone and stop matching your description: respray your car at Pay 'n' Spray, change outfits or get a haircut. Watch out for stolen car trackers.

l: The police in GTA 6 don't just chase you: they learn what you look like. They remember your car, your weapon and your outfit, and keep searching the area until you stop matching that description. Losing them means getting out of the search zone and changing your look. GameSpot, PC Gamer and DPJ explained how it works, and MrDalekJD, KhrazeGaming and GamingBolt showed how to wipe each clue.
According to GameSpot, when someone sees you commit a crime the police get called. A small blue circle shows up on the map: the area cops will search. If they spot you, it turns red and gets bigger.
That's GTA 6's heat system. The police put out your description over the radio, for example "white male in his 30s, driving a yellow Ganado", and it shows up on the heat map.

MrBossFTW frames the colors a little differently: the zone stays blue while you haven't been tied to the crime, and turns red once the police have heat icons on you. Either way, it's centered on the spot where the crime happened.

p.h: The cops aren’t on your minimap
l: If you're used to GTA 5, this one hurts: patrol cars no longer show up on the minimap, so you can't just steer around them. According to MrDalekJD, the police now track you down through witnesses and cameras. Before you do something shady, look around: how many people can see you, and is there a camera on that building? The fewer eyes on you, the less the cops have to work with. Mr Lawrence makes the same point: with no patrol cars on the radar, every getaway gets a bit harder.

p.h: Slap the phone out of their hand
l: According to MrBossFTW, if someone you've upset pulls out their phone to call the police, you can walk up and press Square (X on Xbox). Your character slaps the phone away and the call never goes through. It stops working once a crowd has seen you, since somebody will dial before you can reach everyone.

p.h: The heat icons: what the police know
l: Next to your wanted stars you get a row of icons showing what the police have on you. Each icon you clear is one less thing they can use to spot you.
What they know · How to clear it
Your outfit · Change clothes at a store, at home or from your trunk.
Your appearance · Put on or take off sunglasses, a hat or a mask. A new haircut works too.
Your vehicle · Ditch it or respray it at a Pay 'n' Spray.
A visible weapon · Put your gun away (GamingBolt).
CCTV footage · Destroy the recording at the scene. GamingBolt warns the alarm will go off sooner or later.
Both of you did it · Split Jason and Lucia up. MrDalekJD says this icon shows up later in the game.
Your wanted stars change color and shape depending on what the police know. MrBossFTW breaks down all five:
Stars · What it means
White outline · The police know a crime happened, but not that it was you.
Solid white · They know it was you and they can see you. You're being chased.
Gray · They know it was you but lost sight of you. They're still searching, so get out of the search zone.
Red outline · A crime happened in the area you're in, but you no longer match the description. They won't recognize you right away, though they're on alert.
Solid red · They know you committed a crime in this area. They've lost you for now, but nearby cops are looking for someone who matches how you look right now.

KhrazeGaming lands on the same reading: when the stars are hollow (just an outline, red or white), the police don't have your description. You can even hang around in the search area, as long as you don't do anything suspicious.

He showed it after a store robbery. He'd parked behind the building where nobody saw, so the cops only had his face and his outfit. At his trunk he swapped outfits and took off his sunglasses and cap, both icons disappeared, and he could walk back into the red zone without anyone bothering him.

p.h: Don’t walk around with a rifle out
l: Carrying a big gun in the open draws attention in GTA 6.
KhrazeGaming explains that two long guns don't both fit on your back, so one ends up in your hands. People nearby get nervous and walk off.
GamingBolt adds that machine guns and shotguns in plain sight make bystanders react and even call the cops. If you want to stay low-key, carry a pistol.
KhrazeGaming turns this into a trick before a robbery: he walks around with a long gun out until the witnesses leave, then puts everything back in the trunk before going in.

p.h: Step by step to lose them
l: Get out of the search circle and stay out until your heat fades.
Check the icons next to your stars to see what they have on you.

Change the car: take it to a Pay 'n' Spray and pick Respray in a different color. According to MrDalekJD, a fresh paint job is enough for patrol cars to drive by without noticing you. Mr Lawrence says a respray costs $200, which can wipe out most of a small store robbery's take. Swapping cars costs nothing.
Change your outfit: a clothing store or Ammu-Nation works, sunglasses and hats included.
Change your face: get a haircut at a salon or a tattoo. GamingBolt also suggests a mask.
On the spot: hold L1 (LB on Xbox) and press R1 (RB) to take off pieces like your hat or change how you wear them, DPJ showed. MrDalekJD uses the same shortcut.
Put the gun away and, if Lucia is with you, split up.
MrDalekJD's habit: put on sunglasses and a cap before you do anything dodgy. That way you always have something to take off when you need to vanish.
When they lose your description, you'll hear the radio say they lost sight of you.

p.h: Stars that just wouldn’t go away?
l: It may have been a bug. GTA 6's first patch, released on November 23, fixes an issue where players couldn't lose their wanted level, according to Rockstar's notes as reported by Kotaku. If you did everything in the steps above and the stars stuck around, update the game. See everything else the patch changed.

p.h: You can’t start a mission while wanted
l: In Bombastic's video, the game told him he couldn't start a mission with the cops on his tail. If a mission marker is nearby, lose them first and then head over.

p.h: Mod shops won’t take you either
l: Tuning shops are off the table too. During Elanip's stream, with the police after him, he pulled up to a mod shop and the game turned him away: no entry inside a heat area while you're in a known vehicle. He headed to a Pay 'n' Spray instead. More on tuning in how to customize your car.

With five stars right at the start of the game, JuiceHead got away by stealing a boat and following the coastline until the cops dropped off. He had Accessible Combat on, which cuts the damage you take, and soaked up a lot of shots with no armor. He says you can switch it on mid-chase from the bottom of the Gameplay settings, and that it doesn't turn off achievements. The details are in how to make GTA 6 easier.

p.h: Red lights won’t get you a star
l: Milo had seen on TikTok that cops chase you for any traffic violation, like running a red. He tried it right in front of a patrol car and the officer didn't react at all.

p.h: Keep spare outfits in your trunk
l: BennyCentral, KultZ, KhrazeGaming and GamingBolt all give the same advice: keep a couple of outfits in your car's trunk so you can pull over, change and leave the police with the wrong description. BennyCentral notes you can manage what's in your trunk at any clothing store that has a changing room, and KhrazeGaming loads his from the wardrobe at the safehouse.
A stolen car stays stolen until you register it, DPJ reminds. Some come with trackers:
Yellow tracker: the cops locate the car if you stop for a few seconds.
Red tracker: it pings the police if you slow down. Keep your foot down.
PC Gamer adds that a red (advanced) tracker beeps when you slow down and gives you a few seconds to speed back up. See how to steal cars in GTA 6.
After the story, there are cheats to raise your heat level and your wanted level. There's no cheat to remove stars.
How do you lose your wanted level in GTA 6? Stay outside the search zone until your heat drops, and change your look: respray the car at Pay 'n' Spray, change clothes, or get a haircut or tattoo.
What is heat in GTA 6? It's what the police know about you: your look, outfit and car. They radio out your description, and the more you match it, the longer they keep looking.
How do you get rid of trackers in GTA 6? You can't remove them on the spot. With a yellow tracker, don't stop; with a red one, keep your speed up so it can't ping the police.

What do hollow stars mean in GTA 6? According to KhrazeGaming, hollow stars (just the outline, red or white) mean the police don't have your description. You can stay in the area as long as you don't act suspicious.
Vice City at night, in an official GTA 6 image.
Wanted and in a car the police know, you can't pull into a mod shop.

t: GTA 6 Patch Notes: What the First Update Fixes (November 23)
r: GTA 6's first post-launch patch landed on November 23 with seven fixes: crashes, autosave, stuck weather, missing phone calls, wanted levels, the gym deadlift and fence bags.

l: GTA 6 got its first post-launch patch on November 23, four days after the game came out. Rockstar's patch notes list seven fixes: crashes, autosave, weather that wouldn't change, phone calls that never came, a wanted level you couldn't shake, the gym deadlift bar and partners holding on to your bags. Kotaku ran through the list and linked to the notes on Rockstar Support.
Crashes. Several issues that made the game crash are fixed. If yours still crashes, try the steps in GTA 6 crashing or stuck on loading.
Stuck weather. The weather could stay the same for long stretches. If you want a change right away, there's a cycle weather cheat.
Autosave. The game wasn't autosaving correctly. See how GTA 6 autosave works.

Missing phone calls. Some calls didn't trigger, including ones that move the story forward or unlock missions. If you were stuck waiting for a call, update the game. Our mission list shows what comes next.
Wanted level. A bug could leave you unable to lose your stars. See how to lose the police.
Gym deadlift. The deadlift bar at the gym couldn't be used.
Fence bags. Your partner wouldn't hand the bags over, so you couldn't sell them to a fence. See fence locations.

Plenty of players felt GTA 6 wasn't autosaving as often as it should. Kotaku says at least some of that seems to trace back to this bug. The game still only saves on its own at certain points, though, so save manually before you quit. Our saving guide shows how.
Error CE-108255-1 on PS5. The code isn't in the notes, which only talk about crashes in general. Kotaku says it's unclear whether this one is resolved. Here's what we know about CE-108255-1.

ATMs and the wanted profile. Player complaints about ATMs and about how the wanted profile works aren't covered. Kotaku thinks they could be handled in later updates. Meanwhile, here's how banks and ATMs work.
Kotaku calls this a small patch and expects more in the coming weeks. We'll update this page when the next one lands.

The report we read doesn't give a version number or a download size, and it doesn't explain how to grab the update or check which version you have. We'll add those once an English source we can read spells them out.
Did GTA 6 get an update? Yes. The first post-launch patch arrived on November 23, four days after release, with seven fixes listed in Rockstar's patch notes.

Does the GTA 6 patch fix autosave? It fixes an issue that kept the game from autosaving correctly. Kotaku says that bug explains at least part of the complaints, but you should still save manually before you quit.
Does the update fix error CE-108255-1? Rockstar doesn't mention that code in the notes. They only say several crash causes were fixed, and Kotaku says it's unclear whether this one is among them.
Vice City in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games. It shows the game, not the update itself.

t: 2 GTA 6 Loot Spots With a Legendary Rifle, Big Cash and a Free Supercar
r: Two GTA 6 robbery spots with a legendary assault rifle: a gated house just north of Little Cuba with $25k in stash bags and a nitrous Mercedes, and a Vespucci Island mansion with a free Emerus.

l: GTA 6 marks illegal operations on the map that you can raid, and a few of them hold far more than cash: a legendary assault rifle, safes, luxury watches and even a supercar with no tracker. Here are two that TikTok creators showed on Nov 21 and 22, step by step.
Each spot comes from one creator so far, so this page is unverified. Cash amounts are what showed up in the videos and may differ in your game.

p.h: Gated house just north of Little Cuba (Guardian Brothers AR)
l: Shown by 1deflay, who says the whole run takes about two minutes and adds up to roughly $50,000 counting the car.
Set a waypoint just above Little Cuba in Vice City. A brown van pulls into a gated yard when you arrive.
Head to the back and climb the wall with no spikes on top. Nobody guards that side.
Parked there is a nitrous Mercedes AMG, unlocked and tracker free. The creator says it sells for about $8,500.
Use the AC units outside to get onto the roof, then drop through the hole. There's a watch and other loot on the table.
Go down one level. The room on the left has cash. Someone is standing at the safe: take them out silently for the stealth bonus. The safe gave the creator about $2,700 and $6,300.
On the same floor, drop down through another room to find three enemies. With a suppressed gun, nobody raises the alarm.
In the back you'll find body armor and the legendary Guardian Brothers AR. The center table holds the stash bags: two of them paid $12,600 each in the video.
Leave through the red door with the exit sign. The Mercedes is on your left.

p.h: Vespucci Island mansion (legendary rifle and a free Emerus)
l: Shown by mrgunsenburner, who says you can do it at any point in the story.
Set a waypoint to Vespucci Island, just east of Vice City.
Hop the wall on the left and head upstairs. A suppressed pistol makes this much easier.
Take out the two guards up top and go through the door.
Make your way to the office in the back right. The legendary assault rifle is there, and it stays with you even in Chapter 1. Body armor hangs on the wall next to it.
There are two safes, one on each side of the room, both with cash.
Back in the garage, the red Emerus is unlocked with no tracker. Open the gate and drive off.
Vespucci Island is also where you'll find Paul Walker's car.
Tracker-free cars are perfect to keep or sell. See how to sell cars in GTA 6.
Legendary guns live in your weapon wheel and can't be modified. The full list by region is in GTA 6 unique weapon locations.
Another great early loot run is the early money warehouse.

Where is the legendary Guardian Brothers AR in GTA 6? In a gated house just north of Little Cuba in Vice City. It sits in the back room on the floor below the roof, next to some body armor, guarded by three enemies.
Where is the free Emerus in GTA 6? In the garage of a guarded mansion on Vespucci Island, just east of Vice City. It's unlocked and has no tracker, so you can drive it straight out.
Can you keep a legendary weapon in Chapter 1? Yes. The creator who showed the Vespucci Island mansion says the legendary rifle there stays with you even if you grab it in Chapter 1.
Vice City, home to both spots. This image is for illustration and doesn't show the locations.

t: GTA 6 Black Eagle Import M306 Location (Free Suppressed Rifle)
r: The Black Eagle Import M306 TMR is hidden in the warehouse beside the Black Eagle gun store, near Griffin Shooting Range. Here are both ways into the room.

l: The Black Eagle Import M306 TMR is in a hidden room inside the warehouse next to the Black Eagle gun store, west of Vice City. It's a semi-auto marksman rifle with a suppressor and scope already attached. WiLLiSGaming, Arekkz Gaming and Vexies have all picked it up.
Zoom out until you can read LEONIDA.
Look slightly below the space between the I and the D, as Vexies shows.
Find the Black Eagle store down the road from Griffin Shooting Range. The warehouse is the big building to its right.
Save your game. Staff will call the police, and a surrounded building makes the rifle very hard to reach.
Cover your face so you're harder to identify.
Deal with the three ground floor workers. Arekkz threatens them onto their knees and stays off the upper floor.
This is how Arekkz Gaming and Vexies opened the room:
Go through to the back storage area.
Hotwire the forklift.
Slide the forks under the pallets blocking the room. The left stick raises and lowers them.
Clear the pallets (Arekkz counted three) and walk in.
WiLLiSGaming squeezed through a narrow gap on the left as you enter the warehouse. According to the channel, Jason is too big to fit. The rifle is in a case on the other side.

p.h: What else is in the warehouse
l: A regular rocket launcher. It isn't a unique weapon, so you lose it when you die. See rocket launcher locations.

An office safe with a pistol. Vexies got it open, and in the video the door and the safe use different codes. We've only heard those numbers in the voiceover and haven't checked them on screen, so they aren't printed here.

The Conspiracist Type 9 is in a bunker across the road from the same shooting range. The M306 is a unique variant, so a lost one can be recovered from the Ammu-Nation locker. See how to store weapons in your trunk.
Where is the Black Eagle M306 in GTA 6? In the warehouse next to the Black Eagle gun store west of Vice City, down the road from Griffin Shooting Range.
Do you need to play as Lucia? For the narrow gap, yes, according to WiLLiSGaming. The other route is to move the pallets blocking the room with a forklift.
Does the Black Eagle M306 have a suppressor? Yes, it comes with a suppressor and a scope already fitted.
Lucia picks up the Black Eagle Import M306 TMR, with the name on screen.

t: GTA 6 Map: All 5 Counties and What's in Each One
r: The GTA 6 map is split into 5 counties: Vice-Dale, Leonard, Kelly, Lummox and Mariana. Here are the main spots in each, from Vice City and the airport to the military base and Key Lento.

l: The GTA 6 map of Leonida is split into 5 counties: Vice-Dale, Leonard, Kelly, Lummox and Mariana. Each one has at least one landmark worth knowing, from the packed streets of Vice City down to the Key Lento islands where the story opens.

It's a lot of ground. Rockstar called the map twice the size of GTA 5's, and PC Gamer says it feels even bigger than that: crossing it takes ages, even in a plane. According to PC Gamer, Rockstar also said it beats Red Dead Redemption 2's map, and the two older maps combined. On November 19, 2026, Rockstar put the full map up on its website in high resolution (more below).

The official map lives on Rockstar's site: full high-resolution map of Leonida. It's a single large poster-style image covering Vice City and the rest of the state. PC Gamer notes that it shows the small roads, highways and neighborhoods.
It's handy even if you're already deep into the game. PC Gamer gives three reasons:
The in-game map starts out under a fog of war that only lifts as you explore.

Even with everything uncovered, you can't fit the whole map on screen no matter how far you zoom out. PC Gamer's Chris Livingston cleared it all after 100 hours of play and still couldn't see it in one view.
Smaller roads and neighborhood names only show up once you zoom in close.
From what PC Gamer shows, Rockstar's release is an image rather than an interactive map. For setting waypoints and finding places, you still use the in-game map (see the end of this page).
County · Main locations
Vice-Dale County · Vice City, Vice Beach, VCIA Airport
Leonard County · Ambrosia, Lake Leonida
Kelly County · Port Gellhorn, Gellhorn Raceway, Capri
Lummox County · Mount Kalaga National Park
Mariana County · Mile Zero Air Station, Key Lento
Vice City: the centerpiece, packed with jewelry, cars and drugs to steal. It's by far the densest part of the map.
Vice Beach: a long run of beachfront east of downtown.
VCIA Airport: where the planes sit until somebody takes one. Our airport guide covers how to get in.
Ambrosia: the name sounds pleasant, the place less so. It's home to a biker gang and a sugar refinery.
Lake Leonida: the largest inland lake on the map, right next to Ambrosia.
Port Gellhorn: a former tourist spot gone to seed, with dead malls and grimy hotels. These days the local money comes from drugs and drinks. The town also shows up in our fence locations guide.
Gellhorn Raceway: the place for track racing and drag racing.
Capri: high-end shopping, expensive homes and police with zero patience for street performers.
Mount Kalaga National Park: the big draw in northern Leonida, with room to hunt, fish and go off-road.
Mile Zero Air Station: the military base in the southern keys and the easiest place to grab a tank. Walking in uninvited earns you a steep Wanted level. See how to get into the base.
Key Lento: a strip of outlying islands. This is where you start the game as Jason.

p.h: How long it takes to fly across the map
l: PC Gamer timed 4 minutes and 18 seconds in a Mammoth Dodo seaplane from the southern tip of the islands to the far north, just under an hour of game time. Faster planes probably exist. Steer around the military base on the way, or you'll get four wanted stars.
The in-game map lets you set destinations and look up shops and missions. Our map index guide walks through it.
How many counties are on the GTA 6 map? Five: Vice-Dale, Leonard, Kelly, Lummox and Mariana, according to PC Gamer.

Where can I see the full official GTA 6 map? On Rockstar's website. On November 19 it posted the full map of Leonida in high resolution, with the small roads, highways and neighborhoods. The link is in the Full official map section of this page.

Is there an interactive GTA 6 map? The official map Rockstar posted is one big image, not an interactive map. In the game, the pause menu map lets you zoom, set waypoints and look up shops and missions through the Index, but it starts out covered in fog until you explore.

Is the GTA 6 map bigger than GTA 5's? Yes. Rockstar says it's twice the size, and per PC Gamer it's bigger than the GTA 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 maps put together. It takes ages to cross even by plane.
The in-game map zoomed in on Key Lento, the islands where Jason starts the story.

t: GTA 6 Mask, Clothing, Tattoo and Barber Shop Locations
r: GTA 6 clothing stores, tattoo parlors and salons are listed under the Style tab of the map index, and they never close. For a mask, the confirmed option is a bandana from Ammu-Nation.

l: Every clothing store, tattoo parlor and hair salon in GTA 6 shows up under the Style tab of the map index. If you want to hide your face, the one confirmed option is a bandana, which you'll usually find at Ammu-Nation gun stores. Nobody has found a dedicated mask shop yet.

p.h: Finding the shops on the map
l: Open the map and press right on the D-pad to bring up the index.
Go to the Style tab, the one with the shirt icon.
GamesRadar+ says this tab tracks every place you've discovered to buy clothes, get tattoos, and change hair and makeup for both Jason and Lucia.

Opening hours are never a problem. Rockstar told Kotaku the game has more than 700 stores and every one of them is open 24/7. The studio picked convenience over realism, since showing up to a locked shop wasn't fun. A 3 AM haircut is fine.
This is the shakiest part of the guide, so here's exactly what has been confirmed:

Bandanas at gun stores. Arekkz Gaming suggests buying a bandana at a gun shop to cover your face during crimes. Game Rant agrees: bandanas are among the first masks you can buy and usually turn up at Ammu-Nation, even though accessories aren't on the store's list.
A neck gaiter in the Keys. Game Rant also found a gaiter for sale at Chuck's Tackle & Shot in the Keys.

How to wear it. It sits in the top slot of the item wheel and has two styles. Around your neck it hides nothing. Pulled up over your face it hides your identity, but walking around like that draws attention, especially from cops.
Take it off late. Remove it only once you're mostly in the clear. Pull it down too early and the police get a look at you.

What is not confirmed: a real mask store selling rubber or costume masks. JoblessGarrett went looking early in the game and couldn't find a mask at a clothing store or anywhere else. We'll update this page if one turns up.

p.h: Step by step: buy it and wear it
l: PC Gamer says the earliest mask is at Chuck's Tackle & Shot, near Jason's house in Key Lento:
Walk in, turn right, go forward a little and take the aisle on your left.
Find the Neckwear section on the right-hand shelf.
Buy and equip it. It sits around the neck by default.
To cover your face on PS5, hold L1, press R1 for items, move the stick onto the mask and press up on the D-pad to switch to Wear Style 1.

Changing rooms work like a closet. Kotaku and BennyCentral both point out that any clothing store with a changing room lets you build outfits, manage what you own and stash clothes in your car's trunk, so you don't have to drive home.
Name your outfits. You can rename custom outfits with preset words like "clubbing" or "hunting", which makes the trunk much easier to sort through.
Shop as a couple. Bring Jason and Lucia together and you can buy and try on clothes for both. Buying for your partner also earns romance points.
Every store has exclusives. Kotaku says most clothing stores and salons carry a few items you won't find anywhere else.

Ammu-Nation sells outfits too. In the GamesRadar+ walkthrough for the Chapter 1 mission Unwanted Attention, you shake off the cops by buying an outfit from the mannequins at an Ammu-Nation for $59 to $96.
Robbing a clothing store. MrBossFTW notes you can grab a temporary outfit during the robbery. It's gone for good once you change out of it.
A fresh look also helps when you're wanted. See how to lose the police.

At home: Kotaku says the bathroom mirror lets you shave your beard and your head, but you can't pick a new style there. MrBossFTW adds that Jason can swap a few cuts and his facial hair, and Lucia can change her makeup and hair, but anything new needs a salon.
At a salon: the menu splits styles into Signature and Standard tabs. In GamingWithOva's video at Sara's Unisex Salon, cuts ran from $38 (Crew Cut) to $71 (Beachy Waves, an exclusive).
In the story: KultZ points out that one of Lucia's optional Chapter 1 errands is getting Jason a haircut.
Three style shops come with the Ultimate Edition and unlock in Chapter 1, according to PC Gamer and GamesRadar+:
Shop · What it sells · Where
Stock 305 · Streetwear · Stockyard, Vice City. Index: Style > Casual & Street
Electric Fang Tattoo Parlor · 50+ tattoos by the art collective FAILE · Stockyard, Vice City. Index: Style > Tattoos
Sara's Unisex Salon · Hair, beards, makeup and nails · Hamlet. Index: Style > Hair & Beauty
Outside those, the regular shops in the same tab sell similar clothes and cuts, each with a few exclusives. The full bonus list is in Ultimate Edition bonuses.
NorZZa found Zeke's Electronics in Hamlet, just north of the Keys. It sells phone cases and headphones, which let you listen to music and podcasts while you walk around.
Where do you buy a mask in GTA 6? The confirmed option is a bandana, usually sold at Ammu-Nation gun stores. No source has shown a dedicated mask shop so far.
Where do you get a haircut in GTA 6? At any salon listed under the Style tab of the map index. The bathroom mirror at home only lets you shave or trim your hair and beard.
Where is the tattoo shop in GTA 6? Tattoo parlors are listed under the Style tab of the index. Electric Fang in Stockyard is an Ultimate Edition exclusive.
Do GTA 6 stores close at night? No. Rockstar says all of the game's 700-plus stores stay open 24 hours a day, every day.
The haircut menu at Sara's Unisex Salon: every style shows its price, and the Signature and Standard tabs split out the exclusives.
