In his newer tips video, BennyCentral goes straight for Lock-on if you're losing gunfights, since it makes landing shots far easier while you learn the game. JuiceHead points out that once you're on lock-on, you can also turn on snapping from one enemy to the next.
GTA 6 has no difficulty setting, but the bottom of the Gameplay tab does the same job. JuiceHead shows four options there:

Accessible Combat: you take a lot less damage. MrRoflWaffles uses it so he stops dying mid-mission and losing the cash in his pockets, but warns it makes the game very easy. JuiceHead took on five stars right at the start with it switched on.
Reduced Vehicle Damage: JuiceHead crashed over and over and the car stayed in one piece.
Simplified Mini Games: BennyCentral says it makes hotwiring easier, and JorRaptor uses it for gym workouts. Benny keeps it off himself because he finds the normal mini games more fun.
Auto Drive: how to use it is in how auto drive works in GTA 6.
What each one does, with the menus checked frame by frame, is in how to make GTA 6 easier.

Another Gameplay option puts a helmet on every time you get on a bike and takes it off when you get off. NorZZa tested it a lot, and crashing with a helmet seemed to do less damage, although no two crashes are the same, so it's hard to measure. In one fight after a crash, the other driver punched Jason on his helmet and ended up hurting his own hand. You can also put a helmet on by hand from the radial wheel.

Progress notifications for weapons, vehicles and animals: turn them on. You get a pop-up when you study an animal or find new gear, weapons or vehicles, which helps if you track collectibles or go for 100%. BennyCentral gives the same advice about discovery alerts, because there is so much to find.
Criminal profile and relationship pop-ups: you can turn these off in the UI tab. The game still tracks both, you just stop seeing the messages. What the profile does is in criminal profile explained.

The UI tab lets you show the minimap, the compass, both or neither, and choose whether they stay on screen all the time or show up only when needed. NorZZa recommends the dynamic option at first: the screen stays clean while you explore, and pressing down on the D-pad brings them back along with your stats. NorZZa has both on for now but plans to drop the minimap later and keep only the compass, to watch the world instead of the GPS. JorRaptor also keeps the compass on, because it makes it easier to find a car you parked nearby and to spot activities and icons around you.

Near the end of the UI tab, under Units of Measurement, you can set Distance to Metric, Weight to Kilograms and Temperature to Celsius. There's a Clock Format option there too. NorZZa recommends the switch for anyone outside the US.
Motion blur: BennyCentral turns it off right away. It makes things harder to see at speed, and he says the game runs at 30 fps, which makes it worse.

Vibration: keep it on. BennyCentral normally plays without it, but in GTA 6 a sudden strong rumble while you're on foot means something worth scanning is nearby, like a piece of art. Hold up on the D-pad to open the Waink app and look around. The same app scans cars for trackers.
The Camera tab has separate settings for on foot and driving. You can change how fast the camera turns and its height, from low to high. NorZZa notes the height difference is small.

Zoom is a shortcut, not a menu option. KhrazeGaming shows it: hold down on the D-pad and press square to switch between three distances, over the shoulder, midway and far away. It's kept separately on foot and in vehicles. NorZZa mentions the same three zoom levels.

MrDalekJD answers a question people keep asking: there is no first-person mode in GTA 6, and camera height is the closest setting. The one exception is aiming. With certain attachments on your gun, clicking both sticks while aiming switches to a first-person view. He says this works "if you don't have focus", which isn't fully clear. Everything else stays third person.
If the controls feel odd and you're used to the older games, BennyCentral suggests switching the control scheme to Classic so it plays more like past GTAs.

The in-game phone has its own settings. NorZZa shows you can change the ringtone or turn it off, and pick a wallpaper. Phone cases are sold at Zeke's Electronics in Hamlet, north of the Keys where the game starts. The same store sells headphones, so you can listen to music and podcasts while you walk around.
For the rest of the early game, see the beginner tips. For controls the game never explains, like flipping cars and the car menu, see hidden features.
What is the best movement speed setting in GTA 6? Jog, according to BennyCentral: small stick movements walk and a full push jogs. NorZZa also puts Combat Movement Speed on Jog.
Does GTA 6 have a first-person mode? No. The closest thing is the camera height setting, although certain gun attachments let you aim in first person by clicking both sticks while aiming.
How do you change the camera distance in GTA 6? Hold down on the D-pad and press square (X on Xbox). It cycles between over the shoulder, midway and far.
How do you switch GTA 6 to kilometers? Open Settings, go to the UI tab and scroll to Units of Measurement. Set Distance to Metric, and change Weight and Temperature there too.
The Gameplay tab: Movement Speed on Fast Walk (one of four options), with Combat Movement Speed and Stand & Sprint right below.
Units of Measurement near the end of the UI tab, set to Metric, Kilograms and Celsius.

t: GTA 6 Early Money Warehouse: Where It Is and What to Loot
r: South of Vice-Dale County, close to Jason's house, an abandoned warehouse holds a cash bag, a rifle, an SMG, contraband and a safe with a collectible card. You can go right after the prologue.

l: Early in GTA 6 you can leave Jason's house and come back with over $10,000, a rifle and an SMG. It's all in an abandoned warehouse in the south of Vice-Dale County. Whoever was inside is already dead, so there's no shootout: walk in and take it. GrandTheftIntel, DPJ, LoDj1c, DooDooPoo, YTLukeyy, Arekkz Gaming, FuriousFade, Rodwenn and BennyCentral all showed the same spot.
Area: south of Vice-Dale County, near Hamlet, a short drive from Jason's house.
The building: a red warehouse on the left side of the road, near a quarry and a power plant with smokestacks. The yard is full of trucks and vans.
When to go: any time. GrandTheftIntel went before finishing the first mission. If you haven't discovered the area yet, you can still come back later.
The map is faded around there at the start. Zoom in and drop a marker, or head south through Vice-Dale until you see the warehouse.
Drive there, ideally in something with a big trunk. You'll need it.
Outside box: open the box by the entrance first for a bit of cash.
Teddy bear van: the teddy bear truck parked out front has drugs in the back. Arekkz and BennyCentral both grab it before heading in.
Break the door open and go in. The bodies are already on the floor.
Stash bag: the big bag is worth about $6,000 (DPJ found one with $4,800). Arekkz, FuriousFade and Rodwenn also found a $6,000 bag on the table.

Weapons: loot the bodies. There's an SMG, pistols and, further in, a rifle (DPJ got a Duke 5.56). Arekkz points out the Duke 5.56 here isn't a unique weapon, so you lose it if you die. Rodwenn also found a Desert Eagle pistol in the central room.

Contraband: grab the drugs lying around. They turn into cash at a fence. Each brick is worth $400: the amount pops up on Arekkz's screen, and Rodwenn and FuriousFade give the same number. There are more bricks in a second truck behind another door and in the side room.
Cash register: in the office, empty the register.
Safe: it's in the same office. No code needed: turn the right stick until the circle fills quickly and the lock breaks. Inside is cash, more drugs and a collectible card.

The card is Leroy Rook (Silver), from the Vice City Narcos set. FuriousFade read the name out as soon as he opened the safe, and Arekkz and BennyCentral pulled the same one. Arekkz's screen shows a "Vice City Narcos 1/24" counter, so the set has 24 cards.

In Rodwenn's video, the map card for the Hamlet pawn shop already lists $6,000 in collectibles to sell. That's what the card fetches on the spot. If you'd rather keep it for the set, see collectible cards.
Your bag fills up fast. Open the back of your car and stow the full stash bags there. GrandTheftIntel thinks a car holds about six bags. Then keep looting.
Contraband: take it to Brian's lockup, the first fence, in Key Lento. The door code is 7700. DooDooPoo sold the full drug bag for about $10,000. See all fence locations.

Or at Donnie's: BennyCentral compared both on the map and Donnie's trailer paid $800 more than Brian for the same bag, which came to about $10,000. FuriousFade took the warehouse bags to Donnie and the prompt showed $11,600. He noticed you can't split the sale: drugs and marked bills go together. The payment shows up later in your mailbox at home.
Marked bills: some of the cash comes marked and has to go through a fence too.
The collectible card: GrandTheftIntel sold the Vice City Narcos card for about $6,000 at the store in Hamlet.
Stash the rest at home: there's no ATM early on. Keep your cash under Jason's floorboard, because dying wipes your wallet.

All in, GrandTheftIntel got close to $20,000 before the first mission, and Rodwenn lands in the same place: just under $20,000 once the card is sold. For more ways to build cash, see how to make money in GTA 6. For more early stashes you can hit on the same trip, see GTA 6 secret early items.

Where is the early money warehouse in GTA 6? In the south of Vice-Dale County, near Hamlet and a short drive from Jason's house. It's a red warehouse on the side of the road, next to a quarry, with trucks and vans in the yard.

How much money is in the warehouse? Between the stash bag, the cash register and the safe, it adds up to roughly $9,000 to $11,000. The collectible card from the safe sells for about $6,000 more in Hamlet.
Do you have to finish a mission first? No. GrandTheftIntel went before finishing the first mission, straight from Jason's house. You can also go later in the story.
How do you open the warehouse safe in GTA 6? There's no code. Slowly turn the right stick until the circle fills quickly, and the lock breaks.
Driving up to the warehouse: it's the red building on the left, near the quarry.
The office safe: turn the right stick until you find the sweet spot.

t: GTA 6 Giant Crab Mystery: Computer Password, Safe Code and Reward
r: The giant crab mystery is in a lab in Mariana County. The computer password is CLEAVES, the safe code is 00072 and the boathouse code is 0212. The reward is a stash bag for Brian and the Crabshack VF5 SMG.

l: GTA 6's giant crab mystery can be solved. It's in a hidden lab in Mariana County where someone was experimenting on crabs to make them bigger. The computer password is CLEAVES, the safe code is 00072, the boathouse door code is 0212, and at the end you walk away with a stash bag and the Crabshack VF5 SMG. Gator Keys solved it on stream, and YOUNG DIRK, Arekkz Gaming, Millzaa, RageGamingVideos and BennyCentral all ran through the same codes in their own videos.

Area: Mariana County, in southern Leonida. YOUNG DIRK calls the area Pelican Valley, and so do Arekkz Gaming, Millzaa, RageGamingVideos and BennyCentral. It's most likely the name of the stretch of swamp the island sits in.
The spot: a cluster of strange buildings near the water, with a boathouse next to them.
The clue: a blood trail runs from the main building to the boathouse door, which has a keypad.
Getting there: YOUNG DIRK flew in by plane so he wouldn't need a boat. Try to land right at the site, because the water around it is full of alligators.

Or by boat: Arekkz Gaming and RageGamingVideos took Jason's boat, which is moored at the dock behind his house. Arekkz tied up at the island's little dock and walked in through the gate. It's much quicker than driving or wading.
The Skunk Ape lives in the same county; see the Skunk Ape mission.
Turn on the power. The switch is at the back of the main house. YOUNG DIRK does this before going inside.
Check the back bedroom. There are words carved into the wood. Look at them and use the on-screen zoom: each one becomes a password option on the computer.
Use the computer and pick CLEAVES. YOUNG DIRK cycles through the options with left on the D-pad.
Read the journal. It logs crab experiments. Most crabs died. One was a breakthrough: specimen 00036.
Jump scare. When you back out of the computer, the giant crab attacks. Jason kicks it off and it runs. You can't chase it.
Find where it came from. The tank it broke out of has more notes: the crabs were being raised to eat and sell.
Go back to the computer. A note says safe code = double success. The success was number 36, so the code is 36 × 2 = 00072.

Open the safe. It holds some cash ($1,000 in YOUNG DIRK's video) and the emergency protocol note. Zoom in on it (the prompt in YOUNG DIRK's video is RT on Xbox, R2 on PS5) or press Triangle (Y on Xbox) to show the text: the number is 0212.

Enter the boathouse. Follow the blood trail and punch 0212 into the keypad. The Crabshack VF5 is lying on the floor right by the entrance. Further in, the person behind the experiments made it there and died. On them are a few dollars and a stash bag for Brian.

Gator Keys didn't read the emergency protocol number out loud. In YOUNG DIRK's video the note is on screen with 0212 (2:02), and he types that number into the door keypad (2:40). If the door won't open in your game, double-check the note from the safe.
Item · Value
Stash bag · Between $8,000 and about $10,000, depending on the video. Fence it at Brian's lockup or Donnie's (fence locations)
Crabshack VF5 · Unique SMG with a scope and flashlight already on it. YOUNG DIRK says it goes into your weapon locker for good
Safe · Cash ($1,000 to almost $1,100, depending on the video)
Jet ski · In the boathouse garage, for your getaway

The payout isn't the same in every video. Gator Keys puts the bag at about $10,000. YOUNG DIRK got $8,000 from Brian for it, plus $1,000 from the safe and $12 off the body, so roughly $9,000 in total.

The newer videos lean toward $10,000. Millzaa's bag held $10,000 in marked bills and Brian paid him the full amount. Arekkz Gaming says the same bag is worth $10,000 at Donnie's, and the safe gave him $1,093 and Millzaa almost $1,100. RageGamingVideos, on the other hand, reports $8,000 in the bag and $1,000 in the safe, like YOUNG DIRK.

p.h: A closer look at the Crabshack VF5
l: According to RageGamingVideos, the SMG comes with a tactical flashlight and sights already fitted, a biohazard wrap and a little crab sticker. Millzaa shows the same sight and the flashlight on the right side. Arekkz found it great up close: it fires very fast but isn't accurate at range. Since it's a unique variant, you can't change the attachments.

There's a jet ski in the boathouse garage. Millzaa and Arekkz Gaming both show it: roll up the garage shutter, get on and hotwire it to start the engine. That way you leave the island without wading back through the alligator river. Arekkz says it's faster than Jason's boat and handy for hitting other spots in the area on the same trip, like some of the unique weapons.
There's also a locked storage crate near the dock. According to Arekkz, it only opens with bolt cutters, which you don't get until later in the game.

Gator Keys points to Island Claws, a 1980s horror movie where a marine biologist uses growth hormones to breed bigger crabs for food and a giant one breaks loose in the Florida Keys. That's the exact region GTA 6 recreates.
More rare guns like the Crabshack in GTA 6 unique weapons. More secrets in the GTA 6 easter eggs list.
What is the crab computer password in GTA 6? CLEAVES. The password options appear after you look at the words carved into the wood in the bedroom; Cleaves is the right one.
What is the crab lab safe code in GTA 6? 00072. The note says the code is "double success": the crab that worked was number 36, and 36 times 2 is 72.

What is the boathouse door code in the GTA 6 crab mystery? 0212. It's written on the emergency protocol note you find with the safe. YOUNG DIRK shows the note on screen and punches the same number into the keypad.

What do you get for the giant crab mystery? The Crabshack VF5 SMG, a bag of marked bills worth $8,000 to $10,000 depending on the video, and about $1,000 to $1,100 from the safe. There's also a jet ski in the boathouse to ride out on.
The lab computer unlocked: the grocery list and the note with the safe code hint.

t: How to Refuel and Repair Your Car in GTA 6
r: Pull up to a gas pump, open the Services prompt and pick Refuel to fill up or Repair to fix the car. The price shows first. Electric cars charge at their own stations.

l: To refuel or repair your car in GTA 6, pull up next to a gas pump, open the Services prompt and choose Refuel or Repair. The cost is shown on screen before you commit.
The step by step comes from PC Gamer, and MrBossFTW, Camodo Gaming and StevieWunderKid show the same system in their gameplay.

Gas stations are marked on the map with a fuel pump icon. Open the map and pick the closest one. Camodo Gaming ran low halfway through a trip and pulled into a station before crossing over to an island, so top up before a long drive.
While driving, press down on the D-pad. According to MrBossFTW, that brings up the body condition meter, which works like a health bar for the car, with the fuel gauge right next to it.

StevieWunderKid noticed the fuel needle on the dashboard actually drops as the tank empties, and the engine temperature climbs when you sit still. To see the dashboard up close, pull out your phone while driving and the camera moves inside the car.
Drive up close to the pump until the Services prompt appears.
Choose Refuel. The dollar cost is listed next to it.
Press the interact button.
Jason or Lucia grabs the pump handle.
Hold the button shown in the lower right corner until the tank fills.
They hang the handle back up and you're back in the driver's seat.
Fuel was one of the most debated features before launch, but it barely gets in the way. According to PC Gamer, a full tank lasts a long time, even when you're driving fast.
The catch is stolen cars. A random driver's tank might already be running on fumes when you take it.
Electric cars skip the pump. Look for charging stations on the map instead:
Pull up close to one.
Pick Charge Vehicle. The cost appears on screen.
A quick shot of the charger readout shows the battery climbing to 100%.
Once it's done, drive off.
Repairs are the real reason to visit a gas station, and they happen at the same pump:
Pull up until Services appears.
Choose Repair instead of Refuel.
The camera swoops up into the sky for a moment. When it comes back down, the car is fixed.

The price scales with the damage. It's worth paying to protect a car you've customized at a car shop, or a nicer car you've claimed by pulling its tracker at a Pay 'n' Spray once the story unlocks that.

According to MrBossFTW, the gas pump isn't your only option: Pay 'n' Spray and mod shops fix cars too. All of them charge, so in your first few hours, when cash is tight, he suggests driving carefully to keep the car in one piece. Camodo Gaming limped a wrecked car over to Coastal Auto Care, Joey's shop, to get it fixed.

JorRaptor has a way to skip the repair bill. Save your game, then load that same save straight away. Most of the time you spawn at home with your bank balance untouched and a fully repaired car parked outside, at no cost.
There's a trade-off:
Stolen guns are gone. Any stolen firearms you were carrying don't come back with you.
Drugs stay. Whatever narcotics you were carrying turn up in the car's trunk.

He also suggests carrying just enough cash for gas and body armor and leaving the rest in your stash or the bank, since you lose whatever's on you if you die or get busted. Opening the account is covered in how the bank and ATMs work.

p.h: Before you have a BuckMe account
l: According to Hazard, early in Chapter 1, before you open your BuckMe account, you can't pay for repairs at a gas station or a Pay 'n' Spray at all. In his experience those shops only take bank transfers, so the cash in your floorboard stash is useless there, while gas and groceries can still be paid in cash. His car got so mangled he was more or less driving on three wheels.

That's one channel's account. The other channels on this page paid for repairs at the pump without running into it. If a station turns down your money early on, open the BuckMe account first: Hazard says it unlocks with the mission Buck Me, right after Lucia's party.
For other car tricks, like shoving a car that ran dry, see GTA 6 hidden features. To keep a car you stole, read how to steal cars, and to park your own, check the garage locations and prices.
How do you get gas in GTA 6? Pull up next to a pump at any gas station, pick Refuel from the Services prompt and hold the on-screen button until the tank is full.
How do you repair your car in GTA 6? Use the same gas pump and pick Repair from the Services prompt. The price depends on how banged up the car is.
How do you charge an electric car in GTA 6? Find a charging station on the map, pull up and choose Charge Vehicle. A short scene shows the battery filling to 100%.
Do cars run out of gas fast in GTA 6? No. A full tank lasts a long time, but a car you take from a stranger may already be close to empty.
At the pump, the game lists both services with their prices: refuel for $28 or repair for $90.

t: GTA 6 Chapter 1 Walkthrough: The First 7 Missions Step by Step
r: A step-by-step guide to GTA 6 Chapter 1, from Prologue to Unwanted Attention: the goal of each mission, the controls the game teaches and how to avoid failing.

l: GTA 6's Chapter 1 opens with Lucia behind bars, then hands you Jason in the Leonida Keys and starts stacking up missions fast. Below is the goal of each of the first 7 missions, from Prologue to Unwanted Attention, plus the controls the game teaches and what to watch out for. It's built on GamesRadar+'s walkthrough, which is still being written and currently ends at mission 7. The Lab Fees codes match what Bombastic and Musty Sky showed in their own playthroughs.
Controls are listed as PS5 / Xbox.
Goal: learn the basics as Lucia, still locked up in Leonida Penitentiary.
Talk to your cellmates: hold L2 / LT to target someone and press X / A to talk.
Follow the guard to area A102 and wait. You can chat with other inmates in the meantime.
In Counselor Gates' office, a flashback to a bank robbery kicks in. Hold L2 / LT to point the gun and press Square / X to threaten. Lean on the teller and grab the cash bundles with Triangle / Y.
A customer will grab Lucia. Tap Square / X quickly to break free.
Run across the rooftops: Square / X jumps and climbs, L3 runs, and L3 again sprints.
Don't stress: with 2 stars there's no real way out. Lucia always gets caught at the end, because the story needs her to.
Goal: scoop up the packages dropped into the sea, then pull Donnie out of the Kingfisher camp.
R2 / RT speeds up the boat and L2 / LT slows it down. Follow the pink circle on the minimap.
Near a package, press L3 + R3 together for Focus: rings pulse around whatever you're hunting for. Get close and Cal hooks it on his own.
There are 3 packages. If the minimap fades, press down on the D-pad to bring the objective back. X / A does tight turns at speed.

Donnie changes the plan over the radio: head to a small dock about 0.5 miles away. That's where you try the binoculars: hold L1 / LB, pick them on the wheel with the right stick, let go, then use them with L2 / LT.

At the camp (Sunrise RV Park), stealth is the way to go. Circle / B crouches. There are no vision cones: watch the yellow bar over enemies' heads and yellow flashes at the screen edges instead. Stick to the left side of the camp and stay off the main road.
When Donnie mentions a turbine, hold R3 to spot it on the west side. He's in the shack next to it. Expect a fistfight inside: Square / X punches and X / A right before a hit lands counters it.
Low on health? There's a Zombix bottle on top of the terrarium in the middle of the shack.
A big gunfight follows on the way out. R1 / RB moves you in and out of cover. You can hold up to 2 pistols and 2 long guns.
Optional: a green dollar sign marks Brian's cash inside a white and red camper. Someone jumps you once you're inside.

Escape in the Dodo seaplane: R2 / RT throttles up, the left stick handles pitch, and Square / X or Circle / B work the rudder. To land at Brian's marina to the north, hold L2 / LT to slow down and ease the nose down.
Finally, drop Cal off at home in Jason's Ganado and head back to Jason's place. Lucia calls.
GamesRadar+ counts the house as part of Gear Up. None of it is required, but it pays off:
Repairs: 5 jobs (railing, steps, roof, bedroom wall and painting that wall). According to the guide, they help your relationship with Lucia later on.
Stash: Jason can only carry $2,000 in pocket cash. The loose floorboard next to the bed holds up to $20,000.

Collectibles: magazines and books inside the house. GamesRadar+ counts 4 and GameSpot counts 5, and the two sites disagree about the downstairs storage room (see the table). GameSpot says to read them all before Chapter 1 ends.
Title · Where, per GamesRadar+ · Where, per GameSpot
Ashes of Glory · Bedroom dresser · Bedside table
Lethal By Design · Dining table · Living room coffee table
Orca: A Whole Different Animal · Bookcase with the radio · Desk beside a radio and a pile of books
Body Copy · Not listed · Table on the back porch, by the workout area
Off the Hook · Counter in the downstairs storage room · Not listed
Reel Talk · Not listed · Storage area under the house

For the downstairs storage room, this page used to list Off the Hook, as GamesRadar+ does; GameSpot puts Reel Talk there instead. Both could be in there, or one site may have the name wrong, so check everything you can pick up in that room. Christian Konopatzki's video confirms Ashes of Glory is in the bedroom. GamesRadar+ says there are 27 of these collectibles in total, and every location found so far is in our magazines, books and comics guide.
Goal: buy a longarm at Ammu-Nation (Chuck's Gun Shop).
Before leaving, check the mailbox outside: that's where job payments land. If you stashed all your money, take some back out.
On PS5, the touchpad opens the in-game index with missions and destinations. Holding down on the D-pad shows nearby places.
Talk to Chuck at the counter. GamesRadar+ recommends the Fortune & Son Moreland shotgun for $350. The Duke 556 assault rifle costs $1,450 and could eat most of your cash.
Carrying a gun in the open draws attention. Leave it in the locker at the back of the store or in your trunk.
A fight breaks out as you leave. Settle it with your fists so the cops stay out of it: Square / X punches, holding X / A blocks and tapping X / A dodges.
Goal: get the Ganado fixed at Joey's shop (Coastal Auto Care), at the bottom end of Key Lento.
In the index, go to the diary tab and set Fix Your Car as your destination. Leaving Ammu-Nation, turn left.
Stop at the green garage door, hold up on the D-pad to talk to Joey, then drive inside.
Under Full Engine, pick Stock Engine for $100. Switch tabs with L1 / LB and R1 / RB. Under Cosmetics, the Respray is free.
Ultimate Edition owners will find the free Retro Build under Pro Builds > Full Kits, which paints the car and bumps its speed and acceleration.
Lucia will appreciate the repair too. Afterwards you can call Joey from your contacts to fix or deliver the Ganado.
Goal: collect overdue rent at the Moonstone Boutique, in the Key Lento art market.
Before going in, call Brian (up on the D-pad, then Contacts). He explains the shop is a front for a drug lab.
Want a more professional Criminal Profile? Don't storm in shooting. Target the clerk with L2 / LT and pick X / A to defuse or Square / X to threaten.
When he pulls a baseball bat, take it with Triangle / Y. Leave his face alone and he hands over the code before running off.
The safe is in the back: code 0420. Use Focus (L3 + R3) to find items, and empty the register on your way out.
Brian wants the goods in his lockup. The door code is 7700. Drop everything in the box and collect your pay from Jason's mailbox later.

How it went for Bombastic: he tried talking first. The clerk claimed he had no rent money, and only after Jason got aggressive did he offer the acid instead and give up the code 0420. The safe was in the back room, and the register only had a few dollars in it. Musty Sky uses the same 7700 to open Brian's lockup when he drops off stolen goods.
More codes are on our GTA 6 safe codes page, and selling stolen goods is covered in fence locations.
Goal: collect rent from Mandy, who only pays if Jason fixes something first.
Brian calls: answer with up on the D-pad.
Mandy's place is close to Jason's house. Look for the green car in the driveway and the American flag.
Inside, target her with L2 / LT and ask for a plunger with Square / X.
The plunger sits next to the toilet. Grab it with Triangle / Y and go to the kitchen sink.
Tap R3 over and over to plunge. Then Jason crawls under the sink: hold R2 to turn the wrench, five times. What comes out is gross. Then you're free to leave.
Goal: get a Phoenix out of the police impound lot in Hamlet and hand it to Brian.
Meet Cal under the underpass and drive his 95 Bison 900 to Hamlet, 1.6 miles away (around 5 minutes). Hold left on the D-pad to switch radio stations.
Cal installs the Cop Scanner on your phone, so you can listen in on police radio.
The easiest way through, with the fewest stars, is stealth. Leaving the cops unharmed also helps your Criminal Profile.
Don't force the gate with Square / X, it's loud. Hop the fence with X / A and crouch right away with Circle / B.
Head straight to the back of the lot. In front of a white van there's a stack of boxes: climb them and get over the next fence.

There are 3 cops: one watching a boat on the left, one looking at a car in the garage ahead, and one in the guard station on the right. Throw a bottle with R2 near the guard station, then crouch-run in and open the gate at the controls.
The Phoenix is hoisted up in the middle of the lot (the WAiNK app on your phone helps you spot it). To hotwire it, line up both sticks with the glowing spots on the bars.
Driving off gives you 2 stars straight away. Get out of the red circle on the minimap fast.
Brian sends you to the Pay 'n' Spray behind Boone Speedway. Do both: repair it (better condition means a bigger reward) and respray it so the cops stop recognizing the car.
Drop it at Brian's garage and grab your pay from the back office.
To lower your recognition, take off the hat and sunglasses from the menu (L1 / LB, items tab with R1 / RB) or buy a new outfit off the mannequins at the nearby Ammu-Nation ($59 to $96).
To get home, call Joey to bring your car or ring Paradise Taxi. Once there, eat, shower and sleep.
For more on stars, heat and recognition, see how to lose the police in GTA 6.
Chapter 1 keeps going after Unwanted Attention. Names and order for the rest are in our GTA 6 mission list. GamesRadar+'s guide is still in progress and should cover the next missions soon.
What is the first mission in GTA 6? Prologue, with Lucia in prison. The flashback chase always ends with her getting caught, so don't waste time trying to escape.
What is the Moonstone Boutique safe code in GTA 6? 0420. Brian's lockup, where you drop the goods right after, opens with 7700.

How do you get through Unwanted Attention with less police heat? Hop the fence, stay crouched and throw a bottle to distract the cop in the guard station. After the theft, repair and respray the Phoenix at Pay 'n' Spray.
Is it worth repairing Jason's house in GTA 6? Yes. It's optional, but GamesRadar+ says it improves your relationship with Lucia later on.
Jason on the boat at the start of Gone Fishing, his first mission in Chapter 1.
Ashes of Glory, one of the reads in Jason's house, picked up in the bedroom with the options to open it, show the text, flip it or put it back.

t: Can You Cheat on Lucia or Romance Mandy in GTA 6? Plus What's in Mandy's Sink
r: No. Jason can't cheat on Lucia or romance Mandy: he turns down every advance, and Rockstar says that wouldn't fit the couple's story. Here's also what comes out of Mandy's sink.

l: No. In GTA 6, Jason can't cheat on Lucia and you can't romance Mandy. Mandy flirts with him all the time, but Jason turns her down every single time, and you have no control over it. Rockstar has said the game is built around the couple and that this kind of option doesn't fit their story.
Mandy is the tenant you meet in the Chapter 1 mission Pipework.

p.h: Why Mandy isn’t a romance option
l: According to GameSpot, which played through the mission:
Mandy makes it obvious from the start that she's into Jason.
No dialogue choice lets you steer things in a romantic direction. Jason is set on making things right with Lucia.
At the end of the mission, after the sink is fixed, she makes one last try to get him to stay. Jason leaves, and the game doesn't let you choose otherwise.
The full rent collection walkthrough and where her house is are in Mandy in GTA 6.

PC Gamer reports that a group of players was upset about not being able to pick up other women in the game. In a statement to Shacknews, Rockstar said GTA 6 is the story of a couple on the run and that everything in the game is there to support that story. A lot of features from earlier GTA games were left out for that reason.

You can still go to clubs, even as a couple, but there's no option to go further with anyone else. The only relationship the game tracks is Jason and Lucia's. See how it works in Jason and Lucia's romance guide.

p.h: Can you go back to Mandy’s place?
l: Yes. GameSpot says that later on, walking, biking or driving past her house can trigger more conversations between the two. Even so, she's still not a romance option, which is why GameSpot puts "relationship" in quotes.
Plenty of people are looking up the "sink scene" from Pipework. Apex Films' video shows what happens:
Jason tries the plunger on the kitchen sink first. It doesn't work.
He crawls under the sink and uses a wrench to loosen the pipe. In that part of the video, the wrench prompt shows up on RT, an Xbox button. The PS5 buttons are on the Mandy mission page.
Out of the pipe comes a small object completely covered in grime. Jason holds it up near his face and grimaces.
The moment is quick and the object is filthy. The sources don't agree on what it is:
PC Gamer: it looks like a finger, and Mandy grabs it out of Jason's hand right away and leaves with it. The article says this has made plenty of players suspicious of her.
GameSpot: it only calls it a curious item that was clogging the pipes.
Apex Films: in that part of the video, the object is caked in grime and hard to make out.
Rockstar hasn't explained the scene. For now, the "finger" is PC Gamer's reading, not something the game confirms.
The same video wanders around Mandy's yard and her green car looking for more clues, but doesn't show anything conclusive. For the whole mission with every button, see the Chapter 1 walkthrough.
Can you cheat on Lucia in GTA 6? No. There's no option for Jason to get with anyone else. Rockstar says it doesn't fit the couple's story.
Can you romance Mandy in GTA 6? No. Mandy flirts with Jason constantly, but he shuts her down every time and you don't get a say in it.
What's in Mandy's sink in GTA 6? A small, grime-covered object that was clogging the pipe. Jason grimaces, and the scene never makes clear what it is.
Can you go back to Mandy's house after the mission? Yes. GameSpot says passing by her place later can trigger new conversations, but she's still not a romance option.
Jason at Mandy's kitchen sink during Pipework, with the prompt to use the plunger.
Under the sink, Jason pulls a small, grime-covered object out of the pipe and grimaces.

t: How to Fix the Railing in GTA 6 (and Every Other Repair at Jason's House)
r: The railing is on the lower back deck by the gym gear. Here's where every repair at Jason's house is, the buttons, what to buy for Lucia, and why you have to finish before you pick her up.

l: To fix the railing in GTA 6, go out the back of Jason's house, head down to the lower deck with the gym equipment, hold Triangle (Y on Xbox) at the gap in the railing and press R2 (RT) to nail the new panels in. The railing is one of several repairs around the house. They're all optional, each one helps Jason's relationship with Lucia, and there's a catch: you can only do them before you pick Lucia up from prison.

The repair objective shows up in Chapter 1, while Lucia is about to get out. GamesRadar+ calls it the Repair The House side mission and files it under Gear Up. GameSpot explains the backstory: the waterfront house in Key Lento belongs to Jason's boss, Brian Heder, who lets him stay there rent-free. It costs Jason nothing, but it's half finished, with a missing wall and a leaky roof.

GameSpot warns that the projects lock as soon as you decide to go and get Lucia. Once she moves in, anything you left undone can't be finished anymore. So knock them all out before you drive to the prison.
Even if you don't care about the romance, GameSpot points out that the house simply ends up nicer.

It depends who's counting. GamesRadar+ and Arekkz Gaming list the wall and the paint job separately, for 5 repairs. GameSpot rolls both into a single Fix Wall project and says there are 4. The actual work is the same.

p.h: Every repair and what it unlocks
l: Buttons are listed as PS5 / Xbox:
Repair · Where · What to do · What you get
Railing · Lower back deck with the gym gear and the BBQ, at the gap next to an aluminum ladder · Hold Triangle / Y to fit new panels, then R2 / RT to nail them · A boost with Lucia

Steps · Bottom of the outside staircase up to the front door, the one closest to the mailbox and driveway. The planks sit on a blue tarp · Hold Triangle / Y. Hold L2 / LT and R2 / RT to rip out the old steps, then press X to put in new ones · A boost with Lucia
Leaky roof · Front of the house, up the yellow ladder beside the door · Walk into the ladder to climb, go to the exposed patch and nail tiles with R2 / RT · A boost with Lucia

Bedroom wall · Jason's bedroom. The plasterboard is stacked at the foot of the bed, and the open wall frame is across from the bed · Hold Triangle / Y and screw the panels in with R2 / RT · A boost with Lucia, and it unlocks the paint job
Paint · Paint cans next to the dresser · Pick Tropical Green, Stormy Blue or Peach Pastel · A boost with Lucia. Afterwards Jason stores the cans in the storage room outside, where the punching bag is
For the steps, GamesRadar+ only lists X for installing the new boards and doesn't give the Xbox button. GameSpot rates the roof as the easiest repair to find and the railing as one of the trickiest.
One thing trips people up here: you can see the gap from the upper deck, but you can't repair it from that side. Here's the route GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer describe:
Inside the house, open the glass sliding door near the TV and step out onto the back deck.
Straight ahead, opposite the door and near the deck chairs, you'll see the railing with panels missing. You can't fix it from here.
Turn left and take the stairs on your right down to the lower deck, where the barbell, weights and BBQ are.

Face the house and look for the gap in the railing beside an aluminum ladder. GamesRadar+ puts it to the left of the ladder; PC Gamer says it's between the ladder and the weights. In Arekkz Gaming's video there are loose boards and paint cans leaning underneath.
When the paintbrush icon appears, walk up and hold Triangle (Y). Jason starts fitting the new panels.
Press R2 (RT) every time the game prompts you to nail a panel in. A Nail prompt with R2 shows up on screen.

The wall comes first. GameSpot describes the bedroom wall as only half built. GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer both say the panels are stacked at the foot of Jason's bed, while GameSpot tells you to interact with the wooden frame on the wall across from the bed. Screw the plasterboard in with Triangle (Y) and R2 (RT), then walk over to the paint cans by the dresser and choose a color. Arekkz points out that the color is entirely up to you.

p.h: What to buy and do before Lucia gets home
l: According to GameSpot, once the house projects are done there are a few more time-sensitive jobs before Lucia arrives, and she appreciates all of them:
pick up the groceries;
get her a custom necklace (our beginner tips mention a store and a price);
collect her friend's clothes for her;
buy flowers;
get a haircut (see the barber and clothing stores).

p.h: What you get out of it
l: A better relationship with Lucia. Arekkz calls fixing the house one of the easiest ways to raise it, and says each job gives the relationship a bump. GamesRadar+ says the payoff shows up later on, and GameSpot notes that the game itself tells you the projects make Lucia happier.

A punching bag. Once the wall is painted, Jason stores the paint cans in a storage room outside. The punching bag is at the back of that room: hold Triangle (Y) to hang it and press Square (X on Xbox) to train your stamina.
MrDalekJD lists the same jobs (drywall, roof leaks, fresh paint) and also frames them as a way to impress Lucia before she moves in.

You can start as soon as Gear Up begins. KultZ suggests the day Lucia calls with errands before you pick her up: you have to carry the groceries into the house anyway, so knock out the bedroom wall and the steps while you're there.
The hard limit is the prison run. Per GameSpot, once you commit to picking Lucia up, there's no going back to the projects.

While you're home, grab the magazines and books lying around too: GameSpot counts 5 in the house and says to read them all before Chapter 1 wraps up. See where they are in the magazines, books and comics guide.
To keep building the relationship after that, see the Jason and Lucia romance guide. The early missions are covered in the Chapter 1 walkthrough.

How do you fix the railing in GTA 6? Go out the back of Jason's house and down to the lower deck with the gym equipment. Hold Triangle (Y on Xbox) at the gap in the railing next to the ladder, then press R2 (RT) to nail the new panels in.

Where is the ladder to fix the roof in GTA 6? At the front of Jason's house, right next to the front door. It's a yellow ladder. Climb it, walk up to the hole in the roof and nail the tiles down with R2 (RT).
Does fixing Jason's house help with Lucia? Yes. Arekkz Gaming says each repair gives your relationship with Lucia a bump, and GameSpot notes the game itself says the projects make Lucia happier.

Can you fix Jason's house after picking up Lucia? No. According to GameSpot, once you choose to go and get Lucia, any project you haven't finished is locked for good. Wrap them all up before you head to the prison.
The broken railing at the back of Jason's house, on the deck with the gym equipment.
Jason nailing the new railing panels: the game shows Nail on R2.

t: Mandy in GTA 6: Where Is Mandy's House and How to Collect Her Rent
r: Mandy's house is a short drive from Jason's place: look for the green car in the driveway and the American flag. Here's how to find it in the index and finish Pipework.

l: Mandy's house is a short drive from Jason's place. GamesRadar+ gives two landmarks: a green car in the driveway and an American flag flying outside. None of our sources name the street, so the quickest way there is to set the mission as your destination from the map index.
Mandy is the tenant in Pipework, a Chapter 1 mission where Brian sends Jason to collect her overdue rent.

According to GamesRadar+, Brian calls a couple of minutes after you drop the Moonstone Boutique stash at his lockup at the end of Lab Fees. Answer with D-pad Up when your phone rings. He's got another tenant behind on rent and wants Jason to go collect.

The sources don't agree on the order. GamesRadar+ puts Pipework right after Lab Fees, while PC Gamer's list has it as mission 7 of Chapter 1, after Unwanted Attention, summed up as Jason doing some DIY. If Brian hasn't called yet, check the mission list to see what comes first.

p.h: Finding the house with the index
l: Open the map (touchpad on PS5).
Press D-pad Right to bring up the index.
On the Story tab (the journal icon), select Mandy's mission and press X (A on Xbox) to make it your active destination. The GPS draws the route.
When you reach the street, look for the green car. In GTA Series Videos' playthrough it's a convertible parked on the gravel out front.
The index is covered in full in our index guide.
Buttons are listed as PS5 / Xbox:
Chat with Mandy outside. She invites Jason in.
She leads you to the back bedroom. Hold L2 / LT to interact and press Square / X to ask if she has a plunger. She'll only pay up if Jason helps with a repair.
Cross the hall to the bathroom. The plunger is next to the toilet: pick it up with Triangle / Y.
Take it to the kitchen sink and press Triangle / Y again.
Tap R3 over and over to work the plunger.
That doesn't clear it, so Jason crawls under the sink. Hold R2 / RT to turn the wrench. Mandy keeps talking the whole time; just keep going.
After five turns, you find what was blocking the pipe. GamesRadar+ only says it's disgusting. Then get out of the house.

For that last part, GamesRadar+ only gives the PS5 buttons (R3 and R2). In Apex Films' video, played on an Xbox controller, the wrench prompt sits on RT. KultZ backs up the ending: the job finishes with Jason under Mandy's kitchen sink.

p.h: What comes out of Mandy’s sink
l: This is the bit that has so many people searching for the "GTA 6 sink mission". In Apex Films' video, Jason loosens the pipe and pulls out a small object caked in grime. He holds it close to his face and grimaces. It's over in a second and the object is filthy. PC Gamer says it looks like a finger, and that Mandy grabs it out of Jason's hand right after. GameSpot doesn't say what it is, only that a curious item was clogging the pipes. Rockstar hasn't explained it.
For a closer look at the scene with screenshots, and why nobody has confirmed what the object is yet, see the sink section of can you cheat on Lucia or romance Mandy?.
How the visit ends: GameSpot says that once the sink is sorted, Mandy makes one more attempt to get Jason to stay. He says no and walks out, and the game gives you no say in it.

Going back later: according to GameSpot, passing by Mandy's house on foot, by bike or by car can kick off more conversations with her. She still isn't a romance option, though. See can you romance Mandy?.
What's next: with the rent paid, GamesRadar+ points you to Cal's texts, which lead into the next mission.
How much it pays: none of the sources say what Jason earns from this job.

A plane crash: Arekkz Gaming says that once you've progressed the story and met Mandy, crossing a bridge he marks on the map can trigger a small plane crashing into the nearby swamp. The wreck has valuables you can sell, but enemies show up if you hang around too long.
Every other early mission, with the same button prompts, is in the Chapter 1 walkthrough.
Where is Mandy's house in GTA 6? A short drive from Jason's house. Look for the green car in the driveway and the American flag, or set the mission as your destination from the map index.
What is Mandy's mission in GTA 6? It's Pipework, in Chapter 1. Brian sends Jason to collect Mandy's overdue rent, and she only pays once he unclogs her kitchen sink.
Where is the plunger in Mandy's house? In the bathroom across the hall, right next to the toilet. Grab it with Triangle (Y on Xbox) and take it to the kitchen sink.

What comes out of Mandy's sink in GTA 6? A small, filthy object stuck in the kitchen pipe. Jason pulls it out, looks at it up close and pulls a face, but you can't make out what it is. GameSpot just calls it a curious item.
Pulling up at Mandy's house: the green car, a convertible, sits on the gravel driveway.

t: GTA 6 Meteorite Location: Where to Find and Sell It
r: The GTA 6 meteorite crashed into a campsite on the east side of Mount Kalaga, in Lummox County. Grab it with Triangle and sell it on the Lifeinvader marketplace or at a pawn shop.

l: The GTA 6 meteorite is sitting in a wrecked campsite on the east side of Mount Kalaga, the big mountain in Lummox County at the top of the map. You can pick up a chunk of the rock and sell it later. Robbin Rams and Milo both found the same spot on video. It isn't the only one, either: at least four more are out there, listed at the bottom of this page.
County: Lummox County, in the far north of the map.
Mountain: Mount Kalaga. Robbin Rams found the meteorite on the right-hand (east) side of the mountain.
Getting there: Milo says to walk east down the hill. Robbin Rams flew in by helicopter and spotted the crash site while circling the mountain.
What to look for: flattened tents, knocked-over camping chairs and a crater glowing purple in the middle. It looks like someone was camping there when the rock came down.
The only other things lying around are a few bottles. Robbin Rams searched the area for more loot and found nothing else.

In his video, Robbin Rams calls the place "Mount Chiliad". That's the mountain from GTA San Andreas and GTA 5. In GTA 6, the big northern mountain is Mount Kalaga, inside Mount Kalaga National Park in Lummox County.
Robbin Rams also says he's in "Lumas County", which is Lummox, and Milo places the crash site in Lummox County too. You can see all five counties in the GTA 6 map guide.
Walk up to the rock in the middle of the crater.
Press Triangle on PS5 (Y on Xbox).
A gold box icon with the meteorite shows up, and your character slips the rock into a pocket.

After that, Robbin Rams couldn't find the meteorite anywhere in his inventory, and the help pages in the menu don't mention it. ZacCoxTV had the same problem with the meteorite from the UFO house. So far, nobody has shown where the item ends up.

Lifeinvader marketplace: right after grabbing the meteorite at the UFO house, ZacCoxTV got a line in the game explaining that it's a piece of a meteorite, that plenty of them are scattered around, and that people on the Lifeinvader marketplace pay good money for them.

Pawn shop: ZacCoxTV says you can also take one to a pawn shop, but he doesn't say which. Hamlet Pawn, near Jason's house, is the one players use for selling collectible cards, as covered in the collectible cards guide.
None of the videos show the sale going through or how much it pays. Until someone does, the value of a meteorite is unknown.
UFO house in Bellville: there's a meteorite under the owner's bed. To get inside, you have to break in through the garage.

Crater at the top of Mount Kalaga: ZacCoxTV showed a crater with a freshly fallen meteorite, still smoking, at the summit, next to a ring of stones nobody has figured out yet. He doesn't mention the campsite, so it may be the same spot as the one Robbin Rams and Milo found, or a second one close by.
Both Robbin Rams and ZacCoxTV say it reminds them of the meteorites in Red Dead Redemption 2.

p.h: Three meteorites next to the carcasses
l: GameSpot found a collectible meteorite near each of the three strange creature carcasses in Mariana County. The carcasses are curiosities you can scan with the WAiNK app, so you can tick off both on the same trip:
Carcass · How to get there · Note
Abismo Key · Take the highway south-southwest to Abismo Key, then cut through the mangrove to the south until you reach the beach · It looks like the skeleton of an alien
Goose Key · Inside the military base, Mile Zero Air Station, following the coastline northeast · Restricted area, so stay out of the soldiers' sight
Wetman Bay · In Wetman Bay, on the island north of the beach covered in dead sharks · It's out in a chain of islands, so bring a boat
The rest of the curiosities are in WAiNK curiosities and landmarks.
For more aliens, UFOs and other secrets, see the GTA 6 easter eggs list.
Where is the meteorite in GTA 6? In a wrecked campsite on the east side of Mount Kalaga, in Lummox County at the top of the map. There's another one under the bed in the UFO house in Bellville.
Where do you sell the meteorite in GTA 6? On the Lifeinvader marketplace through your phone, or at a pawn shop, according to ZacCoxTV. No video has shown the price yet.
Is Mount Chiliad in GTA 6? No. Robbin Rams uses the GTA 5 name in his video, but the mountain he's on is Mount Kalaga, in Lummox County.

Where are the other meteorites in GTA 6? GameSpot found one next to each strange creature carcass in Mariana County: on Abismo Key, on Goose Key inside the military base, and on an island in Wetman Bay. There's also one under the bed in the UFO house in Bellville.
The campsite wrecked by the meteorite, with the crater still giving off purple smoke.

t: GTA 6 Military Base Location: How to Get Into Mile Zero Air Station
r: The GTA 6 military base is Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key, in the southwest corner of the map. The easiest way in is the stunt jump ramp on the southeast side. Inside: jets, tanks and helicopters.

l: The GTA 6 military base is Mile Zero Air Station, and it's the easiest place to grab a fighter jet, a tank or a military helicopter. The simplest way in is a stunt jump ramp that launches you over the fence. PC Gamer and T5G both showed it.
On Goose Key, in Mariana County, in the southwest corner of the map.
It's out on the big bridges to the southern keys. It feels far, but it's close to Jason's first house in Key Lento.
Head to the southeast corner of the base along the southern access road.
Get past the concrete barricade checkpoints. They're lightly manned, but expect some gunfire.
Look for a big dirt mound against the barbed wire fence. That's the Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump.
Hit it at speed. You get credit for the stunt jump and land inside the base.

TGG recommends hitting the ramp on a dirt bike, which weaves through the checkpoints more easily. If the jump fails, go faster. The main gate works too, but it has far more guards and a vehicle blocking the entrance.
T5G points out it's the same idea as the classic ramp into the military base in GTA 5.
Vehicle · Type
Hauners P-996 Lazer · Fighter jet
Hauners Rhino · Tank
Hauners APC · Armored transport
Botticher Buzzard · Attack helicopter
Mammoth Patriot · Truck
Botticher 015A · Plane

Once you land, turn left. Maka91Productions finds the tanks on the left side of a huge building just past the fence, with big and small ones parked together. The Rhinos are the big ones, and they sit closest to the fence you jumped over. Arekkz Gaming took a different route, driving past the bunkers and the jets, and found a whole row of Rhinos at the back of a corner of the base.
Getting in: walk up and press Triangle (Y on Xbox). Your character climbs in through the hatch automatically, but Arekkz warns you can still take bullets while that happens.
Firing: the Rhino has a single main gun. Maka91Productions fires it with RB (R1 on PS5).
Watch the sky: the gun can't tilt up far enough to hit anything overhead, and rocket helicopters show up once your stars climb.
Climbing into a Rhino also pops the Challenging Tank achievement. The full walkthrough is in how to get a tank in GTA 6.

The base also hides one of the WAiNK app's curiosities. According to GameSpot, if you follow the coastline northeast inside Mile Zero Air Station, you'll find the Goose Key Carcass, the remains of some strange creature, with a collectible meteorite right next to it. It's a restricted area, so try to get there without the soldiers spotting you. The rest are in WAiNK curiosities and landmarks, and what to do with the rock is in the meteorite guide.

p.h: Can you keep the jet or the tank?
l: Not for good. RageGamingVideos points out that military vehicles have permanent trackers: you can take one out and have fun, but you can't keep it as your own. He also shows the quickest route: take the highway exit on the east side of the base, turn right right after it, and the ramp points you straight over the fence. Inside, the jets sit in a row, the tanks are further in, and there are APCs around the corner.
Make an extra save before you go in. With GTA 6's criminal profile system, causing chaos on base can follow you, and the save lets you take it back.
Before you go, TGG suggests:
buying body armor at Ammu-Nation (up to 3, at the counter, under Equipment);
packing Zombix and adrenaline to heal on the way;
saving your game, since dying with cash on you means losing it.

Once inside, the military tries to box you in: head straight for the jets. The jet has a machine gun and missiles, but it also carries a red tracker, and fighter jets come after you. In the video, stealing the tank earned a six-star wanted level. See how to get six stars.

If you're spotted on base you get a wanted level and an immediate gunfight. The plan: jump in over the ramp, go straight to the vehicle you want and leave. If you took the jet, fly low to be seen less. See how to lose the police.
If you just want a plane to explore, there are seaplanes and a helicopter nobody is guarding in Southwind, right next to the base: see where to find your first plane and helicopter.
Where is the military base in GTA 6? It's Mile Zero Air Station, on Goose Key in Mariana County, in the southwest corner of the map. It's close to Jason's first house in Key Lento.
How do you get into the military base in GTA 6? Use the Mile Zero Air Station Southeast stunt jump: a dirt mound against the barbed wire fence on the southeast corner. Hit it at speed in a car.
How do you get a tank in GTA 6? The military base has Hauners Rhino tanks. It's the easiest place to steal one, but you get a wanted level as soon as you're spotted inside.

Where are the tanks inside the GTA 6 military base? After the ramp, go left: Maka91Productions finds the Rhinos beside a huge building just past the fence. Arekkz Gaming found another row tucked into a back corner of the base, past the jets.
The dirt mound against the base fence: that's the stunt jump ramp.

t: GTA 6 Radio Tower Easter Egg: Where the Egg Is and What Happens When You Throw It
r: At the top of the tallest radio tower in GTA 6 there's a nest with a literal Easter egg. The climb takes about six minutes, and throwing the egg off the top triggers a secret cutscene.

l: GTA 6 has a literal Easter egg. At the top of the tallest radio tower in the game there's a bird's nest with a colorful egg in it. You can stash the egg in your inventory or throw it off the tower, and throwing it triggers a secret cutscene.
T5G, ZacCoxTV, MrDalekJD, InkTV and Typical Gamer all showed the egg on video, and Kotaku reported a player's find on launch day.

The tower: the tallest radio tower on the map, in South Vice-Dale County, right next to Hamlet. InkTV marks it just north of Hamlet, off a side road, and Typical Gamer describes the spot as northeast of Mariana County, just south of Vice-Dale County. It shows up on the map as a 3D object, and you can spot it from far away.
Getting in: hop the fence at the base of the tower.

The climb: ladders, one after another. T5G took about six minutes; MrDalekJD says 10 to 15 minutes going slow. There are platforms about a third, half and two thirds of the way up where you can catch a break.
By helicopter: you can land on top, but MrDalekJD warns it's risky. The ladders are the safe way.
Clouds at the top: the tower pokes through the cloud layer. InkTV reached the top unable to see the ground and waited a couple of minutes for it to clear.
There are several tall radio towers around the map. T5G found a character on another one trying to climb it, a nod to streamers who climb towers in games.

p.h: What to do with the egg
l: Grab the egg from the nest. The nest is near the top but not at the highest point: there's still more ladder above it.
Choose: stash it in your inventory or throw it off the top.
If you throw it, aim high, over the railing. MrDalekJD's first, weaker throw didn't trigger anything. A high throw starts a short cutscene. We won't spoil it, but it's worth the climb.
You only get one egg. After throwing his, Typical Gamer tried to pick up another and the game wouldn't let him.

Above the nest, at the highest point of the tower, there's a base jump challenge. Two cones mark the jump-off spot, and a full parachute sits right there for you to grab, so you don't even need to bring one.
Typical Gamer equipped the parachute, jumped and found that the course wraps around the tower. He clipped the cables and that was the end of the run.
ZacCoxTV also climbed to the very top and jumped from there.
The other jump spots are in GTA 6 base jump locations.

InkTV grabbed the egg, threw it and got the cutscene. Then, on the last set of ladders, he ran into an influencer who was already at the top. She tells you she got there first and you'll have to wait, and the two of you trade a few jabs. It isn't a mission, just one more surprise for whoever makes the climb.
ZacCoxTV points out that GTA Vice City had a hidden chocolate Easter egg. The radio tower egg in GTA 6, which is also set in Vice City, looks like a callback to that joke.
A fall from the tower kills you, and falling halfway means climbing it all again. Walk, don't sprint, when you move from one ladder to the next.
Before you start, equip your parachute in your items. It saves you if you slip, and it's the fastest way down.
More secrets in the GTA 6 easter eggs list.
Where is the Easter egg in GTA 6? In a bird's nest at the top of the tallest radio tower in the game, in South Vice-Dale County right next to Hamlet. T5G and MrDalekJD show the same tower.
What happens if you throw the egg off the tower in GTA 6? A short, unexpected cutscene plays. Throw it high over the railing: MrDalekJD says a weak throw didn't trigger it.
How long does it take to climb the GTA 6 radio tower? Six to fifteen minutes of ladders. T5G and ZacCoxTV took about six; MrDalekJD says 10 to 15 minutes if you take it slow.

Who is the woman at the top of the GTA 6 radio tower? An influencer who got there before you. In InkTV's video she says she got there first and you'll have to wait, and they trade a few jabs. There's no mission attached.
Climbing the tallest radio tower in the game takes about six minutes.
The nest at the top of the tower, with the egg and the pickup prompt.
At the very top of the tower: the base jump cones and a full parachute to grab.

t: How to Customize Your Car in GTA 6 (Tuning Shop, Engine and Paint)
r: In GTA 6 you customize cars at a tuning shop like Coastal Auto Care, near Jason's house. You can change the engine, exhaust, body kit, paint and interior. Register the car first.

l: You customize cars in GTA 6 at a tuning shop, and one opens up very early: Coastal Auto Care, close to Jason's house. You can upgrade the engine, swap the exhaust, fit a full body kit, change the paint and even redo the interior. Register the car first if you plan to keep it, because customizing is one of the perks that come with registration.

StevieWunderKid says you get access to a shop near Jason's house pretty early in the story. Drive in with a car and pick what you want to change. The shop's name, Coastal Auto Care, shows up on the menu in Bombastic's video and on the banner behind the cars in Stevie's.

p.h: Lose the cops before you pull in
l: A tuning shop won't let you in while you're wanted. During Elanip's stream, with the police after him, he pulled up to a shop and the game refused. The on-screen message explains that mod shops are off-limits inside a heat area when you're driving a known vehicle. He gave up on that one and drove to a Pay 'n' Spray instead. Shake the police first, then come back. Tips for that are in how to lose the police.
Part · What it does · Shown by
Engine · Restore it, then upgrade it. Each level changes the engine pitch and rev limiter · StevieWunderKid, Bombastic
Exhaust · Mostly about sound: a new, much louder note plus backfires when you lift off the throttle · StevieWunderKid
Body · Full body kits (Full Kits) · Bombastic
Paint · Custom liveries · Bombastic
Interior · You can change it too · Bombastic
In the engine menu from Bombastic's video, only Full Engine was available. Intakes, Transmission and Boost were locked, and the video doesn't explain what unlocks them.

Stevie says the jump between engine levels is easy to hear. Bombastic was amazed by how much you can change and wondered whether every car in the game gets this many options. None of the videos show what the parts cost.

In the Full Kits section, Bombastic found a kit that was only there because he owns the Ultimate Edition, and he put it on his car. Camodo Gaming says the same: if you paid for the pricey edition, you get exclusive kits. The full list of extras is in the Ultimate Edition bonuses guide.

According to GameSpot, being able to customize a car at shops is one of the perks of registering it. A registered car can also be summoned with the Scooter Bros app for a small fee, stores all your weapons in the trunk automatically, and can be repaired if it gets destroyed.
Where to register: at Moses's garage or a Pay 'n' Spray, once you've met Moses in Chapter 2.
Trackers: a car with a tracker can't be registered until you've met the people who remove them. After that, any Pay 'n' Spray can pull it. More in how to steal cars and how to sell cars.

A damaged car won't take a new paint job. Camodo Gaming tried to respray a car he had just smashed up, and the game told him to repair it first. Repair costs and the places that do it are in how to refuel and repair your car.

Think twice before covering the factory paint. Once Camodo resprayed, the car's original paint scheme was gone. He guessed a tuning shop might bring it back but didn't try, and said he'd reload his save otherwise. If you like the stock look, save the game first.
Where can you customize cars in GTA 6? At a tuning shop. One unlocks early in the story near Jason's house: Coastal Auto Care.

Do you need to register a car to customize it in GTA 6? GameSpot lists customizing at shops as one of the perks of registering. You can register at Moses's garage or a Pay 'n' Spray once you've met Moses in Chapter 2.
Why can't I repaint my car in GTA 6? It's probably damaged. The game makes you repair the car before it lets you respray it.
What does an engine upgrade do in GTA 6? Each level changes the engine pitch and rev limiter, according to StevieWunderKid. You can clearly hear the difference between levels.
The Coastal Auto Care engine menu: Full Engine is available and the other parts are still locked.
A car parked inside Coastal Auto Care, the tuning shop near Jason's house.
With the police searching, a mod shop turns away a known car inside a heat area.

t: All GTA 6 Garage Locations and Prices (and How to Buy Them)
r: GTA 6 has 10 garages. Two are free through the story and the rest cost $4,000 to $40,000. Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone or in person.

l: GTA 6 has 10 garages. Some come free with the story, and the rest you buy through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone or by visiting them in person. Prices run from $4,000 to $40,000: the closer to Vice City and the richer the neighborhood, the pricier.
Garages let you keep a stolen car without paying to register it. Space is tight, though: according to PC Gamer, each garage holds one car.
Open your phone (Up on the D-pad).
Go to the Vice City Real Estate app.
Pick a garage and buy it. You can also go to the garage and buy it there.
Garage · Price · Where
Mitchel Auto Center · $4,000 · Central Kelly County, in the middle of the "Kelly County" label on the map, east of Port Gellhorn
Persistence Road Garage · $9,500 · Western Bellville, north of Vice City in South Leonard County
7th Avenue Garage · $12,000 · Just east of the airport in south Vice-Dale County, off the main highway northwest of Tequesta
Store 'N' Bolt · $16,800 · Northern Ambrosia, near the big monument
Wyatt Motors · $21,600 · Central Ambrosia, right by the Pay 'n' Spray
Vela Rota Drive Garage · $30,000 · The middle of Capri
Bonita Court Garage · $34,000 · Central Washington Island
Atlantic Court Garage · $40,000 · Ocean Beach, just east of the "Vice Beach" label, south of the Y Hotel
Port Gellhorn Station Garage · Free · Port Gellhorn, north of Moses' auto shop. Comes with the story
Paradise Garage · Free · Northeast Watson Bay, southeast of Grassrivers. Comes with the Ultimate Edition's Dominator Buggy
GameSpot also found garages that only appear when the game stores a vehicle for you. Those can't be bought. And there are no garages in Lummox County.

There's one more garage that isn't on GameSpot's list, and it's only for GTA+ members. GamesRadar+ says it's an exclusive single-car garage in Crosstown, there so you have somewhere safe for another membership perk, a '90s Annis Venturas Blvd Elegy. PC Gamer also lists the single-car garage and notes you can park the Elegy or any other car in it. GamesRadar+ adds that some GTA+ perks only show up once you reach certain points in the story, so it may not be there on day one. The full list is in every GTA+ reward in GTA 6.

A garage is only as good as what's inside it. One of the rare finds is the Grotti Itali RSX, which sits in a garage on Vespucci Island near Vice City. It has an alarm and an advanced tracker, so you'll need the key cloner to take it. The route is in where to find the Grotti Itali RSX.

p.h: Other ways to keep a car
l: Parking spots at home: you can leave a stolen car in the spots outside your current safehouse.
Register it: at a Pay 'n' Spray you can register a stolen car as yours. See how to steal cars.
So far, only garages have shown up for sale in the real estate app. No source has shown a house for sale early in the game. This page will be updated if that changes.
How do you buy a garage in GTA 6? Through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, or by going to the garage in person. Some come free with the story.
What is the cheapest garage in GTA 6? Mitchel Auto Center in Kelly County, for $4,000. Port Gellhorn Station and Paradise Garage are free.
How many cars fit in a GTA 6 garage? Not many. According to PC Gamer, each garage holds one car. GameSpot says one or a couple.
Can you buy a house in GTA 6? So far only garages have shown up for sale in the real estate app. No source has shown a house for sale early in the game.
Port Gellhorn, home to one of the free garages, in an official image.

t: Does GTA 6 Have Online or 2 Player?
r: No. GTA 6 launched on November 19 as a single-player game, with no online mode, co-op or local 2 player. Rockstar hasn't announced when multiplayer will arrive.

l: No, GTA 6 doesn't have an online mode or a 2 player mode. It launched on November 19 as a single-player game. PlayStation's FAQ and Xbox's official page use the exact same words: GTA 6 is a single-player experience.
Single player only. The PlayStation Store lists the game as 1 player, so there's no split screen, no local co-op and no online co-op.
Offline play works. PlayStation lists offline play as enabled. You need the internet to download the game, not to play it.
No online date. Rockstar hasn't announced a multiplayer mode for GTA 6, or when one might arrive.

On launch day, Kotaku's live coverage noted that players who spent hundreds of hours in GTA Online were still desperate to know what Rockstar has planned for multiplayer in GTA 6. Windows Central's review lists the player count as "single player (for now?)", with a question mark. Until Rockstar says something, any date you see for a GTA 6 online mode is guesswork.
Rockstar says GTA 6 supports Remote Play on PlayStation and Xbox. That only streams your own game from your own console to another screen. It doesn't let a second person join in.

Digital purchases of either edition made before November 20, 2026 include one month of GTA+, Rockstar's membership. Rockstar lists it as part of the digital bonuses, and PlayStation notes the month rolls into a paid monthly subscription unless you cancel it in your account settings before the next payment date.
What it costs afterward: GamesRadar+ puts GTA+ at $7.99 / €7.99 / £6.99 a month on PS5 and Xbox Series X. PC Gamer quotes the same $7.99.
Where to claim it: GamesRadar+ says to open the pause menu and go to the Store tab. PC Gamer found it on the "store" page of the main menu.

What it does in GTA 6: even without a multiplayer mode, the membership adds a few story-mode perks, including an exclusive car with its own garage, free or cheaper rides, 10% more for cars you sell and some shop discounts. PC Gamer isn't impressed, calling it thin for a monthly bill. The full list is in every GTA+ reward in GTA 6.

Everything on this site is about story mode. The GTA 6 cheats only work there, and we don't publish anything for online play, where cheating can get an account banned. If you're just starting out, read our beginner tips and see how autosave works.
Does GTA 6 have online? Not at launch. PlayStation and Xbox both describe GTA 6 as a single-player experience, and Rockstar hasn't announced an online mode or a date for one.
Is GTA 6 2 player? No. The PlayStation Store lists it as 1 player, so there's no split screen or local co-op.
Can you play GTA 6 offline? Yes. PlayStation lists offline play as enabled. You only need the internet to download the game.
When does GTA 6 Online come out? There's no official date. On launch day, Kotaku noted that GTA Online fans were still waiting to hear Rockstar's multiplayer plans.
Vice City in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games.

t: How to Steal Cars in GTA 6: Hotwiring, Slim Jim, Key Cloner and Trackers
r: Stealing cars changed in GTA 6: most cars have alarms, keyless cars can't be hotwired and some have trackers. Here's when you get the slim jim and the key cloner, and how to beat trackers.

l: Stealing a car in GTA 6 isn't just smashing a window and driving off anymore. Almost every car has an alarm, keyless cars won't hotwire, and some have trackers that call the police. As the story moves on you get tools for all of that. PC Gamer mapped which mission gives you each tool, and MrDalekJD and KhrazeGaming show the system in their beginner videos.

The Waink It app tells you what you're dealing with before you touch the car. MrDalekJD checks every car with it before he takes it: the app shows whether it's locked, alarmed or fitted with a tracker, which is exactly what decides whether the police end up on your tail.

KhrazeGaming warns that the pool of easy cars is small early on. Lots of them need a slim jim or a key cloner, and Waink It tells you which tool each one calls for. The cars you can still just smash and hotwire are mostly older models.
GameSpot adds that the same scan shows the car's sale value and what it costs to register it as yours.

p.h: You can’t steal cars in your own neighborhood
l: Near home, some cars come up with a warning that vehicles in your neighborhood can't be stolen. Bombastic got that message when he walked up to a car to take it, and ZoneX mentions it too. Don't waste time there: drive a bit farther from home and pick another target.
Walk up to the door and press interact. The game tells you if it's locked, alarmed or keyless.
Smash the window. If it's alarmed, the alarm goes off and draws attention.
Inside, hotwire it: use the sticks to find the "sweet spot". It takes a second or two.
Keyless cars won't start with hotwiring. For those you need the key cloner.
You can still pull people out of their cars, but many fight back. You have to mash a button to win. Lose, and they slam your head into the car and drive off. And plenty of Leonida drivers are armed.

p.h: The tools and when you get them
l: Tool · What it does · When you get it
Waink It app · Scans a car: make, lock, alarm, keyless, tracker, condition, sale price and registration cost · Chapter 1, mission 6 (Unwanted Attention), with Cal
Slim jim · Pops the lock without breaking the window or setting off the alarm. Slower than your elbow · Chapter 2, mission 5 (Moses)
Key cloner · Clones the key with your phone: unlocks and starts keyless cars · Chapter 3, mission 16 (Steal the Zorruso for Randy)
The slim jim doesn't work if someone is sitting in the car. Then you have to break the window.

MrDalekJD confirms the slim jim comes from Moses in chapter 2. Once you have it, it stays in both Jason's and Lucia's inventory for good with no need to equip it, and it also lets you open a car's trunk quietly to loot it. More in the slim jim and snap gun guide.
To clone a key: stand by the door, press interact, pick Clone Key and use the stick to find the sweet spot and speed it up.

Standard tracker: doesn't call the cops. PC Gamer says it just stops you modifying the car at a mod shop until you register it. GameSpot says otherwise: a car with a standard tracker can't be registered at all until you meet, in the story, someone willing to remove it.

Advanced tracker: alerts the police and pinpoints you. According to GameSpot, it pings the cops every so often once you get too far from where you took the car. Keep your speed up so it can't send a signal. Slow down and a meter in the corner starts filling, and you have a few seconds to speed up again.

GameSpot explains that you meet characters who can remove both kinds of tracker as the story goes on. Once they've agreed to help, any Pay 'n' Spray can take the tracker off. Until then, neither fences nor Pay 'n' Spray will buy a car that still has one. The video doesn't say which mission unlocks this.
In MrDalekJD's view, an advanced tracker is no problem for a short dash away from the scene, but pick another car if you plan to stay hidden for a while.

p.h: Registering a car to keep it
l: You can't register anything in chapter 1. According to MrDalekJD, you're stuck with the starter car. You can still steal cars off the street, but they won't be saved.
Registration unlocks in chapter 2, after the main story mission Moses in Port Gellhorn.
Where: drive the car into a Pay 'n' Spray. GamingBolt warns that not everything fits: a monster truck they found while exploring was too big to get inside, so it couldn't be registered.

Trackers and registration still come in two versions. MrDalekJD says that once it unlocks you can register cars that don't have a tracker, and GameSpot backs that up: a car with either kind of tracker can only be registered after you've met whoever removes them. PC Gamer, on the other hand, says a standard tracker only stops you modifying the car until it's registered. Until someone tests it properly, pick a car without a tracker if you want to keep it.

p.h: What registering looks like at the La Perle Pay ‘n’ Spray
l: Typical Gamer, about halfway through the story, drove a rare car into the Pay 'n' Spray in La Perle and went through the whole menu:
Repair: fixes engine and body damage.
Respray: a new paint job. Red cost him $200.
Register: swaps the plates and makes the car yours. For a Progen Royal Ruby Emerus, that was $29,900.
Sell: the same shop will buy the car from you.
Stored Vehicles: a second tab lists the cars you've already put away.
