The registration price matched what Waink It showed before he took the car. The Emerus card read: unlocked, security deactivated, no tracker, $30,000 sell value and $29,900 to register. On a car like that, keeping it costs almost as much as you'd get for selling it.

He couldn't afford it in the end. He had $25,392 in the bank and $9,671 in cash, and the menu said he didn't have enough. On screen, the respray price carries both the bank icon and the cash icon, while the registration price only has the BuckMe bank icon. It looks like registration comes out of your bank balance only, though no source has tested that yet.

Pay 'n' Spray: sells stolen cars, with a limit of 3 per day. It's also where you register a car to make it yours, from chapter 2 on. According to GameSpot, it won't take a car that still has a tracker until later in the story.
Moses (chapter 2): buys older, low-profile cars and often tells you where the ones he wants are. After a sale he needs a while before taking another.
Randy (chapter 3): pays more, but only wants flashy, expensive cars.
Storage: a garage bought through the real estate app on your phone (one car per garage), or the parking spots outside your safehouse. See every garage and price.

With GTA+: according to GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer, GTA+ members get 10% more when they sell a car they own at a Pay 'n' Spray. GamesRadar+ adds that the cars that come with the Ultimate Edition can't be sold at all. The full list of perks is in every GTA+ reward in GTA 6.
Waink It tells you if a car suits Moses or Randy. Selling cars is one of the best earners in chapter 2: see how to make money fast. To shake the cops after a theft, see how to lose the police.
How do you steal a keyless car in GTA 6? With the key cloner, which you get in chapter 3, mission 16, Steal the Zorruso for Randy. Before that, keyless cars can't be hotwired.
How do you get the slim jim in GTA 6? It comes in chapter 2, in the fifth mission, Moses. The mechanic Moses gives you the tool and shows you how to use it.

How do you beat a car tracker in GTA 6? According to GameSpot, you'll meet people later in the story who remove trackers, and after that any Pay 'n' Spray can pull one. Until then, drive fast with an advanced tracker: slow down and it beeps, giving you a few seconds to speed up.

How do you keep a stolen car in GTA 6? Register it at a Pay 'n' Spray. That unlocks in chapter 2, after the story mission Moses; in chapter 1 you're stuck with the starter car. The Waink It app shows how much registration costs.
Jason on a motorcycle in Leonida, in an official GTA 6 image.

Who plays Jason in GTA 6? Dylan Rourke, who tops the main cast list in Rockstar's official credits.

t: GTA 6 Criminal Profile Explained: The Honor System and All 5 Levels
r: GTA 6's criminal profile tracks how many people you kill. There are 5 levels, from Professional to Irredeemable, each with its own bonus. Jason and Lucia have separate profiles, and the last one sticks.

l: GTA 6's criminal profile is the system that tracks how you treat people in the world, much like the honor system in Red Dead Redemption 2. It comes down almost entirely to how often you kill. Wounding or incapacitating enemies keeps your profile clean, while killing cops, civilians and defenseless animals drags it down. Jason and Lucia each have their own profile, and according to GameSpot both of them start at Hardened. Playing non-lethally lifts you to Professional, while a high body count drags you to Violent, then Psycho, and finally Irredeemable.
Every level comes with an emoji-style "face with horns" icon that appears on screen.

JorRaptor explains how to read it. After you do something, a demon icon often pops up on the right side of the screen. A yellow or orange one means you were careful: few kills, or you got away without being spotted. A purple one means you went after civilians, cops and every enemy in sight. Those colors line up with the table below.
Level · Color · How you get there · Bonus
Professional · Yellow · Only the violence you need, incapacitate instead of kill, stay undetected · Non-lethal takedowns and kind acts toward citizens fill your focus meter
Hardened · Orange · Kill enemies, kill citizens only in self-defense, don't worry about being seen · Same as Professional
Violent · Purple · Skip non-lethal options, kill enemies and police, kill citizens at random · Headshots fill your focus meter
Psycho · Light gray · Kill lots of cops, regularly kill helpless citizens, kill pets and defenseless animals (hunting doesn't count) · Headshots fill focus, but you can't surrender to the police
Irredeemable · Dark gray · Stay Psycho for too long · No bonus listed
Focus is the game's bullet time. If you've finished the story, there's even an unlimited focus cheat.

p.h: What earns focus at each level
l: At Professional and Hardened, focus comes from non-lethal takedowns and small good deeds. GameSpot's examples are rescuing civilians, petting animals and even dropping trash in a bin. At Violent and Psycho, headshots are what fill the meter. For other ways to top it up, see how to increase focus.

Across the first four levels, your profile moves up and down as you play. Irredeemable is different: once you hit it, it stays. Rockstar says it will have a lasting effect on Jason and Lucia, but nobody knows yet what that means.

You do get a warning. GameSpot says a split appears in the Psycho icon right before you tip over into Irredeemable, so that's your cue to stop killing. GameSpot's advice is to avoid the rank altogether, since it changes your playthrough in a big and lasting way. If you're curious anyway, keep a backup manual save first, ideally once the story is done or nearly done. Here's how saving works. JorRaptor gives the same advice if you just want to cause chaos without thinking about your profile: save first, then load that save afterward.
Keep the permanent rank in mind before chasing a 6 star wanted level. Getting there means killing a lot of cops and soldiers, and PC Gamer warns that can hit your profile hard.
GameSpot lists what keeps you at the top tier:
Stay hidden. Finish missions without being detected where you can.

Use non-lethal takedowns instead of killing enemies. JorRaptor shows one way to do it in a gunfight: with focus active, aim at the yellow marks that show up on an enemy. The shot hurts them badly without killing them.
Don't kill civilians, and that includes running people over by accident while driving.
Defuse when offered. Some missions give you a prompt to calm things down, which can lead to an outcome where nobody dies.
Spare people who surrender when the game gives you that choice. The Arnold decision is one example of a spare prompt.

p.h: Can you shoot your way through and stay Professional?
l: PC Gamer's writer finished the main story with both characters at Professional, dipping into Hardened now and then. The approach was to stay non-lethal where possible, using focus to aim for knees and elbows in gunfights.

The body count still wasn't small. The endgame stats show 321 enemies and 58 cops killed, against 461 enemies and 107 cops incapacitated. There are also 98 animal kills on the record, and the writer suspects most were birds that refuse to get out of the way of vehicles.

p.h: Does your profile change the story or the ending?
l: No story spoilers: this only covers what the profile affects, not what happens.

Story scenes: yes. Rockstar senior design director Luke Howard told Game Informer that a number of story scenes were recorded in different versions, depending on the couple's relationship and their criminal profile. GamesRadar+ reports the differences range from small details to bigger changes.

The ending: unknown so far. GameSpot says some players suspect the profile plays into the ending, but nothing confirms it. JorRaptor, for one, says in his video that it affects the endings, without showing it. What GameSpot does confirm is that the relationship and the couple's savings decide the ending.
See what's known in how many endings GTA 6 has, and how to raise the relationship in the romance guide.
The quickest way, according to JorRaptor, is to hold D-pad Right while you play. Later on, it also shows up in the Jason & Lucia menu.

For the menu, open it and go to the Jason & Lucia tab, which GameSpot also points to. In the image above, the profile sits at the top of Jason's page there. For more on how the game works early on, see the beginner tips.

What are the criminal profile levels in GTA 6? There are five: Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho and Irredeemable. Jason and Lucia both start at Hardened, according to GameSpot. The more people you kill, the further down you go.

Is the Irredeemable profile permanent in GTA 6? Yes. You land there by staying Psycho for too long, and you can't climb back out. A split showing up in the Psycho icon means you're close. The other four levels move up and down as you play.
How do you keep a Professional profile in GTA 6? Keep violence to what's necessary, incapacitate enemies instead of killing them and stay undetected. Don't kill cops or civilians for no reason.
Do Jason and Lucia share a criminal profile? No. Each of them has a criminal profile of their own.
Jason's page in the Jason & Lucia menu, with his criminal profile at Hardened.

t: GTA 6 Romance Guide: How to Raise Jason and Lucia's Relationship and What It Gets You
r: Jason and Lucia's relationship has 4 levels. Holding hands, texting back, going out and pulling off crimes together add hearts, while neglect and failed joint missions take them away.

l: To raise Jason and Lucia's relationship in GTA 6, act like a couple: hold hands, talk, go out together, answer texts and pull off crimes as a team. Every action that counts plays a chime and puts a +♥ on the right side of the screen, according to PC Gamer. There are 4 levels. The couple starts Chapter 1 on good terms, but reaching the top still takes a while. It pays off: GameSpot says a maxed-out relationship is one of the two things the best ending asks for.
Level · Name
1 of 4 · Running on empty
2 of 4 · Partners in Crime
3 of 4 · Crazy in Love
4 of 4 · Hot Together
Your level moves with how you play and what you choose, in story missions, in random crimes and in everyday life at home.
PC Gamer lists these, and says there are plenty more:
Affection: holding hands, a hug or a kiss (look for the prompt with a heart), greeting your partner when you meet up, and complimenting new clothes or a new haircut.
At home: going to bed at the same time, hanging out on the couch, starting a conversation, and picking Go Out when you're both home.
Dates: getting your hair done together, minigolf, scuba diving, dancing at a club, and jumping out of a plane together with a parachute.
Gifts: buying food or drinks and handing them over, or buying clothing accessories for each other. Both of you have to be at the store.
Phone: replying to texts, checking in by text, sending selfies, and texting goodnight when you're away from home.
Manners: opening the car door for each other.
Money and crime: successful joint crimes and deposits into the Buck Me savings account.
For more early game advice, including fixing up the house, see our beginner tips. Shopping together also comes up in hidden features.
You can lose points too. It didn't happen often in PC Gamer's run, and these were the causes:
failing a joint mission;
ignoring your partner for a while;
some mission choices your partner doesn't agree with;
hitting them with your car.

Rockstar's advice is that a strong relationship needs both sides. Be good to Lucia while you play as Jason, and be good to Jason while you play as Lucia. PC Gamer's writer finished the story at 4/4 after spending almost the same amount of time with each character.

They each have solo missions, storylines and activities, and some of those are required. You can spend long stretches with one character. Just check in with your partner now and then, answer their texts, and switch over every so often.

p.h: What you get out of it
l: Crimes go better as a pair. A second person can hold people at gunpoint, handle crowd control during a robbery, shoot out a cop's tires while you drive, and carry off more loot than one person could.

Intimate couple scenes. You can't trigger them on demand. The game offers them at certain moments, shown by double hearts over the home icon on the map or by a short timed prompt. In PC Gamer's playthrough, every one happened at 4/4, including one after a big savings milestone and one after a large heist.
A better ending. The relationship feeds into how the story ends. The section below covers what 4/4 gets you over 1/4.
No story spoilers: this part only covers what the relationship changes, not what happens.
This page used to say nobody knew yet, because PC Gamer had played the story once and kept the relationship high almost the whole way. Part of the answer is in now:

It shapes your ending. GameSpot says the best ending needs the couple at the top relationship level and their shared savings maxed out at $2 million. Max out the relationship but not the savings and you get a good ending, though not the best one. What a low relationship leads to is still being tested, and GameSpot expects one ending is tied to hitting neither goal.

Some scenes play out differently. Rockstar senior design director Luke Howard told Game Informer that a number of story scenes were recorded in more than one version, depending on the relationship and your criminal profile. GamesRadar+ reports the changes go from small touches to bigger differences. In one case, Jason takes Lucia aside after a robbery to see how she's doing, and the feel of that talk depends on where the two of them stand.

A cold relationship doesn't cost you any story. If the romance fades, Jason and Lucia stay partners in crime and you still play the whole thing. The more romantic versions of scenes are layered on top.
For how many endings there are and what each one needs, see how many endings GTA 6 has. To fill the savings account, see how to deposit at the bank.

No. Jason and Lucia's relationship is the only one the game keeps track of. In a statement to Shacknews, quoted by PC Gamer, Rockstar said everything in the game is there to support the couple's story. That's why there's no way to cheat on Lucia or get together with Mandy. More on that in can you cheat on Lucia or romance Mandy?.
How many relationship levels are there in GTA 6? Four: Running on empty (1/4), Partners in Crime (2/4), Crazy in Love (3/4) and Hot Together (4/4).
How do you know the relationship went up in GTA 6? You hear a chime and a +♥ shows up on the right side of the screen. That's the only signal.
What makes you lose hearts with Lucia? Failing a joint mission, ignoring your partner for too long, some mission choices they disagree with, and running them over with your car.

Does the relationship affect the ending in GTA 6? Yes. According to GameSpot, the best ending needs the relationship maxed out and $2 million in the couple's savings. A maxed relationship without the full savings gets you a good ending, but not the best one.
The in-game hint: some actions and tasks help build your relationship with Lucia.

t: How to Increase Focus in GTA 6: Every Method
r: Fishing is the fastest way to raise focus in GTA 6, at about 5% per fish. Basketball, the snake, petting animals, food, pool, golf, the shooting range and Shirley's rum run help too.

l: The fastest way to increase focus in GTA 6 is fishing: Arekkz Gaming got about 5% focus per fish, against 1% per basket on the basketball hoop. You can also raise it by feeding Jason's snake, petting dogs and cats, eating before you head out, playing pool or golf, using the shooting range and doing side jobs like Shirley's rum run. This guide pulls together tips from eight English-speaking YouTube channels, Kotaku and GamesRadar+.

Focus is the ability you turn on by clicking both sticks (L3 + R3 on PS5, LS + RS on Xbox). It slows time in gunfights, shows enemy weak points and highlights loot. The higher your focus level, the longer you can keep it running, and BennyCentral calls it the stat you want to train the most.
BennyCentral, Arekkz Gaming, KhrazeGaming and GamingBolt all point to fishing. There are fishing rods behind Jason's house, so you don't have to travel. Grab one and walk down to the water.
Press L3 + R3 to turn on focus. Fish get highlighted, so you know where to cast.
Cast your line, then reel in slowly to lure a fish.
When you feel a nibble, press R2 right away to hook it.
Don't reel in yet. Let the fish fight until it wears itself out. If it swims one way, pull the rod the opposite way.
Once it calms down, reel in as fast as you can. If it starts fighting again, repeat step 4.

Step 1 is from Arekkz Gaming, and steps 2 to 5 are KhrazeGaming's technique. KhrazeGaming adds that fishing, like other minigames that raise your stats, also improves focus. BennyCentral found it the most effective way to train it: every fish you land moves your focus level up. He repeats it in a later tips video, where he calls fishing the quickest way he's found to grow the bar and says a few minutes on the water make a real difference. In JorRaptor's video, a Focus +10% pop-up appears while Jason walks down a dock with his rod during the fishing segment, though the clip doesn't make clear exactly what triggered it.

p.h: Basketball and the snake at Jason’s house
l: Activity · What the channels found
Fishing · About 5% per fish (Arekkz Gaming).
Basketball hoop, right outside · 1% per basket (Arekkz Gaming). RageGamingVideos says it raises focus by a certain amount per day, which points to a daily limit.
Feeding the snake · Raises focus. RageGamingVideos says once per day; Arekkz Gaming says to feed it whenever you're back home.
Checking on the snake · Just stopping to look at the snake in the living room gives 3%, according to BennyCentral.

RageGamingVideos treats it as a daily routine. Stat training runs on timers, so he does a strength workout, a cardio workout and a focus workout once per timer reset, for each character, because Jason and Lucia are tracked separately. MrDalekJD adds that working out every day for three days in a row builds up both strength and focus.

GamingBolt lists four ways to permanently raise focus, all without violence: fishing, pool, golf and the shooting range. The shooting range also helps you get used to aiming and test different settings.

Your criminal profile counts too. According to GamingBolt, the Professional and Hardened profiles get a higher max focus, while Violent and Psycho refill focus with headshots. The details are in criminal profile explained.

Early in the story, Shirley, the neighbor on the corner by Jason's house, yells at you as you drive past. Stop and talk to her and she asks you to pick up some rum. RageGamingVideos says that bringing it back gives a permanent upgrade to focus. MrDalekJD found this favor in the map's Exploration tab, which lists jobs for your neighbors, and a later favor for Shirley lets you use her car.

BennyCentral files these under what the game calls thoughtful actions, and says doing Shirley's favor is worth the same 3% as checking on the snake. Before you head off for the rum, pet Argula, Shirley's dog. GamesRadar+ says it counts as a thoughtful action that can push your focus bar up, depending on your criminal profile.
These come from Kotaku's launch tips:

Pet dogs and cats. Hold the left trigger (L2 or LT) on one to zoom in, then praise or pet it. It buffs focus and earns good behavior points for your criminal profile. The Pet option doesn't show up right away, though. In icePlaysGTA's video, aiming L2 at a labrador only brought up Praise (X), Scold (Square) and Study (R1). Once he praised the dog, Praise dropped off the list and Pet appeared on Triangle. So if you can't find it, praise first. The full walkthrough is in how to pet animals.
Throw away your garbage. Not littering boosts focus and also earns good behavior points.

Eat and drink before heading out. Food and drinks buff health, stamina and focus. MrDalekJD gives the same tip: eat or drink at home before you leave, especially before a story mission. Pick carefully at the fridge: BennyCentral says water buffs stamina and focus, while the protein shake buffs health and stamina instead.
DPJ also lists helping people, feeding pets and feeding your own snake as ways to earn focus. None of these sources says how much each one gives, or how long the buff lasts.
Once you beat the story, the unlimited focus cheat stops the meter from ever running out. For other uses of focus, like finding the source of shouting or spotting alarmed doors, see hidden features.

Exact numbers are still thin. The 5% per fish and 1% per basket come only from Arekkz Gaming, and the permanent boosts from pool, golf and the shooting range come only from GamingBolt. The 3% for the snake and for Shirley's favor comes only from BennyCentral.
What is the fastest way to increase focus in GTA 6? Fishing. Arekkz Gaming got about 5% focus per fish, using the rods behind Jason's house.
How do you permanently increase focus in GTA 6? Go fishing, play pool or golf, use the shooting range and bring Shirley her rum. GamingBolt and RageGamingVideos say these raise focus for good.
How much focus does basketball give in GTA 6? About 1% per basket, according to Arekkz Gaming. RageGamingVideos says the hoop only gives a certain amount per day.
How do you turn on focus in GTA 6? Click both sticks at the same time: L3 + R3 on PS5, LS + RS on Xbox.
Jason lands a Stoplight Parrotfish. Every fish you catch raises your focus.

t: GTA 6 WAiNK Curiosities and Landmarks: Where to Scan Them
r: GTA 6 has 31 WAiNK landmarks and, per one video guide, 35 curiosities to scan. Here are the 15 already mapped in Mariana County and exactly where to find them.

l: There are 31 WAiNK landmarks to scan in GTA 6, according to GameSpot, and vAnother Level's video guide counts 35 curiosities on top of that. Both lists count toward the You WAiNKer! trophy, which needs 100 scans. Below are the 15 spots in Mariana County that GameSpot has published so far, all of which also show up in the video.
To scan, hold Up on the D-pad, aim and press R1 (RB on Xbox). The full walkthrough of how scanning works is on the WAiNK sculptures page.
GameSpot's route starts near Jason's house, heads south and west, then finishes in the swamps up north.
Curiosity · Where it is
Christmas House · A house fully decked out for Christmas on the westernmost street in Key Lento
Plunge Masters Deep Sea Chalet · Same street, at the Plunge Masters sign. Scan the mural behind the shed
Abismo Key Carcass · Take the highway south to Abismo Key and walk through the mangroves to the beach. It's the skeleton of something that looks alien
Derelict Spy Vessel · A ship run aground at the tip of the southeastern Permit Keys island. Bring a boat
Beach Party Site · An abandoned beach party on the northern edge of the central Permit Keys island
Fingerpost · Right next to the beach party, tucked behind trees and mangroves. A prompt pops up when you're close
Goose Key Carcass · Another carcass, along the northeastern shore of Mile Zero Air Station
Desert Island Piano · A piano on a tiny island in the chain south of Cottonmouth Lake and Gambit Bay
Vibrant Pond · A warning sign in front of a pool of muck in the swamp to the north
Dead Sharks · A beach covered in rotting sharks on the southern islands of Wetman Bay
Wetman Bay Carcass · The third carcass, on the island north of the sharks
NoFlusher Homestead · Home of a NoFlusher, one of the game's oddball groups, west of the Kingfisher swamp base
Be careful at the Goose Key Carcass: it's inside the military base, which is a restricted area, so try not to let the soldiers see you. See how to get in at military base location.
Each of the three carcasses has a meteorite lying nearby. Find out what to do with them in meteorite locations and selling.
Landmark · Where it is
Badger R&D Tower · The big radio tower on the main road, south of Brian's marina in Key Lento
Thicc Herbie · The giant blimp on Maroon Key, where the mission Hey, Arnold takes you
Riquezas Key Radome · The radome at the southern tip of the Riquezas Keys, past Mile Zero Air Station

Thicc Herbie is a trick one. GameSpot couldn't scan the blimp while standing on Maroon Key; it only worked from far away, at Abismo Key State Park across the water to the south. vAnother Level scanned it from the park's parking lot off the Sunbelt Hwy.
vAnother Level went through all 108 scannables in the game. A few examples outside Mariana County:
Landmarks: Aqua Stadium (Gloriana Key), Fleeca Field (Rockridge) and the giant Vice City sign (West Vice-Dale County).
Curiosities: the Halloween House (central Capri) and a UFO-shaped animal barn in the backyard of a light-blue house on Kingston Rd in Watson Bay.
NoFlusher tags: 15 faint teal chalk symbols on the sidewalk, most of them in Ocean Beach. Cal texts you asking if you've ever noticed strange symbols on a manhole. Every tag counts as a scan too.
One difference between the sources: the video files the Derelict Spy Vessel under landmarks, while GameSpot puts it with the curiosities. It's the same spot either way; only the list changes.
How many WAiNK landmarks are in GTA 6? There are 31, according to both GameSpot and vAnother Level's video guide.
How many WAiNK curiosities are in GTA 6? vAnother Level counts 35. GameSpot's list isn't finished yet and covers 12 so far, all in Mariana County.
Why can't I scan the Thicc Herbie blimp in GTA 6? It only scans from a distance. Head to Abismo Key State Park, across the water to the south of Maroon Key, and scan it from there.
Are there dead aliens in GTA 6? There are three strange creature carcasses that count as WAiNK curiosities: on Abismo Key, Goose Key and in Wetman Bay. Each one has a meteorite nearby.
The Fingerpost in the Permit Keys: the wooden signpost points to Vice City and Los Santos.

t: How to Get a Tank in GTA 6: Rhino Location and the Challenging Tank Trophy
r: The Rhino tank in GTA 6 is parked at the Mile Zero Air Station military base. Jump the fence, head to the tank row and press Triangle. Taking one pops the Challenging Tank trophy.

l: To get a tank in GTA 6, head to the Mile Zero Air Station military base in the southwest corner of the map, jump the fence using the dirt ramp and drive over to the row of Hauners Rhino tanks. Walk up to one and press Triangle (Y on Xbox) to climb in. A few moments later the Challenging Tank trophy pops. Maka91Productions, Arekkz Gaming and MrDalekJD all ran the full route on video.
Want a tank without raiding the base? A secret quest that starts at a Vice City memorial ends in a bunker with a tank you keep for good. See GTA 6 free tank in the secret bunker.

Make a backup save. Arekkz Gaming saved to a separate slot first. After his rampage in the tank, his Jason's criminal profile had turned to Psycho. The trophy sticks to your account, so you can load the old save afterwards.
Armor and healing. Maka91Productions suggests popping adrenaline before you go in and wearing body armor.
The base is in Mariana County. From Jason's house, MrDalekJD followed the road through Abismo Key down to Southwind.
Just before the main gate, drive past the yellow blocks in the road and the guards at the checkpoint.
Take the right. There's a dirt mound against the fence: it's a stunt jump that launches you into the base.
Arekkz Gaming tried several cars and nearly all of them cleared it. Big trucks can clip the railing and roll. The full route is in military base location.
Left after the ramp. Maka91Productions and MrDalekJD both turned left after landing. The tanks sit to the left of a huge building just past the fence, with the biggest ones closest to the fence.

A whole mix. You'll also see smaller tanks, APCs, machine gun vehicles and even fixed turrets. The Rhinos are the big ones. Arekkz Gaming found a whole row of them at the back of a corner on the southwest side of the base, past the bunkers and the jets.
Get in: press Triangle (Y) next to the tank. Your character climbs in through the hatch automatically, and you can still take fire while that happens.
Shoot: the Rhino has one cannon, up front. Maka91Productions fires it with R1 (RB on Xbox).
Power: in Arekkz Gaming's video, a single shell wrecked nearly everything and even knocked out another tank.
Blind spot: the cannon can't aim high enough to hit helicopters.
Radio: yes, the tank has a radio, and you can change stations.

The moment MrDalekJD climbed into a tank inside the base he had 5 stars. Once he started causing damage he reached 6 stars. From there you get lighter tanks, other Rhinos, cars trying to box you in and helicopters with rockets, which are the real threat. Eventually the engine gives out and the tank explodes.

The tank also has a tracker, so the police know where it is even once you're off the base. Arekkz Gaming's suggestion is to sneak in without firing a shot and drive straight out, to leave with fewer stars. For the top wanted level, see six-star wanted level.
There is a cheat that spawns a Rhino, but it only unlocks after you complete every survival challenge, and the button sequence hasn't been published yet. Keep an eye on the cheats list.

Where is the tank in GTA 6? At the Mile Zero Air Station military base in Mariana County, in the southwest corner of the map. The Rhinos are parked in one corner of the base alongside smaller armored vehicles.
How do you get into the tank in GTA 6? Walk up and press Triangle (Y on Xbox). Your character climbs in through the hatch on their own, but you can still get shot on the way up.
How do you unlock the Challenging Tank trophy? Get into a Rhino. It popped a few seconds later for Maka91Productions and after a few shots for Arekkz Gaming.
Can you keep the tank in GTA 6? Not for good. The tank has a tracker, so the police always know where it is, even off the base.
A Rhino tank rolling between the hangars at Mile Zero Air Station while the base is on alert.

How many WAiNK sculptures are in GTA 6? There are 23. The counter pops up on screen with your first scan, reading WAiNK Sculptures 1/23.

t: GTA 6 Airport Location: Where It Is and How to Steal a Jet
r: The GTA 6 airport is Vice City International, on the west side of Vice-Dale County. Commercial jets sit on its two runways, and you can steal one. There are also ATMs to break into in the terminal.

l: The GTA 6 airport is Vice City International, and it's huge. Commercial jets are parked on both runways at all times, and you can sneak onto one and fly off. PC Gamer mapped what's there.
On the west side of Vice-Dale County, southwest of the city.
You can't miss it once you're in the city: two giant runways in a wedge shape.
Get onto the airfield and head for one of the commercial jets parked on the runways.
Climb aboard and take off.
PC Gamer's tip: throw it in reverse to get clear before the tarmac support vehicles end up under your wheels.
Expect trouble: an airport is a restricted area, and breaking in is a crime. Once you're airborne, fly low to be seen less, and have a way out. See how to lose the police.

p.h: What happens once you’re in the air
l: Milo tested it. He walked up to a business jet parked next to a hangar, climbed the stairs and took off with a 4-star wanted level. Soon after, blue lights showed up in the sky. Those were fighter jets, and they opened fire with rockets. He couldn't shake them, and the jet went down. His video doesn't show which airfield he took off from, but the lesson is the same anywhere: if you see blue lights while flying a stolen plane, get ready to bail out with a parachute.
Vehicle · Type
Botticher 015A · Jet
Lapwing Streamer 216-C · Plane
Declasse D7700 · Utility truck
Brute Ripley · Service vehicle
HVY Airtug · Service vehicle
The central terminal also has a lot of ATMs you can break into, according to PC Gamer. Beyond that there aren't many marked activities: it's a big campus to explore.
No wanted level: seaplanes and a helicopter sit unguarded in Southwind, close to Jason's house. See where to find your first plane and helicopter.
Fighter jet: the military base has the Hauners P-996 Lazer.
Before you fly, grab a parachute.
PC Gamer is still the only English source that pins down the airport itself, so the badge says "Unverified".
Where is the airport in GTA 6? Vice City International Airport is on the west side of Vice-Dale County, southwest of the city. You can spot it by its two huge runways in a wedge shape.
Can you steal a plane at the GTA 6 airport? Yes. Commercial jets are always parked on the runways and you can sneak aboard and fly off, according to PC Gamer.
Is there an easier plane to steal in GTA 6? Yes. Seaplanes and a helicopter sit unguarded in Southwind, close to Jason's house, so you can take them without a wanted level.
A jet over the Vice City sign, in an official GTA 6 image.

t: How to Get Free Guns and Body Armor From Cop Car Trunks in GTA 6
r: GTA 6 police cars carry assault rifles, shotguns and even body armor. Pickups just need you to open the crate in the bed. Patrol cars need a slim jim if you want to skip the alarm.

l: The quickest way to get free guns in GTA 6 is to raid a police car trunk. Cop cars can carry an assault rifle, a shotgun, ammo and even body armor. It's a handy way to gear up fast, as long as you accept the risk of messing with police property. PC Gamer laid out the trick, Milo showed it working, and JuiceHead added a couple of tips.
Older GTA games used to hand you a shotgun when you stole a cop car. Vice City's police are better equipped than that, and PC Gamer singles out shotguns and assault rifles as the main haul.

p.h: Police pickups: no alarm at all
l: Cops sometimes drive pickup trucks such as the Bravado Bison. You'll see them both out in the country and in town.
Climb into the truck bed.
Open the storage crate.
Take the weapons, ammo and anything else inside. You might even find a Stun Gun.
Nothing goes off, which makes pickups the easy option.

p.h: Patrol cars: bring the slim jim
l: Regular patrol cars have alarms on both the doors and the trunk. The way around that is the slim jim, a tool you get in the Chapter 2 mission Moses. More on it in slim jim and snap gun.
Slim jim the driver's door and get in.
Once you're inside, the trunk unlocks.
Walk around to the back and open it.
Help yourself to whatever is there: an assault rifle, a shotgun or body armor. The alarm stays quiet.
No slim jim yet? You can still pop the trunk. Your character pries it open with a screwdriver, but the alarm will sound.

p.h: What Milo pulled out of one
l: Milo had just died and lost every gun he owned. He walked up to an ordinary cruiser parked at the curb, opened the trunk and came away with assault rifles, a shotgun and pistol ammo. If you've just been wasted and need to rearm, this is a quick fix.
JuiceHead says cop cars are both common and easy to rob, and he has two tips:
Traffic stops: when officers pull someone over at the side of the road, you'll sometimes see two cruisers parked nose to tail. He says you can very often loot the one at the back.
Night time: trunks on parked cars in general are soft targets after dark, because hardly anyone reacts to the alarm.
According to him, a cop car trunk gets you long guns, body armor and better healing items at a point in the game when you'd normally have none of that.

p.h: Stash the guns in your own car
l: Walking around with a rifle in your hands or slung on your back draws attention. After the raid, go to your own car's trunk and you'll get a prompt to stow the weapons there. The full breakdown is in how to store weapons in your trunk.

p.h: Where to find an empty cop car
l: Don't try it with officers inside. PC Gamer makes the same point.
Look for cruisers parked around town or outside police stations, such as the ones in Port Gellhorn and Vice City.
If things go wrong and the cops come after you, see how to lose the police.
Curious which guns are in the game? Check the GTA 6 weapons list.
How do you get free guns in GTA 6? Open the trunk of an empty police car. It can hold an assault rifle, a shotgun, ammo or body armor.
Does opening a cop car trunk set off the alarm? On a patrol car, yes, unless you slim jim the door and get in first. The crate on a police pickup has no alarm.
Where can you find parked cop cars in GTA 6? At police stations, such as the ones in Port Gellhorn and Vice City. Stay away from cars with officers inside.

Which cop car is easiest to rob in GTA 6? JuiceHead goes for the rear car when two cruisers are lined up at a roadside traffic stop. Police pickups are easy too, since the crate in the bed has no alarm.
An open police car trunk with a Duke 556 assault rifle ready to grab.

t: Where to Find a Rocket Launcher in GTA 6
r: The rocket launcher sits in a secret cellar under a trailer across from the Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, west of Vice City, next to the Conspiracist Type 9. Another is in a Black Eagle warehouse.

l: The easiest rocket launcher to grab in GTA 6 is hidden in a cellar under a rundown trailer, right across the street from the Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, west of Vice City. Down there you'll find a launcher with 4 rockets, some grenades and the unique Conspiracist Type 9 machine pistol. Five channels have now been to the spot: WiLLiSGaming, Milo, Millzaa, Rodwenn and FuriousFade. WiLLiSGaming also found a second launcher in a Black Eagle warehouse.

p.h: Where it is: opposite the Griffin Shooting Range
l: The shooting range is labeled on the map, so use it as your landmark:
Millzaa opens its map card: Griffin Shooting Range, in Balsero. It's a range that also sells guns and gear, and the waiver costs $5.
Zoomed all the way out, the spot sits just under the D and A of LEONIDA, between Kelly County and Vice-Dale County.
The trailer is across the street from the range. Millzaa, Rodwenn and Milo all park there and climb the fence.

WiLLiSGaming came in along the SR-120, with Omega Pkwy just to the south and Buckskin Swamp off to the west. In his voiceover he says "Mariana County", but both his map and Millzaa's show the Vice City area. He suggests waiting until Chapter 2, since the story sends you that way anyway.
Drive to the Griffin Shooting Range and pull over on the opposite side of the road. You don't need to go inside the range.
Hop the fence into a lot full of old trailers that looks like a junkyard. The game pops a reminder here that cops will spot you faster if your weapon is out in the open.
Go into the trailer (WiLLiSGaming describes an RV covered in antennas).

Find the way down. Rodwenn, Milo and Millzaa use a hatch in the floor that drops into a cellar under the trailer. WiLLiSGaming describes a bunker door at the back of the trailer instead. If you can't spot one, look for the other.
Downstairs there's a dead man in a chair and a phone with a View Media option. WiLLiSGaming says the clip on that phone shows what happened to him.
Rodwenn finds the rocket launcher behind the chair. The Conspiracist Type 9 is in a gun case to the left, and the shelf holds Frag Grenade pickups, healing items and adrenaline.
In FuriousFade's video, the pickup prompt names the launcher H-AT Launcher.
4 rockets. The weapon wheel in WiLLiSGaming's video shows 1 loaded and 3 in reserve.
WiLLiSGaming says rockets can't be bought, so hang on to these for late in the story or a real emergency.
The launcher isn't a unique weapon. Die with it and it's gone, so keep it holstered until you need it.
WiLLiSGaming mentions other launchers around the map but doesn't say where, apart from the Black Eagle one.

p.h: The second one: Black Eagle warehouse
l: The Black Eagle warehouse, home of the Black Eagle Import M306 TMR rifle, has another launcher. That makes 2 launchers and 8 rockets by his count. WiLLiSGaming doesn't show where the warehouse is on the map, and getting in is fiddly: only Lucia fits through the gap that leads to the rifle. The details are in unique weapons.

p.h: The gun that comes with it
l: The Conspiracist Type 9 shows its name in yellow, the mark of a unique weapon. WiLLiSGaming says those stay with you even after you die. To carry guns in your trunk, see how to store weapons in your car, and for everything else, the GTA 6 weapons list. More stashes worth raiding early on are in secret early items.
Where is the rocket launcher in GTA 6? In a cellar under a rundown trailer across the street from the Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, west of Vice City. A second one is in a Black Eagle warehouse.
How many rockets does the junkyard launcher have? Four: one loaded and three in reserve, as the weapon wheel in the video shows.
Do you lose the rocket launcher when you die in GTA 6? Yes. WiLLiSGaming says it isn't a unique weapon, so it's gone if you die.
Can you buy rockets in GTA 6? Not according to WiLLiSGaming. That's why he says to save them for when you really need them.
Lucia heads into the junkyard that hides the rocket launcher bunker.
The map WiLLiSGaming shows for the junkyard, between Kelly County and Vice-Dale County.
Inside the bunker: the case with the Conspiracist Type 9 and grenades on the shelf.

t: Where to Find Arthur Morgan's Hat in GTA 6 and How Much It Costs
r: Arthur Morgan's hat from Red Dead Redemption 2 is for sale at a yard sale in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County. In game it's the Genuine Cowboy Hat, and it costs $35 on screen.

l: Arthur Morgan's hat from Red Dead Redemption 2 is for sale at a yard sale in Port Gellhorn, in Kelly County. In GTA 6 it's called the Genuine Cowboy Hat, and it costs $35 in IGN's footage of the purchase.
Area: Port Gellhorn, Kelly County. IGN puts the house right next to Wild Hog Point, roughly 8 miles northwest of Jason and Lucia's house.
The house: blue, with a tall American flag right out front. According to IGN, it's the only house on the block with a yard sale, so it's hard to miss.

Getting there: PC Gamer stumbled on it while driving around Port Gellhorn. Along the road there are "Yard Sale" signs with balloons tied to them and arrows. Follow them and they lead you straight to the sale.
Landmark: a Ferris wheel is visible in the background on the hat's purchase screen.
IGN says the yard sale only shows up from Chapter 2 onward. Before that, you'll just find a regular house there. For help reading the map, see GTA 6 regions and counties.
Show up with at least $35 on you.
The hat sits on one of the tables. Walk up to it to get the prompt to look at it.
On the item screen, choose to buy it or to buy and wear it straight away.
Action · PS5 (IGN's video)
Buy · Square
Buy & Wear · X
Exit · Circle
PC Gamer wrote that it only paid $5. In IGN's video, though, the tag clearly reads $35, and IGN tells you to bring that much. Carry $35 so the trip isn't wasted.

IGN's video puts the hat side by side with a shot of Arthur in Red Dead Redemption 2: same brown leather, same braided band around the crown. IGN's take is that it's just missing some wear and tear. PC Gamer says that seen from the back, there's no mistaking it.

In IGN's footage, Lucia is the one who tries it on and buys it. None of the sources show Jason wearing it. Other clothing and accessory shops are in mask, clothes, tattoo and barber shops, and more nods to other Rockstar games are in the easter eggs list.
Where is Arthur Morgan's hat in GTA 6? At a yard sale in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, next to Wild Hog Point. The house is blue with a tall American flag out front.
How much is Arthur's hat in GTA 6? IGN's video shows a $35 price tag. PC Gamer mentioned $5, but bring $35 to be safe.
What is Arthur Morgan's hat called in GTA 6? Genuine Cowboy Hat, in brown leather.
Can Jason wear Arthur Morgan's hat? Unknown so far. In the footage, Lucia is the one who buys and wears it.
Lucia tries on the Genuine Cowboy Hat at the yard sale: $35, brown leather, with the Ferris wheel in the background.

t: Should You Give the Statue to Benedict Halifax in GTA 6?
r: Go ahead and give Benedict Halifax the statue in Dubious Provenance, Chapter 3. Refusing only slows you down: the mission plays out the same and you end up handing it over anyway.

l: Go ahead and give the statue to Benedict Halifax. According to PC Gamer, the mission plays out the same way no matter what you pick. Refusing only drags things out, because you'll have to drive back to Capri later and give it to him anyway.
The choice comes up in Dubious Provenance, the 4th mission of Chapter 3.
It kicks off after Cal comes to the Bayside apartment you're borrowing from Boobie to look at the hard drive.
Once Cal leaves, a statuette icon shows up at the closet door. That's the bronze statuette you picked up along with the hard drive back in Chapter 1.
Interact with it and head to Capri, a ritzy town on the other side of the map.
At the antiques store, the owner, Evelyn Andrews, turns the piece down. In Vice City Standard's video she says it's either a very good fake or stolen, and threatens to call the authorities.
Outside, Benedict Halifax approaches the couple behind her back. He introduces himself as someone who authenticates and sells art, hands over his card and offers to appraise the statue.
Where the mission sits in the story is in the mission list.
When the decision comes, the screen goes grey and two options appear. In Vice City Standard's video, played on Xbox, they show up as Give (A) and Reject (X).
Choice · What happens
Give · Halifax leaves you a watch as collateral and then disappears for a while. You have to call him several times to track him down again
Reject · You keep the statue, but the mission stalls. To move on, you go back to Capri later and give it to him
The watch he offers is a 1972 Crowex Chronograph, which he describes as very valuable. In the same conversation he identifies the statue as a rare bronze Venus, if it's genuine.

p.h: Why you should just hand it over
l: The outcome is the same either way. Refusing only adds an extra trip back to Capri. If you want to keep the story moving, give him the statue the first time and then keep calling Halifax until he picks up.

Nobody knows yet. GameSpot lists trusting Halifax as one of the choices that might matter at the end of the story, with no confirmation. What's known about the endings is in how many endings GTA 6 has.
Another story choice where the next scene barely changes is whether to kill or spare Arnold in Chapter 1.
Should I give Halifax the statue in GTA 6? Yes. According to PC Gamer, the mission ends the same way either way, and refusing just means driving back to Capri later to hand it over.
Which mission has Benedict Halifax? Dubious Provenance, the 4th mission of Chapter 3. It starts from the statue in the closet of the Bayside apartment after Cal's visit.
What does Halifax give you for the statue? A watch as collateral, the 1972 Crowex Chronograph, which he leaves with you while he appraises the piece.
Does giving Halifax the statue change the ending? Unknown. GameSpot thinks it's possible this choice matters later, but nothing has been confirmed.
The Benedict Halifax choice: Give or Reject the statue. On Xbox that's A or X.

t: The Red Hulk in GTA 6: Who Kyle Is and Where He Comes From
r: GTA 6's Red Hulk is Kyle, a farmer who turns into a red giant after using sketchy chemicals to grow huge strawberries. At the end you can hug him for a Focus boost.

l: GTA 6's Red Hulk is Kyle, a farmer who turns into a red-skinned giant. According to Kotaku, he comes from a side mission where you help the farmer grow extremely large strawberries. To pull that off he uses some questionable chemicals, and the transformation is what you get.

His name is right there on screen in Aaraz Gaming's video: the prompt reads "Talk to Kyle", and the name Kyle sits in the corner when you get close. He's not a random monster, either. Kotaku explains that by the time this scene happens, Jason already knows the farmer from the strawberry quest.
He blew up thanks to a stream by IShowSpeed, one of the first streamers to reach this mission. His clip spread fast, and Kotaku asked Rockstar what was going on.
In the video, the player is controlling Lucia. The scene takes place at a farm with a red-doored barn and cars on fire nearby, and Kyle is down on one knee, huge and red, in ripped jeans.
Talking to him brings up dialogue options. One of them is "You gotta go", on Cross on PS5.
When Kyle opens his arms, the screen shows Hug on Triangle and Decline on Square.
After the hug, a "Focus buffed" message pops up: your character's Focus gets a boost. See what Focus does in how to increase Focus.
None of the sources say where the farm is or what the missions are called, so there's no route to mark yet. Meanwhile, more side missions with oddball characters are in Strangers and Freaks.
Kotaku asked Rob Nelson, Rockstar's head of production, why a creature like this made it into the game. According to Nelson:
adding this kind of zany stuff mostly comes down to feel, and now and then he wonders, "Are we going too crazy?";
the team gets pitched loads of ideas from across the studio and encourages people to try them out. If it's fun or funny enough, it stays in;
Rockstar loves playing with players: you never know whether the paranormal stuff is real or fake, like whether it's really Bigfoot or a guy in a Bigfoot mask.
Kyle isn't alone. Kotaku notes that players have already found Bigfoot, spotted UFOs and run into a giant crab that nobody has explained yet.
Is there a Hulk in GTA 6? There's a red, Hulk-like giant. It's Kyle, a strawberry farmer who transforms after using chemicals on his crops.
How does the farmer become the Red Hulk in GTA 6? According to Kotaku, he uses questionable chemicals to make his strawberries grow huge, and the transformation is the result.
Can you hug the Red Hulk in GTA 6? Yes. At the end of the scene you get a Hug prompt (Triangle on PS5), and the hug gives you a Focus buff.
Kyle, now huge and red, opens his arms at the farm: the prompt offers Hug or Decline.

t: How to Fast Travel in GTA 6: Taxis, RydeMe, Buses and Trains
r: GTA 6 has no free map-click fast travel. You pay to skip the trip instead: a Paradise Taxi, a RydeMe car, or a bus or train where you hold Triangle to jump ahead.

l: There's no free fast travel in GTA 6; you can't click a spot on the map and warp there. Skipping a long trip costs money: call a Paradise Taxi or a RydeMe car and ask to go straight to the destination, or ride a bus or train and skip to another stop. GamesRadar+ lists those three options, and every one of them costs a bit of cash.
You get Paradise Taxi's number during a Chapter 1 mission, and it lives in your phone's Contacts.
Set a waypoint on the map before you call.
Press Up on the D-pad, open Contacts and ring Paradise Taxi.
The cab shows up fast. In Imack Studios' video it pulled up within seconds.
Get in and confirm the destination with the driver.
To skip the drive, focus on the driver with L2 (LT on Xbox) and ask with Triangle (Y). That's $100 on top of the fare, the same amount BennyCentral pays.
Paradise Taxi only takes pocket cash, so hit an ATM first if your wallet is empty. Imack Studios called a cab in Vice City to get back to Jason's house, and the fare came to $268.
The RydeMe app unlocks in Chapter 2, according to GamesRadar+, and it sits on your phone with the other apps.
Request a ride back to your safehouse or type in any other destination.
Rides are charged to your BuckMe bank account, not your wallet.
Skipping works the same way: L2 on the driver, then Triangle, for an extra $100.
In Chapter 3 you can sign up for a BuckMe Premium account, and one of its perks is 20% off every RydeMe ride.
Leonida has working buses and trains. They don't come to you, though; you wait at the stop or station.
Hold Down on the D-pad to see whether there's a stop nearby.
Walk up to the stop to see when the next service is due.
Board and take a seat. On the train, Kibbles Gaming held Triangle (Y) to sit down at the Port Gellhorn station.
Pick a stop on the line and hold Triangle (Y) to skip the journey.

Kibbles Gaming skipped ahead to another stop and got dropped off there, with no way back onto the same train. He also found a side benefit: just riding the train around reveals the parts of the map it passes on the way.
Method · Unlocks · Paid with · Skipping
Paradise Taxi · Chapter 1 · Pocket cash · $100 extra
RydeMe · Chapter 2 · BuckMe account · $100 extra
Bus and train · Not stated · Cash (amount not stated) · Hold Triangle (Y)

The cab is the easiest because it comes to you. Buses and trains take patience but make sense when you're already near a stop. For other travel tricks like autopilot and refueling, see GTA 6 hidden features. To put money into BuckMe for RydeMe, see bank and ATM deposits, and to learn where each region is, use the map of regions and counties.
Is there fast travel in GTA 6? Not for free. Pay for a taxi or a RydeMe car plus $100 to skip the drive, or catch a bus or train and skip the journey once you're aboard.
How do you skip a taxi ride in GTA 6? Inside the car, focus on the driver with L2 (LT on Xbox) and ask to skip with Triangle (Y). It costs $100 on top of the fare.
When do you unlock RydeMe in GTA 6? In Chapter 2, according to GamesRadar+. It charges your BuckMe account, and the Chapter 3 Premium account takes 20% off every ride.
Can you ride trains in GTA 6? Yes. Wait at a station, board the train, hold Triangle (Y) to sit and then skip the journey to another stop.
Vice City in an official screenshot. Driving across the map takes a while, and a cab lets you skip the trip.

t: How to Use Photo Mode (Photo Studio) in GTA 6
r: GTA 6's photo mode is called Photo Studio. Pause and press Square (X on Xbox), tweak camera, effects, lighting and filters, then hold X (A) to save the shot.

l: Photo mode in GTA 6 is called Photo Studio, and it's there from early in the story. Pause the game and choose Photo Studio, or press Square on PS5 (X on Xbox) from the pause menu. It freezes the exact moment you paused, so you can set up a shot in the middle of a chase or a shootout. TheNewbs paused right as police backup was rolling in and built a photo around it.
Photo Studio also works during cutscenes, but GameSpot says you get fewer options there.
The button guide sits in the bottom-right corner. On a controller:
Action · PS5 · Xbox
Move the camera · Left stick · Left stick
Change the angle · Right stick · Right stick
Zoom · L2 / R2 · LT / RT
Switch tabs · L1 / R1 · LB / RB
Hide the menus · Triangle · Y
Save the photo (hold) · X · A
Leave · Circle · B
Hide the menus before you shoot so you can see the whole frame. Leaving without saving throws away everything you set up, so save first.

Camera: camera speed, a grid for framing, roll, aspect ratio, field of view, depth of field, aperture and focus distance. There's also a toggle to make your character invisible. The Breakdown cycled through eight aspect ratios, including 16:9, 2.35:1, 1:1 and the vertical 9:16.
Effects: exposure, contrast, shadows, saturation, tint, bloom and chromatic aberration.
Lighting: add light sources in up to five slots, with presets such as stage lights and camera flashes. Each light has its own intensity, range and beam angle, and you can switch it off to compare.
Vehicle: toggles your car's lights, such as the headlights and brake lights.

Overlay: turns gameplay effects on or off and adds a vignette, color isolation or a filter. GameSpot singles out three filters: Cartoon Universe (a light cel-shaded look), Found Footage (grainy and distorted, like a found-footage movie) and Pixel Art (an 8-bit look).

Photos are saved as normal console screenshots. On Xbox you'll find them under captures in the guide menu, and on PS5 they land in the console's captures too. TheNewbs couldn't find a way to browse them inside the game on Xbox.

For quick shots, use the Camera app on Jason or Lucia's phone. It can flip around for a selfie and lets you pick a pose and facial expression. If your partner is with you, you can change their pose too.

The phone camera is separate from Snapmatic, the in-game social network, which has its own tricks. For more phone features and controls the game never explains, see GTA 6 hidden features. If you want sharper shots in general, check the best settings, and for great backdrops, the map of regions and counties.
How do you open photo mode in GTA 6? Pause the game and pick Photo Studio, or press Square on PS5 (X on Xbox) while the pause menu is up.
How do you take a picture in GTA 6 photo mode? Hold X on PS5 or A on Xbox. A quick tap doesn't save it; you have to hold the button.
Where are GTA 6 photo mode pictures saved? As a console screenshot, in your PS5 or Xbox captures. TheNewbs couldn't find an in-game gallery for them on Xbox.
Can you take selfies in GTA 6? Yes, with the Camera app on the phone. You can change your character's pose and expression, and your partner's pose too if they're with you.
The Camera tab of the Photo Studio on Xbox, with the button guide on the right: zoom, move, angle, hide UI and save photo.

t: GTA 6 Secret Alien Lab: Location, How to Find Your Keypad Code and Free the Alien
r: The secret alien lab sits at South Point Airfield in Hamlet. Its keypad code isn't fixed: it shows up in the dream after the UFO abduction and differs between playthroughs.

l: GTA 6 hides a secret government lab with alien experiments. It sits under an abandoned building at South Point Airfield in Hamlet, and at the far end there's a small gray alien you can set free. The keypad code isn't the same for everyone: it comes from the alien dream that the abducted character has after the UFO event. ZacCoxTV was first to show the rescue (he credits the find to a player called The Truth Hurts), and GameSpot has since published the full route.

p.h: Before you go: abduction and dream
l: The lab is the last step of a chain:
The UFO abduction, at night in Kelly County.
The alien dream, which shows your code and a dry run of the lab.
The lab itself, where you rescue the alien.
This page used to give 2314 as the code, the number ZacCoxTV used. The code actually comes from the dream, and players are getting different ones:
Who showed it · Code
Skill Games (Jason) · 2134
ZacCoxTV (Jason) · 2314

To get yours, count the light bars in each group above the keypad in the dream, left to right. Each group is one digit. GameSpot says it's usually 2134, and that inside the lab the number is also marked on the wall to the left of the keypad.
GameSpot names the spot South Point Airfield, in Hamlet, next to the radio tower.
On the map in ZacCoxTV's video it's east of Pelican Valley, beside a small airstrip, at the end of Boundary Rd, south of the T.H. Power Station and north of Shoeless Keys.
Look for an old graffiti-covered building behind a fence, with rusty radio towers around it, restricted area signs and a locked gate.
Get inside the fence. The gate stays shut. GameSpot says part of the fence on the left side can be climbed.
Go up to the roof. Use the ladder on the far side of the building and drop in through the open hatch. Head downstairs.
Enter your code on the keypad next to the door with the red restricted area sign. The light turns green and the door opens.
Ride the elevator down to the basement. It's an abandoned lab full of skeletons of workers, soldiers and even cows, with cobwebs everywhere.
Solve the control room panel. GameSpot mentions a tape in there about why aliens keep taking cattle. Press the panel buttons until every light is green, then pull the lever to unlock the doors.
Work through the three doors. In GameSpot's order:
the middle one still has radiation that slowly drains your health, so move fast;
the left door and corridor lead to a desk with a bottle of milk; take it;
go back to the control room and through the right door, where a capsule takes the milk and opens up to reveal the alien.
Grab the alien and run. Picking it up releases a toxic gas. Get back to the elevator quickly and go up.
Carry the alien out of the facility.
Earlier versions of this page called it a glass of milk. GameSpot says bottle, and it's a bottle Jason picks up in the dream footage from Skill Games.

Outside, the alien wakes up and looks at your character before being beamed up into a flying saucer. Then government agents pull up. The saucer disappears, comes back and wipes out their vehicles. It looks like a thank-you for saving the alien.

ZacCoxTV and Skill Games both played this chain as Jason. GameSpot says either Jason or Lucia can be the one abducted, and the dream goes to whoever was taken. We haven't seen an English video of Lucia doing the lab itself yet.
ZacCoxTV also showed another player's clip where Lucia walks through a place with portals, planets and a sphere showing the map. That's the alien dream, which comes after the abduction.
More aliens, UFOs and meteorites in the GTA 6 easter eggs list.

What is the alien lab code in GTA 6? There isn't a single code. It appears in the dream the abducted character has after the UFO event, as light bars above a keypad. Skill Games got 2134 and ZacCoxTV used 2314.
Where is the alien lab in GTA 6? At South Point Airfield in Hamlet, according to GameSpot. It's a fenced building with radio towers east of Pelican Valley, at the end of Boundary Rd.
Do I need the dream before the alien lab? It's how you learn your code. GameSpot also says the code is written on the wall to the left of the keypad inside the lab.
Are there aliens in GTA 6? Yes. An abandoned lab in Hamlet has a small gray alien you can free. There's also a UFO abduction late at night, a dream full of alien eggs and meteorites you can sell.
The abandoned facility with radio towers near Pelican Valley, where the keypad door is.
The keypad in the alien dream: 2, 1, 3 and 4 bars, so this player's code was 2134.
Inside the lab: Jason lifts the alien out in the capsule room.

t: GTA 6 Jet Ski Dog Location: How to Find Dog Island and Get $1,200
r: In GTA 6, if you swim with no boat in the middle of Gambit Bay, a dog in a life jacket and goggles shows up on a jet ski. It takes you to Dog Island, where a dog digs up about $1,200.

l: GTA 6 has a dog that drives a jet ski. It wears a life jacket and goggles, shows up when you're stranded in the water and gives you a ride to an island full of dogs. If you make friends with them, one of the dogs digs up hidden cash: $1,218 in ZoneX's video.
Four channels showed the encounter (ZoneX, ZacCoxTV, T5G and InkTV), and Kotaku also reported the dog that rescues players with its jet ski.

p.h: How to make the dog show up
l: Take a boat to Gambit Bay.
In the middle of the bay, jump in the water and leave the boat behind. According to ZoneX, you need to be truly stranded, with no boat nearby.
Keep swimming and wait. After a while the dog arrives on a jet ski and starts barking.
The game lets you praise or scold it. Praise it.
Climb on the back of the jet ski.
The dog rides around the bay before heading to the island. Stay on until it stops on its own. ZoneX warns that a lot of people jump off thinking it's just a joyride and miss the best part.
The ride ends at an island with a pack of dogs on the beach.
They bring you toys. Pick them up and throw them so the dogs fetch.
If they like you, one of them starts walking around the island. Follow it.
It digs up the cash. ZoneX got +$1,218 on screen.
ZacCoxTV tells the same story with one difference: a dog led him to a hidden wallet filled with money. The reward may vary.
Once you've been there, the island is on your map and you can come back by boat. ZoneX shows the exact spot at the end of his video, from 1:10.
InkTV got picked up by the dog as well, and he has a theory: the jet ski dog works as the game's safety net for players who spend too long stuck in the water.
Whether you can collect the money more than once.
Whether the dog shows up for both Jason and Lucia.
For more early-game cash, see how to make money fast in GTA 6. More secrets are in the GTA 6 easter eggs list.
Where is the jet ski dog in GTA 6? It shows up in Gambit Bay. Head to the middle of the bay, jump in the water, leave your boat behind and keep swimming until it arrives.
How much money do you get from Dog Island in GTA 6? In ZoneX's video the dog dug up $1,218. ZacCoxTV was led to a hidden wallet with cash instead.
Should you praise or scold the jet ski dog? Praise it. When it arrives the game gives you both options, and praising it is what gets you the ride.
The dog in a life jacket and goggles arrives on a jet ski while Jason swims in Gambit Bay.
On the island, the dog digs up the cash: +$1,218 on screen.

t: GTA 6 UFO Location: How to See the Abduction (The Truth Is Out There Trophy)
r: The GTA 6 UFO shows up at night in the woods east of Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, once Chapter 1 is done. If a car with blinking lights is parked there, the abduction plays out and the trophy pops.

l: The GTA 6 UFO shows up at night (PowerPyx and GameSpot say after 2 a.m.) in a stretch of woods east of Port Gellhorn in Kelly County. If you arrive and there's a car with blinking hazard lights parked on the road, the scene plays out: a woman gets abducted, you help her, and in the end you get taken too. That's how you earn The Truth Is Out There trophy, a nod to The X-Files. It's also the first step of a longer chain that continues with the alien dream and the secret alien lab.
Unlocks: GameSpot says it's only available after you finish Chapter 1.

Location: east of Port Gellhorn, along a road that cuts through the woods. PowerPyx marks the exact spot on the map in his guide. GameSpot describes it as northwest of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County, and InkTV found the car close to the building where Chapter 2 begins.

Time: PowerPyx and GameSpot both say after 2:00 a.m. InkTV, though, got there at about 11:30 p.m. and the UFO still showed up. If nothing happens before midnight, wait until after 2 a.m. You can sleep at home to skip ahead.
Solo: PowerPyx and GameSpot both say to go alone, playing as one character.
According to PowerPyx, the event is random:
Blinking car is there: the UFO will show up.
Car isn't there: drive away and come back later. Repeat until it appears.
Near the car you'll find strange clues: a dropped bag, stones laid out like a ritual, clothes on the ground and a flashing phone. GameSpot notes the car faces a trail heading into the woods.
Head into the woods following the blue light. You'll see a woman being pulled up into the beam.
She comes back dazed and asks you to bring her car. In InkTV's video the game marked the car as an objective, and he got taken before he could drive it back.
It isn't over: your character gets abducted next, and the screen goes white.
You wake up somewhere else and the The Truth Is Out There trophy pops.

ZacCoxTV woke up the next day. In InkTV's video, Lucia calls Jason afterwards and tells him he's been gone for about three days. Milo says the event is rare and only happens at night in northern Kelly County.

p.h: After the abduction: the dream and the lab
l: The abduction is only the start. According to GameSpot, some time later the character who was taken has a dream while asleep. The dream shows the code for a secret lab as light bars, plus a dry run of an alien rescue.
Learn how to read the code in the alien dream guide. It isn't the same in every playthrough.
Then head to the secret alien lab at South Point Airfield in Hamlet and free the alien.

p.h: The trophy can pop elsewhere too
l: The Truth Is Out There hasn't only unlocked after the abduction:
Milo got it right after watching ghostly figures fight at the top of a lighthouse at night, with no abduction in the video.
Robbin Rams got it while opening the safe in the haunted hotel.
Nobody has worked out the rule yet. The trophy may cover more than one of the game's supernatural mysteries.
The alien dream, which follows the abduction and gives you the lab code.
The secret alien lab, with an alien locked inside.
The San Andreas UFO house in Bellville.
More in the GTA 6 easter eggs list.

Where is the UFO in GTA 6? In a stretch of woods east of Port Gellhorn, Kelly County; GameSpot places it northwest of the Starlet Motel. Go at night after finishing Chapter 1: if a car with blinking lights is parked on the road, the abduction will happen.

How do you get The Truth Is Out There trophy in GTA 6? Watch the abduction scene all the way through. Follow the light into the woods, help the abducted woman, and then you get taken too. The trophy pops right after.
The UFO didn't show up. What now? PowerPyx says it's random: if the blinking car isn't there, drive away and come back later, always after 2 a.m.

What happens after you get abducted in GTA 6? The screen goes white and you wake up somewhere else, sometimes days later. Later on, the abducted character has a dream that reveals the code for the secret alien lab.
The UFO's light beam in the woods, late at night.

t: How Many Endings Does GTA 6 Have and What Decides Them
r: GTA 6 has at least 4 endings, according to people who've finished it. The best one needs a maxed-out relationship and $2 million in the couple's savings. No story spoilers.

l: No story spoilers: this page only covers how many endings exist and which game systems drive them. Nothing about what actually happens.

GTA 6 has at least 4 endings, based on reviewers and players who have already finished the story, as GameSpot reports. Rockstar itself confirmed to GameSpot that there is more than one ending. The two things that matter most are Jason and Lucia's relationship and how much money sits in the couple's savings account.

p.h: How many endings people have seen
l: Rockstar: confirmed to GameSpot that the game has multiple endings, without giving a number.
GameSpot: its team finished the game and saw 2 endings. Adding what other players have reported, the site counts at least 4.
Kotaku: its reviewer also saw 2 endings and says they play out in very different ways.
That count could go up as more people finish the game in different ways.
GameSpot points to two late-game systems:
The couple's relationship. The closer Jason and Lucia are, the better.
The shared savings account. It tops out at $2 million.
Ending · What you need
The best one · Maxed-out relationship and full savings ($2 million)
A good one · Maxed-out relationship without filling the savings
The rest · Still being tested. GameSpot expects one of them comes from hitting neither goal
To raise the relationship, see Jason and Lucia's romance guide. To build up that $2 million, see how to make money in GTA 6, and remember to bank what you earn.
Criminal profile. Some players think each character's criminal profile counts too, since it shifts depending on whether you kill or spare people. Nobody knows yet whether it touches the ending.
Mission choices. GameSpot says some story decisions could matter at the end, such as whether you give the statue to Benedict Halifax. That hasn't been confirmed either.

p.h: Scenes change along the way, too
l: It's not just the finale. Rockstar senior design director Luke Howard told Game Informer that several story scenes were captured in different versions depending on the couple's relationship and criminal profile, ranging from subtle to more significant changes, as GamesRadar+ reports.

His example: after Lucia pulls off a tense armored truck robbery, Jason pulls her aside to check on her. That moment has several versions, with the couple closer or more distant. If the romance fizzles, they stay partners in crime and the story doesn't lose anything for it.

You can. According to Kotaku, once the credits roll the game takes you back to just before the final mission, and its marker stays on the map. You can fix whatever you missed and play the finale again. How that works is covered in keep playing after the ending.
How many endings does GTA 6 have? At least 4, based on reviewers and players who have finished it, as reported by GameSpot. Rockstar confirmed there's more than one.
How do you get the best ending in GTA 6? According to GameSpot, reach the finale with Jason and Lucia at the top relationship level and the couple's savings maxed out at $2 million.
Does the criminal profile affect the GTA 6 ending? Nobody knows yet. Some players think so, but no source has confirmed it.
Can you see another ending without starting over? Yes. After the credits, the game takes you back to just before the final mission, and its marker stays on the map.
Jason and Lucia: their relationship is one of the systems that changes how GTA 6 ends.

t: Where to Find the Grotti Itali RSX in GTA 6: Vespucci Island Garage
r: The Grotti Itali RSX sits in a garage at the north tip of Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands. It's alarmed, has an advanced tracker and needs the key cloner.

l: The Grotti Itali RSX is parked in a garage at the north tip of Vespucci Island, one of the Rialto Islands just off Vice City. That's the same island where you find Paul Walker's car. Two channels went to the same house and found the same black and white RSX: Imack Studios during the day and KingAlexHD at night.
Island: Vespucci Island in the Rialto Islands. On Imack Studios' map it sits east of Catalan Island, joined to it by a bridge, with Casanova Island and Salton Memorial Island nearby.
Spot: the north tip of the island, at a house on the bend where the road loops around the end of the island.
Out front: a wooden gate, with a white luxury car parked on the driveway.
Imack Studios points out that nearly every house on this island has something expensive in the garage, so it's worth a slow drive around.
Park outside the house and hop the wooden fence next to the gate.
Walk around to the side door of the garage, the one with small glass panes.
Pick Break Open and head inside.
The Itali RSX is right there, next to a yellow ladder leaning on the wall.
Both videos scan the car and get the same card:
Field · Result
Access · Key Cloner
Security · Alarmed
Tracker · Advanced

At the driver's door you get two prompts: Clone Key or Smash Window. Smashing the window isn't enough, because a car that needs the cloner won't start on a hotwire. The cloner unlocks later in the story; how to steal cars in GTA 6 covers when you get it.

The advanced tracker is the real headache. Imack Studios warns that it makes this one much harder to get away with, since it gives away where the car is. Neither video actually drives the RSX out of the garage.

p.h: More expensive cars on the same island
l: Imack Studios stopped at two more houses on Vespucci Island:
A red supercar behind the fence of another house. It also offers Clone Key or Smash Window. His advice is to jump the fence without breaking anything so you don't draw attention.

A Furia on the driveway of a mansion close by. Its card matches the RSX: key cloner, alarm and advanced tracker. That garage door opens with a lock minigame where you find the sweet spot and fill the circle fast. According to Imack Studios, there are collectible cards on a table inside. See what they sell for in collectible cards.
Randy's wish list points to a different Furia, at a mansion in Peacock Estates.
Where is the Grotti Itali RSX in GTA 6? In the garage of a house at the north tip of Vespucci Island, in the Rialto Islands, right where the road bends. It's the same island as Paul Walker's car.
How do you steal the Itali RSX in GTA 6? With the key cloner. Waink It shows it's alarmed and has an advanced tracker, so hotwiring won't work.
Is the Itali RSX there at night in GTA 6? Yes. Imack Studios found it around 2 pm in-game and KingAlexHD found it at night in the same garage.
The Grotti Itali RSX in the garage. The Waink It card asks for the key cloner and shows an alarm and an advanced tracker.
The north tip of Vespucci Island on the map. The Itali RSX house is on the bend in the road.

t: How to Get Body Armor in GTA 6: Where to Buy It, How to Equip It and Free Armor
r: In GTA 6 you buy body armor at a gun store and put it on from the weapon wheel. It adds a blue bar over your health, refills if it doesn't break, and you can find it for free.

l: In GTA 6 you get body armor by buying it at a gun store, then you put it on from the weapon wheel. While you wear it, a blue bar sits above your health and soaks up bullets before your health does. You can also find armor for free in police cars and in houses you raid.
At a gun store. JorRaptor grabbed his at the store nearest Jason's house, Chuck's Tackle & Shot, and says you can choose the color. His video doesn't show the price.
Open the weapon wheel.
Armor has its own slot on the wheel, apart from your guns.
Select it and the blue bar appears on top of your health bar.
JorRaptor only straps it on right before a shootout.
Here's how JorRaptor explains it:
Incoming fire drains the blue bar first. Your health only takes hits once it's gone.
If the vest survives the fight, the bar refills over time and you can use it again.
If the bar hits zero, the vest breaks and you need to buy a new one.
One trick: take the vest off just before it breaks. You keep it, but every bullet after that goes straight to your health.

Police cars: BennyCentral opened the trunk of a cop car at the Hamlet impound and walked off with a rifle, a shotgun and a vest. Save first, since the cops don't take it well. Full steps in free guns from cop cars.

The gun nut's house: according to BennyCentral, a stilt house in Key Lento that looks a lot like Jason's holds armor, a machine gun and a rifle, plus the unique Gun Nut SMS01 sniper. The owner is home and comes at you.
Mansions: Typical Gamer broke into a random mansion, forced open a safe and came out with armor, a rare rifle and cash.
Cheat: there's a body armor cheat, but it only unlocks after 100 workouts.
JorRaptor puts armor near the top of his early shopping list, along with a suppressor for your pistol. The rest of the arsenal is in the GTA 6 weapons list.
Where do you buy body armor in GTA 6? At a gun store. JorRaptor bought his at the store closest to Jason's house and picked the color at the counter.
How do you equip body armor in GTA 6? From the weapon wheel, where armor has its own slot. Once it's on, a blue bar shows up above your health.
Does body armor regenerate in GTA 6? If it doesn't break, yes: the blue bar fills back up over time. If it breaks, you have to buy a new one, according to JorRaptor.
Can you get free body armor in GTA 6? Yes. Police car trunks can have a vest, and so can houses you break into. There's also a body armor cheat.
Jason wearing armor. The blue bar above the health bar is the vest's protection.

t: Where to Find All Magazines, Books and Comics in GTA 6
r: GTA 6 has 27 magazines, books and comics to collect. Five are in Jason's house, and GameSpot says to read them all before Chapter 1 ends. Here's where they are.

l: There are 27 magazines, books and comics to collect in GTA 6, going by the counter that appears on screen when you pick up your first one. The earliest batch is in Jason's house in Key Lento, and GameSpot's advice is to read all of them before Chapter 1 wraps up.
Title · Where it is
Lethal By Design · Coffee table in the living room
Orca: A Whole Different Animal · Desk next to a radio and a stack of books
Ashes of Glory · Bedside table
Body Copy · Table on the back porch, by the workout area
Reel Talk · Inside the shed under the house
GameSpot doesn't say exactly what happens to these after Chapter 1, only that you shouldn't put them off. Grab all five early to be safe.
