In Christian Konopatzki's video, Ashes of Glory gets picked up during the mission Feng Shui, when Jason heads home to catch up with Cal. The moment he takes it, the corner of the screen reads Magazines, Books & Comics 1 / 27.
Title · Where it is
RX-Men · Magazine rack in the 24/7 store east of Key Lento's main road
RX-Men is a spoof of the X-Men. GameSpot is still adding to its list, so these six are the only published locations for now.
Walk up and press the Examine prompt.
With the book in hand you get four options: R1 to open it, Triangle to show the text, Square to flip it and Circle to put it back (RB, Y, X and B on Xbox).
Page through to the end before you put it down.
Map markers. GameSpot says some of these mark points of interest on your map. See what that can unlock in how to increase Focus.
Collection. Each one ticks up the 27-item counter.
Laughs. Plenty of them poke fun at life in Leonida or spoof real-world media.
To know where you stand in the story while you collect, keep the Chapter 1 walkthrough handy. If you're hunting collectibles in general, collectible cards work differently and can be sold.
How many magazines, books and comics are in GTA 6? The in-game counter says 27. It pops up in the corner of the screen when you grab your first one.
Can you miss the magazines in Jason's house in GTA 6? GameSpot says to read every book and magazine in the house before the end of Chapter 1. Don't leave them for later.
Where is the RX-Men comic in GTA 6? On the magazine rack of the 24/7 store just east of the main road through Key Lento.
Why read magazines in GTA 6? Some of them mark points of interest on your map. The rest are jokes or bits of Leonida lore, and they all count toward the collection.
Ashes of Glory, picked up in Jason's bedroom, with the options to open it, show the text, flip it or put it back.

t: GTA 6 Gun Store Unique Weapons: Prices, Locations and Bundles
r: Every GTA 6 gun store sells one or two unique weapons you can't buy anywhere else, like Big Shots' The Silver 1922, plus up to three bundles with mods. Prices and store locations inside.

l: Gun stores in GTA 6 carry one or two unique weapon variants that only that store sells, along with up to three bundles of guns that come with mods already fitted. Arekkz Gaming went through three stores and the names and prices are right there on screen. He's the only channel to show them so far, so treat this as unverified for now.

p.h: How to spot a store’s unique weapon
l: Walk into any gun store and check the minimap: unique weapons show up as a gold gun icon.
Get close to the display and press Triangle (Y on Xbox) when View pops up.
The card shows an Exclusive tag, the price and a line naming the only store that sells it.
Two things the screen tells you before you buy:
You can't modify them. Every one carries the "Variants can't be modified" warning. What you see is what you get.
You pay from BuckMe. The price uses the banking app's icon. At Phil's, Arekkz had $6,905 in his wallet and $1,774 in BuckMe, and a $3,780 purchase was blocked for low BuckMe funds. Hit an ATM first.
Store · Location · Unique weapon · Type · Price
Chuck's Tackle & Shot · Key Lento, the starter store · Mahi Nipper .38 · Compact pistol · $1,160
Big Shots · Hamlet · The Silver 1922 · Heavy pistol · $2,210
Big Shots · Hamlet · Sand Storm ES9 · Military pistol · $1,470
Phil's Ammu-Nation · Next to Peacock Estates · Honky Tonk Mustang .357 · Magnum revolver with a red dot · $3,780
Phil's Ammu-Nation · Next to Peacock Estates · Star Spangled 556 · Carbine rifle in a US flag finish · $3,050

The map lists Chuck's inventory as Limited and the other two as Expanded, so the bigger stores simply stock more. Arekkz rates The Silver 1922 as one of the harder-hitting pistols; its card shows 5.5 damage against 4.2 for the Sand Storm ES9.
Talk to the clerk (L2 when you're close) and open Weapons and Mods. The first tab is Bundles, with up to three per store.
Store · Bundle · Price · On screen
Chuck's Tackle & Shot · Fortune & Son Moreland 850 (shotgun) · $2,445 · Weapon and mods
Chuck's Tackle & Shot · Duke 556 · $1,920 · Mods only, for a rifle you already own
Big Shots · Kozlov KZ-59 (assault rifle) · $3,620 · Locked: buy 1 more gun
Big Shots · ADB FRA (battle rifle) · $6,165 · Locked: buy 1 more gun
Phil's Ammu-Nation · Girardi Super400 (shotgun) · $7,445 · Sold out
Phil's Ammu-Nation · ADB M350 (machine gun) · $13,455 · Sold out

Watch the small print: some bundles only unlock after you buy more guns at that store, and others read "Currently sold out". The video doesn't show when stock comes back. The Duke 556 bundle at Chuck's is mods only, and you can grab the rifle itself for free at the early money warehouse.

If you only care about performance, the free unique guns around the map cover the early game; see GTA 6 unique weapon locations. The store variants are for the look and for collectors. Once bought, they come back from the gun store locker if you lose them. To keep them on hand, see how to store weapons in your trunk.
Can you buy unique weapons in GTA 6? Yes. Each gun store stocks one or two exclusive variants marked with a gold gun icon. Big Shots in Hamlet sells The Silver 1922 pistol for $2,210.
Can you customize a unique weapon from a gun store? No. The purchase screen says variants can't be modified, so they keep their own paint job and attachments.
What are gun store bundles in GTA 6? Weapons sold with mods already fitted, found in the Bundles tab after you talk to the clerk. Some unlock only after you buy more guns, and some can be sold out.

Why does the gun store say I don't have enough money? Prices come out of your BuckMe account, not your wallet. In Arekkz's video the store turned him down for low BuckMe funds while he had almost $7,000 in cash.
Inside Big Shots in Hamlet: the View prompt with a gold gun icon marks a unique weapon for sale.
The front of Phil's Ammu-Nation near Peacock Estates, home of the Star Spangled 556 and the Honky Tonk Mustang .357.

t: Is Niko Bellic in GTA 6? The Chapter and Mission Where He Appears
r: Yes. GTA 4's Niko Bellic has a cameo near the end of GTA 6's story: Chapter 5, Top of the World, Ma, in the mission Taking Liberties. His original voice actor is back.

l: Spoiler warning: this page tells you where in the story Niko shows up. It doesn't say what happens in the scene.

Yes, Niko Bellic, the hero of GTA 4, is in GTA 6. He makes a cameo in Chapter 5, Top of the World, Ma, during the mission Taking Liberties, according to PC Gamer. That's the last chapter, so you won't see him until you're near the end of the story.
What · Detail
Chapter · 5: Top of the World, Ma
Mission · Taking Liberties
Timing · The last stretch of the story
Cutscenes · Two, according to Kotaku

In the mission list, Taking Liberties is the 2nd mission of Chapter 5. If you're still early on, you have a long way to go: Chapter 5 is short, but it comes after almost the whole campaign. For a sense of the hours, see how long it takes to beat GTA 6.

GTA 4 came out in 2008, and Niko is back a lot older. Kotaku and ZacCoxTV's video both show him with grey hair in the mission's cutscenes. The channel reacts to footage captured by another player and shows both moments where he appears.
It's a story cameo. None of the sources say you get to play as Niko.

p.h: The original voice actor is back
l: Niko is voiced once again by Michael Hollick, the actor from GTA 4. Fans got suspicious before anyone reached Chapter 5: his name was on the cast list Rockstar shared, credited only as "The Hitman". Kotaku and GamesRadar+ confirmed that role is Niko, hidden in the credits to protect the surprise.
GamesRadar+ points out that Hollick had complained years ago about his pay for GTA 4, which is part of why his return turned heads. The rest of the cast is in GTA 6 characters and voice actors.

It's real. When the first clips went around, plenty of people assumed they were edited. Kotaku played that far and confirmed the scene is in the game. More nods to older Rockstar games are in the easter eggs list.
What mission is Niko Bellic in GTA 6? Taking Liberties, in Chapter 5 (Top of the World, Ma), close to the end of the story.
Who voices Niko in GTA 6? Michael Hollick, the same actor from GTA 4. The credits list him only as The Hitman to keep the surprise.
Does Niko show up early in GTA 6? No. The cameo is in the final chapter, so you have to get through most of the story first.
An older, grey-haired Niko Bellic in one of his Chapter 5 cutscenes.

t: GTA 6 Secret Early Items: Free Guns, Cash and a Car Near the Start
r: Early in GTA 6 you can grab free snipers, a rocket launcher, unique guns, Paul Walker's car and loot bags worth up to $10,000. Here's where each one is and the best order to collect them.

l: You don't need to spend a cent early in GTA 6 to kit yourself out. Without any mission, you can pick up four snipers, a rocket launcher, several unique guns, a jet ski, Paul Walker's car and loot bags worth up to $10,000 each. Four channels went to the same spots: Rodwenn, Arekkz Gaming, Millzaa and FuriousFade.
Spot · Where · What you get
Radio tower · Key Lento, about 0.36 miles from Jason's house · SM-69 sniper, 2 trading cards, a parachute
Teddy bear warehouse · South Vice-Dale County, east of Hamlet · $6,000 bag, drugs, Duke 556 rifle, a card worth $6,000
Manatee Motel · Northern Pelican Valley, just south of Hamlet · Safe, drugs and the unique Kingfishers Laird 350 sniper
Swamp shack · Pelican Valley · Unique Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 sniper and Swamp Bait revolver
Crab lab · Pelican Valley · Crabshack VF5 SMG, $10,000 bag, a jet ski
Griffin Shooting Range trailer · Balsero, Vice City · H-AT launcher, Conspiracist Type 9 SMG, grenades
Vespucci Island garage · Vespucci Island, Vice City · Paul Walker's green Eclipse
This one is basically next door: Millzaa's map put it 0.36 miles from Jason's house. Scan it with your phone first, since it counts as a landmark, then start climbing.
Go through the gate and take the stairs up inside until they lead you out a door.
Climb the outside ladder, enter the next room and take another ladder.
A trading card sits on a table up there.
The SM-69 sniper leans on the balcony outside, scope included. A second card is inside the phone box. Arekkz also found around $150 in a side cabinet.
A parachute waits at the very top. It's single use: Millzaa jumped, and Jason tossed it away after landing.
The tower SM-69 is a regular gun, so you lose it if you die.
It's the red warehouse by the quarry, east of Hamlet. Everyone inside is already dead, so there's no fight. Bring a truck.
The teddy bear van in the yard has drugs stuffed in the toys.
Inside, a $6,000 bag of marked bills sits on a table near a Duke 556 rifle and an SMG.
Each drug brick is worth $400, per the on-screen pickup in Arekkz's video.
The office safe opens with the right stick. It holds the Leroy Rook (Silver) card from the Vice City Narcos set, which the Hamlet pawn shop buys for $6,000.
Full walkthrough: early money warehouse.
It's at the north end of Pelican Valley, across the water just south of Hamlet. You'll hear gunfire and a tiger as you arrive, with a man shooting at it and yelling for help.
Wait for the tiger and the man to go down, then step into the room.
Grab the cash on the table, the flare gun and the back-room safe: Millzaa got $917.
The next room over has $640 in drugs and a case holding the Kingfishers Laird 350 sniper. The game tells you you've unlocked a unique weapon variant.
Come armed. In Millzaa's video, a group showed up shooting right after.

Deep in the Pelican Valley swamp there's a shack with dead gators on the porch. The unique Cruel Huntsman's SM-69 hunting rifle lies on the floor. Using focus to zoom around, Millzaa also spotted the Swamp Bait revolver close by. The water is full of live gators, so cross carefully.

Also in Pelican Valley. Arekkz took the boat from the dock behind Jason's house. The payoff is the Crabshack VF5, a $10,000 bag of marked bills and close to $1,100 in the safe. The boathouse garage holds a jet ski for the ride out, handy for the next stops. The codes are in our giant crab mystery guide.
This is the long drive. Griffin Shooting Range is in Balsero, on the west side of Vice City.
Park across the street from the range and hop the fence into the trailer park.
Head into the trailer: there's a hatch in the floor.
The cellar holds the H-AT launcher, the unique Conspiracist Type 9 SMG in a gun case, grenades and healing items.
The launcher isn't unique and disappears if you die. More in where to find a rocket launcher.

p.h: Three more guns along the way
l: Arekkz chained these together on the jet ski from the crab lab:
Kingfishers W-22, a suppressed small game rifle: in a gun case in the main cabin of a small island in Wetman Bay, southwest of Hamlet. Expect enemies.
A regular sniper: on the Grassrivers beach west of Watson Bay, through a gap in a compound's fence, no fight needed.
Turnt Nipper .38, a unique pistol with a red dot: a glider is stuck in the trees on a sandy islet in Bobcat Bight. Shoot the ropes until it drops; the pistol is inside.

Unique guns stay, regular ones don't. Unique finds carry the gold gun icon and can be recovered at a gun store locker. Everything else is gone when you die, so use the trunk. See every one in GTA 6 unique weapon locations.
Marked bills aren't spendable yet. The bags have to go to a fence such as Brian (code 7700) or Donnie.
The Fast & Furious car. The green Eclipse sits in a garage on Vespucci Island with a HAD YOU plate. Millzaa and Rodwenn both picked it up early.

Where can I get a sniper early in GTA 6? At the top of the Key Lento radio tower near Jason's house there's a scoped SM-69. The unique Kingfishers Laird 350 sits in the Manatee Motel, just south of Hamlet.
Is there a rocket launcher early in GTA 6? Yes. It's in a cellar under a trailer across the street from Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero, next to the unique Conspiracist Type 9 SMG.
Which early stash pays the most in GTA 6? The crab lab, with a $10,000 bag of marked bills. The South Vice-Dale warehouse is close behind: a $6,000 bag, drugs and a trading card worth $6,000.

Do I keep the guns I find around the map? Only the unique ones, marked with a gold gun icon. Regular finds like the tower sniper and the warehouse rifle are lost when you die, so stow them in your trunk.
Climbing the Key Lento radio tower: a sniper, two trading cards and a parachute wait at the top.
The floor hatch in the trailer across from Griffin Shooting Range leads to the rocket launcher stash.

t: GTA 6 Haunted Hotel: Marbelle Hotel Location and Safe Code (Silent Hill Easter Egg)
r: The Marbelle Hotel in Vice City is GTA 6's haunted hotel. A door opens on its own, the map turns foggy at night like Silent Hill, and a rooftop notebook has the safe code.

l: GTA 6's haunted hotel is the Marbelle Hotel, a run-down building in Vice City that's closed and up for sale. Inside you'll find mannequins, a door that swings open by itself and glowing writing on the walls. After that the whole game turns into a foggy night, straight out of Silent Hill, and a notebook on the roof gives you the code to the safe downstairs. Robbin Rams is the only creator to show it so far, so it's marked as unverified for now.
County: Vice-Dale County, in the city part of Vice City. Robbin Rams shows the map marker at 0:24 in his video.
The building: three floors, "Marbelle Hotel" across the top, "For Sale" and "Closed" signs out front and two lit windows on the top floor.
Neighborhood: the rooftop notebook is a realtor's pitch that mentions Crosstown and views of the 404 interstate.
Walk around to the back of the building.
One door there opens without breaking in. Just walk through.
You'll already see messages scrawled on the walls inside.
A safe with a keypad in a corner downstairs. You need the code from the roof.
A mannequin standing in a corner and another lying in a bed. They don't move, but Robbin Rams warns about a jump scare.
A collectible card. See how the collectible cards work.

On one of the floors, a door opens by itself and the lights start flickering. Walk through and glowing white text fills the walls. Once it fades, the roof door is open and the game has changed: it's night and thick fog covers the entire map, not only the hotel. It was daytime when Robbin Rams walked in.

Up on the roof you'll hear strange noises and spot writing on the floor. There's a billboard next to the hotel. Robbin Rams climbed it, fell and lost a big chunk of health, and found nothing up there, so skip it.
On the roof, find the notebook in a corner.
It's a sales listing that insists the hotel has no ghosts and tells you to stay off the roof.
One number on the page is circled. That's the safe code. In Robbin Rams' game it was 955214, but he says yours could be different.
Head back down to the safe and punch it in.
Cash: $236 plus another $141 in the video.
A luxury watch: the Crowex Ambassador 'Breakfast'. The counter read "Luxury Watches 2/34", so there are 34 watches to collect.
As he looted the safe, the "The Truth Is Out There" trophy popped. That's the same trophy as the UFO abduction, and nobody has explained yet why it unlocked at the hotel.
Robbin Rams went back later. The text didn't appear, the door didn't open on its own and the fog stayed gone, though it was still night. There were now two identical notebooks on the roof.
More strange places in the GTA 6 easter eggs list.
Where is the haunted hotel in GTA 6? It's the Marbelle Hotel, a closed three-story building up for sale in Vice City, in Vice-Dale County. Go in through the back door.
What is the Marbelle Hotel safe code? It's the circled number in the notebook on the roof. In Robbin Rams' game it was 955214, but he warns yours may differ, so read your own notebook.
What's in the haunted hotel safe? Some cash and a luxury watch, the Crowex Ambassador 'Breakfast', which counts toward the game's watch collection.
Can you trigger the Silent Hill fog again? Not in Robbin Rams' video. On his second visit the wall text never showed up and the fog didn't come back.
The Marbelle Hotel's front, with the two lit windows on the top floor.
Once the door opens by itself, the game switches to a foggy night.

t: GTA 6 Alien Dream Sequence: How to Get the Secret Lab Code
r: After the UFO abduction, the character who was taken dreams of alien eggs, cows and a keypad. The light bars in the dream spell out the code for the secret alien lab.

l: The alien dream is the second step of GTA 6's UFO mystery, and it's where you get the code for the secret alien lab. After the abduction that pops "The Truth Is Out There", whoever was taken (Jason or Lucia) has a strange dream while sleeping. The code shows up as groups of light bars above a keypad, and the rest of the dream walks you through the lab before you ever set foot in it. GameSpot lays out the whole chain, and Skill Games recorded Jason's dream from start to finish.
No abduction, no dream. If you haven't done that part yet, see the UFO abduction guide. GameSpot says it opens up once you've finished Chapter 1.
Only the character who was abducted has it. In Skill Games' video that's Jason.
It begins with a short scene of him asleep in bed. GameSpot says it comes after some time has passed, so don't expect it the same night.
You're in control the whole way, walking around barefoot in white clothes.
A dark hallway with round lights in the ceiling.
A room packed with alien eggs glowing blue. That's where the "alien eggs" in the video titles come from.
A room with planets and a sphere in the middle that shows a view of the map. GameSpot says the dream gives you glimpses of where to go and what to do.
A keypad under rows of light bars. That's your code (see below).
A control panel full of lights and switches.
A bright white room with cows and a small table with a bottle of milk, which Jason picks up.
It's a rehearsal. In the real lab, according to GameSpot, you also solve a light panel, grab a bottle of milk and put it into the alien's capsule.
Look at the light bars above the keypad. Count the bars in each group from left to right. Each group is one digit.

In Skill Games' video the groups have 2, 1, 3 and 4 bars, and Jason starts typing 2134. GameSpot also says the code is usually 2134, which suggests it isn't the same in every playthrough. Write down whatever your dream shows. GameSpot adds that inside the real lab the code is also marked on the wall to the left of the keypad.

Jason wakes up in bed and the dream is over. Now head for the real thing: GameSpot puts the lab at South Point Airfield in Hamlet, by the radio tower. The full route inside, from the roof hatch to the alien's capsule, is in the alien lab guide.
Night-time UFO abduction in Kelly County, with "The Truth Is Out There".
The dream: eggs, cows, milk and the code in light bars.
The lab at South Point Airfield: code, milk and the alien rescue.
More secrets in the GTA 6 easter eggs list.
How do you get the alien lab code in GTA 6? From the dream you have after the UFO abduction. Count the light bars in each group above the keypad, left to right: each group is one digit.
Is the GTA 6 alien lab code always 2134? Not necessarily. GameSpot says it's usually 2134, which means it can change. Use the number your own dream shows.
When does the alien dream happen in GTA 6? Some time after the abduction, in a scene where the abducted character is asleep in bed. Only the character who was taken has the dream.
The alien egg room in Jason's dream after the abduction.
The dream keypad: count the bars in each group. Here it's 2, 1, 3 and 4, so the code is 2134.

t: All GTA 6 Base Jump Locations and How to Complete Them
r: GTA 6 has 25 base jump challenges, mostly on Vice City skyscrapers. Here are the spots found so far and how to land in the ring without failing.

l: There are 25 base jump challenges in GTA 6, according to GameSpot, and most of them start from the roof of a Vice City skyscraper. A few are outside the city, like the one on the tallest radio tower on the map. Only four spots have been shown for certain so far, and nobody has published the full list yet.
Look for the purple parachute icon on the map. Base jumps also show up under the Exploration tab of the index.
Each one has a free parachute sitting between two green cones, with a few energy drinks on the ground.
For skyscrapers, walk in on the ground floor and ride the elevator to the roof. The jump often starts from the helipad.
Once you're up there, the game tells you to equip a parachute and to use Focus (L3 + R3) to spot the cones that mark the jump-off point. Both Typical Gamer and ZacCoxTV get that prompt on camera.
Put on a parachute, either your own or the free one at the spot.
Run to the edge between the two cones and press X (A on Xbox) to jump.
Press X (A) again in mid-air to open the canopy.
Steer with both sticks and fly through the pink rings in the air.
To slow down for a tight ring, hold X (A). The canopy flares and kills your speed for a moment. You can't hold it forever, but it buys enough time to line up the next checkpoint.
At the end there's a big pink ring on the ground. When you're right above it, press Triangle (Y) to drop the parachute and land on your feet.
Finish under the par time.
If the run goes wrong, hold Square (X on Xbox) to restart from the top.
Touching down with the canopy open. It counts as a fail even inside the ring. Cut away with Triangle (Y).
Cutting away too high. The landing only counts if the drop is short.
Clipping the structure. The radio tower course loops around the tower itself, and Typical Gamer's run ended when he flew into the cables.
Going over the par time.
Location · Area
Maven Residences Building · Downtown Vice City
Crimson Palms Condominiums · Washington Beach
Rico Huxley Hotel · Tequesta
Tallest radio tower in the game · Southern Vice-Dale County, near Hamlet

The three buildings come from GameSpot's list, which is still being filled in. The tower is in both videos: there's a full parachute to pick up at the top and the cones sit on the highest platform. Getting there means a long ladder climb. While you're up there, check out the radio tower Easter egg.

If you don't own a parachute yet, see where to get one. Every jump also counts toward unlocking the parachute cheat. To find downtown Vice City, Washington Beach and Tequesta, use the map of regions and counties.
How many base jumps are in GTA 6? There are 25 base jump challenges, according to GameSpot. Most sit on top of Vice City skyscrapers, with a few outside the city.

How do you land a base jump in GTA 6? When you're right above the pink ring on the ground, press Triangle (Y on Xbox) to cut away the parachute. Floating all the way down with the canopy open fails the challenge.
Do you need your own parachute for base jumps in GTA 6? No. Every base jump has a free parachute waiting at the jump-off point, between the two cones.
How do you find base jumps on the GTA 6 map? Look for the purple parachute icon. Base jumps are also listed under the Exploration tab of the index.
The jump-off point at the top of the radio tower: two cones on the platform and a free parachute to grab.

t: GTA 6 Classic Controls: How to Switch Back to GTA 5 Buttons
r: In GTA 6, open Pause, Settings, Control Scheme and pick Classic. Sprint moves back to X (A on Xbox) and jump to Square, the way it worked in GTA 5.

l: To play GTA 6 with GTA 5's button layout, pause the game, go to Settings and change Control Scheme from Default to Classic. Sprint goes back to X (A on Xbox) and jump goes back to Square (X on Xbox), just like GTA 5. GamesRadar+ walked through the switch, and kevinsmak and Checkmark Academy both showed the menu on a PS5.
Press Options on PS5 (Menu on Xbox) to pause.
Open Settings.
The very first option is Control Scheme, with three choices: Default, Classic and Left-handed.
Press right until you land on Classic.
Back out with Circle. The game asks you to hold a button to confirm the change, as Checkmark Academy showed.
Going back to Default works the same way.
kevinsmak put both schemes side by side on PS5, button by button. Only four actions move:
Action · GTA 6 Default · Classic, GTA 5 style
Sprint · L3 (LS) · X (A)
Jump and climb · X (A) · Square (X)
Melee · Square (X) · Circle (B)
Crouch · Circle (B) · L3 (LS)
The Xbox button is in brackets. GamesRadar+ lists the same Classic layout for both consoles.
Everything else on foot is identical in both schemes: R2 shoots, L2 aims, R1 takes cover, L1 holsters, Triangle interacts and R3 looks behind.

The third scheme flips the controller: you move with the right stick and look with the left. Shoot moves to L2, aim to R2 and sprint to R3, while the face buttons match Default. kevinsmak showed that one too.

The same screen lets you check the full button map for each situation before you confirm. kevinsmak counted nine categories, including on foot, aiming, vehicles, swimming and parachute. Checkmark Academy opened the aiming one to check: R2 shoots, L2 aims.

kevinsmak's take: if you have years of GTA 5 in your hands, Classic will feel like home. The catch is that on Classic your right thumb handles sprinting, and that's the same thumb that moves the camera, so it leaves the camera while you run. Default keeps sprint on the left stick and frees your right thumb for the camera.

If you stick with Default but get tired of clicking the stick, there's a middle ground: in the Gameplay tab, set Movement Speed to Run. Your character then runs whenever the left stick is pushed all the way.

p.h: While you’re in there: the HUD
l: GamesRadar+ suggests checking the HUD settings in the same menu. With the default Dynamic HUD, the minimap, your bank balance and the health, stamina and focus bars only show up when you press down on the D-pad. Each one can be toggled on or off in Settings.
The rest of the options worth changing are in the best GTA 6 settings, and the controls the game never explains are in GTA 6 hidden features. New to the game? Start with the GTA 6 beginner tips.
How do you get GTA 5 controls in GTA 6? Pause the game, open Settings and change Control Scheme to Classic. Sprint moves to X (A on Xbox) and jump to Square (X on Xbox).
How do you sprint with X in GTA 6? Switch the control scheme to Classic in Settings. On the default scheme, sprint is on L3, clicking in the left stick.
What changes with GTA 6 classic controls? Just four buttons: sprint, jump, melee and crouch. Shooting, aiming, cover and interact stay where they are.
The Classic scheme on PS5: run on X, jump on Square, melee on Circle and crouch on L3.

t: GTA 6 Delights Mission: Should You Help Frankie or Not?
r: In the Chapter 2 Delights robbery, Frankie asks Jason if he can dance. Say yes or no, you still rob the club: the choice only changes the scene before the heist.

l: It makes no difference to the heist: help Frankie or turn him down, you still rob the Delights. The choice only changes the scene that plays out before the robbery. That's PC Gamer's finding after going through both versions of the Chapter 2 mission.
Heads up: this page covers one mission choice from Chapter 2 and nothing else from the story.
Chapter 2, in Port Gellhorn.
Jason and Lucia are helping Vicky rob her boss Frankie, who runs the Delights club.
In PC Gamer's mission list, the Chapter 2 mission where Jason and Lucia visit a nightclub is called Afternoon Delight. The full order is in the GTA 6 mission list.

Jason slips in through the club's back door while he and Lucia set up the robbery, and runs straight into Frankie. There's a show that night and one of the dancers can't go on. Mario, the lead dancer, takes one look at Jason and gets an idea. Frankie has the same one and asks, in a hurry, whether Jason can dance.
You get only a couple of seconds to answer, so make up your mind before you reach that point.
Answer · What happens · The heist
Help · Jason steps in for the missing dancer and joins the show on stage, with Lucia watching from the crowd · Goes ahead as normal
Don't help · Mario walks off and the show is canceled. Frankie tries to work up the crowd by himself until Jason fires a shot into the ceiling and announces the robbery · Goes ahead as normal

PC Gamer doesn't mention any consequence beyond the scene itself: both paths end with you robbing the place. The outlet thinks both are worth seeing, but helping is the funnier one, mostly because of Lucia's reaction to seeing Jason up there.
Want to see both? GTA 6 doesn't let you replay a finished mission, so make a manual save before you head into the club, as covered in how to replay missions in GTA 6.
Another story choice people keep asking about comes in Chapter 1: kill or spare Arnold.
Should you help Frankie in the GTA 6 Delights mission? It doesn't matter for the heist, which happens either way. PC Gamer found the version where you help a lot more fun.

What happens if you don't help Frankie in GTA 6? The show gets canceled, Frankie tries to work the crowd on his own, and Jason cuts him off with a shot into the ceiling to announce the robbery. The heist carries on as normal.
What chapter is the Delights mission in? Chapter 2, in Port Gellhorn, when Jason and Lucia help Vicky rob her boss, Frankie.
Port Gellhorn, where the Delights mission takes place, in an official GTA 6 image.

t: GTA+ in GTA 6: Every Story Mode Reward and What It Costs
r: GTA+ in GTA 6 gets you an exclusive Annis Elegy, a Crosstown garage, free transit and rentals, 10% more on car sales and 10% off at many stores, for $7.99 a month.

l: A GTA+ membership gives you a handful of story mode extras in GTA 6: an exclusive '90s Annis Venturas Blvd Elegy, a single-car garage in Crosstown, free transit and rentals, 10% more when you sell your own cars and 10% off at a bunch of shops. None of it is required to finish the game. GamesRadar+ and PC Gamer both published the full list, and their breakdowns match.
Perk · What you get
Annis Venturas Blvd Elegy · A '90s sports coupe with top-tier tuning and an exclusive widebody look
Crosstown garage · One parking spot, for the Elegy or any other car you own
Public transit · Free rides
Rentals · Free bike, Seashark (jet ski) and scooter rentals
RydeMe · Cheaper fares in the rideshare app
Scooter Bros · Two extra car delivery credits per day
Car sales · 10% more for owned vehicles sold at Pay 'n' Spray
Stores · 10% off weapons, clothes, haircuts, tattoos and vehicle mods at participating shops

p.h: Things to know before you subscribe
l: Some perks unlock later. GamesRadar+ says the RydeMe discount kicks in once you get the app in Chapter 1, and the Scooter Bros upgrades arrive from Chapter 3 on.
You need to be online. Claiming the perks takes an active membership and an internet connection.
Car sales: the 10% bonus covers owned cars sold at Pay 'n' Spray. Ultimate Edition vehicles can't be sold at all. More in how to sell cars in GTA 6.
Store discounts: not every shop takes part. In the in-game index, eligible businesses have a small yellow icon above their name. See how the index works.
The Elegy: GamesRadar+ calls it a solid first car for street races once you reach Vice City. The Crosstown garage is GTA+ only; the rest are in GTA 6 garage locations and prices.

GTA+ costs $7.99, €7.99 or £6.99 a month on PS5 and Xbox Series X · S. It renews every month and can be canceled at any time. You can sign up through the PlayStation Store, the Microsoft Store or straight from the GTA 6 menu.

If you pre-ordered, you already have one free month waiting: open the menu, go to the Store tab and redeem it. After that it renews automatically at the regular price unless you cancel. The details of the pre-order month are covered in does GTA 6 have online multiplayer.
PC Gamer points out that subscribing through GTA 6 also gets you the GTA Online version of GTA+, which includes $500,000 in-game cash every month, exclusive cars and discounts there.

Both outlets treat it as a bonus rather than a must. GamesRadar+ calls the perks nice to have but not essential. PC Gamer is blunter: the game already has more than 500 vehicles, and by midgame nobody is sweating rideshare fares or haircut prices. Its take is that GTA+ only really adds up if you also want the GTA Online perks. If you don't, cancel before the free month runs out.

What do you get with GTA+ in GTA 6? An exclusive Annis Venturas Blvd Elegy, a single-car garage in Crosstown, free transit and rentals, cheaper RydeMe rides, 10% more on owned car sales and 10% off at participating stores.
How much is GTA+? $7.99, €7.99 or £6.99 a month on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It renews monthly and you can cancel any time.
Do you need GTA+ to play GTA 6? No. The perks are optional, and the story plays the same without a membership.
The Vice City sign in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games.

t: How to Pet Dogs and Cats in GTA 6
r: To pet a dog or cat in GTA 6, walk up to it, press L2 or LT and praise it. Once you've praised it, a Pet option shows up, on Triangle on PS5.

l: To pet a dog or cat in GTA 6, get close and press L2 (LT on Xbox). That brings up options to praise, scold and study the animal. Praise it, and a Pet option appears. GamesRadar+ laid out the steps, and icePlaysGTA showed the whole thing working on a Labrador on PS5.
Walk up to a dog or cat. Unlike people, animals don't show a button prompt before you engage them, which is why a lot of players miss this.
Press L2. Praise, Scold and Study pop up in the corner of the screen, with the animal type listed next to L2.
Press X to praise it.
Praise drops off the list and Pet takes its place on Triangle. Press it and your character crouches down to give the animal some love.
GamesRadar+ warns that it can take a few rounds of praise, and the pet option doesn't always show up. If it gets stuck, keep praising or try a different animal.
Option · PS5 button · What it does
Praise · X · The first step, and what unlocks petting
Pet · Triangle · Only appears after praising
Scold · Square · Tells the animal off
Study · R1 · Adds the animal to your collection

According to GamesRadar+, Study is the only way to add an animal to your collection. In icePlaysGTA's clip, the game simply labeled the animal "Dog" before the study. Afterward it showed the breed: Labrador Retriever.

You can study from a distance too. Dndo showed the binoculars method: aim at the animal, zoom in until you can see it clearly, then hold R1 (RB on Xbox) until the circle fills. That's how he logged a bird.

In the animals list in the menu, every entry tracks how many times you've praised, petted, fed and scolded it, how many you've killed and how often you've been attacked by one. Dndo showed those stats on screen.
Domestic animals only: dogs and cats. Wildlife won't let you.
There are different breeds out there, so it's worth studying every dog and cat you run into.
The one exception is a single alligator you can pet, at the yard sale just around the corner from Jason's house.
The Mini Mart cat: a cat that hangs out at the Key Lento Mini Mart in Chapter 1. GamesRadar+ calls it one of the cutest cats it has seen in a game.
Argula, Shirley's dog: Jason's neighbor Shirley has a dog. GamesRadar+ says petting it counts as a thoughtful action that can raise your focus bar, depending on your criminal profile.
The yard sale gator, near Jason's house.
Petting animals is one of the small things that feed your focus. The rest are in how to increase focus in GTA 6, and the wild animals you can hunt or catch are in GTA 6 fishing and hunting.

GamesRadar+ also slips in a tip for anyone trying to stay on Lucia's good side: stop at the Mini Mart and buy groceries before you pick her up from jail. You'll meet the store cat on the way. More on that in the Jason and Lucia relationship.
How do you pet a dog in GTA 6? Walk up to it, press L2 (LT on Xbox) and praise it. After the praise, a Pet option appears, mapped to Triangle on PS5.
Why can't I pet animals in GTA 6? The Pet option only shows up after you praise the animal, and sometimes not even then. It also only works on domestic animals like dogs and cats.
Can you pet an alligator in GTA 6? Just one: the gator at the yard sale around the corner from Jason's house. Wild alligators can't be petted.
Jason petting a Labrador after praising it.
Pressing L2 on a dog brings up the Praise, Scold and Study options.

t: Does GTA 6 Have First Person? (The Phone-While-Driving Trick)
r: GTA 6 has no first-person mode. Pulling out your phone while driving puts the camera inside the car, and a camera button trick keeps you in first person until you visit a repair shop.

l: No, GTA 6 doesn't have a first-person mode, and it isn't hiding anywhere in the menus. You can get close, though. The easy way: pull out your phone while you're driving and the camera switches to the driver's view on its own. StevieWunderKid, MrBossFTW and Bombastic all show it in their videos. GamesRadar+ also tested a second trick with the camera button that keeps you in first person until you visit a repair shop.

MrDalekJD says plenty of people have gone digging through the settings for a first-person option, and it just isn't there. The closest thing you'll find is the camera height setting. StevieWunderKid agrees there's no official first-person driving view and says he has no idea whether Rockstar will add one later. GamesRadar+ confirms there's no dedicated first-person mode, even though GTA 5 had one.
Other camera tweaks, like the three zoom distances, are covered in the best GTA 6 settings.
Get in a car and start driving.
Take out your phone.
The camera moves inside the car, at the driver's eye level.

You keep full control of the car, but your driving gets worse. MrBossFTW explains that the road goes out of focus and you can't see much, so your attention is split. Bombastic tried texting at speed, called it really dangerous and said this is the first person you get in the game. In that same stretch of his video he ended up crashing, and the car lost its engine and a wheel.
Save it for an empty straight or slow cruising, not a police chase.

p.h: The camera button trick: first person until the repair shop
l: GamesRadar+ walked through a way to stay in first person, including while driving with the road in focus. It started with a Reddit user and builds on the fact that the phone already flips the camera. Here's how:
Pause the game and open Settings.
Go to the Controller tab and scroll down to Touch Pad Button (PS5) or View Button (Xbox).
Set that button to Camera, then close the menu.
Get in a car and take out your phone with D-pad up.
Put the phone away with Circle (B on Xbox) and right away tap the touch pad (the View button on Xbox) several times.

The timing window is tight, so expect a few attempts. Once it works, the camera stays in first person pretty much all the time. According to GamesRadar+, driving works almost perfectly, and the right stick lets you look around the cabin and at your passenger. Gunplay is clumsier.

To switch back, drive to a repair shop. The short cutscene of the car rolling into the garage resets the camera, and you can leave right away. If you're done with the trick, change the button setting back to what it was.

p.h: What you can see from the driver’s seat
l: StevieWunderKid used the phone trick to show off the dashboard, and almost all of it works:
Speedometer and tachometer move, on both analog and digital clusters.
Gear display: the dash shows park, reverse, neutral and drive. Cars with a digital readout even show the gear number as you shift up and down.
Gearbox sounds: sitting still, you can hear the car clunk between drive and reverse. On the move the shifts make a mechanical noise too, but the engine and street sounds mostly cover it.
Temperature gauge: it climbs when the car sits still and drops slightly as you drive, much like GTA 5.
Fuel gauge: the needle falls in step with the fuel readout on your HUD. Fuel actually runs out now, so see how to refuel and repair your car.
Stevie also points out how detailed the interiors are, and from this view you can take in the whole cabin.

p.h: First person on foot and through a scope
l: This page originally said the only first-person view outside a car was through a scope. MrDalekJD says that with certain optic attachments, clicking both sticks together while aiming switches to a first-person sight. MrBossFTW shows a different input for scoped weapons: hold L2 (LT on Xbox) and click R3 (RS) to toggle the aiming view.

GamesRadar+ goes further. It says that same L2 + R3 input gives you a temporary first-person view in most situations, including walking around and talking to people, not just behind a scope. The one exception is driving. If one input doesn't work for you, try the other.
Outside of those cases, the game stays in third person. For more early-game basics, see the GTA 6 beginner tips.
Is there a first-person mode in GTA 6? No. There's no option for it in the settings. The closest thing is the camera height setting.

How do you drive in first person in GTA 6? Take out your phone while driving and the camera moves inside the car. For first-person driving with a clear view of the road, use the camera button trick explained on this page.

Can you aim in first person in GTA 6? Yes, through scopes. GamesRadar+ says holding L2 (LT) and clicking R3 (RS) also gives you a first-person view on foot and while talking to people, just not while driving.
How do you get back to third person in GTA 6? If you used the camera button trick, drive to a repair shop. The short cutscene of your car pulling in resets the camera, according to GamesRadar+.
Driving with the phone out: the camera switches to the driver's view, wheel and dashboard included.
The car interior from the inside, in the view you get by taking out your phone while driving.

t: GTA 6 Hair Growth and Weight System Explained
r: Hair and beards don't grow on their own in GTA 6. Weight does shift with food and exercise, but only a little. Here's how to change your look, how to gain weight and what the fitness app tracks.

l: Hair and beards don't grow over time in GTA 6. The GamesRadar+ review spells it out: unlike Arthur Morgan in Red Dead Redemption 2, Jason and Lucia keep the same look until you decide to change it. Their bodies do change, though. Food and exercise shift weight and muscle, just less dramatically than you might expect.

p.h: Hair and beards only change when you change them
l: Since nothing grows back by itself, you have two ways to adjust your look.

1. The bathroom mirror at home. Kotaku says you can shave your beard and your head there, but you can't choose a new style. MrBossFTW's footage backs that up: the mirror's Hairstyle menu offered a single option, Buzz Cut, and a separate Body Hair menu let him shave Jason's chest.

MrBossFTW sums it up this way: at the mirror, Jason can switch between a few cuts and his facial hair, and Lucia can change her makeup and hair. For a style that's different from your current one, you need a salon.

2. A salon. It's the only way to get long hair back. Kotaku jokes that only Vice City's barbers have the power to make hair regrow instantly. Like every store in the game, salons are open 24 hours a day. Our guide to mask, clothing, tattoo and barber shops shows where to find them.
The practical takeaway: think twice before you shave it all off. Going back costs you a salon visit.

p.h: Weight changes, but only a little
l: In its review, GamesRadar+ says eating and exercising affect how defined Jason's and Lucia's bodies look, and resting helps offset the wear and tear of a criminal lifestyle. But weight and health swings are milder than in Red Dead Redemption 2, and you're never at the mercy of the system.
To keep an eye on your progress, open the fitness app on your phone. GamingBolt points out that it shows your strength, cardio and focus, so you can see which one needs work.

p.h: Can you make Jason or Lucia fat?
l: Yes, but not very fat. Within hours of launch, players hit the maximum weight for both characters, and GamesRadar+ shared the results: neither looks as big as Arthur Morgan at his heaviest.
The player behind "True Fat Jason" posted the steps:
Eat at least four burgers or tacos from the fast food chains.
Go to sleep.
Eat more fast food.
Damage your car until the game prompts a repair. According to the player, the repair's loading screen gives the calories time to sink in.
Skip workouts with both characters.

This is a player's method passed along by GamesRadar+, not an official rule from Rockstar. The same player also showed an "Overweight Strong" Jason with plenty of both fat and muscle, built from heavy workouts plus a fast food diet.

Jason changes more than Lucia. Kotaku's roundup of early player discoveries notes the same ceiling and adds that Lucia's shape barely moves compared to Jason's. Jason can end up with a noticeable gut, while she stays close to her starting build. If you want to see the system at work, try it with Jason.

Going the other way means training. MrDalekJD explains that weights build strength and health, while the treadmill, running and the punching bag build stamina. Want an extra reason to hit the gym? Try the Gym Bro challenge for $1,000, and check the beginner tips for more early-game advice.
How long it takes for body changes to become clearly visible.
Whether muscle fades if you stop training. Nobody has shown that in the released game yet.
Whether weight affects running or fighting.
Does hair grow in GTA 6? No. Jason's and Lucia's hair and beards stay the same until you change them at the bathroom mirror or a salon.
How do you get long hair back in GTA 6? Only at a salon. The mirror at home can shave or trim, so if you buzz it off you'll have to pay for a new cut.

How do you gain weight in GTA 6? Eat a lot of fast food, sleep and skip workouts. That method comes from a player cited by GamesRadar+, and even at max weight the characters only get a little heavier.
Where can you check your fitness in GTA 6? Open the fitness app on your phone. It shows your strength, cardio and focus levels.
The bathroom mirror at home only offers shorter cuts: the Hairstyle menu lists just the Buzz Cut.

t: GTA 6 Kill or Spare Arnold: What Happens
r: In the Chapter 1 mission Hey Arnold!, sparing Arnold keeps your criminal profile cleaner, while killing him pushes it toward violent. The next cutscene barely changes. Here's how each choice works.

l: Spare Arnold. In the Chapter 1 mission Hey Arnold!, which GamesRadar+ calls the story's first major moral choice, letting him go is easier on your criminal profile, and killing him doesn't earn you anything. The scene that follows is almost identical either way. What really changes is your profile, plus a possible Arnold cameo later on.

p.h: How the mission gets you there
l: Hey Arnold! comes after Pipework in the mission list. Arnold is Brian's business partner and he's gone quiet. According to GamesRadar+, he's unhappy with how Brian runs the drug side of things.
Jason, Brian and Cal track Arnold down at a radar station near the Aerostat.
After a heated exchange, Arnold and his crew bolt in a pickup truck. A car chase with gunfire follows.
The chase ends at the Key Lento marina. Arnold ditches the truck and runs. Brian tells Jason to shut him up, however he sees fit.
Chase him on foot. Either you tackle him on the way, or he runs out of room at the end of the pier. Then he starts begging.

p.h: Every choice and what it does
l: Choice · How · Result
Spare · Hold L2 (LT) to interact, then press X (A) on Spare · Jason threatens Arnold and lets him go. Counts toward a more restrained profile
Kill on the pier · Shoot him while he's begging · A warning says indiscriminate violence leads to a violent profile
Kill during the chase · Shoot Arnold or his truck before the pier · Faster, but counts toward a ruthless profile
Do nothing · Wait on the pier · Arnold leaves. PC Gamer says this counts the same as sparing him

The guides don't agree on the labels. GamesRadar+ calls it a Restrained contribution for sparing and Ruthless for the chase kill. PC Gamer says killing him gives you a Hardened rating. None of those match the five tiers in the criminal profile exactly, so the simple read is this: sparing leans clean, killing leans violent.

Barely. GamesRadar+ says the cutscene after your choice is the same. Gamerpillar and Red Dead Family recorded both versions, and only one line is different. At Brian's party he asks if the job is handled:
If you killed him: Jason says it's taken care of.
If you spared him: Jason says Arnold will keep his mouth shut, and Brian likes hearing that.
According to GamesRadar+, when you spare him Arnold slips away and Brian never finds out he was let go.
At the same party Brian introduces Kenton, who opens up the diving jobs, as Syed Abbas Sheerazi's video shows. See sunken treasure and shipwrecks.

PC Gamer writes that sparing him leads to an appearance in a later mission. The wording is muddled: it says Brian shows up later if you let "him" live. Brian is in the story either way, so it most likely means Arnold. It doesn't say which mission or what changes there. No guide or video has shown that return yet, so the long-term payoff hasn't been shown so far. PC Gamer adds that there's no downside to sparing him and no bonus for killing him.
Still working through the chapter? The Chapter 1 walkthrough covers the other missions.
Should I kill or spare Arnold in GTA 6? Spare him. It hurts your criminal profile less, and PC Gamer says killing him gives you nothing extra.
How do you spare Arnold in GTA 6? Catch him on the pier at the Key Lento marina, hold L2 (LT on Xbox) to interact and press X (A on Xbox) on Spare.
What happens if you spare Arnold? Jason threatens him and lets him swim off. Your profile leans cleaner, and the story carries on the same way.
Does Arnold come back later? PC Gamer suggests so, in a later mission, but its wording is muddled and it doesn't say which one. Nobody has shown it yet.
Arnold cornered at the end of the pier, with the Spare prompt in the corner of the screen.

t: How to Store Weapons in Your Trunk and Recover Them at Ammu-Nation in GTA 6
r: GTA 6 limits how many guns you carry. The rest go in your Personal Vehicle's trunk, and the Ammu-Nation weapons locker stores and returns every gun you own. Here are the buttons.

l: In GTA 6 you keep spare guns in your Personal Vehicle's trunk and manage everything you own from the weapons locker at Ammu-Nation. You need both, because unlike older GTA games, this one caps how many weapons you can have on you. GamesRadar+, MrBossFTW, WiLLiSGaming and GameSpot all describe the same system.

Picking up a gun doesn't mean it's yours for the rest of the game. GameSpot says an equipped weapon can vanish when a mission moves the story on, when you sleep, or for other reasons. The fix is to stow it in your Personal Vehicle or check the weapons locker. GameSpot counts more than 100 weapons in the game.
According to GameSpot, guns come from a handful of places:
Ammu-Nation purchases. The safest route. Choosing buy and equip puts the gun straight into your loadout.
Bodies. Loot them from enemies you've killed or knocked out.
Cop cars and military armories.
Legendary weapons, marked with a gold gun icon, in compounds such as Kingfisher hideouts.
Story missions, some of which let you keep the gun afterwards.
Hold L1 (LB on Xbox) to open your loadout, on foot or in a vehicle. It has two tabs, Weapons and Items, and R1 (RB) flips between them.
The Weapons tab has these slots:
Slot · How many
Sidearms · 2
Hands · 1
Equipment · 1
Longarms · 2
Melee · 1
Explosives · 1
The Items tab has a single slot for each of these: Masks, Headgear, Headwear, Outfits, Bags, Gear, Eyewear and Smokes. To equip something, move the right stick over the slot and press X (A on Xbox).
Walk to the back of your Personal Vehicle and press Triangle (Y) to open the trunk.
When the prompt shows up, hold L1 (LB) to bring up the loadout.
Move the stick to a slot and cycle through what you have with left and right on the D-pad.
To stow a longarm, press Square (X on Xbox).
From here you can swap stored items and equip any sidearms or longarms you've left in the car.

Only your own car counts. Pop the trunk on any vehicle and you'll see a Stow Longarms option, but GameSpot warns that guns stashed in a car you don't own stay with that car, and you'll usually lose track of it. Use your Personal Vehicle, which is always nearby or a phone call away.

According to GameSpot's video, once you register a car in your name, all your weapons are stored in its trunk automatically. That's one of the perks of registering, along with summoning the car through an app and repairing it if it gets destroyed. Here's how registering works.
Open the Index, go to the weapons tab and find your nearest Ammu-Nation. Here's how the Index works.
Walk up to the green locker inside the store.
Hold L1 (LB) to manage your loadout, or press Triangle (Y) to manage your weapons.
Pick Manage Weapons. It lists every gun you own, along with any Unique Weapon Variants you've bought or found.

One GamesRadar+ guide says every Ammu-Nation has a locker. The other one is more precise: nearly all of them do, except the Pawn shop versions. GameSpot says there's a tall green locker in every Ammu-Nation in Leonida and doesn't mention the exception.
Garages work too. Per GameSpot, any garage you've bought that has a weapons locker does the same job. Prices are in our garage guide.

p.h: Getting back lost or destroyed guns
l: Dropped a gun mid-chase or had it destroyed? As long as you own it, Manage Weapons at the locker gets it back for you. That covers guns you bought and unique ones. Guns taken from enemies don't come back (see below).
GameSpot explains where a "missing" gun usually turns up:
In Manage Weapons, pick the class (pistols, SMGs, assault rifles and so on).
Hover over the weapon type, for example the Duke .556 assault rifle, and press Triangle (Y) to open its Variants tab.
That tab lists every version of that type you own. Found yours? Press X (A on Xbox) to put it in your loadout.
If it isn't in your trunk, your loadout or the locker, GameSpot says it's probably gone for good.
MrBossFTW breaks down how the game treats your guns:
Type · Where it comes from · What happens to it

Unowned · Taken from enemies or picked up off the ground · Usable while the ammo lasts, but it never becomes yours. Leave it behind and it's gone for good. Stash it in your Personal Vehicle's trunk if you want to keep it around
Owned · Bought at Ammu-Nation · Free to take back out from the weapon locker at certain Ammu-Nations or from your Personal Vehicle's trunk
Unique (yellow) · Found around the map or at Ammu-Nation · Unlocked for good the moment you pick it up
WiLLiSGaming backs up the unique part: these guns survive death, and you can pull them from your car or swap your loadout at a gun store. Here's where to find them: GTA 6 unique weapons.
Watch out at the locker: according to MrBossFTW, you can't use the Ammu-Nation weapon locker while you're carrying unowned weapons. Drop them before you build a new loadout.

p.h: Choosing what rides in the trunk
l: At the locker, press Square (X) on each weapon category to add it to or remove it from your Personal Vehicle's trunk. Clear out guns you never use, so the ones you want are quicker to reach when the cops or a gang are on your tail.

When a weapon has a Unique Weapon Variant available, a gold gun icon shows in the bottom left corner. Press Triangle (Y) to open a sub-menu where you can equip the variant, or your own customized version if you already own the base gun.
The locker also lets you equip sidearms, longarms, explosives, melee weapons and other items on the spot. Just be aware that the staff may not appreciate you waving a rifle around their shop.
To stock the trunk without spending money, see free guns from cop cars and the GTA 6 weapons list.
How many weapons can you carry in GTA 6? Two sidearms and two longarms, plus one melee slot and one explosives slot. Everything else waits in your trunk or at Ammu-Nation.

How do you get a lost weapon back in GTA 6? Go to the green locker in an Ammu-Nation, press Triangle (Y on Xbox) and pick Manage Weapons. Every gun you own is listed there. If you can't see it, hover over the weapon type and press Triangle (Y) to open its Variants tab.
How do you put a longarm in your trunk in GTA 6? Open your Personal Vehicle's trunk with Triangle (Y), hold L1 (LB) for the loadout and press Square (X on Xbox) to stow the longarm.

Do you keep guns you take from enemies in GTA 6? Not for good. They never become yours: you can use them while the ammo lasts and stash them in your trunk, but leave one behind and it's gone. Only bought and unique guns come back from the Ammu-Nation locker.
The game's own tip: most Ammu-Nations have a weapon locker, and you can move weapons to your Personal Vehicle's trunk.

t: GTA 6 Fishing and Hunting: How to Do It and Where to Sell
r: In GTA 6, fishing starts on the dock behind Jason's house and boosts your focus. Hunting is the one that pays: Bret in Lummox County buys animals straight out of your trunk. Here's how both work.

l: You can fish and hunt in GTA 6. Fishing starts with the rods on the dock behind Jason's house and it's one of the best ways to raise your focus. Hunting is where the money is: you sell your kills to Bret in Lummox County, who buys them straight out of your trunk.
At home: Arekkz points out there are fishing rods at the back of Jason's house, so you don't have to travel anywhere.
From a boat: KhrazeGaming fishes off the side of a boat out at sea.
More spots: GamesRadar+ says the Activities tab of the map index lists every fishing and hunting spot you've discovered.

p.h: How to fish, step by step
l: Grab a rod and walk to the edge of the water.
Press L3 + R3 (focus) to highlight the fish, so you know where to cast. Arekkz uses this every time.
Cast your line toward the fish. DPJ holds L2 first, then holds R2 to cast (LT and RT on Xbox). The longer you hold R2, the farther the bait flies.
Reel in slowly to lure a fish toward the bait. The button for this depends on your reel mode, covered below.
The moment you feel a nibble, press R2 to hook it. DPJ says the cue is the controller rumbling.
Don't reel yet. Let the fish thrash until it wears itself out. If it pulls one way, pull your rod the opposite way.
Once it calms down, reel in as fast as you can. If it starts fighting again, repeat step 6.
Near the boat, your character lifts the fish out of the water and you choose whether to keep it or throw it back, per DPJ.

Steps 4 to 7 are KhrazeGaming's method, which he compares to the fishing in Monster Hunter. His footage shows the on-screen prompts: Hook Fish (R2), Lure Fish, Reset Cast and Grip (L2). In DPJ's video the same Grip prompt shows up on LT, the Xbox left trigger.
There's a setting just for how you reel in. DPJ found it under Pause > Settings > Gameplay > Fishing, at the bottom of the list. You get 3 options:
Rotate the right stick.
Button: hold or tap Square (X on Xbox).
Pull the right stick.
DPJ recommends option 2. He doesn't say which one is selected by default.

That's why guides disagree on how to lure a fish. Some creators hold L2 and gently move the right stick, which matches one of the stick modes, while DPJ is on the button mode and taps Square instead. If the stick does nothing in your game, check this setting.
DPJ breaks down what to watch once a fish is on the line:
Bubbles on the water and the line pulling: the fish is fighting. Tilt the left stick away from the direction it's pulling. If it's swimming away from you, pull the stick down.
Bubbles gone: that's your window to reel in, using whatever input your reel mode uses. Stop when the bubbles come back and go back to steering with the left stick.
Keep going until the fish is next to the boat. Then you get the keep or release choice from step 8.

Focus: Arekkz says each fish gives a 5% focus bonus, far more than the 1% per basket from basketball. BennyCentral calls fishing the most effective way to train focus, and GamingBolt lists it among the activities that permanently raise it.
Baited My Tackle trophy: beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
Fisheye cheat: unlocked by catching 100 fish. Cheats only work after you finish the main story.
What about selling fish? No source has shown fish being sold so far.
You can hunt any animal you find, or take requests from Bret, Jason's old military buddy. According to PC Gamer:
Bret's hunting missions open up in Chapter 2, in Lummox County, and they're Jason only.
He asks for tougher and tougher animals and pays more each time.
There are legendary animals, and they're worth more.
A single kill pays anywhere from hundreds to thousands of dollars.
For gear, the index sorts Ammu-Nation stores by speciality, and one of them is Hunting, per GamesRadar+. Hunting a unique animal for Bret unlocks the Fair Game trophy.
Your buyer is Bret:
Small animals: park outside his building and walk in. He automatically buys whatever is in your trunk.
Big animals: PC Gamer's writer spotted a large boar in the woods and shot it with the rifle from his truck. Bret paid $2,500 and came to collect the carcass himself.

So haul your kills in your personal vehicle. GamesRadar+ confirms its trunk stores the spoils from hunting trips. Nobody has published a full price list per animal yet. For other ways to earn, see how to make money in GTA 6.

How do you fish in GTA 6? Grab a rod from the dock behind Jason's house, use focus (L3 + R3) to spot fish, cast, slowly reel to lure one in and press R2 to hook it. Let it tire out before you reel it in.
Can you hunt in GTA 6? Yes. You can hunt any animal you come across, or take hunting jobs from Bret, Jason's old military buddy, starting in Chapter 2.
Where do you sell animals in GTA 6? To Bret in Lummox County. Park outside his building and walk in, and he buys whatever is in your trunk. He picks up big kills himself.
Can you sell fish in GTA 6? No source has shown fish being sold so far. For now, fishing pays off in focus and in your fish collection.
Fishing off a boat, with the Hook Fish (R2), Lure Fish, Reset Cast and Grip (L2) prompts in the corner.

t: Where to Find Helicopters and Planes in GTA 6 Without the Cops
r: Airfields and helipads marked on the GTA 6 map almost always have a free plane or helicopter, and nobody calls the cops. Here are the spots you can read on the map in the video.

l: The easiest way to grab a helicopter or plane in GTA 6 without the cops is to go to an airfield or helipad marked on the map. LunarGaming says these spots have a free aircraft waiting 99% of the time, and taking it doesn't alert the police or any gang.

His video covers about 16 spots, starting in Mariana County. He only talks during the intro, then shows each one on the in-game map. Not every location has a readable name on that map, so the list below sticks to the ones we could read for sure.
In the order they appear in the video:
Where (from the map in the video) · Type · What was there
Southwind, next to Mile Zero Air Station · Helipad on a pier · Helicopter
Near T.H. Power Station · Helipad · Green helicopter
On Boundary Rd · Airfield · Blue biplane
East of Port Gellhorn · Grass airfield · McKittrick Farm crop duster
Northern Lummox County · Helipad · Helicopter
Leonard County · Airfield · Lapwing Mammatus, parked on a paved path between houses
Between Lake Leonida and Waning Sands · Airfield with a hangar · Plane inside the hangar
North tip of Vice Beach · Helipad · Helicopters, including a Nagasaki Sea Sparrow
The map in the video also marks a spot near MacAlister Gold Mine, but you can't tell which aircraft sits there.
A few more spots show up without a readable name on the map:
an airstrip on an island with a beach, home to a black and orange stunt plane with Black Dragon painted on the wings;
a seaplane base with a hangar and a dock;
a helipad with a Bottcher Buzzard. Climbing in made the game show a Military Vehicles 1/8 counter.
The military base, the lifeguard stations and the international airport all have aircraft, but LunarGaming says they'll get you a Wanted Level.
ZoneX adds that the yellow zones that appear on the map as you get close are restricted areas, like the base and the airport, and the stars come almost instantly.
If you really want a jet, check how to steal a plane at the airport and how to get into the military base.

LunarGaming leaves the city out of his list. According to him, most tall buildings and big hotels in Vice City have a helipad on the roof, and they're already marked on the map. He also mentions seaplanes and helicopters scattered along the coast, around Lake Leonida and in Grassrivers.
It's at the spot east of Port Gellhorn. The plane has the McKittrick Farm logo on the tail and a spray bar under the wing.
When you walk up, a man asks if you're there for the "dusting job". The video doesn't show that job.

ZoneX also suggests grabbing a crop duster from an airstrip for early flights. Flying clears the map fog much faster than driving, and a jet taken from the base gets chased down and shot at. He doesn't name the airstrip.
In the vehicle menu shown in the video, the Lapwing 300-H is described as a light plane built for dusting crops that also handles aerial stunts.

Southwind, the first stop on the list, is close to Jason's house. The route there, plus what's in the hangar and on the dock, is in first plane and helicopter. To get your bearings on the counties mentioned here, see the GTA 6 map guide.

Where can you get a helicopter without the cops in GTA 6? At any helipad marked on the map, like the pier in Southwind or the north tip of Vice Beach. LunarGaming says they almost always have a helicopter and nobody calls the police.
Where is the crop duster in GTA 6? On a grass airfield east of Port Gellhorn, with the McKittrick Farm logo on the plane. Someone there asks if you're there for a dusting job.
Does stealing a plane at the airport give you a wanted level in GTA 6? Yes. LunarGaming says the international airport, the military base and the lifeguard stations all get you wanted.
Is it worth flying early in GTA 6? For exploring, yes. ZoneX says flying clears the fog off the map much faster than driving.
The crop duster with the McKittrick Farm logo, at the spot east of Port Gellhorn.
A free green helicopter sitting on one of the helipads marked on the map.

t: GTA 6 Retail Therapy Trophy: How to Unlock It
r: To unlock Retail Therapy, rob 3 shops back to back with Jason and Lucia together while you're still wanted. It can't be done before Chapter 2.

l: To unlock the Retail Therapy trophy in GTA 6, rob 3 shops back to back with Jason and Lucia together, and don't let the Wanted Level drop between robberies. It's a bronze trophy worth 20G on Xbox, according to the GamesRadar+ trophy list.

Not before Chapter 2. PowerPyx's video has an on-screen note saying that's the chapter where you unlock playing as Jason and Lucia together. Since the trophy needs your partner with you, there's no point trying earlier.
Three different stores. You can't hit the same store twice in a row. Mr Lawrence says it shows as closed or unavailable for a while, with a small red heat area drawn around it.
Each robbery gives you 1 or 2 stars, he adds. The trophy description asks you to hold on to that Wanted Level until the third store is done.
It's good for the relationship too. Mr Lawrence says robbing as a couple raises Jason and Lucia's relationship.

p.h: PowerPyx’s route: 3 jewelry stores in a row
l: There's no voiceover in PowerPyx's video, only game audio, so everything here comes from text on the screen. He picked three jewelry stores near each other, and the map card is nearly identical for all of them:
Order · Store · Map card
1 · Covgari · Small high-end jewelry store, medium security, $14,000 to $25,000
2 · Blanc & Giroux · Small high-end jewelry store on NE 19th St, medium security, $14,000 to $25,000
3 · Roval Jewelry · Large high-end jewelry store, medium security, $14,000 to $25,000
Between the second and third stores, the game shows the neighborhood name: Decor District.
What shows up on screen during the run:
On the sidewalk with Lucia next to you, you get Talk and Hold Hands prompts. That's how you know your partner is with you.
Inside, the Jewelry prompt grabs pieces from the display cases one at a time.
Right after the first robbery, a Crime reported message pops up.
The back door gives you Use Snap Gun or Break Open, and the safe in the back room offers Plant Explosive.
The stars keep climbing from store to store. By the third one, the video shows 4 stars and police at the door.
With no commentary, the video never says why he went for jewelry stores over convenience stores.

p.h: Another option: the stores in the Keys
l: Musty Sky shows a cluster of stores near Jason's house in the Keys. His video is about making money, not this trophy:
a gas station with 2 stores;
2 more down the road on the left. The clerk at one of them tends to carry a shotgun.

He says not to shoot anyone, since fewer stars make it easier to keep robbing. The catch: in his video the star disappears as he drives down the road. For the trophy, that can't happen before the third store. None of the videos we watched tried this route for Retail Therapy.
For masks, safes and how much each store pays, see how to rob stores in GTA 6. After the third store you're still wanted, so check how to lose the police for the getaway.
What do you need to do for Retail Therapy in GTA 6? Rob 3 shops back to back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. It's a bronze trophy worth 20G on Xbox.
When can you get Retail Therapy? From Chapter 2 on. PowerPyx's video points out on screen that this is when you can play Jason and Lucia together.
Can you rob the same store twice in a row in GTA 6? No. Mr Lawrence says a store you just hit shows as closed for a while, so you need 3 different ones.
Which stores did PowerPyx rob for the trophy? Three jewelry stores close together: Covgari, Blanc & Giroux and Roval Jewelry. On the way between them, the game names the area as the Decor District.
Covgari on the map, the first jewelry store on PowerPyx's route: medium security and a $14,000 to $25,000 take.
Jason and Lucia on the sidewalk together, heading to the first store of the run.

t: Can You Replay Missions in GTA 6?
r: No. GTA 6 won't let you replay a mission once it's done. The only way back is to load a manual save from before it, though you can restart a mission while you're still in it.

l: No, GTA 6 has no mission replay. Once you finish a mission, there's no menu that lets you pick it and play it again. ZoneX notes that this is a change from GTA 5, and GamesRadar+ confirms there's no way to replay missions. Your only route back is loading a manual save you made before it.

If you saved before a mission, loading that save lets you play it again. The catch is that you're sent back to that point in the story and lose everything you did afterward. That's why ZoneX says to save before every mission and before every big story choice.
Here's how to save, per GamesRadar+:
Open the main menu with Start (Options on PS5).
Go to Game.
Pick a save slot.
Select Save Game.
Loading works from the same menu. The full walkthrough is in how to save in GTA 6.

You can't save during a mission. GamesRadar+ explains that you can still restart the mission from the menu (Start), either from the beginning or from the last checkpoint. That's handy for retrying a section that went wrong before you wrap it up. After the mission ends, it's locked in.
You get 15 manual save slots, and GamesRadar+ puts the mission count at close to 100. You can't keep a save in front of every single one, so you have to plan:
Chapter saves: GamesRadar+ suggests keeping one save at the start and one at the end of each major chapter. That way you can jump back to any part of the story.
Mission and choice saves: this is ZoneX's tip. Use your leftover slots for it and keep overwriting the oldest ones.

The 16th slot is reserved for autosaves. It kicks in after missions, when you die or get busted, and after some big open-world encounters. Because it's a single slot the game overwrites by itself, it can't hold on to an older point in the story. More in GTA 6 autosave explained.

Vice City Dispatch, in a video that pulls together points from several reviews, notes that a lot of GTA 6's biggest paydays come from story missions, heists included. Since finished missions can't be replayed, you can't run one again to collect the reward twice. Each of those payouts lands exactly once.
For money you can earn over and over, see how to make money in GTA 6. To see how many missions are left, check the GTA 6 mission list.
Can you replay missions in GTA 6? No. Once a mission is finished it's gone. The only way to play it again is to load a manual save from before it.
How do you restart a mission in GTA 6? While you're in the mission, open the menu with Start and restart from the beginning or from the last checkpoint.
How many save slots does GTA 6 have? There are 15 manual save slots, plus a 16th slot used only for autosaves.
Can you farm mission payouts in GTA 6? No. Since finished missions can't be replayed, each mission only pays out once.
The GTA 6 main menu. Your save slots live under the Game option.
Driving through the open world in the video where ZoneX points out there's no mission replay.

t: How to Rob Stores in GTA 6 Without Getting Caught: Step by Step and Payouts
r: To rob a store in GTA 6 without getting caught, park out of sight, clear out witnesses, hide your face and change outfits after. Early on, a register pays around $1,000.

l: To rob a store in GTA 6 without getting caught, hide your car, get rid of witnesses, cover your face and change clothes as soon as you're done. That way the cops end up with no usable description and you can move on to the next store. KhrazeGaming, Arekkz Gaming, KultZ, GamingBolt, JoblessGarrett, Mr Lawrence and TheSpazo all walked through their methods on video. According to Mr Lawrence, not every store shows up on the map, but you can rob almost any store you can walk into.

Cover your face. A cap and sunglasses already help, as KhrazeGaming showed. Mr Lawrence says a mask, hat or glasses keeps the store's CCTV from recognizing you. Arekkz Gaming suggests a bandana, which you can buy at the gun shop. Early in the game, JoblessGarrett looked for a mask to buy and couldn't find one.

Hide your car. Park behind the building or in a quiet spot nearby. KhrazeGaming says this keeps the vehicle from being tied to the robbery. Mr Lawrence likes to have a fast car or a bike ready for the getaway.
Keep a spare outfit in the trunk. Put an outfit together at a wardrobe, like the one at your safehouse, and store it in your car. KultZ and GamingBolt give the same advice.
Go at night. KultZ found it the best time: fewer people on the street, and the shop is often empty. TheSpazo noticed the same thing, with fewer cops around at night and an easier time losing them.
Solo or as a couple. You can rob a store as Jason, as Lucia or with both of them together. Mr Lawrence says robbing as a couple helps grow their relationship.
Start with a clothing store. Arekkz Gaming picks these first because you can grab a spare outfit while you're inside. TheSpazo prefers clothing stores too; see the payouts at the bottom of the page.
Anyone hanging around will call the police the moment things go wrong. There are two ways to empty the place without firing a shot:

Provoke them: walk up to a customer and choose the Provoke option. It annoys them and they usually walk out (Arekkz Gaming). JoblessGarrett did this in a Key Lento liquor store and the customers left.
Carry a long gun: take your long guns out of the trunk. You can't fit two of them on your back, so one stays in your hands. People get nervous and leave, except for the clerk (KhrazeGaming).

Be careful with the second one. GamingBolt warns that walking around with machine guns or shotguns out in the open makes people react and can even get someone to call the cops. KhrazeGaming stows his extra weapons back in the trunk before going in, so they don't end up in his description. If you want to stay low-key, GamingBolt suggests a pistol.
Walk in with your face covered and your robbery outfit on.
Aim at the clerk. The Threaten prompt shows up on screen. According to KhrazeGaming, most clerks go along with it and hand over the register cash.

Or do it the Arekkz Gaming way: knock the clerk out with a couple of punches and take whatever is in the register and around the shop. To open the register yourself, Mr Lawrence presses Triangle (Y on Xbox).
Take every last dollar. JoblessGarrett found only $300 at first, almost left, and then turned up more cash inside the store.
Wipe the camera footage. JoblessGarrett destroyed it inside the shop. GamingBolt points out you can do this at the scene, but the alarm will go off eventually.

Vice City Dispatch, which rounds up what the reviews say, puts it in the best order: kill the alarm and the cameras before the robbery and nobody calls it in. If a camera already caught you, wipe the tapes in the security room and the police are left without a description.

Some stores have a safe. Arekkz Gaming says certain clerks will tell you there's one and hand over the combination if you threaten them with a gun.
