In the staff area, press L3+R3 to turn on Focus mode, which highlights things you can interact with, safes included. For more on finding the combination, see the safe codes guide.

No code? You can use explosives. Mr Lawrence warns that the blast damages some of the cash inside, while hunting for the code gives the police more time to show up. Vice City Dispatch says the same: blowing the safe gets you out faster, but with less money.
Expect 1 or 2 stars. That's the wanted level a store robbery gives you, according to Mr Lawrence. He adds that the police will usually know your location, your car and the outfit you're wearing.
Get out fast. With no witnesses nearby, it takes the clerk a while to call the police (KhrazeGaming).
Your car stays clean. When the cops showed up after KhrazeGaming's robbery, they only had his face and clothes. The car parked behind the store wasn't part of the description.
Change your look. Head back to the trunk, put on a different outfit and take off the cap and sunglasses. The recognition markers go away and you don't even have to leave the area (KhrazeGaming).
Swap cars or respray. If the cops saw your car, switch vehicles or hit a Pay 'n' Spray. Mr Lawrence points out that a respray costs $200, which can eat most of what one store pays.
Leave the red zone. Once the stars are gone, a red heat zone stays on the map. Get out of it to lose the police for good (Mr Lawrence).

Bring a partner: GamingBolt recommends robbing as a pair, both masked. One keeps the crowd under control and warns you when the cops are close. If you're carrying several bags, hand one to the other character, who can also pull the police away. Split up when you run.
To shake the cops for good, read how to lose the police. Anything that isn't pocket cash has to go through a fence: see fence locations.

p.h: Can you rob the same store again?
l: Not right away. Mr Lawrence says a store you just hit shows up as closed or unavailable for a while. A small red heat area is also marked around it, and if you rob it again while that area is active, the cops get there faster. TheSpazo makes the same point about clothing stores: once you've robbed one, you can't go back to it any time soon, so you have to work through several.
Channel · What they got
KhrazeGaming · Around $1,000 or a bit more per register early in the game
KultZ · Close to $600 from one store; over $2,000 across several on a good night
JoblessGarrett · $300 at first, plus more after searching the store
Mr Lawrence · A couple hundred dollars in most registers
TheSpazo · $600 to $900 from some clothing stores; about $3,100 after a string of stores, mostly in Vice City

The sources disagree here. TheSpazo calls clothing stores the best early target: some paid $600 to $900 each, and a string of stores, mostly in Vice City, got him to about $3,100. Vice City Dispatch, quoting Forbes, says the cash from a clothing store probably isn't worth it. Payouts change from store to store, so try a few. The only place TheSpazo tells you to skip is the tattoo shop, which he calls a waste of time.
For a robbery with hidden cash, check out the parrot money at the Three Sheets liquor store.

How much money do you get from robbing a store in GTA 6? It varies a lot. KhrazeGaming got around $1,000 from a register early on, while Mr Lawrence says most registers only hold a couple hundred. TheSpazo pulled $600 to $900 from some clothing stores.
How do you get customers to leave a store in GTA 6? Talk to them and pick the Provoke option, or walk near them with a long gun in your hands. Either way, they usually leave.

How do you avoid being recognized after a store robbery in GTA 6? Go in with a cap and sunglasses or a bandana, then change into a spare outfit from your trunk right after. Leave your car out of sight behind the store.
Do stores have safes in GTA 6? Some do. The clerk may give up the combination if you threaten them with a gun, and Focus mode (L3+R3) highlights the safe in the back.
Jason holds up the clerk at a beach shop, with the Threaten prompt on screen.

t: How to Save in GTA 6: Manual Saves, 15 Slots and Why Saving Gets Disabled
r: In GTA 6 you save from the main menu: pick Game, then Save Game. There are 15 manual save slots. Using a cheat disables saving until you quit the game.

l: GTA 6 has manual saving, so you choose when to create a checkpoint. The quickest way is the main menu: choose Game and then Save Game. There are 15 manual save slots, according to PC Gamer and ZoneX.
Open the main menu.
Select Game.
Choose Save Game and pick one of the 15 slots.
You load an older save from the same menu.
PC Gamer suggests keeping a save at the start of each chapter. With 15 slots you have room to go back to any point in the story and try a mission a different way.

Unlike GTA 5, GTA 6 won't let you replay a mission once it's done. According to ZoneX, the only way back in is to load a manual save from before it, so he saves before every mission and before any big story choice. Vice City Dispatch, which pieces its videos together from reviews, makes the same point: finished missions don't come back, so you can't earn their payout twice.
That's separate from restarting the mission you're currently playing, which you can still do from the menu (see below).
Saving often also protects your money: the cash on you is lost if you die, so stash it and save.
There's no quit option in the game. GamesRadar+ says you have to go back to the PS5 or Xbox home screen and close the app from there. Save first, or you'll load back in from the last autosave.

On top of the 15 manual slots there's a 16th slot reserved for the autosave. It saves after missions, when you get wasted or busted, and after some big open world moments. It happens less often than you'd think: see GTA 6 autosave explained.
You can't save from the menu during a mission. From the Start menu you can restart the mission from the beginning or from the last checkpoint.

After using a cheat, saving is disabled until you quit the game. To save again, quit without saving and load back in. That's why it's worth saving before you try any cheat. Since cheats only unlock after the story, you don't need to worry about it early on.
See also the GTA 6 beginner tips.
How do you quit GTA 6? There is no quit option in the game. Save, go back to the PS5 or Xbox home screen and close the game from there.
How do you save in GTA 6? Open the main menu, choose Game, then Save Game, and pick one of the 15 slots.
How many save slots does GTA 6 have? 15 manual save slots, according to PC Gamer and ZoneX, plus a separate slot for the autosave.
Why can't I save in GTA 6? If you used a cheat, saving is disabled until you quit the game. Quit without saving and load back in.
The Rusty Anchor bar in the Keys, in an official GTA 6 image.

t: How to Get a 6 Star Wanted Level in GTA 6
r: Six stars is the top wanted level in GTA 6. PC Gamer and MrDalekJD both got there with a tank stolen from the military base. Once you're there, there's no escape: the police never stop.

l: To get a 6 star wanted level in GTA 6, PC Gamer says you have to cause mass destruction and a huge body count. The only method it found was stealing a tank from the military base and blowing up other tanks and vehicles with it. MrDalekJD also hit six stars with a tank from the base, and says the base's fighter jet can get you there too.
Six stars is as notorious as you can get under the new wanted system. Getting there means killing a lot of cops and soldiers, and that comes with a price.

p.h: How the top star levels work
l: Some things haven't changed from earlier games:
Breaking into the airport and stealing a passenger jet gets you into the highest star levels. Here's how to steal a plane from the airport.
Hijacking an APC at the military base does the same. The way in is covered in the military base guide.
At 5 stars, the police send a tank after you.
The sixth star sits above all of that. According to PC Gamer, only mass destruction and loss of life will unlock it.
Head to the military base.
Steal a tank.
Use it to destroy other tanks and vehicles until the sixth star lights up.
The article doesn't say how many vehicles you need to wreck or how long it takes. PC Gamer also frames this as the only way it managed to do it, which isn't the same as the only way that exists.
MrDalekJD reached six stars on video, inside the military base. The route in is covered in the military base guide.
With the tank:
The moment he climbed into a tank inside the base, he got 5 stars instantly.
Fighting the base security from the tank, he hit 6 stars shortly after. Military helicopters joined the chase too.
The tank has a tracker. Even if you drive it out of the base, the police know where it is.
With the fighter jet:
Taking off in one of the base's jets also gives you 5 stars instantly. He says it can go up to 6, but in his video it stayed at 5.
The jet starts with no weapon selected. Hold L1 (LB on Xbox) to open the weapon wheel and pick missiles or the machine gun.
The base sends other jets after you. The game's hint is to fly low to get away.

Both sources agree on the main point: a tank from the base can take you to six stars, and from there the police won't back off. The difference is the effort. PC Gamer had to destroy other tanks and vehicles. In MrDalekJD's video, the sixth star showed up while he was still fighting the base security.

There's no coming back from 6 stars. At this level your heat and wanted level no longer go down, and the law keeps hunting you. MrDalekJD saw the same thing: at six stars, the police don't stop until they take you down.
Dying is the only real exit. That's PC Gamer's takeaway, since hiding doesn't work.
Your criminal profile takes the hit. Killing that many cops and soldiers can drag your criminal profile way down. It works a lot like the honor system in Red Dead Redemption 2.
If you just want to shake off an ordinary chase, see how to lose the police.

How do you get 6 stars in GTA 6? Steal a tank from the military base and cause chaos. PC Gamer got there by blowing up other tanks and vehicles; MrDalekJD got there while fighting the base security from inside the tank.
Can you escape a 6 star wanted level in GTA 6? No. At six stars your heat and wanted level stop dropping, and the police never give up. Dying is effectively the only way out.
How many stars until a tank shows up in GTA 6? Five. Just like in older GTA games, hitting 5 stars gets a tank sent after you.

How many stars do you get for stealing a fighter jet in GTA 6? Five right away, according to MrDalekJD, and it can climb to six. The jet has no weapon selected at first: hold L1 (LB on Xbox) to pick missiles or the machine gun.
A tank rampaging through the military base, with six wanted stars at the top of the screen.

t: GTA 6 Slim Jim and Snap Gun: What They Do and Which Mission Unlocks Them
r: The slim jim opens locked cars without smashing glass and comes from Moses in the Chapter 2 mission Moses. The snap gun opens locked doors quietly and comes from Yasmani in Chapter 3.

l: The slim jim pops open a locked car without breaking the glass, and you get it in Chapter 2, during the mission Moses. The snap gun picks locked doors quietly, and you get it in Chapter 3, after the mission Dubious Provenance. Both are tied to story progress, so neither will help you in the opening missions.
Tool · What it does · Who gives it to you · When
Slim jim · Unlocks cars with no smashed glass and no alarm · Moses · Chapter 2, mission Moses
Snap gun · Opens locked doors quietly · Yasmani · Chapter 3, after Dubious Provenance
Moses gives you the slim jim in the Chapter 2 mission named after him, Moses. It comes right after Girls' Trip, the mission where Lucia goes shopping and makes a new friend.
GameSpot shows the same thing on video: in Chapter 2 you meet Moses, and once the introductions are done he gives you the slim jim and shows you how it works.

According to GameSpot, in Chapter 1 the only way into a locked car is to smash the window and hotwire it. Smashing the window sets off the alarm, so hotwire quickly and get away. The alarm shuts off after a while, but until then the people around will be suspicious.
Walk up to a car door.
Pick slim jim to start a short sequence.
Work the analog stick to find the sweet spot and hold it for a second. The door pops open.

p.h: What it can and can’t do
l: It gets you into older cars without the alarm. GameSpot says it's the only way to break into an older parked car without setting the alarm off. With it, you can quietly get into any car that doesn't need the key cloner.
It opens the trunk without an alarm. Worth a look, since trunks can hold weapons, drugs or cash.

It won't start a keyless car. Some cars only need unlocking before you hotwire them, but keyless models need the key cloner. GameSpot says the cloner arrives in Chapter 3 through Randy, and cars you open with it don't need hotwiring at all.
Yasmani gives you the snap gun in Chapter 3, once you've finished the jewelry store job in the mission Dubious Provenance.
Equip it and walk up to a locked door.
Pick the Use snap gun option.
Use the left stick to find the lock's sweet spot.
Squeeze the right trigger (R2 on PS5, RT on Xbox) until the meter fills. You're in.
The snap gun gets you through the door without setting off the alarm, but the alarm is still armed. It can still go off if you kick in another door, smash a display case, or a store worker trips it.
PC Gamer's tip: use the snap gun on the back door. That route takes you to the office, where you can switch the alarm off completely.

For hotwiring, the key cloner and trackers, see how to steal cars in GTA 6. Moses buys stolen cars and Yasmani buys stolen goods; check the fence locations. And for robberies with a safe, there's the safe codes guide.
When do you get the slim jim in GTA 6? In the Chapter 2 mission Moses, right after Girls' Trip. Moses hands it over himself.
How do you get the snap gun in GTA 6? Yasmani gives it to you in Chapter 3, after you pull off the jewelry store job in the mission Dubious Provenance.
Can the slim jim start a keyless car in GTA 6? No. It only unlocks the door. Keyless cars need the key cloner.
Does the snap gun turn off a store's alarm? No. It gets you through the door without tripping the alarm, but the alarm stays armed. Go in the back and reach the office to shut it off for good.
Next to a locked car, the game offers the slim jim (Triangle) or smashing the window (Circle).

t: How Long to Beat GTA 6: Story and 100%
r: GTA 6's story takes about 45 to 90 hours to beat, depending on how much you explore. Add every optional mission and it's 80 to 100 hours. Doing everything takes 200-plus.

l: Beating GTA 6's story takes roughly 45 to 90 hours, depending on how often you wander off. If you clear every optional mission as well, plan on 80 to 100 hours. Finding every collectible and finishing every activity pushes it past 200 hours. Those numbers come from critics who finished the game for review and from the GamesRadar+ estimate.
Who · Hours · What they did
Jeff Gerstmann (cited by Kotaku) · About 45, maybe 50 counting reloads · Beat the story
Kotaku · About 90 to the credits · Story plus plenty of side content. Now past 150 hours and still finding new things
PC Gamer · About 100 · Finished the main story
GamesRadar+ · Over 100 · Story, every optional mission and a good chunk of the activities
IGN (cited by PC Gamer) · 120 · Beat the game with big parts of the map still unvisited
Kotaku reckons a faster player could wrap up the story in around 60 hours, and doesn't think you can realistically finish it much quicker than Gerstmann's 45 to 50.
Playstyle · Hours
Main story only · 60 to 80
Every main and optional mission · 80 to 100
Every collectible and activity · 200+

p.h: Why the range is so wide
l: The map is huge, and it's packed with distractions. The GamesRadar+ reviewer didn't reach Lummox County until the 80-hour mark. PC Gamer admits to losing hours just picking a point on the horizon and getting sidetracked on the way there.
In practice, sticking to the story keeps you near the 45 to 60 hour range. Stop for every store, robbery and side activity and you'll sail past 90.
According to PC Gamer's list, the story has 91 missions across 5 chapters. Every name is in our GTA 6 mission list.

For a sense of pacing, MrDalekJD says Chapter 1 wraps up, with the mission where you finally play as Lucia, around 6 to 10 hours in, depending on how much you explore. The Chapter 1 walkthrough covers it step by step.
Kotaku points out that GTA 5 takes 32 hours to rush through the story, per HowLongToBeat, and over 50 with side content. Going by the numbers above, GTA 6 asks for a lot more of your time.
Finishing the story doesn't end the game. You can keep playing after the ending, and anyone chasing the platinum should check the trophy and achievement list.
How many hours is GTA 6's story? Between 45 and 90 hours, based on reviewers who finished it. GamesRadar+ puts the main story at 60 to 80 hours.
How long does it take to 100% GTA 6? More than 200 hours, according to the GamesRadar+ estimate for finding every collectible and finishing every activity.
How many missions are in GTA 6? The main story has 91 missions across 5 chapters, according to PC Gamer's mission list.
How long is Chapter 1 in GTA 6? About 6 to 10 hours, according to MrDalekJD. It ends with the mission where you play as Lucia for the first time.
GTA 6's pause menu, with the Jason & Lucia, Map, Brief and Progress tabs, open on the Key Lento map.

t: What Happens When You Get Arrested in GTA 6: What You Lose and Keep
r: Getting busted in GTA 6 costs you your pocket cash and any guns you picked up, and your personal car gets impounded if you were in it. Banked money, your home stash and guns you bought are safe.

l: Get arrested in GTA 6 and you'll see the Busted screen, followed by the bill: your pocket cash is gone, any weapons you don't own are gone, and if you were in your personal car, it's headed to the impound lot. Money in the bank, cash in your home stash and guns you bought all survive.

1. Your pocket cash. MrDalekJD, MrBossFTW and KultZ all give the same warning: getting busted takes the cash you're carrying. MrBossFTW says you drop all of the loose money on you. Dan Allen Gaming's video shows it in action: right after the arrest, the HUD flashes -$244 and the wallet reads $0. PC Gamer describes the penalty as a few hundred dollars and notes you can carry at most $20,000 on your person anyway. Carry less, lose less.
2. Weapons you don't own. GamesRadar+ splits guns into owned and unowned. Anything you picked up from enemies or found in the world is unowned, and it's lost for good if you're Busted or Wasted.

3. Your loot bag. GamingBolt warns that getting busted or killed by the cops can cost you the bag from a heist. It isn't always gone: head back to the scene and look for a green bag icon. The cops may also have taken it.
4. Your personal car, if you were driving it. GamesRadar+ says getting Busted in your Personal Vehicle sends it to the impound lot. You have two ways to get it back:
Pay a hefty fee to the ScooterBros app to pull it out. That route may cost you any stash bags in the trunk.
Check the Personal tab of the index to see where it's being held and steal it back yourself. If the cops already took the bags out, check nearby police cars.
The bank. MrDalekJD and MrBossFTW both say money in your BuckMe account isn't touched when you're arrested. See bank accounts and ATMs.
Your home stash. PC Gamer reminds you that cash hidden under the bedroom floorboards in Key Lento is safe too. See losing money when you die.

Guns you paid for. Weapons bought at Ammu-Nation come back. MrDalekJD shows your full collection waiting in the weapons locker at any Ammu-Nation, and GamesRadar+ notes you can also grab them from your personal car's trunk. See storing weapons in your trunk.

Goods in your own trunk. PC Gamer says stolen goods stored in your car's trunk can be recovered even if the car is impounded. Just don't stash anything in a car you don't own, because losing the car means losing the load.

None of the guides or videos we read show a character serving a sentence. In Dan Allen Gaming's clip, the camera sweeps over the Keys after the Busted screen and Jason is back on his feet on the street, free, with an empty wallet. Exactly where the game drops you after an arrest isn't explained by any source we could read.
Two things are clear:
The game autosaves. GamesRadar+ says the hidden autosave slot kicks in when you're busted, when you die and after big open-world encounters.
The prologue arrest is scripted. In the Prologue mission, Lucia's two-star escape always ends in Busted because it's part of the story, as the GamesRadar+ walkthrough points out.

Talk your way out. Kotaku explains that a one-star wanted level can be cleared by talking to the cop: hold the left trigger to focus on them with no gun out and choose to defuse. The other option on that menu is to provoke them.
Tasers put you down. In Dan Allen Gaming's video, a taser hit drops Jason and the game shows a prompt to get up. The cops pinned him moments later.
Bank first. Hit an ATM or your stash before a robbery.
Escape properly. Change clothes, swap cars and get out of the search area. The full method is in how to lose the police.
What do you lose when you get arrested in GTA 6? Your pocket cash and any weapons you took from enemies or found lying around. If you were driving your personal vehicle, it gets impounded.
Do you lose your guns when you get busted in GTA 6? Only the ones you don't own. Guns you bought at Ammu-Nation come back and wait in the store's weapons locker or your personal car's trunk.
Is there jail time in GTA 6? None of the guides or videos we read show a character serving time. After the Busted screen you're back on the street with an empty wallet.

How do you get an impounded car back in GTA 6? Pay the ScooterBros app to pull it from the impound lot, or check the index to see where it's held and go get it yourself. Using the app can cost you any bags in the trunk.
The Busted screen appears after the cops pin Jason to the ground.

t: GTA 6 Age Rating: What It's Rated and Why
r: GTA 6 is rated M (Mature 17+) by the ESRB and PEGI 18 in Europe, for blood and gore, intense violence, drug use, strong sexual content, nudity and strong language.

l: GTA 6 is rated M for Mature 17+ by the ESRB in North America and PEGI 18 in Europe. Both boards flag the same core reasons: graphic violence, drug use, strong sexual content and harsh language. PlayStation's official page puts it plainly: the game is intended for adult players.
Board · Rating · Reasons listed
ESRB (US and Canada) · M (Mature 17+) · Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content, Use of Drugs and Alcohol; In-Game Purchases
PEGI (Europe) · 18 · Strong graphic violence, strong sexual themes and use of illegal drugs; in-game purchases
Ratings differ from country to country, and PlayStation recommends checking your local rating before you buy.
The ESRB's summary explains why it landed on M. In short:
missions are built around crime, like stealing cars, pulling heists and dealing drugs, using guns, explosives and melee weapons;
you can attack civilians and police, which raises your wanted level;
there's frequent blood, and some weapons can dismember;
sex scenes are implied and fade to black, and nudity appears in some situations;
characters can use drugs and alcohol, which distorts the screen and affects the controls;
there's crude humor and strong language, including racial slurs.

PEGI gave it an 18 for strong graphic violence, strong sexual themes and illegal drug use. Its write-up says violence is frequent, bloody and highly realistic, and that you can hurt anyone in the open world, from bystanders to cops. Drug use is described as frequent and prominent. It also mentions strong swearing and discriminatory language on the in-game TV shows and radio stations. Pets can be harmed, though without the same level of injury detail as people. In-game purchases are optional, and PEGI notes you can play without buying anything extra.

PlayStation's GTA 6 page warns that Grand Theft Auto games regularly feature profanity, violence, sexual themes and illegal acts, and are generally not recommended for children. PlayStation accounts can be age restricted through the PlayStation Family app. On Xbox, the free month of GTA+ that came with pre-orders can't be redeemed by child accounts with restrictions on age-restricted content, according to Xbox Wire.

GTA 6 is a single-player game, so there's no online lobby to worry about at launch: see does GTA 6 have online or 2 player. For what's in each edition, read Ultimate Edition bonuses, and learn how the game tracks your crimes in criminal profile explained.
What is GTA 6 rated? M for Mature 17+ by the ESRB in North America and PEGI 18 in Europe.
Why is GTA 6 rated M? The ESRB lists Blood and Gore, Intense Violence, Mature Humor, Nudity, Strong Language, Strong Sexual Content and Use of Drugs and Alcohol.
Does GTA 6 have in-game purchases? The ESRB and PEGI both flag in-game purchases. PEGI notes the game can be played without buying anything extra.
Can parents block GTA 6? Yes. PlayStation says accounts can be age restricted with the PlayStation Family app.
Jason and Lucia in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games.

t: GTA 6 Download Size: How Many GB on PS5 and Xbox
r: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB of free space, according to Rockstar, and PlayStation says to clear at least 212 GB on PS5. The boxed copy has no disc, only a download code.

l: GTA 6 needs up to 212 GB of free space. That's the figure on Rockstar's support page, which says the exact amount depends on your console. PlayStation's official game page tells PS5 owners to clear at least 212 GB before downloading.
PS5 and PS5 Pro: clear a minimum of 212 GB (PlayStation).

Xbox Series X · S: Rockstar's "up to 212 GB" covers Xbox too. We haven't found an exact Xbox figure on an official page, but Windows Central's Series X review called the game roughly a 200 GB package.
For scale, 212 GB is more than a quarter of a standard 825 GB PS5. On the Xbox Series S, which has less storage, it takes an even bigger slice.
Rockstar confirms that the physical version of GTA 6 only contains a download code. There's no disc inside. In practice:
you download the full game whether you buy digital or boxed;
the boxed version only exists for the Standard Edition, and Standard owners can upgrade to Ultimate later in the PlayStation or Microsoft store;
PS5 codes are tied to the region of your PlayStation account, while Xbox codes aren't region-locked.

Free up space first. On PS5, check what you have under Settings > Storage. To see the exact size the game needs, open it in your Game Library, go to "..." > View Product, and the required space shows on the right.

Let it download in Rest Mode. PlayStation recommends turning on Auto-Install in Rest Mode (Settings > Saved Data and Game/App Settings > Automatic Updates) and Stay Connected to the Internet (Settings > System > Power Saving > Features Available in Rest Mode).
Use a wired connection if you can. At 100 megabits per second, 212 GB takes roughly five hours in ideal conditions. Wi-Fi is usually slower.
Pre-loading opened on November 10 for anyone who pre-ordered digitally, so if you bought early, the game may already be on your console.

Not sure your console can run it at all? See where you can play GTA 6. If the download stalls, our crash and loading screen fixes cover it. Once it's installed, check the Ultimate Edition bonuses and our beginner tips.
How many GB is GTA 6? Rockstar says up to 212 GB of free space, depending on your console. PlayStation tells PS5 owners to clear at least 212 GB.
Does GTA 6 come on a disc? No. Rockstar says the boxed version only has a download code inside, so the whole game gets downloaded either way.
How big is GTA 6 on Xbox Series X|S? Rockstar's figure of up to 212 GB covers both consoles. Windows Central's Xbox reviewer described it as roughly a 200 GB package.
Where can I see the exact size on PS5? In your Game Library, select the game, open the ... menu and pick View Product. The required space shows on the right.
Ambrosia in an official GTA 6 image released by Rockstar Games.

t: GTA 6 FPS and Performance on PS5, PS5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S
r: GTA 6 runs at 30fps on every console, with no 60fps or performance mode. PS5 Pro holds it best with the sharpest image, while Xbox Series S often dips below 30.

l: GTA 6 runs at 30fps on every console: PS5, PS5 Pro, Xbox Series X and Xbox Series S. There's no 60fps mode and no 40fps mode either. What changes from one console to the next is how sharp the image looks and how well each one holds that 30.
The numbers here come from Digital Foundry's two tech reviews of the final game, one covering PS5 and PS5 Pro and the other covering Xbox Series X and Series S.
Console · Internal resolution · How well it holds 30fps
PS5 Pro · 1440p, rebuilt with PSSR · Nearly flawless; 24fps at worst during heavy explosions
PS5 · 1440p · Small dips throughout; sustained drops in heavy chaos
Xbox Series X · About 1440p · Stable most of the time; drops in chases and shootouts, around 20fps at worst
Xbox Series S · 720p · Often in the mid to upper 20s; around 20fps at worst
Xbox One (cloud) · Uses Series S settings · Depends on your connection

Rockstar's technology production director told Kotaku that the PS5 Pro's processor is only slightly better than the base PS5's and isn't powerful enough to run the game's simulation at higher frame rates. Kotaku asked about a 60fps or 40fps option arriving later, and Rockstar said it won't happen on current consoles. Digital Foundry calls GTA 6 a 30fps-only game on console, at least at launch.

p.h: PS5 Pro is the best way to play
l: PlayStation's official page lists two Pro upgrades: PSSR upscaling for extra clarity and ray-traced shadows. According to Digital Foundry, both PS5 models render at 1440p internally, but on Pro the PSSR output convincingly passes for 4K, while the base PS5 looks like a stretched 1440p image.
Digital Foundry's reviewer played more than 50 hours on Pro without spotting a single dip. He only got it to drop by filling a street with explosions, and even then it bottomed out at 24fps.

p.h: Xbox Series X and Series S
l: On Series X, the game holds 30fps the vast majority of the time. Drops show up when the processor gets hammered: fast chases, crashes, or gunfights in crowded intersections. The worst Digital Foundry logged was around 20fps. Windows Central, which reviewed on Series X, says it didn't notice dips even at top speed on the freeway.

Series S keeps nearly every visual feature from Series X, just at lower quality and a 720p internal resolution. The cost is performance: combat and fast driving keep it in the mid to upper 20s for long stretches. Kotaku's launch coverage quoted Digital Foundry calling it the loosest 30fps lock of the four consoles, and Digital Foundry suggests playing on another console for now.
There's no quality versus performance choice. These are the settings Digital Foundry flagged:
Motion blur: goes from 0 to 10, with 3 as the default. Maxed out, motion looks smoother; turned off, the image is clearer but choppier.
Camera sensitivity: the camera feels sluggish, and raising sensitivity helps a bit.
120Hz with VRR: on Series X, enabling this on your TV smooths over dropped frames. It helps less on Series S.
Locked: depth of field and the edge vignette can't be changed.

Wondering where else it runs? See where you can play GTA 6. If the game is closing on its own rather than dropping frames, try our crash and loading screen fixes. For everything else, start with our beginner tips and the hidden features the game doesn't explain.
Does GTA 6 run at 60fps? No. It runs at 30fps on every console, PS5 Pro included. Rockstar told Kotaku the consoles' processors can't run its simulation any faster.
What's the best console to play GTA 6 on? PS5 Pro. Digital Foundry found it holds 30fps almost perfectly and uses PSSR to build an image that passes for native 4K.
How does GTA 6 run on Xbox Series S? Worst of the four. Digital Foundry measured a 720p internal resolution and long stretches in the mid to upper 20s, dropping to about 20fps at worst.
Does GTA 6 have a performance mode? No. There's no quality or performance toggle. The game is capped at 30fps on all consoles, at least at launch.
A GTA 6 street scene from Digital Foundry's PS5 and PS5 Pro tech review.

t: GTA 6 Impound: How to Get Your Car Back
r: In GTA 6 you get a car out of impound by paying the Scooter Bros app or by going to the lot yourself. The map index shows where it is. Here's what can happen to the stuff in your trunk.

l: To get your car back from the impound in GTA 6, pay the Scooter Bros app on your phone to release it, or head to the impound lot and take it back yourself. This works for your personal vehicle, the one registered in your name. The map index tells you which lot it's sitting in.

p.h: Why the cops took your car
l: GamesRadar+ lists three ways your ride ends up in impound:
You ditched it to shake a Wanted Level. That clears your Vehicle Heat, but the cops will most likely tow it.
You got Wasted while driving it.
You got Busted while driving it.
More on shaking the cops in how to lose the police.
Personal vehicle: open the map index and scroll to the Personal tab. Your registered car is always marked there, and if it's impounded, that's where you see which lot is holding it.
Last car you used: GamesRadar+ says the last unowned vehicle you dropped is also marked under Personal, so you can find a stolen ride again.
Scooter Bros is an app on Jason's and Lucia's phones. It brings your car to you, repairs it and gets it out of the police impound. Kotaku and BennyCentral both walk through those three uses.
It's pricey. GamesRadar+ calls it a significant fee, and Kotaku says impound recovery isn't cheap. Neither gives an exact number.
Risk to your loot: going through Scooter Bros may cost you any stash bags hidden in the trunk, per GamesRadar+.
Premium: for $12,500 you get three free uses every in-game day. Kotaku and BennyCentral both recommend it once you can afford it, since it pays for itself over time.
GamesRadar+ suggests this route if you care about what was in the car:
Check the Personal tab in the index to see which lot has your car.
Go there and steal your own car back.
If the cops already pulled the loot out of your trunk, check the cop cars parked nearby. Your goods may be in one of them.

The game teaches you how to slip into an impound lot during the Chapter 1 mission Unwanted Attention: hop the fence, stay crouched and toss a bottle to distract the guard. The steps are in the Chapter 1 walkthrough. No source has tested that approach with your own car.
The sources don't fully agree:
PC Gamer says that even if the cops impound your car, you can recover the jewelry, drugs and marked bills from the trunk later and sell them.
GamesRadar+ warns that the stash bags may be lost if Scooter Bros does the recovery.
So it's worth selling your haul quickly at a fence. And don't stash goods in a car you don't own: PC Gamer warns you might lose them along with the car.

Per GamesRadar+, Scooter Bros recovers your personal vehicle when it's lost, impounded or destroyed, always for a fee. An unowned car that gets destroyed is gone for good, trunk and all. To register a car, drive it into a Pay 'n' Spray and pay the fee, which depends on the make and model. Cars with a standard or advanced tracker can only be registered once you're further into the story.
How do you get your car out of impound in GTA 6? Pay the Scooter Bros app to release it, or go to the impound lot and take it back yourself. The map index shows which lot it's in.
Where is my car in GTA 6? Open the map index and go to the Personal tab. Your registered vehicle is always marked there, even when it's been impounded.
How much is Scooter Bros Premium? $12,500. It gives you three free uses of the app every in-game day, according to Kotaku and BennyCentral.

Do you lose your trunk stash when your car is impounded? You might. GamesRadar+ warns that recovering the car through Scooter Bros can cost you the stash bags. Getting it from the lot yourself gives you a better shot.
The entrance to a Police Impound lot, with the chain-link gate and seized cars inside.

t: GTA 6 Index: How to Find Missions, Shops and Set a Destination
r: In GTA 6, the map index opens with Right on the D-pad and splits into 9 tabs, from Story to Food. Here's what each tab lists, how to set a destination and how Quick Navigation works.

l: GTA 6's map fills up with icons fast, and the easiest way to find what you want is the index. It sorts missions, robberies, shops and activities into tabs. The tab breakdown comes from GamesRadar+. Kotaku, BennyCentral and GamingBolt all use the same Quick Navigation shortcut, and BennyCentral and MrDalekJD explain what the map colors and the fog mean.
Open the map with the touchpad (PS5).
Press Right on the D-pad. The index bar shows up on the side of the screen.
Pick a tab and hover over each entry to read more about it.
Tab · Icon · What it lists
Personal · arrow · Your vehicles, residence, owned garages and ATMs for cash deposits
Story · diary · Story missions; the ones under "Optional" can be done any time
Robberies · cash sack · Discovered banks, vehicle drop-offs, stick-ups, gang hideouts and more
Activities · weights · Races, shooting ranges, golf, hunting, fishing, gyms and clubs
Exploration · magnifying glass · Points of interest, optional quests, neighbor favors, stunt jumps, base jumps and pawn shop collectors
Vehicles · car · Mod shops, Pay 'n' Spray, gas stations, transport hubs, ferries and your unlocked garages
Weapons · gun · Ammu-Nation stores, split into Everyday, Premium, Hunting and Pawn
Style · shirt · Clothing stores, tattoo parlors, hair and makeup for Jason and Lucia
Food · knife and fork · Bars, cafes, convenience stores, fast food and liquor stores
Anything you just discovered shows up in the index with an orange diamond.

Take a proper look at the Exploration tab. MrDalekJD points out that it lists favors your neighbors want, like a liquor run for Shirley next door, plus mini games and side jobs that hand out bonuses you might not know about.
From the map or index: hover over the task and press X. It becomes your active destination and the GPS shows the route.

Quick Navigation, no map needed: while roaming, hold Down on the D-pad. Time slows down and nearby points of interest appear (missions, gas stations, shops). Press R3 on a marker to set the route. Handy when you're low on fuel. BennyCentral and GamingBolt use the same shortcut, and NorZZa notes it also brings up the minimap and your stats for a moment.
Extra markers: you can only have one active destination. You can still drop as many markers as you like: with the map open, point at a spot and press Square.
The game never tells you, but BennyCentral worked out what the building colors on the map mean:
Dark blue: there's a way in somewhere. Sometimes it's only a garage or a small corridor.
Light blue: you can't go in.
To find the door, rotate the map and look around the building. Out in the world, the interact prompt pops up once you're close to a door that opens.

p.h: The map starts covered in fog
l: The first time you open the full map, most of it is hidden under fog. Each patch only shows up once you've walked, driven or flown through it. MrDalekJD says flying clears big chunks fastest. The more you reveal, the more shops and points of interest show up in the index.
KhrazeGaming also uses the taxi skip to reach spots he's never been to. Here's how in hidden features.
Between chapters, check the Robberies and Exploration tabs. That's where banks, gang hideouts and collectors show up, and they pay well. See also how to make money in GTA 6 and the beginner tips.
How do you open the index in GTA 6? Open the map (touchpad on PS5) and press Right on the D-pad. The index bar shows up on the side, split into tabs.
Where are my missions in GTA 6? In the index, open the Story tab (the diary icon). Story missions come first; the ones under Optional can be done any time.
Can you set more than one waypoint in GTA 6? Only one active destination at a time. You can still drop as many map markers as you like by pressing Square on a location.
What does the orange diamond mean in the GTA 6 index? It marks something you just discovered. Check the index now and then so you don't miss new stuff.
Quick Navigation: hold Down on the D-pad and the game shows what a nearby spot offers, here Brian's lockup.

t: GTA 6 Gym Bro Challenge: How to Win $1,000 From D-Bag
r: On Shore Drive, across from the Hotel Dixon, a gym bro named D-Bag bets $1,000 you can't choke him out. Take the bet and mash Circle as fast as you can. You only get one shot at the offer.

l: The GTA 6 gym bro is a street encounter worth $1,000 right at the start. His name is D-Bag, he trains on a grassy strip on Shore Drive across from the Hotel Dixon, and he bets you can't make him tap to a rear naked choke. MrBossFTW showed how it plays out.
Street: Shore Drive, basically across from the Hotel Dixon.
The spot: the grassy area between the beach and the road.
How to spot him: a buff guy shadowboxing.
MrBossFTW says you can do it very early in the game.
Talk to him. D-Bag brags about his neck and challenges you to choke him out: $1,000 if he taps.
Accept. He walks you through the hold and you lock it in.
Mash Circle (B on Xbox) as fast as you can.
Hold on long enough and he taps, then pays up.
MrBossFTW lost his first attempt because he underestimated how much mashing it takes. He came back and won the second time.
Sleep first. MrBossFTW went in with full energy and stamina after sleeping, which helped him last longer.
Don't decline. If you say no, he won't offer the bet again.

You can just fight him. He puts up a real fight, but knocked out he drops some cash and Zombix. If he dies, the $1,000 is on his body, though MrBossFTW says that's far more trouble than winning the bet.
More early cash in how to make money in GTA 6 and the parrot money robbery.
Where is the gym bro who gives $1,000 in GTA 6? On Shore Drive, basically across the street from the Hotel Dixon, on the grassy strip between the beach and the road. Look for a guy shadowboxing.
How do you beat D-Bag's choke challenge? Take the bet and mash Circle (B on Xbox) as fast as you can until he taps. Go in with full energy and stamina.
Can you retry the D-Bag challenge? If you turn the bet down, he won't offer it again. If you accept and lose, MrBossFTW was able to come back and try again.
The grassy strip on Shore Drive, between the beach and the street, where D-Bag trains.

t: Do You Lose Money When You Die in GTA 6? How to Keep Your Cash Safe
r: Yes: in GTA 6, if you die or get busted with cash in your pocket, you lose it. Money stashed at your safehouse or in your account stays safe. Carry only what you'll spend.

l: Yes, in GTA 6 you lose the cash you're carrying if you die or get busted. WiLLiSGaming, JoblessGarrett, DPJ, MrDalekJD, BennyCentral and KultZ all warn about it: get wasted or busted with money in your pocket and it's gone. The money you've stashed at your safehouse or put in your account isn't affected.

The stash at your safehouse. At the start, Jason keeps everything under the loose floorboards in his bedroom. Anything you put there is safe. KultZ points out that early on you don't have a bank account yet, so this is the only safe spot you've got.

BuckMe. Early in the story Lucia wants to open a bank account, but Jason has bad credit. The bank gives him the BuckMe app to build it up, and you have to put $5,000 in it for the story to move on. That's the "family savings".
According to WiLLiSGaming, the game itself tells you to keep any extra cash you're not going to spend in your stash, your bank account, an ATM or BuckMe.

There's no account in the first hours, but it doesn't take long. According to MrDalekJD, the bank unlocks through a chapter 1 story mission called Buck Me, so he recommends playing the story until you reach it. Once your account is open:
Deposits only work at an ATM. You have to walk up to one in person. There's no way to bank money from your phone, so you can't save your cash halfway through a shootout.
Your phone can find the closest ATM. Open the BuckMe app and scroll down: it shows you the nearest ATM, so you don't have to search the full map.

Money in the bank stays put. MrDalekJD says whatever is in your account isn't touched when you die or get busted. That's why he stops at an ATM before every mission, robbery or anything that might draw the police.
Step by step: GTA 6 bank account and ATMs.

It isn't only cash. MrDalekJD warns that if you die carrying loot bags, they're gone, along with all the work it took to fill them. After a score, skip the shortcuts through busy streets and don't start fights on the way. Stash it or take it to a fence first.

GamingBolt found that a lost bag isn't always gone for good. Go back to where it happened and look for a green bag icon: it may be the one you dropped. The police could also have grabbed it, and then it's up to you whether getting it back is worth the trouble.

Don't walk around with zero: you'll need cash for shops, repairs, fuel and taxis. DPJ's advice is to stash often but always keep a little on you. Take only what you'll spend on that trip. KultZ keeps just enough on him for the errands Lucia asks for in chapter 1 and hides the rest under the floor.
Before a dangerous mission or a robbery: stash your money first. WiLLiSGaming did Donnie's package runs and then hit a gang hideout with all his cash on him and had to fight about 30 enemies.
In the water: sharks attack. JoblessGarrett nearly died to one after making $3,200 diving.
With the cops on you: getting busted costs you the cash too.
According to WiLLiSGaming, your cash resets to zero when chapter 2 starts, no matter where it is. Only the BuckMe family savings carry over. See how to make money fast in GTA 6.
See also the beginner tips and how to lose the police.
Do you lose money when you die in GTA 6? Yes. The cash you're carrying is lost if you die or get busted. Money stashed at home or in your account stays safe.
How do you store money in GTA 6? Put it in the stash under the floorboards in Jason's bedroom. Later in chapter 1 you also get a bank account, and from then on you can deposit at any ATM.
Is there a bank in GTA 6? Yes, but not from the start. It unlocks in the chapter 1 story mission Buck Me, along with the BuckMe app. You can only deposit in person at an ATM, not from your phone.

Do you lose loot bags when you die in GTA 6? Yes, they go with you. GamingBolt says it's worth heading back to the spot and looking for a green bag icon, since it may be yours. The police might have taken it too.
The Leonida Keys, where Jason's first safehouse is, in an official image.

t: GTA 6 Weapons List: Confirmed Guns, Trailer Guns and Where to Get Them
r: PC Gamer's list of GTA 6 weapons with confirmed names, like the Klose K17 pistol and the Duke 556 rifle, plus the guns only seen in trailers. Here's where to grab your first ones.

l: PC Gamer's list of confirmed GTA 6 weapons has five handguns, one shotgun and one rifle, plus a hammer, a baseball bat, the Molotov cocktail and a grenade launcher. These are the guns whose names showed up in official videos, in Rockstar's own messaging or in the Ultimate Edition details.

Keep in mind the list was built before launch, from the trailers and the gameplay reveal, so the full game almost certainly has a lot more. One change from GTA 5 stands out: instead of generic names, nearly every gun now carries a parody manufacturer brand.
Weapon · Group · Based on
Klose K17 · Handgun · Glock 17
Morgan revolver · Handgun · Smith & Wesson 629
Girardi ES9 · Handgun · Beretta 92FS
Mustang .357 · Handgun · Colt Python
Nipper .38 · Handgun · P226 or Bersa Firestorm 380
Moreland 850 · Shotgun · Remington 870 Magnum
Duke 556 Assault Rifle · Rifle · M4 Carbine
Hammer · Melee ·
Baseball bat · Melee ·
Molotov cocktail · Throwable ·
Grenade launcher · Projectile ·
None of these had an official name when PC Gamer wrote the list. They were picked out from screenshots and footage:
Capo pistol: Jason holds one at the end of the liquor store robbery in the first trailer, and Raul Bautista carries one later. It looks like a Colt M1911.
MP5-style SMG: Jason and Lucia use it in the bank robbery from the second trailer. Jason's had a red dot sight, likely an upgrade you buy in the game.
Hunting rifles: a Duke-branded sniper rifle, a bolt action that resembles the Remington 700, and one that resembles the M1A, all carried by hunters out in the woods.
MAC-10-style SMG: Jason has one wearing the paint job from the Vintage Vice City pre-order pack.
Double-barreled shotgun: a hunter aims one at an alligator.
M249-style light machine gun: the owner of Phil's Ammu-Nation shows one off in the second trailer.
On the wall at Phil's Ammu-Nation: AK-47-style rifles, Uzi-style SMGs and a shotgun close to the Benelli M4.
PC Gamer also jokes about the stiletto heel Lucia uses to hit a man in the gameplay reveal, though it suspects that moment is a cutscene only.
PC Gamer's list doesn't say where to find each gun. Here's what we do know:
Ammu-Nation: the gun store appears in the second trailer, stocked with rifles and SMGs. To store and recover what you buy, see how to store weapons in your trunk.
Police cars: in a separate guide, PC Gamer shows cop car trunks holding assault rifles, shotguns and even body armor. The steps are in free guns from cop cars.
Early game: you can grab a rifle early at the early money warehouse, and a sniper rifle from the Skunk Ape mission.

Which weapons are confirmed in GTA 6? According to PC Gamer, the handguns Klose K17, Morgan revolver, Girardi ES9, Mustang .357 and Nipper .38, the Moreland 850 shotgun and the Duke 556 rifle. Add a hammer, baseball bat, Molotov and grenade launcher.
Where do you buy guns in GTA 6? At Ammu-Nation, the series' gun store, which shows up in the second trailer. You can also take rifles and shotguns for free from police car trunks.
Is there a double-barreled shotgun in GTA 6? It looks that way, though it has no official name yet. A hunter is seen aiming one at an alligator.
The Duke 556 rifle on the gun shop screen in the released game.

t: GTA 6 Cars List: Every Make, Model and Vehicle Type So Far
r: Every GTA 6 car and motorbike spotted so far, by make and model, from Jason's Vapid Ganado to the '95 Grotti Cheetah. The fastest cars in the game are still unknown.

l: GTA 6 has sedans, coupes, pickups, sports cars, motorbikes, dirt bikes and ATVs, and this page lists every model identified so far by make and name. It's based on PC Gamer's running list, which was put together largely by pausing Rockstar's trailers and official screenshots before launch. That means a lot of these names are educated guesses, and PC Gamer says outright that many makes and models are still unconfirmed.

p.h: Cars tied to the game and its editions
l: These have a confirmed name or show up in edition material:
Car · What we know
Vapid Ganado · Jason's ride. A two-door coupe based on the 1970 Ford Ranchero. The Ultimate Edition gives it a retro body kit
'95 Grotti Cheetah · Ferrari-style classic. Ultimate Edition only
'67 Vapid Dominator Buggy · Off-road take with huge tires. Looks like an Ultimate Edition extra
Sirius · Muscle car that resembles a classic Dodge Charger. Part of the Ultimate Edition's Classic Car Collection
Vapid Riata · Returning model with a retro paint job, also in the Classic Car Collection
Schyster Deviant · Wears a Deviant badge in the Classic Car Collection art, with a slightly different hood
Canis Kamacho · Long four-door pickup seen in a shot of One-Eyed Willie's shop. Unclear whether the truck or just the paint job is exclusive
'55 Vapid Stanier · The game's version of the 1955 Ford Crown Victoria. Comes with the Vintage Vice City pre-order pack
PC Gamer matched these from tail lights, grilles and window shapes. They're the outlet's IDs, not Rockstar's:
Albany Buccaneer Custom: sits very low, parked between the PMP and the Tulip M-100.
Benefactor Schafter V12: four-door luxury sedan.
Bravado Banshee: white with bright blue chrome, in the line of sports cars outside the Dominion Hotel in Trailer 2.
Bravado Gauntlet Hellfire: muscle car, half hidden by traffic in Trailer 1.
Declasse Tulip M-100: magenta, modeled on a late '70s to early '80s Chevy Malibu.
Grotti Carbonizzare, Grotti Cheetah Classic and Grotti Furia (the Furia is a supercar).
Invetero Coquette: PC Gamer admits this one is a shaky match.
Oceanic: yellow, a nod to the Oldsmobile Super 88.
Pfister Comet S2 Cabrio: two-door convertible.
Schyster PMP: green, with a more modern look than in GTA 4.
Vapid Caracara 4x4: a giant F-150-style pickup owned by Brian Heder, Jason's landlord.
Bike · What we know
Dinka Enduro · Off-road bike. An Ultimate Edition bonus
Alvino V1 · New to the series, based on the Ducati Panigale V2 and Aprilia RS 660. It's on the cover art
Nagasaki Carbon RS · Seen in red and white with what looks like a custom exhaust
Miabatsu Sanchez · The series' classic dirt bike, seen in Trailer 1
Miabatsu Manchez · Nearly identical to the Sanchez, minus the front mudflap

The trailers show motorboats, kayaks, jet skis, airboats, yachts and even cruise ships. In the sky there are helicopters, airliners, crop dusters and a blimp. If you want to fly, see where to find your first plane and helicopter.
Nobody has clocked GTA 6's fastest cars yet. PC Gamer checked the trailers for the fastest cars in GTA 5's story mode:
GTA 5 car · Seen in GTA 6?
Truffade Z-Type · No
Truffade Adder · No
Grotti Turismo R · No
Vapid Dominator · Yes, including a pink 1967 model
Grotti Cheetah · Yes, in both trailers
Bravado Banshee · Yes, in Trailer 2. No word on the faster GTS version
Cars: Vapid, Grotti, Bravado, Declasse, Albany, Benefactor, Invetero, Pfister, Schyster and Canis. Bikes: Dinka, Nagasaki, Miabatsu and Alvino.
Once you find a car you like, check the garage locations and prices to keep it, or read how to steal cars to grab one off the street.
What is Jason's car in GTA 6? The Vapid Ganado, a two-door coupe based on the 1970 Ford Ranchero. The Ultimate Edition adds a retro body kit for it.
What is the fastest car in GTA 6? Nobody knows yet. PC Gamer only spotted three of GTA 5's fastest cars in the trailers: the Vapid Dominator, Grotti Cheetah and Bravado Banshee.
Are there motorbikes in GTA 6? Yes. The Alvino V1, Nagasaki Carbon RS, Dinka Enduro and the Sanchez and Manchez dirt bikes have all been spotted, and there are ATVs too.
